verses.name: Psalms 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1"/><div sID="gen3" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 1</title> <lg sID="gen4"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1"/> Happy are those<l eID="gen5" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6"/>who do not follow the counsel of the wicked,<l eID="gen6" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7"/>not halting in ways frequented by sinners,<l eID="gen7" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen8"/>nor taking a seat in a gathering of scoffers.<l eID="gen8" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:2
verses.text: But the law of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is their joy,<l eID="gen9" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen10"/>they study it day and night.<l eID="gen10" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:3
verses.text: They are like trees<l eID="gen11" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen12"/>planted by runlets of water,<l eID="gen12" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen13"/>yielding fruit in due season,<l eID="gen13" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen14"/>leaves never fading.<l eID="gen14" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15"/>In all that they do, they prosper.<l eID="gen15" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen16"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:4
verses.text: Not so fare the wicked, not so;<l eID="gen17" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen18"/>like chaff are they, blown by the wind.<l eID="gen18" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:5
verses.text: So the wicked will not stand firm in the judgment,<l eID="gen19" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen20"/>nor sinners appear, when the righteous are gathered.<l eID="gen20" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:6
verses.text: For the way of the righteous is dear to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen21" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen22"/>but the way of the wicked will end in ruin.<l eID="gen22" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen16"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.1"/> <div eID="gen3" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2"/><div sID="gen23" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 2</title> <lg sID="gen24"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2"/> Why this turmoil of nations,<l eID="gen25" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen26"/>this futile plotting of peoples,<l eID="gen26" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:2
verses.text: with kings of the earth conspiring,<l eID="gen27" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen28"/>and rulers consulting together,<l eID="gen28" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen29"/>against the <divineName>Lord</divineName> and against his anointed,<l eID="gen29" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:3
verses.text: to snap their bonds<l eID="gen30" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen31"/>and fling their cords away?<l eID="gen31" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen24"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen32"/> <l level="1" sID="gen33"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:4
verses.text: He whose throne is in heaven laughs,<l eID="gen33" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen34"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> mocks them.<l eID="gen34" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen35"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:5
verses.text: Then he speaks to them in his wrath,<l eID="gen35" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen36"/>and in his hot anger confounds them.<l eID="gen36" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen37"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:6
verses.text: “This my king is installed by me,<l eID="gen37" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen38"/>on Zion my holy mountain.”<l eID="gen38" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen32"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen39"/> <l level="1" sID="gen40"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:7
verses.text: I will tell of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s decree.<l eID="gen40" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen41"/>He said to me: “You are my son,<l eID="gen41" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen42"/>this day I became your father.<l eID="gen42" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen43"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:8
verses.text: Only ask, and I make you the heir of the nations,<l eID="gen43" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen44"/>and lord of the world to its utmost bounds.<l eID="gen44" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen45"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:9
verses.text: You will break them with sceptre of iron,<l eID="gen45" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen46"/>shatter them like pottery.”<l eID="gen46" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen39"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen47"/> <l level="1" sID="gen48"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:10
verses.text: So now, you kings, be wise:<l eID="gen48" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen49"/>be warned, you rulers of earth.<l eID="gen49" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen50"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:11
verses.text: Serve the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in awe,<l eID="gen50" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen51"/>kiss his feet with trembling,<l eID="gen51" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen52"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:12
verses.text: lest, angry, he hurl you to ruin;<l eID="gen52" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen53"/>for soon will his fury blaze.<l eID="gen53" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen54"/>Happy all who take refuge in him.<l eID="gen54" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen47"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.2"/> <div eID="gen23" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3"/><div sID="gen55" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 3</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.</title> <lg sID="gen56"/> <l level="1" sID="gen57"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3"/> How many, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are my foes!<l eID="gen57" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen58"/>Those who rise up against me are many.<l eID="gen58" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen59"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:2
verses.text: Many are those who say of me,<l eID="gen59" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen60"/>“There is no help for him in his God.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen60" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen56"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen61"/> <l level="1" sID="gen62"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:3
verses.text: But you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are shield about me,<l eID="gen62" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen63"/>my glory, who lifts up my head.<l eID="gen63" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen64"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:4
verses.text: When loudly I call to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen64" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen65"/>from his holy hill he gives answer. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen65" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen61"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen66"/> <l level="1" sID="gen67"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:5
verses.text: I laid down and slept:<l eID="gen67" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen68"/>now I wake, for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> sustains me.<l eID="gen68" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen69"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:6
verses.text: I fear not the myriads of people<l eID="gen69" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen70"/>who beset me on every side.<l eID="gen70" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen66"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen71"/> <l level="1" sID="gen72"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:7
verses.text: Arise, <divineName>Lord</divineName>: save me, my God,<l eID="gen72" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen73"/>who strikes all my foes on the cheek,<l eID="gen73" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen74"/>and shatters the teeth of the wicked.<l eID="gen74" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen75"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:8
verses.text: Victory belongs to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen75" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen76"/>let your blessing descend on your people. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen76" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen71"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.3"/> <div eID="gen55" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4"/><div sID="gen77" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 4</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader, with stringed instruments. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen78"/> <l level="1" sID="gen79"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4"/> Answer my cry,<l eID="gen79" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen80"/>God, my defender.<l eID="gen80" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen81"/>Often from straits you have brought me<l eID="gen81" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen82"/>to spacious places.<l eID="gen82" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen83"/>So now show me your favour<l eID="gen83" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen84"/>and hear my prayer.<l eID="gen84" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen78"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen85"/> <l level="1" sID="gen86"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:2
verses.text: How long, you proud people,<l eID="gen86" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen87"/>will my honour be stained<l eID="gen87" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen88"/>by the slanders you love,<l eID="gen88" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen89"/>and the lies that you follow? <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen89" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen90"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:3
verses.text: See! The <divineName>Lord</divineName> has shown me<l eID="gen90" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen91"/>his wonderful kindness:<l eID="gen91" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen92"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> hears,<l eID="gen92" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen93"/>when I call to him.<l eID="gen93" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen85"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen94"/> <l level="1" sID="gen95"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:4
verses.text: Sin not in your anger:<l eID="gen95" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen96"/>but speak in your heart<l eID="gen96" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen97"/>on your bed, and be still. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen97" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen98"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:5
verses.text: Offer true sacrifice,<l eID="gen98" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen99"/>trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen99" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen94"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen100"/> <l level="1" sID="gen101"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:6
verses.text: Many are longing<l eID="gen101" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen102"/>for fortune to smile.<l eID="gen102" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen103"/>Lift upon us<l eID="gen103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen104"/>the light of your face.<l eID="gen104" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen105"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:7
verses.text: You have put in my heart, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen106"/>a deeper joy<l eID="gen106" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen107"/>than was theirs who had corn<l eID="gen107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen108"/>and wine in abundance.<l eID="gen108" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen100"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen109"/> <l level="1" sID="gen110"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:8
verses.text: So in peace I will<l eID="gen110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen111"/>lie down and sleep;<l eID="gen111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen112"/>for you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, keep me<l eID="gen112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen113"/>safe.<l eID="gen113" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen109"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.4"/> <div eID="gen77" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5"/><div sID="gen114" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 5</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader: A psalm of David, to be accompanied by the flute.</title> <lg sID="gen115"/> <l level="1" sID="gen116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5"/> Hear my words, <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen117"/>give heed to my whisper.<l eID="gen117" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:2
verses.text: Attend to my loud cry for help,<l eID="gen118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen119"/>my king and my God.<l eID="gen119" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen120"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:3
verses.text: When I pray to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in the morning,<l eID="gen120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen121"/>hear my voice.<l eID="gen121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen122"/>I make ready for you in the morning,<l eID="gen122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen123"/>and look for a sign.<l eID="gen123" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen115"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen124"/> <l level="1" sID="gen125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:4
verses.text: For you are no God who takes pleasure in wickedness:<l eID="gen125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen126"/>no one of evil can be your guest.<l eID="gen126" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen127"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:5
verses.text: No braggarts can stand in your presence,<l eID="gen127" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen128"/>you hate all workers of wrong.<l eID="gen128" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:6
verses.text: You destroy all speakers of lies,<l eID="gen129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen130"/>people of blood and deceit you abhor.<l eID="gen130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:7
verses.text: But I, through your kindness abundant,<l eID="gen131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen132"/>may enter your house,<l eID="gen132" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen133"/>and towards the shrine of your temple<l eID="gen133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen134"/>may reverently bow.<l eID="gen134" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen124"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen135"/> <l level="1" sID="gen136"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:8
verses.text: Lead me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in your righteousness<l eID="gen136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen137"/>because of my enemies.<l eID="gen137" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen138"/>Make your way level before me.<l eID="gen138" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:9
verses.text: For their mouth is a stranger to truth,<l eID="gen139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen140"/>their heart is a pit of destruction.<l eID="gen140" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen141"/>Their throat is a wide open grave,<l eID="gen141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen142"/>their tongue the smooth tongue of the hypocrite.<l eID="gen142" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen135"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen143"/> <l level="1" sID="gen144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:10
verses.text: Condemn them, God;<l eID="gen144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen145"/>let their schemes bring them down to the ground.<l eID="gen145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen146"/>For their numberless crimes thrust them down<l eID="gen146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen147"/>for playing the rebel against you.<l eID="gen147" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen148"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:11
verses.text: But let all who take refuge in you<l eID="gen148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen149"/>ring out their gladness forever.<l eID="gen149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen150"/>Protect those who love your name,<l eID="gen150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen151"/>so they may exult in you.<l eID="gen151" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen152"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:12
verses.text: For you give your blessing, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to the godly,<l eID="gen152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen153"/>and the shield of your favour protects them.<l eID="gen153" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen143"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.5"/> <div eID="gen114" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6"/><div sID="gen154" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 6</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; with instrumental music on the sheminith. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen155"/> <l level="1" sID="gen156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6"/> Rebuke me not, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in your anger,<l eID="gen156" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen157"/>punish me not in your wrath.<l eID="gen157" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen158"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:2
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, be gracious to me<l eID="gen158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen159"/>in my weakness.<l eID="gen159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen160"/>Heal me <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen161"/>for racked is my body;<l eID="gen161" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen162"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:3
verses.text: all of me utterly racked.<l eID="gen162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen163"/>Why do you wait so long, <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen163" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen155"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen164"/> <l level="1" sID="gen165"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:4
verses.text: Turn, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, rescue me;<l eID="gen165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen166"/>save me, because of your love.<l eID="gen166" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen167"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:5
verses.text: For in death none can call you to mind;<l eID="gen167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen168"/>in Sheol who can praise you?<l eID="gen168" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen164"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen169"/> <l level="1" sID="gen170"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:6
verses.text: I am so weary of sighing.<l eID="gen170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen171"/>All the night I make my bed swim,<l eID="gen171" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen172"/>and wet my couch with my tears.<l eID="gen172" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen173"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:7
verses.text: My eyes swollen with grief;<l eID="gen173" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen174"/>from weeping caused by my foes.<l eID="gen174" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen169"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen175"/> <l level="1" sID="gen176"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:8
verses.text: Begone, workers of wrong,<l eID="gen176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen177"/>for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has heard my loud weeping,<l eID="gen177" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen178"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:9
verses.text: the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has heard my entreaty,<l eID="gen178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen179"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> accepts my prayer.<l eID="gen179" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen180"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:10
verses.text: My foes will be stricken with terror,<l eID="gen180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen181"/>brought to shame and dismay in a moment.<l eID="gen181" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen175"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.6"/> <div eID="gen154" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7"/><div sID="gen182" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 7</title> <title type="psalm">A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> about Cush, the Benjamite.</title> <lg sID="gen183"/> <l level="1" sID="gen184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7"/> <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God, I take refuge in you.<l eID="gen184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen185"/>Deliver me, save me from all who pursue me;<l eID="gen185" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen186"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:2
verses.text: or like lions they will tear me to pieces,<l eID="gen186" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen187"/>and rend me, past hope of rescue.<l eID="gen187" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen183"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen188"/> <l level="1" sID="gen189"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:3
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my God, if my life has been such<l eID="gen189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen190"/>if my hands have been stained with guilt,<l eID="gen190" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen191"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:4
verses.text: if friends I paid back with evil,<l eID="gen191" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen192"/>if I plundered my foes without cause,<l eID="gen192" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen193"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:5
verses.text: may the enemy chase and find me,<l eID="gen193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen194"/>trample my life to the ground,<l eID="gen194" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen195"/>my honour leave in the dirt! <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen195" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen188"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen196"/> <l level="1" sID="gen197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:6
verses.text: Arise, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in anger,<l eID="gen197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen198"/>against my foes rise in fury.<l eID="gen198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen199"/>Awake for my help:<l eID="gen199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen200"/>let justice be done.<l eID="gen200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:7
verses.text: Gather the nations about you,<l eID="gen201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen202"/>and sit on your lofty throne,<l eID="gen202" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen203"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:8
verses.text: as the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the judge of the peoples.<l eID="gen203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen204"/>Judge me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in my innocence<l eID="gen204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen205"/>and according to my integrity.<l eID="gen205" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen196"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen206"/> <l level="1" sID="gen207"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:9
verses.text: Put an end to the wrong of the wicked,<l eID="gen207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen208"/>protect the righteous.<l eID="gen208" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen209"/>Searcher of hearts and minds,<l eID="gen209" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen210"/>righteous God.<l eID="gen210" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen211"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:10
verses.text: God is my shield:<l eID="gen211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen212"/>he saves the upright in heart.<l eID="gen212" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen206"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen213"/> <l level="1" sID="gen214"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:11
verses.text: God is a just judge,<l eID="gen214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen215"/>constant in righteous anger.<l eID="gen215" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen216"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:12
verses.text: He will sharpen his sword without fail,<l eID="gen216" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen217"/>his bow is bent and ready,<l eID="gen217" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen218"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:13
verses.text: his deadly weapons are ready,<l eID="gen218" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen219"/>his arrows he makes of flame.<l eID="gen219" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen213"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen220"/> <l level="1" sID="gen221"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:14
verses.text: The enemy who conceives evil;<l eID="gen221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen222"/>pregnant with mischief,<l eID="gen222" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen223"/>giving birth to lies,<l eID="gen223" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen224"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:15
verses.text: a pit they have made and dug;<l eID="gen224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen225"/>but into the hole that they made they will fall.<l eID="gen225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen226"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:16
verses.text: On their own heads their mischief comes back;<l eID="gen226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen227"/>on their own skulls their violence comes down.<l eID="gen227" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen228"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:17
verses.text: I will give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his justice,<l eID="gen228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen229"/>and sing to the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> Most High.<l eID="gen229" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen220"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.7"/> <div eID="gen182" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8"/><div sID="gen230" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 8</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader: A psalm of David, to be accompanied by a stringed instrument.</title> <lg sID="gen231"/> <l level="1" sID="gen232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8"/> <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God!<l eID="gen232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen233"/>How glorious in all the earth is your name!<l eID="gen233" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen234"/>Your praise reaches as high as the heavens,<l eID="gen234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen235"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:2
verses.text: from the mouths of children and infants.<l eID="gen235" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen231"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen236"/> <l level="1" sID="gen237"/>You have built a fortress<l eID="gen237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen238"/>against your enemies,<l eID="gen238" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen239"/>to silence the foe and the rebel.<l eID="gen239" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen236"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen240"/> <l level="1" sID="gen241"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:3
verses.text: When I look at your heavens,<l eID="gen241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen242"/>the work of your fingers,<l eID="gen242" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen243"/>the moon and the stars,<l eID="gen243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen244"/>which you have set there,<l eID="gen244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen245"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:4
verses.text: what are mortals,<l eID="gen245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen246"/>that you think of them,<l eID="gen246" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen247"/>humans,<l eID="gen247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen248"/>that you visit them?<l eID="gen248" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen240"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen250"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:5
verses.text: Yet you made them little less than divine,<l eID="gen250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen251"/>crowned them with glory and majesty,<l eID="gen251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen252"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:6
verses.text: made them lord of the works of your hands,<l eID="gen252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen253"/>put all things under their feet ---<l eID="gen253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen254"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:7
verses.text: sheep and oxen,<l eID="gen254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen255"/>all of them;<l eID="gen255" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen256"/>and the wild beasts also:<l eID="gen256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen257"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:8
verses.text: birds of the air,<l eID="gen257" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen258"/>and fish of the sea,<l eID="gen258" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen259"/>and all that crosses the paths of the ocean.<l eID="gen259" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen249"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen260"/> <l level="1" sID="gen261"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:9
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God!<l eID="gen261" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen262"/>How glorious in all the earth is your name!<l eID="gen262" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen260"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.8"/> <div eID="gen230" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9"/><div sID="gen263" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 9</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; ‘almuth labben. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen264"/> <l level="1" sID="gen265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9"/> With all my heart I will praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen266"/>all your wonders I will rehearse.<l eID="gen266" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen267"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:2
verses.text: I will rejoice and exult in you,<l eID="gen267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen268"/>singing praise to your name, Most High;<l eID="gen268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen269"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:3
verses.text: because backward my foes were turned,<l eID="gen269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen270"/>they stumbled and perished before you.<l eID="gen270" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen264"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen271"/> <l level="1" sID="gen272"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:4
verses.text: My right and my claim you have upheld,<l eID="gen272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen273"/>you did sit on the throne as a fair judge,<l eID="gen273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen274"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:5
verses.text: rebuking the nations, destroying the wicked,<l eID="gen274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen275"/>and blotting their name out forever and ever.<l eID="gen275" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen276"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:6
verses.text: The foe is vanished, ruined forever,<l eID="gen276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen277"/>their cities destroyed, their memory perished.<l eID="gen277" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen271"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen278"/> <l level="1" sID="gen279"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:7
verses.text: See! The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is seated forever<l eID="gen279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen280"/>on the throne he established for judgment,<l eID="gen280" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen281"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:8
verses.text: ruling the world with justice,<l eID="gen281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen282"/>and judging the nations with equity.<l eID="gen282" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen278"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen283"/> <l level="1" sID="gen284"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:9
verses.text: So the <divineName>Lord</divineName> proves a haven to the oppressed,<l eID="gen284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen285"/>a haven in times of trouble.<l eID="gen285" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen286"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:10
verses.text: Well may they trust you who know your name,<l eID="gen286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen287"/>for those who seek you, you never abandon.<l eID="gen287" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen283"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen288"/> <l level="1" sID="gen289"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:11
verses.text: Sing praise to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, whose home is in Zion,<l eID="gen289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen290"/>declare his deeds among the nations.<l eID="gen290" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen291"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:12
verses.text: As avenger of blood, he keeps them in mind,<l eID="gen291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen292"/>he does not forget the cry of the wretched.<l eID="gen292" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen288"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen293"/> <l level="1" sID="gen294"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:13
verses.text: Show me favour, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen295"/>see how my foes afflict me,<l eID="gen295" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen296"/>lift me up from the gates of death;<l eID="gen296" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen297"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:14
verses.text: so I may, in your help exulting,<l eID="gen297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen298"/>tell forth your praise at the gates of Zion.<l eID="gen298" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen293"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen299"/> <l level="1" sID="gen300"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:15
verses.text: The nations are sunk in the pit which they made,<l eID="gen300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen301"/>in the net that they hid, their own foot is entangled.<l eID="gen301" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen302"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:16
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is revealed in the judgment he wrought,<l eID="gen302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen303"/>the wicked are snared in their own handiwork. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen303" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen299"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen304"/> <l level="1" sID="gen305"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:17
verses.text: Let the wicked depart to Sheol,<l eID="gen305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen306"/>all the nations that live forgetful of God.<l eID="gen306" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen307"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:18
verses.text: For the needy will not be always forgotten,<l eID="gen307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen308"/>nor the hope of the helpless be lost forever.<l eID="gen308" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen304"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen309"/> <l level="1" sID="gen310"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:19
verses.text: Arise, <divineName>Lord</divineName>; don’t let them triumph:<l eID="gen310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen311"/>before your face let the nations be judged.<l eID="gen311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen312"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:20
verses.text: Strike them with fear, <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen313"/>show the nations how frail they are. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen313" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen309"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.9"/> <div eID="gen263" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10"/><div sID="gen314" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 10</title> <lg sID="gen315"/> <l level="1" sID="gen316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10"/> Why do you stand, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, so far away,<l eID="gen316" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen317"/>hiding yourself in times of trouble?<l eID="gen317" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen318"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:2
verses.text: The wicked, in their pride, are pursuing the helpless:<l eID="gen318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen319"/>let them be caught in the schemes they have plotted.<l eID="gen319" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen315"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen320"/> <l level="1" sID="gen321"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:3
verses.text: For the wicked boast of their wanton greed;<l eID="gen321" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen322"/>the robber despises the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and curses him,<l eID="gen322" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen323"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:4
verses.text: in wicked pride, thinks:<l eID="gen323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen324"/>God doesn’t care,<l eID="gen324" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen325"/>God doesn’t call to account.<l eID="gen325" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen320"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen326"/> <l level="1" sID="gen327"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:5
verses.text: Never a season that they do not prosper;<l eID="gen327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen328"/>your judgments are far above out of their sight:<l eID="gen328" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen329"/>they scoff at their foes.<l eID="gen329" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen326"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen330"/> <l level="1" sID="gen331"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:6
verses.text: Each says in their heart,<l eID="gen331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen332"/>“I will never be shaken;<l eID="gen332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen333"/>I will live for all time<l eID="gen333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen334"/>untouched by misfortune.”<l eID="gen334" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen335"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:7
verses.text: Their mouths are full of deceit and oppression:<l eID="gen335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen336"/>under their tongues lurks mischief and wrong.<l eID="gen336" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen330"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen337"/> <l level="1" sID="gen338"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:8
verses.text: Lying in secret in some village ambush,<l eID="gen338" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen339"/>and stealthily watching, they murder the innocent.<l eID="gen339" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen340"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:9
verses.text: Like a lion lurks in a secret lair<l eID="gen340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen341"/>they lurk intending to catch the defenceless;<l eID="gen341" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen342"/>to seize them, to drag them away in their net.<l eID="gen342" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen337"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen343"/> <l level="1" sID="gen344"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:10
verses.text: Their victims are crushed, sink down to the ground.<l eID="gen344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen345"/>Under claws the hapless fall.<l eID="gen345" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen346"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:11
verses.text: In their hearts the wicked say<l eID="gen346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen347"/>that God has forgotten,<l eID="gen347" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen348"/>has hidden his face,<l eID="gen348" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen349"/>will see nothing.<l eID="gen349" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen343"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen350"/> <l level="1" sID="gen351"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:12
verses.text: Arise, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, lift up your hand,<l eID="gen351" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen352"/>do not forget the cry of the wretched.<l eID="gen352" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen353"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:13
verses.text: Why do the wicked treat God with contempt,<l eID="gen353" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen354"/>and say in their hearts, “God doesn’t care”?<l eID="gen354" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen350"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen355"/> <l level="1" sID="gen356"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:14
verses.text: You have seen the trouble and sorrow;<l eID="gen356" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen357"/>you mark it all, and will take it in hand.<l eID="gen357" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen358"/>The hapless can count on you,<l eID="gen358" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen359"/>helper of orphans.<l eID="gen359" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen355"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen360"/> <l level="1" sID="gen361"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:15
verses.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evil:<l eID="gen361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen362"/>search out their sin, till no more be found.<l eID="gen362" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen363"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:16
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is king forever and ever:<l eID="gen363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen364"/>the nations will vanish from his land.<l eID="gen364" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen360"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen365"/> <l level="1" sID="gen366"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:17
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you have heard the desire of the humble,<l eID="gen366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen367"/>inclining your ear, strengthening their hearts,<l eID="gen367" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen368"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:18
verses.text: rights you have won for the crushed and the orphan,<l eID="gen368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen369"/>so no one on earth may strike terror again.<l eID="gen369" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen365"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.10"/> <div eID="gen314" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11"/><div sID="gen370" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 11</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen371"/> <l level="1" sID="gen372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11"/> In the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I take refuge.<l eID="gen372" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen373"/>How can you tell me<l eID="gen373" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen374"/>to flee like a bird to the mountains?<l eID="gen374" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen371"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen375"/> <l level="1" sID="gen376"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:2
verses.text: “See! The wicked are bending the bow,<l eID="gen376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen377"/>their arrow is set on the string,<l eID="gen377" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen378"/>to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.<l eID="gen378" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen379"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:3
verses.text: In this tearing down of foundations<l eID="gen379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen380"/>what good can a good person do?”<l eID="gen380" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen375"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen381"/> <l level="1" sID="gen382"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:4
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> in his holy temple,<l eID="gen382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen383"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in heaven, enthroned.<l eID="gen383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen384"/>His eyes watch the world,<l eID="gen384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen385"/>they see everyone.<l eID="gen385" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen386"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:5
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> examines the righteous and wicked,<l eID="gen386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen387"/>and the lover of violence he hates.<l eID="gen387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen388"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:6
verses.text: On the wicked he rains coals of fire and brimstone,<l eID="gen388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen389"/>and their drink will be scorching wind.<l eID="gen389" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen390"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:7
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is just, and justice he loves;<l eID="gen390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen391"/>so the upright will see his face.<l eID="gen391" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen381"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.11"/> <div eID="gen370" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12"/><div sID="gen392" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 12</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; on the sheminith. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12"/> Help, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for the good are all gone,<l eID="gen394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen395"/>faithful people have vanished.<l eID="gen395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen396"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:2
verses.text: One lies to another, speaking empty lies,<l eID="gen396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen397"/>with flattering lips and false hearts they speak.<l eID="gen397" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen393"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen398"/> <l level="1" sID="gen399"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:3
verses.text: May the <divineName>Lord</divineName> cut off all the flattering lips,<l eID="gen399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen400"/>and the tongue that utters arrogance,<l eID="gen400" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen401"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:4
verses.text: they declare, “Our tongue is our strength,<l eID="gen401" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen402"/>our allies our lips: who is lord over us?”<l eID="gen402" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen398"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen403"/> <l level="1" sID="gen404"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:5
verses.text: “The poor are despoiled, and the needy are sighing;<l eID="gen404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen405"/>so now I will act,” the <divineName>Lord</divineName> declares<l eID="gen405" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen406"/>“And place them in the safety they long for.”<l eID="gen406" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen403"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen407"/> <l level="1" sID="gen408"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:6
verses.text: The words of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> are words that are pure,<l eID="gen408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen409"/>silver smelted, seven times refined.<l eID="gen409" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:7
verses.text: You will keep us, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen411"/>and guard us from this generation forever,<l eID="gen411" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen412"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:8
verses.text: in a world where the wicked prowl,<l eID="gen412" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen413"/>and worthless people exalted.<l eID="gen413" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen407"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.12"/> <div eID="gen392" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv13"/><div sID="gen414" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 13</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen415"/> <l level="1" sID="gen416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv13"/> How long, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, will you forget me forever?<l eID="gen416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen417"/>How long will you hide your face from me?<l eID="gen417" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen418"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:2
verses.text: How long must I nurse grief inside me,<l eID="gen418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen419"/>and in my heart a daily sorrow?<l eID="gen419" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen420"/>How long are my foes to exult over me?<l eID="gen420" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen415"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen421"/> <l level="1" sID="gen422"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:3
verses.text: Look at me, answer me, <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God.<l eID="gen422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen423"/>Fill my eyes with your light,<l eID="gen423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen424"/>lest I sleep in death,<l eID="gen424" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen425"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:4
verses.text: lest my enemies claim to have triumphed,<l eID="gen425" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen426"/>lest my foes rejoice at my downfall.<l eID="gen426" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen421"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen427"/> <l level="1" sID="gen428"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:5
verses.text: But I trust in your kindness:<l eID="gen428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen429"/>my heart will rejoice in your help.<l eID="gen429" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen430"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:6
verses.text: I will sing to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> who was good to me.<l eID="gen430" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen427"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.13"/> <div eID="gen414" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv14"/><div sID="gen431" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 14</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David</title> <lg sID="gen432"/> <l level="1" sID="gen433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv14"/> Fools say in their heart,<l eID="gen433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen434"/>“There is no God.”<l eID="gen434" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen435"/>Vile, hateful their life is;<l eID="gen435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen436"/>not one does good.<l eID="gen436" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen432"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen437"/> <l level="1" sID="gen438"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:2
verses.text: From heaven the <divineName>Lord</divineName> looks out<l eID="gen438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen439"/>on humans, to see<l eID="gen439" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen440"/>if any are wise,<l eID="gen440" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen441"/>and care for God.<l eID="gen441" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen437"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen442"/> <l level="1" sID="gen443"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:3
verses.text: But all have turned bad,<l eID="gen443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen444"/>the taint is on all;<l eID="gen444" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen445"/>not one does good,<l eID="gen445" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen446"/>no, not one.<l eID="gen446" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen442"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen447"/> <l level="1" sID="gen448"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:4
verses.text: Have they learned their lesson,<l eID="gen448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen449"/>those workers of evil?<l eID="gen449" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen450"/>Who ate up my people,<l eID="gen450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen451"/>eating, devouring,<l eID="gen451" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen452"/>never calling to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen452" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen447"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen453"/> <l level="1" sID="gen454"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:5
verses.text: Sore afraid will they be;<l eID="gen454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen455"/>for God is among<l eID="gen455" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen456"/>those who are righteous,<l eID="gen456" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen457"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:6
verses.text: you may mock the plans of the poor,<l eID="gen457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen458"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is their refuge.<l eID="gen458" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen453"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen459"/> <l level="1" sID="gen460"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:7
verses.text: If only help from Zion<l eID="gen460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen461"/>would come for Israel!<l eID="gen461" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen462"/>When the <divineName>Lord</divineName> brings his people<l eID="gen462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen463"/>a change of fortune,<l eID="gen463" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen464"/>how glad will be Jacob,<l eID="gen464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen465"/>and Israel how joyful!<l eID="gen465" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen459"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.14"/> <div eID="gen431" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv15"/><div sID="gen466" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 15</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David</title> <lg sID="gen467"/> <l level="1" sID="gen468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv15"/> <divineName>Lord</divineName>, who can be guest in your tent?<l eID="gen468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen469"/>Who may live on your holy mountain?<l eID="gen469" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen467"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen470"/> <l level="1" sID="gen471"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:2
verses.text: The person whose walk is blameless,<l eID="gen471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen472"/>whose conduct is right,<l eID="gen472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen473"/>whose words are true and sincere;<l eID="gen473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen474"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:3
verses.text: on whose tongue there sits no slander,<l eID="gen474" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen475"/>who will not harm a friend,<l eID="gen475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen476"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:4
verses.text: nor cruelly insult a neighbour,<l eID="gen476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen477"/>who regards with contempt those rejected by God;<l eID="gen477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen478"/>but honours those who obey the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen478" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen479"/>and keeps an oath, whatever the cost,<l eID="gen479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen480"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:5
verses.text: whose money is lent without interest,<l eID="gen480" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen481"/>who never takes a bribe to hurt the innocent.<l eID="gen481" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen470"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen482"/> <l level="1" sID="gen483"/>The person who does these things will always stand firm.<l eID="gen483" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen482"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.15"/> <div eID="gen466" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv16"/><div sID="gen484" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 16</title> <title type="psalm">A michtam of David.</title> <lg sID="gen485"/> <l level="1" sID="gen486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv16"/> Keep me, O God, for in you I take refuge.<l eID="gen486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen487"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:2
verses.text: I said to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, “You are my <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen487" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen488"/>my happiness rests in you alone.<l eID="gen488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen489"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:3
verses.text: Those who are holy in the land,<l eID="gen489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen490"/>they, they alone, are the noble ones;<l eID="gen490" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen491"/>all my delight is in them.”<l eID="gen491" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen485"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen492"/> <l level="1" sID="gen493"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:4
verses.text: Those who choose other gods<l eID="gen493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen494"/>find endless sorrow.<l eID="gen494" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen495"/>In their offerings of blood I will have no part<l eID="gen495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen496"/>nor take their name on my lips.<l eID="gen496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen497"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:5
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my share and my portion,<l eID="gen497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen498"/>my fate is in your strong hands.<l eID="gen498" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen492"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen499"/> <l level="1" sID="gen500"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:6
verses.text: The boundary lines of my life<l eID="gen500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen501"/>mark out delightful country,<l eID="gen501" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen502"/>my heritage pleases me well.<l eID="gen502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen503"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:7
verses.text: I praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his counsel,<l eID="gen503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen504"/>which so stirs my heart in the night.<l eID="gen504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen505"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:8
verses.text: I keep the <divineName>Lord</divineName> always in mind:<l eID="gen505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen506"/>with him at my hand, I can never be moved.<l eID="gen506" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen499"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen507"/> <l level="1" sID="gen508"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:9
verses.text: So my heart is glad, there is joy inside me;<l eID="gen508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen509"/>and in safety of body I live.<l eID="gen509" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen510"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:10
verses.text: For you will not give me up to Sheol<l eID="gen510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen511"/>nor let any who love you see the pit.<l eID="gen511" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen512"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:11
verses.text: You will show me the path that leads to life,<l eID="gen512" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen513"/>to that fulness of joy which is in your presence,<l eID="gen513" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen514"/>and the pleasures dispensed by your hand evermore.<l eID="gen514" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen507"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.16"/> <div eID="gen484" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv17"/><div sID="gen515" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 17</title> <title type="psalm">A prayer of David.</title> <lg sID="gen516"/> <l level="1" sID="gen517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv17"/> Listen, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to my innocence;<l eID="gen517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen518"/>attend to my piercing cry.<l eID="gen518" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen519"/>Give heed to my prayer<l eID="gen519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen520"/>out of lips unfeigned.<l eID="gen520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen521"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:2
verses.text: Let my vindication come from you,<l eID="gen521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen522"/>your eyes see the truth.<l eID="gen522" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen516"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen523"/> <l level="1" sID="gen524"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:3
verses.text: When you test my heart when you visit at night,<l eID="gen524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen525"/>and assay me like silver --- you can find no evil.<l eID="gen525" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen526"/>I am determined that my mouth should not lie.<l eID="gen526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen527"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:4
verses.text: I gave earnest heed to the words of your lips.<l eID="gen527" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen528"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:5
verses.text: My steps have held fast to the paths of your precepts<l eID="gen528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen529"/>and in your tracks have my feet never stumbled.<l eID="gen529" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen523"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen530"/> <l level="1" sID="gen531"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:6
verses.text: So I call you, O God, with assurance of answer;<l eID="gen531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen532"/>bend down your ear to me, hear what I say.<l eID="gen532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen533"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:7
verses.text: Show your marvellous love, you who save from enemies<l eID="gen533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen534"/>those who take refuge at your right hand.<l eID="gen534" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen530"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen535"/> <l level="1" sID="gen536"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:8
verses.text: Keep me as the apple of the eye,<l eID="gen536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen537"/>hide me in the shelter of your wings.<l eID="gen537" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen538"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:9
verses.text: From wicked people who do me violence,<l eID="gen538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen539"/>from deadly foes who crowd around me.<l eID="gen539" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen535"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen540"/> <l level="1" sID="gen541"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:10
verses.text: They have closed their hearts to pity,<l eID="gen541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen542"/>the words of their mouths are haughty.<l eID="gen542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen543"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:11
verses.text: Now they dog us at every step,<l eID="gen543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen544"/>keenly watching, to hurl us to the ground,<l eID="gen544" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen545"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:12
verses.text: like a lion, longing to tear,<l eID="gen545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen546"/>like a young lion, lurking in secret.<l eID="gen546" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen540"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen547"/> <l level="1" sID="gen548"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:13
verses.text: Arise, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, face them and fell them.<l eID="gen548" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen549"/>By your sword set me free from the wicked,<l eID="gen549" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen550"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:14
verses.text: by your hand, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, from those<l eID="gen550" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen551"/>whose portion of life is this world.<l eID="gen551" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen552"/>But let your treasured ones have food in plenty<l eID="gen552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen553"/>may their children be full and their children satisfied.<l eID="gen553" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen547"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen554"/> <l level="2" sID="gen555"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:15
verses.text: In my innocence I will see your face,<l eID="gen555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen556"/>awake I am filled with a vision of you.<l eID="gen556" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen554"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.17"/> <div eID="gen515" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv18"/><div sID="gen557" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 18</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David, the servant of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, who recited the words of this song to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> after the <divineName>Lord</divineName> had saved him from the power of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said:</title> <lg sID="gen558"/> <l level="1" sID="gen559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv18"/> I love you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my strength.<l eID="gen559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen560"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:2
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my rock, my fortress, deliverer,<l eID="gen560" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen561"/>my God, my rock, where I take refuge,<l eID="gen561" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen562"/>my shield, my defender, my tower.<l eID="gen562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen563"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:3
verses.text: Worthy of praise is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> whom I call on,<l eID="gen563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen564"/>he rescues me from all my foes.<l eID="gen564" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen558"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen565"/> <l level="1" sID="gen566"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:4
verses.text: The waves of death broke about me,<l eID="gen566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen567"/>fearful floods of chaos.<l eID="gen567" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen568"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:5
verses.text: Sheol threw cords around me,<l eID="gen568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen569"/>snares of death came to meet me.<l eID="gen569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen570"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:6
verses.text: In distress I cried to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen571"/>and shouted for help to my God;<l eID="gen571" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen572"/>in his temple he heard my voice,<l eID="gen572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen573"/>into his ears came my cry.<l eID="gen573" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen565"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen574"/> <l level="1" sID="gen575"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:7
verses.text: Then the earth shook and quaked,<l eID="gen575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen576"/>mountains trembled to their foundations,<l eID="gen576" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen577"/>and quaked because of his wrath.<l eID="gen577" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen578"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:8
verses.text: Smoke went up from his nostrils,<l eID="gen578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen579"/>devouring fire from his mouth,<l eID="gen579" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen580"/>coals were kindled by it.<l eID="gen580" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen574"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen581"/> <l level="1" sID="gen582"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:9
verses.text: Then he bent the sky and came down,<l eID="gen582" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen583"/>thick darkness was under his feet.<l eID="gen583" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen584"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:10
verses.text: He rode on a cherub and flew,<l eID="gen584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen585"/>darting on wings of wind,<l eID="gen585" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen586"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:11
verses.text: with his screen of darkness about him,<l eID="gen586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen587"/>in thick dark clouds of water.<l eID="gen587" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen581"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen588"/> <l level="1" sID="gen589"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:12
verses.text: At the radiance before him there passed<l eID="gen589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen590"/>hailstones and coals of fire.<l eID="gen590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen591"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:13
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> thundered from heaven,<l eID="gen591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen592"/>the Most High uttered his voice.<l eID="gen592" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen593"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:14
verses.text: He shot his arrows and scattered them,<l eID="gen593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen594"/>flashed lightnings, and routed them.<l eID="gen594" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen595"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:15
verses.text: The channels of the sea were revealed,<l eID="gen595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen596"/>the world was laid bare to its base,<l eID="gen596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen597"/>at your rebuke, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen598"/>at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.<l eID="gen598" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen588"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen599"/> <l level="1" sID="gen600"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:16
verses.text: He stretched from on high, he seized me,<l eID="gen600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen601"/>drew me up from the mighty waters,<l eID="gen601" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen602"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:17
verses.text: and saved me from those who hated me ---<l eID="gen602" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen603"/>fierce foes, too mighty for me.<l eID="gen603" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen604"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:18
verses.text: In my day of distress they assailed me,<l eID="gen604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen605"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> proved my support.<l eID="gen605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen606"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:19
verses.text: To a spacious place he brought me,<l eID="gen606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen607"/>and, for love of me, he saved me.<l eID="gen607" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen599"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen608"/> <l level="1" sID="gen609"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:20
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> repays my innocence,<l eID="gen609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen610"/>he rewards my cleanness of hands.<l eID="gen610" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen611"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:21
verses.text: For I kept the ways of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen612"/>nor have wickedly strayed from my God.<l eID="gen612" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen613"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:22
verses.text: His commandments were all before me,<l eID="gen613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen614"/>his statutes I put not away.<l eID="gen614" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen615"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:23
verses.text: And I was blameless before him,<l eID="gen615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen616"/>guarding myself from sin.<l eID="gen616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen617"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:24
verses.text: So the <divineName>Lord</divineName> repaid my innocence,<l eID="gen617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen618"/>my cleanness of hands in his sight.<l eID="gen618" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen608"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen619"/> <l level="1" sID="gen620"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:25
verses.text: With the loyal you are loyal,<l eID="gen620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen621"/>and with the blameless blameless.<l eID="gen621" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen622"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:26
verses.text: With the pure you show yourself pure,<l eID="gen622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen623"/>but shrewd with the devious.<l eID="gen623" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen624"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:27
verses.text: For the lowly people you save,<l eID="gen624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen625"/>but haughty eyes you abase.<l eID="gen625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:28
verses.text: You are my lamp, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen627"/>my God who enlightens my darkness.<l eID="gen627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen628"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:29
verses.text: With you I can storm a rampart,<l eID="gen628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen629"/>with my God I can leap a wall.<l eID="gen629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen630"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:30
verses.text: As for God, his way is perfect;<l eID="gen630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen631"/>the word of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is pure.<l eID="gen631" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen632"/>He is shield to all who take refuge in him.<l eID="gen632" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen619"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen633"/> <l level="1" sID="gen634"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:31
verses.text: For who is God but the <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen635"/>And who is a rock but our God?<l eID="gen635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen636"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:32
verses.text: The God who arms me with strength,<l eID="gen636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen637"/>who cleared and smoothed my way.<l eID="gen637" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen638"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:33
verses.text: He made my feet like hinds’ feet,<l eID="gen638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen639"/>and set me up on the heights.<l eID="gen639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen640"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:34
verses.text: He taught my hands how to fight,<l eID="gen640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen641"/>and my arms how to bend a bronze bow.<l eID="gen641" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen633"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen642"/> <l level="1" sID="gen643"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:35
verses.text: The shield of your help you gave me,<l eID="gen643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen644"/>your right hand supports me,<l eID="gen644" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen645"/>you stoop down to make me great.<l eID="gen645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen646"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:36
verses.text: In your strength I took giant strides,<l eID="gen646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen647"/>and my feet never slipped.<l eID="gen647" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen648"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:37
verses.text: So I chased the foe till I caught them,<l eID="gen648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen649"/>and turned not, till I made an end of them.<l eID="gen649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen650"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:38
verses.text: I smashed them, they could not rise,<l eID="gen650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen651"/>they fell beneath my feet.<l eID="gen651" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen642"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen652"/> <l level="1" sID="gen653"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:39
verses.text: You did arm me with strength for war,<l eID="gen653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen654"/>you did bow my assailants beneath me.<l eID="gen654" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen655"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:40
verses.text: You made my foes turn their back to me,<l eID="gen655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen656"/>and those who did hate me I finished.<l eID="gen656" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen657"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:41
verses.text: They cried for help, but none saved them;<l eID="gen657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen658"/>to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, but he answered them not.<l eID="gen658" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:42
verses.text: I beat them like dust of the market-place,<l eID="gen659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen660"/>stamped them like mud of the streets.<l eID="gen660" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen652"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen661"/> <l level="1" sID="gen662"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:43
verses.text: From the strife of the peoples you saved me,<l eID="gen662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen663"/>you made me head of the nations,<l eID="gen663" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen664"/>peoples I knew not did serve me.<l eID="gen664" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen665"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:44
verses.text: On the instant they hear, they obey me,<l eID="gen665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen666"/>foreigners come to me cringing.<l eID="gen666" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen667"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:45
verses.text: Foreigners lose courage,<l eID="gen667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen668"/>and come out of their strongholds trembling.<l eID="gen668" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen661"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen669"/> <l level="1" sID="gen670"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:46
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is alive! Blest be my rock!<l eID="gen670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen671"/>Exalted be God, my protector!<l eID="gen671" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen672"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:47
verses.text: The God who gave me revenge,<l eID="gen672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen673"/>and brought down nations beneath me,<l eID="gen673" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen674"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:48
verses.text: who saved me from angry foes,<l eID="gen674" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen675"/>and set me above my assailants,<l eID="gen675" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen676"/>safe from the violent.<l eID="gen676" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen669"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen677"/> <l level="1" sID="gen678"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:49
verses.text: For this I will praise you among the nations,<l eID="gen678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen679"/>making music, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to your name:<l eID="gen679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen680"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:50
verses.text: for great triumphs he grants to his king,<l eID="gen680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen681"/>and faithful love he shows his anointed,<l eID="gen681" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen682"/>to David and his seed evermore.<l eID="gen682" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen677"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.18"/> <div eID="gen557" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv19"/><div sID="gen683" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 19</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen684"/> <l level="1" sID="gen685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv19"/> The heavens declare God’s glory,<l eID="gen685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen686"/>the sky tells what his hands have done.<l eID="gen686" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen687"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:2
verses.text: Day tells it to day,<l eID="gen687" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen688"/>night reveals it to night,<l eID="gen688" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen689"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:3
verses.text: without speaking, without words;<l eID="gen689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen690"/>without the sound of voices.<l eID="gen690" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen691"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:4
verses.text: But through all the world their voice carries<l eID="gen691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen692"/>their words to the ends of the earth.<l eID="gen692" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen684"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen693"/> <l level="1" sID="gen694"/>He has set in them a tent for the sun;<l eID="gen694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen695"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:5
verses.text: like a bridegroom coming forth from his chamber<l eID="gen695" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen696"/>it joyfully runs its course like a hero.<l eID="gen696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen697"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:6
verses.text: From one end of the heavens it rises,<l eID="gen697" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen698"/>and round it runs to the other,<l eID="gen698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen699"/>and nothing hides from its heat.<l eID="gen699" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen693"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen700"/> <l level="1" sID="gen701"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:7
verses.text: The law of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is perfect,<l eID="gen701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen702"/>renewing life.<l eID="gen702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen703"/>The decrees of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> are trusty,<l eID="gen703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen704"/>making simple ones wise.<l eID="gen704" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen700"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen705"/> <l level="1" sID="gen706"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:8
verses.text: The behests of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> are right,<l eID="gen706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen707"/>rejoicing the heart.<l eID="gen707" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen708"/>The command of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is pure,<l eID="gen708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen709"/>giving light to the eyes.<l eID="gen709" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen705"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen710"/> <l level="1" sID="gen711"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:9
verses.text: The fear of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is clean,<l eID="gen711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen712"/>it endures forever.<l eID="gen712" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen713"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s judgments are true<l eID="gen713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen714"/>and right altogether.<l eID="gen714" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen710"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen715"/> <l level="1" sID="gen716"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:10
verses.text: More precious are they than gold ---<l eID="gen716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen717"/>than fine gold in plenty,<l eID="gen717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen718"/>and sweeter they are than honey,<l eID="gen718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen719"/>that drops from the comb.<l eID="gen719" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen715"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen720"/> <l level="1" sID="gen721"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:11
verses.text: By them is your servant warned;<l eID="gen721" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen722"/>who keeps them has rich reward.<l eID="gen722" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen723"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:12
verses.text: Who can know their flaws?<l eID="gen723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen724"/>Absolve me from those who I know not.<l eID="gen724" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen720"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen725"/> <l level="1" sID="gen726"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:13
verses.text: Keep your servant from wilful sins ---<l eID="gen726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen727"/>from falling under their sway:<l eID="gen727" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen728"/>then blameless and clear will I be<l eID="gen728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen729"/>from great offense.<l eID="gen729" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen725"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen730"/> <l level="1" sID="gen731"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:14
verses.text: May the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart<l eID="gen731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen732"/>be pleasing to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen732" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen733"/>my rock and redeemer.<l eID="gen733" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen730"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.19"/> <div eID="gen683" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv20"/><div sID="gen734" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 20</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen735"/> <l level="1" sID="gen736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv20"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> answer you in the day of distress,<l eID="gen736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen737"/>the name of the God of Jacob protect you,<l eID="gen737" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen738"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:2
verses.text: sending you help from the temple,<l eID="gen738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen739"/>and out of Zion supporting you.<l eID="gen739" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen735"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen740"/> <l level="1" sID="gen741"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:3
verses.text: All your meal-offerings may he remember,<l eID="gen741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen742"/>your burnt-offerings look on with favour. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen742" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen743"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:4
verses.text: May he grant you your heart’s desire,<l eID="gen743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen744"/>and bring all your designs to fruition.<l eID="gen744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen745"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:5
verses.text: We will shout then for joy at your victory,<l eID="gen745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen746"/>and rejoice in the name of our God.<l eID="gen746" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen747"/>May the <divineName>Lord</divineName> fulfil all your petitions.<l eID="gen747" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen740"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen748"/> <l level="1" sID="gen749"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:6
verses.text: Now I am sure that the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen750"/>will give victory to his anointed.<l eID="gen750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen751"/>From his temple in heaven he will answer<l eID="gen751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen752"/>by his mighty triumphant right hand.<l eID="gen752" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen753"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:7
verses.text: Some in chariots are strong, some in horses;<l eID="gen753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen754"/>but our strength is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God.<l eID="gen754" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen755"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:8
verses.text: As for them, they will totter and fall,<l eID="gen755" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen756"/>while we rise and stand firm.<l eID="gen756" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen748"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen757"/> <l level="1" sID="gen758"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:9
verses.text: Give victory, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to the king,<l eID="gen758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen759"/>and answer us when we call.<l eID="gen759" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen757"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.20"/> <div eID="gen734" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv21"/><div sID="gen760" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 21</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen761"/> <l level="1" sID="gen762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv21"/> In your might, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the king rejoices,<l eID="gen762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen763"/>and because of your help how exultant is he!<l eID="gen763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen764"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:2
verses.text: You have granted to him the desire of his heart,<l eID="gen764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen765"/>the request of his lips you have not withheld. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen765" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen761"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen766"/> <l level="1" sID="gen767"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:3
verses.text: You did go forth to meet him with blessing and weal,<l eID="gen767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen768"/>you did set on his head a crown of fine gold.<l eID="gen768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen769"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:4
