verses.text: He asked you for life, you gave it ---<l eID="gen769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen770"/>life lasting many days, forever and ever.<l eID="gen770" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen766"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen771"/> <l level="1" sID="gen772"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:5
verses.text: Great is his glory because of your help,<l eID="gen772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen773"/>honour and majesty you lay upon him.<l eID="gen773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen774"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:6
verses.text: For you make him most blessed forever,<l eID="gen774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen775"/>with the joy of your presence you make him glad.<l eID="gen775" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen771"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen776"/> <l level="1" sID="gen777"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:7
verses.text: For the king puts ever his trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen778"/>the Most High, in his love, will preserve him unshaken.<l eID="gen778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:8
verses.text: Your hand will reach to all your foes,<l eID="gen779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen780"/>and those who hate you your right hand will shatter.<l eID="gen780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen781"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:9
verses.text: You will make them like a furnace of fire,<l eID="gen781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen782"/>when you appear, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen782" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen783"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName> will swallow them up in his wrath.<l eID="gen783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen784"/>The fire shall devour them.<l eID="gen784" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen785"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:10
verses.text: You will sweep their offspring from the earth,<l eID="gen785" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen786"/>their children from humanity.<l eID="gen786" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen787"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:11
verses.text: When they scheme against you<l eID="gen787" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen788"/>and hatch evil plots --- they will fail.<l eID="gen788" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen789"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:12
verses.text: For you make them turn in flight,<l eID="gen789" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen790"/>you aim with your bow at their faces.<l eID="gen790" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen776"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen791"/> <l level="1" sID="gen792"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:13
verses.text: Be exalted, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in your strength,<l eID="gen792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen793"/>to your might we will sing and make music.<l eID="gen793" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen791"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.21"/> <div eID="gen760" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv22"/><div sID="gen794" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 22</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; set to ‘Deer of the Dawn’. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen795"/> <l level="1" sID="gen796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv22"/> My God, my God, why have you left me,<l eID="gen796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen797"/>gone afar from my cry, from the words of my roaring?<l eID="gen797" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen798"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:2
verses.text: I cry in the day-time, but you do not answer;<l eID="gen798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen799"/>even in the night I am never still.<l eID="gen799" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen795"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen800"/> <l level="1" sID="gen801"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:3
verses.text: Yet you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are the Holy One,<l eID="gen801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen802"/>throned on the praises of Israel.<l eID="gen802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen803"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:4
verses.text: In you our ancestors trusted,<l eID="gen803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen804"/>they trusted and you did deliver them.<l eID="gen804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen805"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:5
verses.text: They cried to you, and found safety,<l eID="gen805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen806"/>in you did they trust and were not put to shame.<l eID="gen806" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen800"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen807"/> <l level="1" sID="gen808"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:6
verses.text: But I am a worm, not a person;<l eID="gen808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen809"/>insulted by others, despised by the people.<l eID="gen809" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen810"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:7
verses.text: All who see me mock me,<l eID="gen810" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen811"/>with mouths wide open and wagging heads:<l eID="gen811" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen812"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:8
verses.text: “He committed himself to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>; let him save him.<l eID="gen812" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen813"/>Let him rescue him, since he takes pleasure in him.”<l eID="gen813" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen807"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen814"/> <l level="1" sID="gen815"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:9
verses.text: But you drew me from the womb,<l eID="gen815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen816"/>made me trustfully lie on my mother’s breast.<l eID="gen816" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen817"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:10
verses.text: On your care was I cast from my very birth,<l eID="gen817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen818"/>you are my God from my mother’s womb.<l eID="gen818" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen819"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:11
verses.text: Be not far from me, for trouble is nigh,<l eID="gen819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen820"/>and there is none to help.<l eID="gen820" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen814"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen821"/> <l level="1" sID="gen822"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:12
verses.text: I am circled by many bulls,<l eID="gen822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen823"/>beset by the mighty of Bashan,<l eID="gen823" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen824"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:13
verses.text: who face me with gaping jaws,<l eID="gen824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen825"/>like ravening roaring lions.<l eID="gen825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen826"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:14
verses.text: Poured out am I like water,<l eID="gen826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen827"/>and all my bones are loosened.<l eID="gen827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen828"/>My heart is become like wax,<l eID="gen828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen829"/>melted within me.<l eID="gen829" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen821"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen830"/> <l level="1" sID="gen831"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:15
verses.text: My palate is dry as a sherd,<l eID="gen831" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen832"/>my tongue sticks to my jaws;<l eID="gen832" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen833"/>in the dust of death you lay me.<l eID="gen833" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen834"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:16
verses.text: For dogs are round about me,<l eID="gen834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen835"/>a band of knaves encircles me,<l eID="gen835" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen836"/>gnawing my hands and my feet.<l eID="gen836" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen837"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:17
verses.text: I can count my bones, every one.<l eID="gen837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen838"/>As for them, they feast their eyes on me.<l eID="gen838" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen839"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:18
verses.text: They divide my garments among them,<l eID="gen839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen840"/>and over my raiment cast lots.<l eID="gen840" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen830"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen841"/> <l level="1" sID="gen842"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:19
verses.text: But you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, be not far,<l eID="gen842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen843"/>O my strength, hasten to help me.<l eID="gen843" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen844"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:20
verses.text: Deliver my life from the sword<l eID="gen844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen845"/>my life from the power of the dogs.<l eID="gen845" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen846"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:21
verses.text: Save me from the jaws of the lion,<l eID="gen846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen847"/>from the horns of the wild oxen help me.<l eID="gen847" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen841"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen848"/> <l level="1" sID="gen849"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:22
verses.text: I will tell of your fame to my kindred,<l eID="gen849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen850"/>and in the assembly will praise you.<l eID="gen850" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen851"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:23
verses.text: Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you who fear him.<l eID="gen851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen852"/>All Jacob’s seed, give him glory.<l eID="gen852" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen853"/>All Israel’s seed, stand in awe of him.<l eID="gen853" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen848"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen854"/> <l level="1" sID="gen855"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:24
verses.text: For he has not despised nor abhorred<l eID="gen855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen856"/>the sorrow of the sorrowful.<l eID="gen856" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen857"/>He hid not his face from me,<l eID="gen857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen858"/>but he listened to my cry for help.<l eID="gen858" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen854"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen859"/> <l level="1" sID="gen860"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:25
verses.text: Of you is my praise in the great congregation;<l eID="gen860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen861"/>my vows I will pay before those who fear him.<l eID="gen861" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen862"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:26
verses.text: The afflicted will eat to their heart’s desire,<l eID="gen862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen863"/>and those who seek after the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will praise him.<l eID="gen863" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen864"/>Lift up your hearts forever.<l eID="gen864" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen865"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:27
verses.text: All will call it to mind, to the ends of the earth,<l eID="gen865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen866"/>and turn to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen867"/>and all tribes of the nations will bow down before you.<l eID="gen867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen868"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:28
verses.text: For the kingdom belongs to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen869"/>he is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of the nations.<l eID="gen869" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen870"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:29
verses.text: To him will bow down all who sleep in the earth,<l eID="gen870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen871"/>and before him bend all who go down to the dust,<l eID="gen871" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen872"/>and those who could not preserve their lives.<l eID="gen872" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen873"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:30
verses.text: My descendents will tell of the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen874"/>to the next generation;<l eID="gen874" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen875"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:31
verses.text: they will declare his righteousness<l eID="gen875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen876"/>to people yet to be born:<l eID="gen876" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen877"/>He has done it.<l eID="gen877" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen859"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.22"/> <div eID="gen794" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv23"/><div sID="gen878" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 23</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen879"/> <l level="1" sID="gen880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv23"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my shepherd: I am never in need.<l eID="gen880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen881"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: He lays me down in green pastures.<l eID="gen881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen882"/>He gently leads me to waters of rest,<l eID="gen882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen883"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: he refreshes my life.<l eID="gen883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen884"/>He guides me along paths that are straight,<l eID="gen884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen885"/>true to his name.<l eID="gen885" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen879"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen886"/> <l level="1" sID="gen887"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: And when my way lies through a valley of gloom,<l eID="gen887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen888"/>I fear no evil, for you are with me.<l eID="gen888" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen889"/>Your rod and your staff comfort me.<l eID="gen889" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen886"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen890"/> <l level="1" sID="gen891"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: You spread a table for me<l eID="gen891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen892"/>in face of my foes;<l eID="gen892" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen893"/>with oil you anoint my head,<l eID="gen893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen894"/>and my cup runs over.<l eID="gen894" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen895"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: Surely goodness and love will pursue me ---<l eID="gen895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen896"/>all the days of my life.<l eID="gen896" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen897"/>In the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I will live<l eID="gen897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen898"/>through the length of the days.<l eID="gen898" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen890"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.23"/> <div eID="gen878" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv24"/><div sID="gen899" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 24</title> <title type="psalm">Of David. A psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen900"/> <l level="1" sID="gen901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv24"/> The earth is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s and all that it holds,<l eID="gen901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen902"/>the world and those who live in it.<l eID="gen902" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen903"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:2
verses.text: For he founded it on the seas,<l eID="gen903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen904"/>and on the floods he sustains it.<l eID="gen904" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen900"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen905"/> <l level="1" sID="gen906"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:3
verses.text: Who may ascend the hill of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen907"/>Who may stand in his holy place?<l eID="gen907" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen908"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:4
verses.text: The clean of hands, the pure of heart,<l eID="gen908" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen909"/>who sets not their heart upon sinful things,<l eID="gen909" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen910"/>nor swears with intent to deceive,<l eID="gen910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen911"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:5
verses.text: they win from the <divineName>Lord</divineName> a blessing:<l eID="gen911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen912"/>God is their champion and saviour.<l eID="gen912" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen913"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:6
verses.text: Such must be those who resort to him,<l eID="gen913" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen914"/>and seek the face of the God of Jacob. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen914" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen905"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen915"/> <l level="1" sID="gen916"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:7
verses.text: Lift high your heads, you gates ---<l eID="gen916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen917"/>Higher, you ancient doors;<l eID="gen917" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen918"/>welcome the glorious king.<l eID="gen918" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen919"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:8
verses.text: “Who is the glorious king?”<l eID="gen919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen920"/>“The <divineName>Lord</divineName> strong and heroic,<l eID="gen920" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen921"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> heroic in battle.”<l eID="gen921" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen915"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen922"/> <l level="1" sID="gen923"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:9
verses.text: Lift high your heads, you gates ---<l eID="gen923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen924"/>Higher, you ancient doors;<l eID="gen924" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen925"/>welcome the glorious king.<l eID="gen925" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen926"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:10
verses.text: “Who is the glorious king?”<l eID="gen926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen927"/>“The <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the God of hosts,<l eID="gen927" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen928"/>he is the glorious king.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen928" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen922"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.24"/> <div eID="gen899" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv25"/><div sID="gen929" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 25</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen930"/> <l level="1" sID="gen931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv25"/> To you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I lift up my heart:<l eID="gen931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen932"/>all the day I wait for you.<l eID="gen932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen933"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:2
verses.text: In you I trust, put me not to shame;<l eID="gen933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen934"/>let not my foes exult over me.<l eID="gen934" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen935"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:3
verses.text: None will be shamed who wait for you,<l eID="gen935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen936"/>but shame will fall upon wanton traitors.<l eID="gen936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen937"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:4
verses.text: Make me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to know your ways:<l eID="gen937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen938"/>teach me your paths.<l eID="gen938" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen939"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:5
verses.text: In your faithfulness guide me and teach me,<l eID="gen939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen940"/>for you are my God and my Saviour.<l eID="gen940" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen941"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:6
verses.text: Remember your pity, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and your kindness,<l eID="gen941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen942"/>for they have been ever of old.<l eID="gen942" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen943"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:7
verses.text: Do not remember the sins of my youth;<l eID="gen943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen944"/>remember me in kindness,<l eID="gen944" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen945"/>because of your goodness, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen946"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:8
verses.text: Good is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> and upright,<l eID="gen946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen947"/>so he teaches sinners the way.<l eID="gen947" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen948"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:9
verses.text: The humble he guides in the right,<l eID="gen948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen949"/>he teaches the humble his way.<l eID="gen949" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen950"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:10
verses.text: All his ways are loving and loyal<l eID="gen950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen951"/>to those who observe his charges and covenant.<l eID="gen951" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen952"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:11
verses.text: Be true to your name <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen952" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen953"/>forgive my many sins.<l eID="gen953" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen954"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:12
verses.text: Who then is the person who fears the <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen955"/>He will teach them the way to choose.<l eID="gen955" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen956"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:13
verses.text: They will live in prosperity,<l eID="gen956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen957"/>their children will inherit the land.<l eID="gen957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen958"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:14
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> gives guidance to those who fear him,<l eID="gen958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen959"/>and with his covenant he makes them acquainted.<l eID="gen959" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen960"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:15
verses.text: My eyes are ever toward the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen961"/>for out of the net he brings my foot.<l eID="gen961" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen962"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:16
verses.text: Turn to me with your favour,<l eID="gen962" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen963"/>for I am lonely and crushed<l eID="gen963" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen964"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:17
verses.text: In my heart are strain and storm;<l eID="gen964" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen965"/>bring me out of my distresses.<l eID="gen965" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen966"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:18
verses.text: Look on my misery and trouble,<l eID="gen966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen967"/>and pardon all my sins,<l eID="gen967" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen968"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:19
verses.text: look on my foes oh, so many!<l eID="gen968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen969"/>And their cruel hatred towards me.<l eID="gen969" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen970"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:20
verses.text: Deliver me, keep me, and shame not<l eID="gen970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen971"/>one who takes refuge in you.<l eID="gen971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen972"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:21
verses.text: May integrity and innocence preserve me,<l eID="gen972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen973"/>for I wait for you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen973" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen930"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen974"/> <l level="1" sID="gen975"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:22
verses.text: Redeem Israel, O God,<l eID="gen975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen976"/>from all its distresses.<l eID="gen976" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen974"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.25"/> <div eID="gen929" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv26"/><div sID="gen977" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 26</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen978"/> <l level="1" sID="gen979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv26"/> Defend me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for my walk has been blameless;<l eID="gen979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen980"/>in the <divineName>Lord</divineName> have I trusted unswervingly:<l eID="gen980" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen981"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:2
verses.text: Examine me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and test me;<l eID="gen981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen982"/>test my heart and my mind.<l eID="gen982" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen983"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:3
verses.text: For your love is before my eyes,<l eID="gen983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen984"/>and your faithfulness governs my way.<l eID="gen984" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen978"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen985"/> <l level="1" sID="gen986"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:4
verses.text: I never sat down with the worthless,<l eID="gen986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen987"/>nor companied with dissemblers.<l eID="gen987" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen988"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:5
verses.text: I hate the assembly of knaves,<l eID="gen988" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen989"/>I would never sit down with the wicked;<l eID="gen989" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen990"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:6
verses.text: but, with hands washed in innocence,<l eID="gen990" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen991"/>I would march round your altar, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen991" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen992"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:7
verses.text: singing loud songs of thanks,<l eID="gen992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen993"/>and telling of all your wonders.<l eID="gen993" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen994"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:8
verses.text: O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I love your house,<l eID="gen994" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen995"/>the place where your glory lives.<l eID="gen995" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen985"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen996"/> <l level="1" sID="gen997"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:9
verses.text: Do not gather me up with sinners;<l eID="gen997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen998"/>slay me not with people of blood,<l eID="gen998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen999"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:10
verses.text: whose hands are stained with villainy,<l eID="gen999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1000"/>and whose right hand is filled with bribes.<l eID="gen1000" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1001"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:11
verses.text: But my walk is blameless!<l eID="gen1001" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1002"/>O redeem me, be gracious to me.<l eID="gen1002" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1003"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: My foot stands on even ground,<l eID="gen1003" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1004"/>in the choirs I will bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1004" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen996"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.26"/> <div eID="gen977" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv27"/><div sID="gen1005" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 27</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1006"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv27"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my light and my saviour;<l eID="gen1007" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1008"/>whom then should I fear?<l eID="gen1008" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1009"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName> protects my life;<l eID="gen1009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1010"/>whom then should I dread?<l eID="gen1010" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1006"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1011"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1012"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: When the wicked drew near to assail me<l eID="gen1012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1013"/>and eat up my flesh,<l eID="gen1013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1014"/>it was those who distressed and opposed me<l eID="gen1014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1015"/>who stumbled and fell.<l eID="gen1015" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1011"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1016"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1017"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: Though against me a host should encamp,<l eID="gen1017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1018"/>yet my heart would be fearless:<l eID="gen1018" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1019"/>though battle should rise up against me,<l eID="gen1019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1020"/>still would I be trustful.<l eID="gen1020" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1016"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1021"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1022"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: One thing have I asked of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1023"/>and that do I long for ---<l eID="gen1023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1024"/>To live in the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen1024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1025"/>all the days of my life,<l eID="gen1025" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1026"/>to gaze on the grace of the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen1026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1027"/>and inquire in his temple.<l eID="gen1027" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1021"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1028"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1029"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: For he will hide me in his shelter<l eID="gen1029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1030"/>in the day of misfortune.<l eID="gen1030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1031"/>In his sheltering tent he hides me:<l eID="gen1031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1032"/>he lifts me up on a rock.<l eID="gen1032" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1028"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1033"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1034"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: And now that my head he has lifted<l eID="gen1034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1035"/>above my encircling foes,<l eID="gen1035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1036"/>I will march round the altar and sacrifice,<l eID="gen1036" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1037"/>shouting with joy, in his tent,<l eID="gen1037" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1038"/>making music and song to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1038" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1033"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1039"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1040"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: Hear, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my loud cry,<l eID="gen1040" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1041"/>and graciously answer me.<l eID="gen1041" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1042"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: My heart has said to you,<l eID="gen1042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1043"/>“Your face, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I seek.”<l eID="gen1043" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1039"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1044"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1045"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: Hide not your face from me,<l eID="gen1045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1046"/>reject not your servant in anger:<l eID="gen1046" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1047"/>for you have been my help.<l eID="gen1047" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1048"/>Abandon me not, nor forsake me,<l eID="gen1048" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1049"/>O God of my help:<l eID="gen1049" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1050"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:10
verses.text: for father and mother have left me;<l eID="gen1050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1051"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will take me up.<l eID="gen1051" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1044"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1052"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1053"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:11
verses.text: Teach me your way, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen1053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1054"/>lead me in an even path,<l eID="gen1054" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1055"/>because of my enemies.<l eID="gen1055" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1056"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:12
verses.text: Give me not up, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1057"/>unto the rage of my foes;<l eID="gen1057" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1058"/>for against me have risen false witnesses,<l eID="gen1058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1059"/>breathing out cruelty.<l eID="gen1059" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1052"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1060"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1061"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:13
verses.text: Firm is the faith I cherish,<l eID="gen1061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1062"/>that I, in the land of the living,<l eID="gen1062" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1063"/>will yet see the goodness of God.<l eID="gen1063" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1064"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:14
verses.text: Let your heart be courageous and strong,<l eID="gen1064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1065"/>and wait on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1065" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1060"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.27"/> <div eID="gen1005" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv28"/><div sID="gen1066" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 28</title> <title type="psalm">Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1067"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv28"/> Unto you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, do I cry;<l eID="gen1068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1069"/>my rock, be not deaf to me:<l eID="gen1069" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1070"/>lest, through holding your peace, I become<l eID="gen1070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1071"/>like those who go down to the pit.<l eID="gen1071" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1072"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:2
verses.text: Hear my loud entreaty,<l eID="gen1072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1073"/>as I cry for help to you,<l eID="gen1073" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1074"/>lifting my hands, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1075"/>towards your holy chancel.<l eID="gen1075" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1067"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1076"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1077"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:3
verses.text: Take me not off with the wicked,<l eID="gen1077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1078"/>nor with the workers of wrong,<l eID="gen1078" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1079"/>whose speech to their neighbours is friendly,<l eID="gen1079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1080"/>while evil is in their heart.<l eID="gen1080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1081"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:4
verses.text: Give them as they have done,<l eID="gen1081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1082"/>as their wicked deeds deserve.<l eID="gen1082" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1083"/>As their hands have wrought, so give to them:<l eID="gen1083" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1084"/>requite to them their deserts.<l eID="gen1084" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1085"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:5
verses.text: They are blind to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> does,<l eID="gen1085" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1086"/>to all that his hands have wrought;<l eID="gen1086" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1087"/>and so he will tear them down,<l eID="gen1087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1088"/>to build them up no more.<l eID="gen1088" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1076"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1089"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1090"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:6
verses.text: Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, who has heard<l eID="gen1090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1091"/>my voice as I plead for mercy.<l eID="gen1091" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1092"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:7
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my strength and my shield;<l eID="gen1092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1093"/>my heart trusts in him.<l eID="gen1093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1094"/>I was helped: so my heart is exultant,<l eID="gen1094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1095"/>and in my song I will praise him.<l eID="gen1095" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1089"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1096"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1097"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:8
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is the strength of his people,<l eID="gen1097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1098"/>the fortress who saves his anointed.<l eID="gen1098" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1099"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:9
verses.text: O save your people,<l eID="gen1099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1100"/>and bless your inheritance.<l eID="gen1100" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1101"/>Be their shepherd<l eID="gen1101" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1102"/>and carry them forever.<l eID="gen1102" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1096"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.28"/> <div eID="gen1066" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv29"/><div sID="gen1103" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 29</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1104"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv29"/> Ascribe to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you heavenly beings,<l eID="gen1105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1106"/>ascribe to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> glory and power<l eID="gen1106" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:2
verses.text: Ascribe to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> the glory he manifests:<l eID="gen1107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1108"/>bow to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in holy array.<l eID="gen1108" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1104"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1109"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1110"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:3
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice peals on the waters.<l eID="gen1110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1111"/>The God of glory has thundered.<l eID="gen1111" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1112"/>He peals o’er the mighty waters.<l eID="gen1112" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1113"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:4
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice sounds with strength,<l eID="gen1113" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1114"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice sounds with majesty.<l eID="gen1114" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1109"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1115"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1116"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:5
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice breaks the cedars,<l eID="gen1116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1117"/>he breaks the cedars of Lebanon,<l eID="gen1117" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:6
verses.text: making Lebanon dance like a calf,<l eID="gen1118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1119"/>Sirion like a young wild ox.<l eID="gen1119" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1115"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1120"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1121"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:7
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice hews out flames of fire.<l eID="gen1121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:8
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice rends the desert,<l eID="gen1122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1123"/>he rends the desert of Kadesh.<l eID="gen1123" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1120"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1124"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:9
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s voice whirls the oaks,<l eID="gen1125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1126"/>and strips the forests bare;<l eID="gen1126" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1127"/>and all in his temple say “Glory.”<l eID="gen1127" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1124"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1128"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:10
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> was king at the flood,<l eID="gen1129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1130"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> sits throned forever.<l eID="gen1130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:11
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> gives strength to his people,<l eID="gen1131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1132"/>he blesses his people with peace.<l eID="gen1132" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1128"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.29"/> <div eID="gen1103" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv30"/><div sID="gen1133" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 30</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David. A song for the dedication of the Temple.</title> <lg sID="gen1134"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv30"/> I will extol you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1135" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1136"/>because you have lifted me up,<l eID="gen1136" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1137"/>and not suffered my foes to rejoice over me.<l eID="gen1137" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen1134"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1138"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:2
verses.text: I cried to you for help,<l eID="gen1139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1140"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God, and you healed me.<l eID="gen1140" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:3
verses.text: You have brought me up, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, from Sheol,<l eID="gen1141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1142"/>from my way to the pit back to life you have called me.<l eID="gen1142" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1138"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1143"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:4
verses.text: Sing praise to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, faithful people;<l eID="gen1144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1145"/>give thanks to his holy name.<l eID="gen1145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1146"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:5
verses.text: For his anger lasts only a moment,<l eID="gen1146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1147"/>his favour endures for a lifetime.<l eID="gen1147" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1148"/>Weeping may lodge for the night,<l eID="gen1148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1149"/>but the morning brings shouts of joy.<l eID="gen1149" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1143"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1150"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1151"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:6
verses.text: When all went well, I imagined<l eID="gen1151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1152"/>that never should I be shaken.<l eID="gen1152" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1153"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:7
verses.text: For by your favour, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1154"/>you had set me on mountains strong:<l eID="gen1154" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1155"/>but you hide your face,<l eID="gen1155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1156"/>and I was confounded.<l eID="gen1156" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1150"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1157"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1158"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:8
verses.text: Then to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I cried,<l eID="gen1158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1159"/>to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I begged for mercy,<l eID="gen1159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1160"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:9
verses.text: “What profit is there in my blood,<l eID="gen1160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1161"/>if I go down to the pit?<l eID="gen1161" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1162"/>Can you be praised by dust?<l eID="gen1162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1163"/>Can it tell of your faithfulness?<l eID="gen1163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1164"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:10
verses.text: Hear, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and show me your favour,<l eID="gen1164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1165"/><divineName>Lord</divineName> be a helper to me.”<l eID="gen1165" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1157"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1166"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1167"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:11
verses.text: You have turned my mourning to dancing;<l eID="gen1167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1168"/>my sackcloth you have unloosed,<l eID="gen1168" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1169"/>and clothed me with joy:<l eID="gen1169" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1170"/>that unceasingly I should sing your praise,<l eID="gen1170" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1171"/>and give thanks to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God, forever.<l eID="gen1171" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1166"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.30"/> <div eID="gen1133" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv31"/><div sID="gen1172" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 31</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1173"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv31"/> In you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I take refuge;<l eID="gen1174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1175"/>let me never be put to shame.<l eID="gen1175" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1176"/>Rescue me in your faithfulness;<l eID="gen1176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1177"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:2
verses.text: incline to me your ear.<l eID="gen1177" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1178"/>Deliver me speedily.<l eID="gen1178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1179"/>Be to me a rock of defence,<l eID="gen1179" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1180"/>a fortified house, to save me.<l eID="gen1180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1181"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:3
verses.text: For my rock and my fortress are you;<l eID="gen1181" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1182"/>lead me and guide me so your name will be honoured.<l eID="gen1182" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1183"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:4
verses.text: Draw me out of the net they have hid for me,<l eID="gen1183" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1184"/>for you yourself are my refuge.<l eID="gen1184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1185"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:5
verses.text: Into your hand I commend my spirit:<l eID="gen1185" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1186"/>you ransom me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, faithful God.<l eID="gen1186" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1187"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:6
verses.text: I hate those devoted to worthless idols;<l eID="gen1187" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1188"/>I trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1188" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1189"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:7
verses.text: I will rejoice and be glad in your love,<l eID="gen1189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1190"/>because you have looked on my misery,<l eID="gen1190" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1191"/>and cared for me in my distress.<l eID="gen1191" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1192"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:8
verses.text: You have not given me into the enemy’s hand,<l eID="gen1192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1193"/>you have set my feet in a spacious place.<l eID="gen1193" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1173"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1194"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1195"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:9
verses.text: Be gracious to me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for I am distressed;<l eID="gen1195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1196"/>my eye is wasted away with sorrow.<l eID="gen1196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:10
verses.text: For my life is consumed with grief,<l eID="gen1197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1198"/>and my years with sighing.<l eID="gen1198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1199"/>My strength is broken with misery,<l eID="gen1199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1200"/>my bones waste away.<l eID="gen1200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:11
verses.text: The scorn of all my foes,<l eID="gen1201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1202"/>the butt of my neighbours am I,<l eID="gen1202" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1203"/>a terror to my acquaintance.<l eID="gen1203" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1204"/>At the sight of me in the street<l eID="gen1204" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1205"/>people turn quickly away.<l eID="gen1205" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1206"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:12
verses.text: I am clean forgotten like the dead,<l eID="gen1206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1207"/>am become like a ruined vessel.<l eID="gen1207" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1208"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:13
verses.text: I hear the whispers of many ---<l eID="gen1208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1209"/>terror on every side ---<l eID="gen1209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1210"/>scheming together against me,<l eID="gen1210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1211"/>plotting to take my life.<l eID="gen1211" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1194"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1212"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1213"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:14
verses.text: But my trust is in you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1213" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1214"/>“You are my God,” I say;<l eID="gen1214" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1215"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:15
verses.text: my times are in your hand, save me<l eID="gen1215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1216"/>from the hand of the foes who pursue me.<l eID="gen1216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1217"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:16
verses.text: Make your face to shine on your servant,<l eID="gen1217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1218"/>save me in your love.<l eID="gen1218" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1219"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:17
verses.text: Put me not, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to shame,<l eID="gen1219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1220"/>for I have called upon you.<l eID="gen1220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1221"/>Let the wicked be put to shame<l eID="gen1221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1222"/>silent in Sheol.<l eID="gen1222" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1223"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:18
verses.text: Strike the false lips dumb,<l eID="gen1223" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1224"/>that speak proudly against the righteous<l eID="gen1224" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1225"/>with haughtiness and contempt.<l eID="gen1225" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1212"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1226"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1227"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:19
verses.text: How great is the goodness<l eID="gen1227" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1228"/>you have treasured for those who fear you,<l eID="gen1228" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1229"/>and wrought for those who take refuge in you,<l eID="gen1229" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1230"/>in plain sight of all!<l eID="gen1230" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1231"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:20
verses.text: In your sheltering wings you hide them<l eID="gen1231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1232"/>from plottings of people,<l eID="gen1232" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1233"/>you keep them safe in a bower<l eID="gen1233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1234"/>from the chiding of tongues.<l eID="gen1234" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1226"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1235"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1236"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:21
verses.text: Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen1236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1237"/>for the wonderful love he has shown me<l eID="gen1237" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1238"/>in time of distress.<l eID="gen1238" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1239"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:22
verses.text: For I had said in panic,<l eID="gen1239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1240"/>“I am driven clean out of your sight.”<l eID="gen1240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1241"/>But you heard my plea,<l eID="gen1241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1242"/>when I cried to you for help.<l eID="gen1242" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1235"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1243"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1244"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:23
verses.text: Love the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, all you faithful;<l eID="gen1244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1245"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> protects the loyal,<l eID="gen1245" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1246"/>but repays the haughty in full.<l eID="gen1246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1247"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:24
verses.text: Let your hearts be courageous and strong,<l eID="gen1247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1248"/>all you who wait on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1248" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1243"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.31"/> <div eID="gen1172" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv32"/><div sID="gen1249" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 32</title> <title type="psalm">Of David. A maskil.</title> <lg sID="gen1250"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv32"/> Happy those whose transgression is pardoned,<l eID="gen1251" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1252"/>whose sin is covered.<l eID="gen1252" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1253"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: Happy are those, free from falseness of spirit,<l eID="gen1253" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1254"/>to whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName> reckons no debt of guilt.<l eID="gen1254" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1250"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1255"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1256"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: When I held my peace, my bones wore away<l eID="gen1256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1257"/>with my endless groaning;<l eID="gen1257" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1258"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: for day and night did your hand<l eID="gen1258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1259"/>lie heavy upon me.<l eID="gen1259" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1260"/>The sap of my life was dried up<l eID="gen1260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1261"/>as with fierce summer-heat. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen1261" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1255"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1262"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1263"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: I began to acknowledge my sin,<l eID="gen1263" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1264"/>not concealing my guilt;<l eID="gen1264" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1265"/>and the moment I vowed to confess<l eID="gen1265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1266"/>to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> my transgression,<l eID="gen1266" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1267"/>then you yourself did pardon<l eID="gen1267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1268"/>the guilt of my sin. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen1268" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1262"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1269"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1270"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: For this cause let all who are faithful<l eID="gen1270" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1271"/>pray to you in the time of distress;<l eID="gen1271" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1272"/>then, when the great waters rush,<l eID="gen1272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1273"/>they will not reach to him.<l eID="gen1273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1274"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: For you are my shelter,<l eID="gen1274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1275"/>you protect me from trouble,<l eID="gen1275" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1276"/>and surround me with deliverance. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen1276" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1269"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1277"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1278"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: “With my eye steadfastly upon you,<l eID="gen1278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1279"/>I will instruct and teach you<l eID="gen1279" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1280"/>The way you should go.<l eID="gen1280" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1281"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: Do not be like the horse or the mule,<l eID="gen1281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1282"/>that have no understanding,<l eID="gen1282" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1283"/>but need bridle and halter to curb them,<l eID="gen1283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1284"/>else they will not come near to you.”<l eID="gen1284" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1277"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1285"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1286"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: The godless have many sorrows,<l eID="gen1286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1287"/>but those who trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen1287" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1288"/>will be compassed about by his kindness.<l eID="gen1288" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1289"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: Be glad in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and rejoice, you righteous;<l eID="gen1289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1290"/>and ring out your joy, all you upright in heart.<l eID="gen1290" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1285"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.32"/> <div eID="gen1249" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv33"/><div sID="gen1291" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 33</title> <lg sID="gen1292"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv33"/> Shout for joy in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you righteous:<l eID="gen1293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1294"/>praise for the upright is seemly.<l eID="gen1294" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1295"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:2
verses.text: Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> on the lyre,<l eID="gen1295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1296"/>play to him on a ten-stringed harp.<l eID="gen1296" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1297"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:3
verses.text: Sing to him a new song,<l eID="gen1297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1298"/>play skilfully and shout merrily.<l eID="gen1298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1299"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:4
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is straight in his promise;<l eID="gen1299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1300"/>and all that he does is in faithfulness.<l eID="gen1300" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1301"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:5
verses.text: Justice and right he loves;<l eID="gen1301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1302"/>the earth is full of his kindness.<l eID="gen1302" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1292"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1303"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1304"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:6
verses.text: By his word the heavens were made,<l eID="gen1304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1305"/>all their host by the breath of his mouth.<l eID="gen1305" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1306"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:7
verses.text: He gathers the sea in a bottle,<l eID="gen1306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1307"/>the ocean he puts into store-houses.<l eID="gen1307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1308"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:8
verses.text: Let the whole world honour the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1309"/>let all who live on earth be in awe.<l eID="gen1309" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1310"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:9
verses.text: For at his word it came into being,<l eID="gen1310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1311"/>at his command it stood forth.<l eID="gen1311" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1303"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1313"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:10
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> frustrates the designs of the nations,<l eID="gen1313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1314"/>what the peoples have purposed, he brings to nought,<l eID="gen1314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1315"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:11
verses.text: but the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s own design will stand forever,<l eID="gen1315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1316"/>and what his heart has purposed, through all generations.<l eID="gen1316" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1317"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:12
verses.text: Happy the nation whose God is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1318"/>the people he chose for himself as his own.<l eID="gen1318" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1312"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1319"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1320"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:13
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> looks down from heaven,<l eID="gen1320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1321"/>he sees all of humanity;<l eID="gen1321" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1322"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:14
verses.text: from where he rules he gazes<l eID="gen1322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1323"/>on all who inhabit the earth.<l eID="gen1323" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1324"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:15
verses.text: He fashions the hearts of them all,<l eID="gen1324" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1325"/>and gives heed to all that they do.<l eID="gen1325" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1319"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1326"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1327"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:16
verses.text: It is not by great armies that kings are victorious,<l eID="gen1327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1328"/>it is not by great strength that a warrior saves himself;<l eID="gen1328" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1329"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:17
verses.text: false hope is the war-horse to usher in victory,<l eID="gen1329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1330"/>for all its great might it can provide no escape.<l eID="gen1330" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1326"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1331"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1332"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:18
verses.text: See! The eye of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is on those who fear him,<l eID="gen1332" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1333"/>on those who hope in his kindness;<l eID="gen1333" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1334"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:19
verses.text: to deliver their life from death,<l eID="gen1334" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1335"/>and to keep them alive in famine.<l eID="gen1335" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1331"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1336"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1337"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:20
verses.text: We wait for the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen1337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1338"/>he is our help and our shield.<l eID="gen1338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1339"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:21
verses.text: For in him our heart is glad,<l eID="gen1339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1340"/>we trust in his holy name.<l eID="gen1340" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1336"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1341"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1342"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:22
verses.text: Let your kindness, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, be upon us,<l eID="gen1342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1343"/>as is our hope in you.<l eID="gen1343" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1341"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.33"/> <div eID="gen1291" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv34"/><div sID="gen1344" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 34</title> <title type="psalm">Of David, when he feigned madness in the presence of Abimelech, who drove him away, and he left.</title> <lg sID="gen1345"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv34"/> I will bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName> at all times,<l eID="gen1346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1347"/>in my mouth will his praise be forever.<l eID="gen1347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1348"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:2
verses.text: In the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will my heart make her boast,<l eID="gen1348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1349"/>the humble will hear and be glad.<l eID="gen1349" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1350"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:3
verses.text: O magnify the <divineName>Lord</divineName> with me<l eID="gen1350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1351"/>and let us extol his name together.<l eID="gen1351" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1352"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:4
verses.text: I sought the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and, in answer,<l eID="gen1352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1353"/>he saved me from all my terrors.<l eID="gen1353" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1354"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:5
verses.text: Look to him and you will be radiant,<l eID="gen1354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1355"/>with faces unashamed.<l eID="gen1355" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1356"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:6
verses.text: Here is one who was crushed,<l eID="gen1356" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1357"/>but cried --- and was heard by the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1357" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1358"/>and brought safe out of every trouble.<l eID="gen1358" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1359"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:7
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s angel encamps<l eID="gen1359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1360"/>about those who fear him, and rescues them.<l eID="gen1360" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1361"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:8
verses.text: O taste and see that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is good,<l eID="gen1361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1362"/>happy are those who take refuge in him!<l eID="gen1362" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1363"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:9
verses.text: Fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, all his people,<l eID="gen1363" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1364"/>for they who fear him lack nothing.<l eID="gen1364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1365"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:10
verses.text: Even young lions may be poor and hungry,<l eID="gen1365" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1366"/>but those who seek the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen1366" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1367"/>will not lack any good thing.<l eID="gen1367" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1345"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1368"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1369"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:11
verses.text: Come, children, listen to me.<l eID="gen1369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1370"/>I will teach you the fear of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1370" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1371"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:12
verses.text: Which of you is desirous of life,<l eID="gen1371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1372"/>loves many and happy days?<l eID="gen1372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1373"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:13
verses.text: Then guard your tongue from evil,<l eID="gen1373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1374"/>and your lips from speaking deceit.<l eID="gen1374" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1375"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:14
verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good;<l eID="gen1375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1376"/>seek peace, and pursue it.<l eID="gen1376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1377"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:15
verses.text: The eyes of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> are towards the righteous,<l eID="gen1379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1380"/>his ears are towards their cry for help.<l eID="gen1380" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1381"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:16
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> sets his face against those who do evil,<l eID="gen1377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1378"/>to root their memory out of the earth.<l eID="gen1378" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1379"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:17
verses.text: When they cry, they are heard by the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1382"/>and he saves them from all their distresses.<l eID="gen1382" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1383"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:18
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is near to the broken-hearted,<l eID="gen1383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1384"/>he helps those whose spirit is crushed.<l eID="gen1384" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1385"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:19
verses.text: Many misfortunes befall the righteous,<l eID="gen1385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1386"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> delivers them out of them all.<l eID="gen1386" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1387"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:20
verses.text: He guards all their bones,<l eID="gen1387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1388"/>not one of them is broken.<l eID="gen1388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1389"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:21
verses.text: Misfortune will slay the ungodly;<l eID="gen1389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1390"/>those who hate the righteous are doomed.<l eID="gen1390" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1391"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:22
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> ransoms the life of his servants,<l eID="gen1391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1392"/>and none will be doomed who takes refuge in him.<l eID="gen1392" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1368"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.34"/> <div eID="gen1344" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv35"/><div sID="gen1393" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 35</title> <title type="psalm">Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1394"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv35"/> Contend, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, with those who contend with me,<l eID="gen1395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1396"/>do battle with those who do battle with me.<l eID="gen1396" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1397"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:3
verses.text: Grasp shield and buckler,<l eID="gen1397" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1398"/>and rise up as my help.<l eID="gen1398" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1399"/>  Draw spear and battle-axe,<l eID="gen1399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1400"/>confront those who pursue me.<l eID="gen1400" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1401"/>Assure me that you will help me.<l eID="gen1401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1402"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:4
verses.text: Dishonour and shame be on those<l eID="gen1402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1403"/>who are seeking my life!<l eID="gen1403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1404"/>Defeat and confusion on those<l eID="gen1404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1405"/>who are planning my hurt!<l eID="gen1405" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1406"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:5
verses.text: As chaff before wind may they be,<l eID="gen1406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1407"/>with the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s angel pursuing them.<l eID="gen1407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1408"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:6
verses.text: Slippery and dark be their way,<l eID="gen1408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1409"/>with his angel thrusting them on.<l eID="gen1409" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:7
verses.text: For they wantonly hid their net for me,<l eID="gen1410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1411"/>and dug a pit to destroy me.<l eID="gen1411" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1394"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1412"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1413"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:8
verses.text: Upon them may ruin come unawares;<l eID="gen1413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1414"/>may the net which they hid catch themselves,<l eID="gen1414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1415"/>and into the pit may they fall.<l eID="gen1415" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1416"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:9
verses.text: Then I will exult in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1416" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1417"/>and be joyful because of his help;<l eID="gen1417" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1418"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:10
verses.text: and all my being will say,<l eID="gen1418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1419"/>“Who, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, is like you,<l eID="gen1419" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1420"/>who save the helpless from those too strong for them,<l eID="gen1420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1421"/>the poor and the helpless from those who despoil them?”<l eID="gen1421" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1412"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1422"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1423"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:11
verses.text: Violent witnesses rise,<l eID="gen1423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1424"/>and ask of me things that I know not.<l eID="gen1424" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1425"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:12
verses.text: Evil for good they requite me,<l eID="gen1425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1426"/>leaving me inwardly comfortless.<l eID="gen1426" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1422"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1427"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1428"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:13
verses.text: But when <hi type="italic">they</hi> were sick, <hi type="italic">I</hi> put on sackcloth,<l eID="gen1428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1429"/>and chastened myself with fasting.<l eID="gen1429" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1430"/>I prayed with head bowed low,<l eID="gen1430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1431"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:14
verses.text: as if for my friend or my brother.<l eID="gen1431" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1432"/>I went about bowed and in mourning,<l eID="gen1432" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1433"/>as one who laments his mother.<l eID="gen1433" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1427"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1434"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1435"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:15
verses.text: When I stumbled, they gleefully gathered,<l eID="gen1435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1436"/>strangers gathered around me,<l eID="gen1436" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1437"/>and tore at me without ceasing,<l eID="gen1437" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1438"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:16
verses.text: impiously mocking and mocking,<l eID="gen1438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1439"/>bearing their teeth at me.<l eID="gen1439" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1434"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1440"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1441"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:17
verses.text: How long, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, will you look on?<l eID="gen1441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1442"/>Rescue me from their roaring,<l eID="gen1442" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1443"/>my precious life from the lions.<l eID="gen1443" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1444"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:18
verses.text: I will then give you thanks in the great congregation,<l eID="gen1444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1445"/>and praise you before many people.<l eID="gen1445" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1446"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:19
verses.text: Suffer not those to rejoice over me<l eID="gen1446" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1447"/>who are falsely my foes,<l eID="gen1447" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1448"/>suffer not those who without cause abhor me<l eID="gen1448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1449"/>to wink with the eye.<l eID="gen1449" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1440"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1450"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1451"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:20
verses.text: For it is not peace that they speak<l eID="gen1451" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1452"/>of those who are quiet in the land;<l eID="gen1452" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1453"/>but treacherous charges they plot.<l eID="gen1453" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1454"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:21
verses.text: With wide open mouths they shout,<l eID="gen1454" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1455"/>“Hurrah! Hurrah!<l eID="gen1455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1456"/>With our own eyes we saw it.”<l eID="gen1456" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1450"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1457"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1458"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:22
verses.text: But you have seen, too, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1458" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1459"/>keep not silence, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1459" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1460"/>be not far from me.<l eID="gen1460" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1461"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:23
verses.text: Bestir you, awake, for my right<l eID="gen1461" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1462"/>my God, my <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for my cause.<l eID="gen1462" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1457"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1463"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1464"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:24
verses.text: You are just, <divineName>Lord</divineName>: win for me justice,<l eID="gen1464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1465"/>let them not rejoice over me,<l eID="gen1465" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1466"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:25
verses.text: inwardly saying, “Hurrah!<l eID="gen1466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1467"/>The desire of our hearts at last!<l eID="gen1467" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1468"/>Now we have swallowed him up.”<l eID="gen1468" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1469"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:26
verses.text: Shame and confusion together<l eID="gen1469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1470"/>on those who rejoice at my hurt!<l eID="gen1470" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1471"/>Clothed with shame and dishonour<l eID="gen1471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1472"/>be those who are haughty to me!<l eID="gen1472" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1463"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1473"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1474"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:27
verses.text: Let such as delight in my cause<l eID="gen1474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1475"/>ring out their gladness,<l eID="gen1475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1476"/>and say evermore,<l eID="gen1476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1477"/>“Great is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> whose delight<l eID="gen1477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1478"/>is the well-being of his servant.”<l eID="gen1478" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1479"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:28
verses.text: Then my tongue will tell of your justice,<l eID="gen1479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1480"/>and all the day long of your praise.<l eID="gen1480" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1473"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.35"/> <div eID="gen1393" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv36"/><div sID="gen1481" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 36</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of the servant of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1482"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv36"/> Sin whispers within heart of the wicked,<l eID="gen1483" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1484"/>who have no dread of God before their eyes.<l eID="gen1484" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1485"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:2
verses.text: It flatters them in their eyes<l eID="gen1485" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1486"/>that their sin will not be found out.<l eID="gen1486" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1482"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1487"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1488"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:3
verses.text: First, their speech becomes wicked and false,<l eID="gen1488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1489"/>they give up acting wisely and well.<l eID="gen1489" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1490"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:4
verses.text: Then they plot deliberate wrong,<l eID="gen1490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1491"/>take their stand on the wicked way,<l eID="gen1491" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1492"/>without the least shrinking from evil.<l eID="gen1492" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1487"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1493"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1494"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:5
verses.text: Your love, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, touches the heavens,<l eID="gen1494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1495"/>your faithfulness reaches the clouds.<l eID="gen1495" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1496"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:6
verses.text: Your justice is like the great mountains,<l eID="gen1496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1497"/>your judgments are like the broad sea.<l eID="gen1497" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1498"/><divineName>Lord</divineName>, you save people and animals.<l eID="gen1498" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1499"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:7
verses.text: How precious your love, O God!<l eID="gen1499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1500"/>All may seek shelter in the shadow of your wings.<l eID="gen1500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1501"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:8
verses.text: They feast on the fat of your house,<l eID="gen1501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1502"/>they drink of your brook of delights.<l eID="gen1502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1503"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:9
verses.text: For with you is the fountain of life,<l eID="gen1503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1504"/>in the light that is yours we see light.<l eID="gen1504" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1493"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1505"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1506"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:10
verses.text: O continue your grace to the faithful,<l eID="gen1506" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1507"/>your love to the upright in heart.<l eID="gen1507" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1508"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:11
verses.text: Let no arrogant foot tread upon me,<l eID="gen1508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1509"/>no wicked hand drive me to exile.<l eID="gen1509" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1505"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1510"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1511"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:12
verses.text: There the workers of wrong lie prostrate,<l eID="gen1511" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1512"/>thrust down to rise up no more.<l eID="gen1512" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1510"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.36"/> <div eID="gen1481" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
