verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv37"/><div sID="gen1513" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 37</title> <title type="psalm">Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1514"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv37"/> Be not kindled to wrath at the wicked,<l eID="gen1515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1516"/>nor envious of those who work wrong;<l eID="gen1516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1517"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: for, like grass, they will speedily wither,<l eID="gen1517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1518"/>and fade like the green of young grass.<l eID="gen1518" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1514"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1519"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1520"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: Trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and do good;<l eID="gen1520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1521"/>remain in the land, and deal faithfully:<l eID="gen1521" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1522"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: then the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will be your delight,<l eID="gen1522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1523"/>he will grant you your heart’s petitions.<l eID="gen1523" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1519"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1524"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1525"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: Commit your way to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen1525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1526"/>trust in him, and he will act,<l eID="gen1526" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1527"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: making clear as the light your right,<l eID="gen1527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1528"/>and your just cause clear as the noon-day.<l eID="gen1528" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1524"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1529"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1530"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: In silence and patience wait on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1530" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1531"/>Be not kindled to anger at those who prosper.<l eID="gen1531" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1532"/>At those who execute evil devices.<l eID="gen1532" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1529"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1533"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1534"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: Desist from anger, abandon wrath:<l eID="gen1534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1535"/>be not kindled to anger it leads but to evil:<l eID="gen1535" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1536"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: for evildoers will be cut off,<l eID="gen1536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1537"/>but the land will be theirs, who wait on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1537" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1533"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1538"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1539"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: Yet but a little, and the wicked vanish:<l eID="gen1539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1540"/>look at their place: they are there no more.<l eID="gen1540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1541"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: But the humble will have the land,<l eID="gen1541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1542"/>and the rapture of peace in abundance.<l eID="gen1542" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1538"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1543"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1544"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: The wicked plots against the righteous,<l eID="gen1544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1545"/>snarls like a wild animal;<l eID="gen1545" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1546"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: the <divineName>Lord</divineName> laughs,<l eID="gen1546" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1547"/>for he sees that his day is coming.<l eID="gen1547" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1543"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1548"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1549"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: The wicked have drawn the sword, and bent the bow,<l eID="gen1549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1550"/>to fell the poor, to slay those who walk uprightly;<l eID="gen1550" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1551"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: but their sword will pierce their own heart,<l eID="gen1551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1552"/>and their bows will be broken in pieces.<l eID="gen1552" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1548"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1553"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1554"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: Better is the righteous person’s little<l eID="gen1554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1555"/>than the wealth of many wicked.<l eID="gen1555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1556"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken,<l eID="gen1556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1557"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> upholds the righteous.<l eID="gen1557" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1553"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1558"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1559"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> watches over the days of the blameless,<l eID="gen1559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1560"/>their heritage will continue forever.<l eID="gen1560" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1561"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: They will not be shamed in the evil time,<l eID="gen1561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1562"/>in the days of famine they will be satisfied.<l eID="gen1562" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1558"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1563"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1564"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: Because the wicked will perish:<l eID="gen1564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1565"/>but the foes of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, like a brand in the oven,<l eID="gen1565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1566"/>will vanish, like smoke they will vanish.<l eID="gen1566" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1563"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1567"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1568"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: The wicked must borrow and cannot pay back,<l eID="gen1568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1569"/>but the righteous is lavish and gives.<l eID="gen1569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1570"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: For those blest by the <divineName>Lord</divineName> inherit the land,<l eID="gen1570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1571"/>while those whom he curses will be cut off.<l eID="gen1571" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1567"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1572"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1573"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> supports the steps<l eID="gen1573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1574"/>of those with whom he is pleased.<l eID="gen1574" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1575"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:24
verses.text: Though they fall, they will not be cast headlong,<l eID="gen1575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1576"/>for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> holds their hands.<l eID="gen1576" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1572"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1577"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1578"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:25
verses.text: Never, from youth to age,<l eID="gen1578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1579"/>have I seen the righteous forsaken,<l eID="gen1579" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1580"/>or their children begging bread.<l eID="gen1580" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1581"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:26
verses.text: They are ever lavishly lending,<l eID="gen1581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1582"/>and their children are fountains of blessing.<l eID="gen1582" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1577"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1583"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1584"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:27
verses.text: Turn away from evil and do good<l eID="gen1584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1585"/>and you will live in the land forever.<l eID="gen1585" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1586"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:28
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> loves justice,<l eID="gen1586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1587"/>he does not forsake his friends.<l eID="gen1587" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1583"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1588"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1589"/>The unrighteous will be destroyed forever,<l eID="gen1589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1590"/>and the seed of the wicked will be cut off.<l eID="gen1590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1591"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:29
verses.text: But the land will belong to the righteous,<l eID="gen1591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1592"/>they will live upon it forever,<l eID="gen1592" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1588"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1593"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1594"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:30
verses.text: The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom,<l eID="gen1594" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1595"/>and words of justice are on their tongues.<l eID="gen1595" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1596"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:31
verses.text: The law of their God is in their heart,<l eID="gen1596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1597"/>their steps are never unsteady.<l eID="gen1597" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1593"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1598"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1599"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:32
verses.text: The wicked watches the righteous,<l eID="gen1599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1600"/>and seeks to put them to death.<l eID="gen1600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1601"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:33
verses.text: But the <divineName>Lord</divineName> leaves them not in their hand:<l eID="gen1601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1602"/>at their trial they will not be held guilty.<l eID="gen1602" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1598"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1603"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1604"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:34
verses.text: Wait on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and observe his way:<l eID="gen1604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1605"/>he will lift you to honour the land will be yours,<l eID="gen1605" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1606"/>you will feast your eyes on the doom of the wicked.<l eID="gen1606" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1603"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1607"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1608"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:35
verses.text: I have seen the wicked exultant,<l eID="gen1608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1609"/>lifting themselves like a cedar of Lebanon.<l eID="gen1609" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1610"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:36
verses.text: But the moment I passed, they vanished!<l eID="gen1610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1611"/>I sought for them, but they could not be found.<l eID="gen1611" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1607"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1612"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1613"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:37
verses.text: Preserve your honour and practise uprightness,<l eID="gen1613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1614"/>for such a person fares well in the end.<l eID="gen1614" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1615"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:38
verses.text: But transgressors will perish together.<l eID="gen1615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1616"/>Cut off are the wicked forever.<l eID="gen1616" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1612"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1617"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1618"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:39
verses.text: The righteous are saved by the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1618" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1619"/>who in time of distress is their refuge:<l eID="gen1619" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1620"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:40
verses.text: the <divineName>Lord</divineName> helps and rescue them,<l eID="gen1620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1621"/>from the wicked he rescues and saves them,<l eID="gen1621" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1622"/>because they take refuge in him.<l eID="gen1622" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1617"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.37"/> <div eID="gen1513" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv38"/><div sID="gen1623" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 38</title> <title type="psalm">A Psalm of David. A lament.</title> <lg sID="gen1624"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv38"/> Reprove me not, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in your anger,<l eID="gen1625" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1626"/>and chasten me not in your wrath;<l eID="gen1626" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1627"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:2
verses.text: for your arrows have sunk into me,<l eID="gen1627" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1628"/>and your hand lies heavy upon me.<l eID="gen1628" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1624"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1629"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1630"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:3
verses.text: In my flesh is no soundness<l eID="gen1630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1631"/>because of your anger,<l eID="gen1631" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1632"/>no health in my bones,<l eID="gen1632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1633"/>because of my sin.<l eID="gen1633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1634"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:4
verses.text: For that my guilt<l eID="gen1634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1635"/>is gone over my head:<l eID="gen1635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1636"/>it weighs like a burden<l eID="gen1636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1637"/>too heavy for me.<l eID="gen1637" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1629"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1638"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1639"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:5
verses.text: My wounds stink and fester,<l eID="gen1639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1640"/>for my foolishness I am tormented.<l eID="gen1640" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1641"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:6
verses.text: Bent and bowed am I utterly,<l eID="gen1641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1642"/>all the day going in mourning.<l eID="gen1642" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1638"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1643"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1644"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:7
verses.text: My loins are filled with burning,<l eID="gen1644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1645"/>and in my flesh is no soundness.<l eID="gen1645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1646"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:8
verses.text: I am utterly crushed and numb;<l eID="gen1646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1647"/>I cry louder than lion roars.<l eID="gen1647" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1643"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1648"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1649"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:9
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you know all that I long for,<l eID="gen1649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1650"/>my groans are not hidden from you.<l eID="gen1650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1651"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:10
verses.text: My heart is throbbing,<l eID="gen1651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1652"/>my strength has failed me.<l eID="gen1652" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1653"/>The light of my eyes---<l eID="gen1653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1654"/>even it is gone from me.<l eID="gen1654" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1648"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1655"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1656"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:11
verses.text: My dear ones and friends keep aloof,<l eID="gen1656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1657"/>and my neighbours stand afar off.<l eID="gen1657" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1658"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:12
verses.text: They who aim at my life lay their snares,<l eID="gen1658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1659"/>they who seek my hurt speak of ruin,<l eID="gen1659" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1660"/>nursing treachery all the day long.<l eID="gen1660" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1655"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1661"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1662"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:13
verses.text: But I turn a deaf ear and hear not;<l eID="gen1662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1663"/>like the dumb I open not my mouth.<l eID="gen1663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1664"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:14
verses.text: I am like one without hearing,<l eID="gen1664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1665"/>with no arguments in their mouth.<l eID="gen1665" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1661"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1666"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1667"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:15
verses.text: For my hope, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, is in you.<l eID="gen1667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1668"/>You will answer, O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God,<l eID="gen1668" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1669"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:16
verses.text: when I utter the hope that those<l eID="gen1669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1670"/>who made scorn of my tottering feet<l eID="gen1670" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1671"/>may not rejoice over me.<l eID="gen1671" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1666"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1672"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1673"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:17
verses.text: For I am ready to fall,<l eID="gen1673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1674"/>my pain forsakes me never.<l eID="gen1674" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1675"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:18
verses.text: I acknowledge my guilt,<l eID="gen1675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1676"/>I am anxious because of my sin:<l eID="gen1676" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1672"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1677"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1678"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:19
verses.text: My wanton assailants are strong,<l eID="gen1678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1679"/>those who wrongfully hate me are many,<l eID="gen1679" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1680"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:20
verses.text: who render me evil for good,<l eID="gen1680" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1681"/>and oppose me, because I make good my goal.<l eID="gen1681" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1677"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1682"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1683"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:21
verses.text: Do not forsake me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen1683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1684"/>my God, be not far from me.<l eID="gen1684" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1685"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:22
verses.text: Hasten to help me,<l eID="gen1685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1686"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my saviour.<l eID="gen1686" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1682"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.38"/> <div eID="gen1623" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv39"/><div sID="gen1687" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 39</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1688"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv39"/> I vowed to watch my words,<l eID="gen1689" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1690"/>and sin not with my tongue,<l eID="gen1690" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1691"/>but to put on my mouth a muzzle,<l eID="gen1691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1692"/>while the wicked were in my presence.<l eID="gen1692" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1693"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:2
verses.text: I was silent and dumb,<l eID="gen1693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1694"/>speechless:<l eID="gen1694" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1695"/>but my pain was stirred up.<l eID="gen1695" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1696"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:3
verses.text: My heart grew hot within me;<l eID="gen1696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1697"/>as I mused, the fire was kindled,<l eID="gen1697" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1698"/>till at last the words came to my tongue.<l eID="gen1698" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1688"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1699"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1700"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:4
verses.text: “Teach me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my end,<l eID="gen1700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1701"/>and the sum of my days what it is.<l eID="gen1701" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1702"/>Let me know how transient I am.<l eID="gen1702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1703"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:5
verses.text: See! My days you have made but a span,<l eID="gen1703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1704"/>and my life is as nothing before you.<l eID="gen1704" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1705"/>It is but as a breath that everyone stands: <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen1705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1706"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:6
verses.text: it is but in mere semblance we walk to and fro,<l eID="gen1706" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1707"/>and all our noise is for nothing.<l eID="gen1707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1708"/>We heaps up, and knows not who will gather.”<l eID="gen1708" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1699"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1709"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1710"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:7
verses.text: And now, what wait I for, <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen1710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1711"/>My hope is in you.<l eID="gen1711" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1712"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:8
verses.text: From all my transgressions deliver me;<l eID="gen1712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1713"/>make me not the scorn of the fool.<l eID="gen1713" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1714"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:9
verses.text: I am dumb, never opening my mouth,<l eID="gen1714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1715"/>for this is your own doing.<l eID="gen1715" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1716"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:10
verses.text: Remove your stroke from off me:<l eID="gen1716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1717"/>by the might of your hand I am spent.<l eID="gen1717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1718"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:11
verses.text: When you rebuke someone to punish their sins,<l eID="gen1718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1719"/>you consume, like a moth, what they treasure.<l eID="gen1719" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1720"/>Everyone is only a breath. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen1720" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1709"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1721"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1722"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:12
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen1722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1723"/>attend to my cry for help.<l eID="gen1723" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1724"/>Hold not your peace at my tears.<l eID="gen1724" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1725"/>For I am but a guest of yours,<l eID="gen1725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1726"/>a stranger visiting, like all my ancestors.<l eID="gen1726" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1727"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: Look away from me, let me smile again,<l eID="gen1727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1728"/>before I die and am gone.<l eID="gen1728" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1721"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.39"/> <div eID="gen1687" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv40"/><div sID="gen1729" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 40</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1730"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv40"/> For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I waited and waited,<l eID="gen1731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1732"/>till, inclining to me,<l eID="gen1732" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1733"/>he heard my cry.<l eID="gen1733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1734"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: From the horrible pit he drew me,<l eID="gen1734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1735"/>up out of the miry clay;<l eID="gen1735" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1736"/>he set my feet on a rock,<l eID="gen1736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1737"/>and my steps he made firm.<l eID="gen1737" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1738"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: He put a new song in my mouth,<l eID="gen1738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1739"/>of praise to our God.<l eID="gen1739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1740"/>Many see it, and, filled with awe,<l eID="gen1740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1741"/>put their trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1741" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1730"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1742"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1743"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: Happy the person who has put<l eID="gen1743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1744"/>in the <divineName>Lord</divineName> their trust,<l eID="gen1744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1745"/>not looking to false gods<l eID="gen1745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1746"/>or turning to idols.<l eID="gen1746" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: With us you have wrought in rich measure,<l eID="gen1747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1748"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God,<l eID="gen1748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1749"/>your marvels and purposes for us ---<l eID="gen1749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1750"/>none may compare with you ---<l eID="gen1750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1751"/>were I to declare or to tell them,<l eID="gen1751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1752"/>past counting are they.<l eID="gen1752" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1742"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1753"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1754"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: In offerings bloody or bloodless<l eID="gen1754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1755"/>you have no delight,<l eID="gen1755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1756"/>but with open ears you have made me.<l eID="gen1756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1757"/>Burnt-offering and offering for sin<l eID="gen1757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1758"/>are not what you ask.<l eID="gen1758" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1759"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: Then said I, “Here I am,<l eID="gen1759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1760"/>as the roll of the book has enjoined.<l eID="gen1760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1761"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: My delight, O God, is to do your will,<l eID="gen1761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1762"/>and your law is within my heart.”<l eID="gen1762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1763"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: Well, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you know<l eID="gen1763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1764"/>that, with lips unrestrained,<l eID="gen1764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1765"/>your righteousness I told<l eID="gen1765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1766"/>in the great congregation,<l eID="gen1766" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1767"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: not hiding it in my heart.<l eID="gen1767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1768"/>I have told of your steadfast help,<l eID="gen1768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1769"/>from the great congregation I hid not<l eID="gen1769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1770"/>your love and your faithfulness.<l eID="gen1770" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1771"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: So do not restrain, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen1771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1772"/>your pity from us.<l eID="gen1772" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1773"/>Your love and your faithfulness --- ever<l eID="gen1773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1774"/>may they be our shield.<l eID="gen1774" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1753"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1775"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1776"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: For evils that cannot be numbered<l eID="gen1776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1777"/>have compassed me round.<l eID="gen1777" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1778"/>My transgressions have followed me up ---<l eID="gen1778" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1779"/>I can bear it no more.<l eID="gen1779" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1780"/>They are more than the hairs of my head,<l eID="gen1780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1781"/>and my heart has forsaken me.<l eID="gen1781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1782"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, be pleased to deliver me,<l eID="gen1782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1783"/>haste to my help, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen1783" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1784"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: May those who are seeking my life<l eID="gen1784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1785"/>be ashamed and confounded together;<l eID="gen1785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1786"/>may those who delight in my hurt<l eID="gen1786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1787"/>be defeated and brought to dishonour.<l eID="gen1787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1788"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: May those who hurrah over me<l eID="gen1788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1789"/>be dumbfounded because of their shame.<l eID="gen1789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1790"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: But may all who seek after you<l eID="gen1790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1791"/>rejoice and be glad in you.<l eID="gen1791" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1792"/>May all those eager for your aid,<l eID="gen1792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1793"/>say, “Great is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>” evermore.<l eID="gen1793" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1794"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: I am weak and needy,<l eID="gen1794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1795"/>yet the <divineName>Lord</divineName> cares for me.<l eID="gen1795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1796"/>You are my help and deliverer;<l eID="gen1796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1797"/>don’t delay, my God.<l eID="gen1797" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1775"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.40"/> <div eID="gen1729" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv41"/><div sID="gen1798" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 41</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen1799"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv41"/> Happy are those who consider the weak;<l eID="gen1800" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1801"/>in the day of misfortune the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will deliver them.<l eID="gen1801" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1802"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: He will keep them safe, happy, and long in the land,<l eID="gen1802" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1803"/>and not give them up to the rage of their foes.<l eID="gen1803" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1804"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> will sustain them on bed of languishing;<l eID="gen1804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1805"/>tending their sickness, as long as they lie.<l eID="gen1805" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1799"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1806"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1807"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: For this cause I say, “<divineName>Lord</divineName>, show me your favour;<l eID="gen1807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1808"/>heal me, because I have sinned against you.”<l eID="gen1808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1809"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: My enemies speak of me nothing but evil,<l eID="gen1809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1810"/>“When will he die, and his name pass away?”<l eID="gen1810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1811"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: When they comes to see me, their words ring hollow;<l eID="gen1811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1812"/>their hearts keep gathering mischief the while;<l eID="gen1812" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1813"/>and when they go out, they give it speech.<l eID="gen1813" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1814"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: In secret they whisper together against me,<l eID="gen1814" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1815"/>all those who hate me plot evil against me.<l eID="gen1815" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1816"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: “Some fatal disease has fastened upon him;<l eID="gen1816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1817"/>and now that he lies, he will rise up no more.”<l eID="gen1817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1818"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: My most trusted friend, on whom I relied,<l eID="gen1818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1819"/>who ate of my bread, has turned against me.<l eID="gen1819" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1806"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1820"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1821"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: But do you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, graciously raise me up,<l eID="gen1821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1822"/>that I may pay them their due reward.<l eID="gen1822" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1823"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: By this will I know you delight in me:<l eID="gen1823" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1824"/>if my foes may not shout over me in triumph.<l eID="gen1824" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1825"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: For my innocence you uphold me,<l eID="gen1825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1826"/>and set me forever before your face.<l eID="gen1826" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1820"/> <lb/> <lb/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1827"/> <l level="3" sID="gen1828"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:13
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Blessed be the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the God of Israel,</hi><l eID="gen1828" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen1829"/><hi type="italic">from everlasting to everlasting,</hi><l eID="gen1829" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen1830"/><hi type="italic">Amen and Amen.</hi><l eID="gen1830" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen1827"/>  <div eID="gen1798" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Ps.41"/> <div eID="gen2" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv42"/><div sID="gen1832" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 42</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A maskil of the Korahites.</title> <lg sID="gen1833"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv42"/> Like the hart which longs<l eID="gen1834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1835"/>for brooks of water,<l eID="gen1835" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1836"/>I long<l eID="gen1836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1837"/>for you, God.<l eID="gen1837" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1833"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1838"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1839"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: I thirst for God,<l eID="gen1839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1840"/>for my living God.<l eID="gen1840" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1841"/>When shall I enter in,<l eID="gen1841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1842"/>and see the face of God?<l eID="gen1842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1843"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: My tears have been my food<l eID="gen1843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1844"/>by day and by night;<l eID="gen1844" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1845"/>for they say to me all the day long,<l eID="gen1845" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1846"/>“Where is your God?”<l eID="gen1846" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1838"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1847"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1848"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: My heart floods with sorrow,<l eID="gen1848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1849"/>as I call to mind:<l eID="gen1849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1850"/>how I used to pass on with the throng,<l eID="gen1850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1851"/>at their head, to the house of God,<l eID="gen1851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1852"/>with glad shouts and giving of thanks,<l eID="gen1852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1853"/>in the throng who kept festival.<l eID="gen1853" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1847"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1854"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1855"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: Why am I downcast?<l eID="gen1855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1856"/>Why this moaning within me?<l eID="gen1856" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1857"/>Hope in God;<l eID="gen1857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1858"/>for yet will I praise him,<l eID="gen1858" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1859"/>my help, my God.<l eID="gen1859" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1854"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1860"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1861"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:6
verses.text: I am sunk in my misery;<l eID="gen1861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1862"/>I will therefore call you to mind<l eID="gen1862" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1863"/>from the land of Jordan and Hermon,<l eID="gen1863" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1864"/>the mountain Mizar.<l eID="gen1864" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1865"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:7
verses.text: Flood is calling to flood<l eID="gen1865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1866"/>at the noise of your cataracts;<l eID="gen1866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1867"/>all your waves and your breakers<l eID="gen1867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1868"/>have passed over me.<l eID="gen1868" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1860"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1869"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1870"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:8
verses.text: In the day I cry to the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen1870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1871"/>to summon his kindness;<l eID="gen1871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1872"/>and the song that I sing in the night<l eID="gen1872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1873"/>is a prayer to the living God.<l eID="gen1873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1874"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:9
verses.text: I say to God my rock,<l eID="gen1874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1875"/>“Why have you forgotten me?<l eID="gen1875" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1876"/>Why must I walk so sadly,<l eID="gen1876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1877"/>so hard pressed by the foe?”<l eID="gen1877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1878"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:10
verses.text: It pierces me to the heart<l eID="gen1878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1879"/>to hear the enemy’s taunts,<l eID="gen1879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1880"/>as all the day long they say to me,<l eID="gen1880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1881"/>“Where is your God?”<l eID="gen1881" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1869"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1882"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1883"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:11
verses.text: Why am I downcast?<l eID="gen1883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1884"/>Why this moaning within me?<l eID="gen1884" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1885"/>Hope in God;<l eID="gen1885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1886"/>for yet will I praise him,<l eID="gen1886" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1887"/>my help, my God.<l eID="gen1887" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1882"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.42"/> <div eID="gen1832" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv43"/><div sID="gen1888" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 43</title> <lg sID="gen1889"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv43"/> Right me, defend my cause<l eID="gen1890" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1891"/>against a pitiless people.<l eID="gen1891" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1892"/>From the crafty and crooked,<l eID="gen1892" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1893"/>O God, deliver me.<l eID="gen1893" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1894"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: For you are God my protector:<l eID="gen1894" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1895"/>why have you cast me off?<l eID="gen1895" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1896"/>Why must I walk so sadly,<l eID="gen1896" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1897"/>so hard pressed by the foe?<l eID="gen1897" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1898"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: Send forth your light and your truth,<l eID="gen1898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1899"/>let them be my guides:<l eID="gen1899" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1900"/>to your holy hill let them bring me,<l eID="gen1900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1901"/>to the place where you live.<l eID="gen1901" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1902"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: Then will I go to God’s altar,<l eID="gen1902" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1903"/>to God my rejoicing;<l eID="gen1903" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1904"/>and with joy on the lyre I will praise you,<l eID="gen1904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1905"/>O God, my God.<l eID="gen1905" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1889"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1906"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1907"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: Why am I downcast?<l eID="gen1907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1908"/>Why this moaning within me?<l eID="gen1908" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1909"/>Hope in God;<l eID="gen1909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1910"/>for yet will I praise him,<l eID="gen1910" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1911"/>my help, my God.<l eID="gen1911" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1906"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.43"/> <div eID="gen1888" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv44"/><div sID="gen1912" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 44</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of the Korahites. A maskil.</title> <lg sID="gen1913"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv44"/> O God, we have heard with our ears,<l eID="gen1914" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1915"/>our ancestors have told us<l eID="gen1915" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1916"/>of the work that you wrought in their day,<l eID="gen1916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1917"/>your wonders in days of old,<l eID="gen1917" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1918"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: uprooting and crushing the nations,<l eID="gen1918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1919"/>then planting and settling them.<l eID="gen1919" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1920"/>For it wasn’t their own sword that won them the land,<l eID="gen1920" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1921"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: it was not their own arm that brought them the victory.<l eID="gen1921" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1922"/>Yours was the hand and the arm,<l eID="gen1922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1923"/>yours was the face that shone on them with favour.<l eID="gen1923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1924"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: It was you, my king and my God,<l eID="gen1924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1925"/>that ordained the victories of Jacob.<l eID="gen1925" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1913"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1926"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1927"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: Through you we can thrust back our foes,<l eID="gen1927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1928"/>and by your name tread down our assailants:<l eID="gen1928" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1929"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: for not in my bow do I trust,<l eID="gen1929" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1930"/>nor can my sword win me the victory.<l eID="gen1930" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1931"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: Our victory comes from you,<l eID="gen1931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1932"/>and confusion to those who hate us.<l eID="gen1932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1933"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: In God we boast all the day long,<l eID="gen1933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1934"/>and your name will we praise forever. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen1934" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1926"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1935"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1936"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: Yet you have spurned and disgraced us,<l eID="gen1936" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1937"/>in not going forth with our armies,<l eID="gen1937" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1938"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: and in making us flee from the foe,<l eID="gen1938" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1939"/>so that those who hated us plundered us.<l eID="gen1939" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1940"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: You have let us be eaten like sheep,<l eID="gen1940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1941"/>you have scattered us over the world,<l eID="gen1941" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1942"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: sold your people for a pittance,<l eID="gen1942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1943"/>and getting no gain from their price.<l eID="gen1943" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1944"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: You have made us the butt of our neighbours,<l eID="gen1944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1945"/>the derision and scorn of all round us.<l eID="gen1945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1946"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: O’er the world you have made us a byword,<l eID="gen1946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1947"/>the nations at us shake their heads.<l eID="gen1947" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1948"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: My disgrace is forever before me,<l eID="gen1948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1949"/>my face is covered with shame,<l eID="gen1949" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1950"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: at the words of blasphemer and scoffer,<l eID="gen1950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1951"/>at the sight of the foe and the vengeful.<l eID="gen1951" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1935"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1952"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1953"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: All this has come upon us,<l eID="gen1953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1954"/>yet we have not forgotten you<l eID="gen1954" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1955"/>nor falsely dealt with your covenant.<l eID="gen1955" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1956"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: Our heart has not turned back,<l eID="gen1956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1957"/>nor our steps declined from your way,<l eID="gen1957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1958"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:19
verses.text: that you thus should have crushed us down,<l eID="gen1958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1959"/>and covered us over with gloom,<l eID="gen1959" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1960"/>in the place where the jackals roam.<l eID="gen1960" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1961"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:20
verses.text: Had we forgotten the name of our God,<l eID="gen1961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1962"/>or stretched out our hands to a god that was strange,<l eID="gen1962" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1963"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:21
verses.text: would God not have searched this out?<l eID="gen1963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1964"/>For he knows the heart and its secrets.<l eID="gen1964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1965"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:22
verses.text: But in your cause it is we are killed all the day,<l eID="gen1965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1966"/>and counted as sheep for the slaughter.<l eID="gen1966" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1952"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1967"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1968"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:23
verses.text: Rouse yourself, why do you sleep Lord?<l eID="gen1968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1969"/>Awake, cast us not off forever.<l eID="gen1969" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1970"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:24
verses.text: Why do you hide your face,<l eID="gen1970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1971"/>forgetting our stress and our misery?<l eID="gen1971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1972"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:25
verses.text: For we have sunk down to the dust,<l eID="gen1972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1973"/>our bodies cling to the ground.<l eID="gen1973" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1974"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: Arise, come to our help:<l eID="gen1974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1975"/>for your love’s sake, ransom us.<l eID="gen1975" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1967"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.44"/> <div eID="gen1912" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv45"/><div sID="gen1976" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 45</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; on shoshannim. Of the Korahites. A maskil. A love song.</title> <lg sID="gen1977"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv45"/> My heart is astir with beautiful words:<l eID="gen1978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1979"/>I will sing a song, concerning the king,<l eID="gen1979" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1980"/>with tongue like the pen of a ready writer.<l eID="gen1980" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen1977"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1981"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1982"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: Your beauty is more than mortal,<l eID="gen1982" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1983"/>grace is shed over your lips:<l eID="gen1983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1984"/>therefore God has blessed you forever.<l eID="gen1984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1985"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: Warrior, strap your sword on your thigh.<l eID="gen1985" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1986"/>What glory and splendour!<l eID="gen1986" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen1981"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1987"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1988"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: Good fortune attend you, as forth you ride<l eID="gen1988" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1989"/>in the cause of good faith, and as champion of justice.<l eID="gen1989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1990"/>May your arm instruct you in deeds of dread.<l eID="gen1990" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1991"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: Sharp are your arrows; nations fall under you:<l eID="gen1991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1992"/>pierced to the heart are the foes of the king.<l eID="gen1992" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1987"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1993"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1994"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: Your throne shall endure for ever and ever<l eID="gen1994" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1995"/>your royal sceptre a sceptre of equity.<l eID="gen1995" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1996"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: Right you love and wrong you hate:<l eID="gen1996" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1997"/>therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName> your God anoints you<l eID="gen1997" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen1998"/>With oil of gladness above your fellows.<l eID="gen1998" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1993"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen1999"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2000"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: With myrrh, aloes, and cassia your robes are all fragrant,<l eID="gen2000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2001"/>you are gladdened by music of ivory harps.<l eID="gen2001" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2002"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: King’s daughters stand ready with jewels for you,<l eID="gen2002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2003"/>at your right hand the queen in gold of Ophir.<l eID="gen2003" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen1999"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2004"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2005"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: Listen, daughter, and see; and incline your ear:<l eID="gen2005" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2006"/>forget your folk and your father’s house.<l eID="gen2006" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2007"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: And when the king desires your beauty,<l eID="gen2007" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2008"/>bow to him, for he is your lord.<l eID="gen2008" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2009"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: So shall the Tyrians come with gifts,<l eID="gen2009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2010"/>and the richest of people will do you homage.<l eID="gen2010" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2004"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2011"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2012"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:13
verses.text: The king’s daughter is glorious altogether,<l eID="gen2012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2013"/>with dress of pearls inwrought with gold.<l eID="gen2013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2014"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:14
verses.text: In many-coloured robes she is led to the king,<l eID="gen2014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2015"/>with the virgin companions she brought in her train.<l eID="gen2015" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2016"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:15
verses.text: The king’s palace they enter with joy and rejoicing.<l eID="gen2016" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2011"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2017"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2018"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:16
verses.text: May sons of yours take the place of your fathers,<l eID="gen2018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2019"/>whom you will make princes in all the land.<l eID="gen2019" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2020"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:17
verses.text: Your name will I celebrate world without end,<l eID="gen2020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2021"/>so that nations shall praise you for ever and ever.<l eID="gen2021" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2017"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.45"/> <div eID="gen1976" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv46"/><div sID="gen2022" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 46</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of the Korahites, on alamoth. A song.</title> <lg sID="gen2023"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv46"/> God is our refuge and strength,<l eID="gen2024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2025"/>a very present help in trouble.<l eID="gen2025" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2026"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: So we have no fear, though earth should change,<l eID="gen2026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2027"/>and the hills totter into the heart of the ocean.<l eID="gen2027" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2028"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: Let its waters roar and foam,<l eID="gen2028" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2029"/>let the mountains shake with the swelling thereof.<l eID="gen2029" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2030"/>On our side is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen2030" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2031"/>our sure defence is the God of Jacob. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2031" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2023"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2032"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2033"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: A river there is, whose streams make glad<l eID="gen2033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2034"/>God’s city, the home the Most High has hallowed.<l eID="gen2034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2035"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: God is within her: she cannot be shaken.<l eID="gen2035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2036"/>God helps her at the turn of the morning.<l eID="gen2036" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2037"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: Nations roared, kingdoms tottered:<l eID="gen2037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2038"/>he uttered his voice, earth melted away.<l eID="gen2038" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2039"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: On our side is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen2039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2040"/>our sure defence is the God of Jacob.<l eID="gen2040" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2032"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2042"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: Come and see what the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has done,<l eID="gen2042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2043"/>working appallingly in the earth.<l eID="gen2043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2044"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: He stills wars to the ends of the earth-<l eID="gen2044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2045"/>breaking the bow, snapping the spear,<l eID="gen2045" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2046"/>burning the chariots in the fire.<l eID="gen2046" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2047"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: “Refrain; and know surely that I am God,<l eID="gen2047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2048"/>high over the nations, high over the world.”<l eID="gen2048" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2049"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: On our side is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of Hosts,<l eID="gen2049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2050"/>our sure defence is the God of Jacob. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2050" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2041"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.46"/> <div eID="gen2022" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv47"/><div sID="gen2051" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 47</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of the Korahites. A psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen2052"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv47"/> Clap your hands, all you peoples:<l eID="gen2053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2054"/>shout to God in ringing cries.<l eID="gen2054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2055"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is most high and dread,<l eID="gen2055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2056"/>a great king over all the earth.<l eID="gen2056" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2052"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2058"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: He subdues the peoples under us,<l eID="gen2058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2059"/>the nations under our feet;<l eID="gen2059" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2060"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: he chooses our heritage for us,<l eID="gen2060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2061"/>the glory of Jacob whom he loves. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2061" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2057"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2062"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2063"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: God is gone up with a shout,<l eID="gen2063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2064"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> with the sound of a trumpet.<l eID="gen2064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2065"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: Sing praise to our God, sing praises:<l eID="gen2065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2066"/>sing praise to our king, sing praises.<l eID="gen2066" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2062"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2067"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2068"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: For king of all earth is he:<l eID="gen2068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2069"/>praise God in a skilful song.<l eID="gen2069" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2070"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: God is king over all the nations,<l eID="gen2070" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2071"/>God sits on his holy throne.<l eID="gen2071" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2067"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2072"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2073"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: Princes of nations gather<l eID="gen2073" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2074"/>with the people of Abraham’s God:<l eID="gen2074" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2075"/>for the shields of the earth are God’s;<l eID="gen2075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2076"/>greatly exalted is he.<l eID="gen2076" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2072"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.47"/> <div eID="gen2051" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv48"/><div sID="gen2077" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 48</title> <title type="psalm">A song. A psalm of the Korahites.</title> <lg sID="gen2078"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv48"/> Great is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> and worthy all praise<l eID="gen2079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2080"/>in the city of our God.<l eID="gen2080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2081"/>His holy mountain,<l eID="gen2081" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2078"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: that rises so fair, <lg sID="gen2082"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2083"/>is the joy of all the world.<l eID="gen2083" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2084"/>Like the mount of the gods is Mount Zion,<l eID="gen2084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2085"/>the city of the great king.<l eID="gen2085" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2082"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2086"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2087"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: Once God made himself known<l eID="gen2087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2088"/>as the defence of her palaces.<l eID="gen2088" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2089"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: For see! A concert of kings<l eID="gen2089" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2090"/>passed over the frontier together.<l eID="gen2090" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2091"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: But one glance, and they were astounded;<l eID="gen2091" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2092"/>they hastened away in dismay.<l eID="gen2092" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2093"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: Trembling took hold of them there,<l eID="gen2093" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2094"/>like the pains of a woman in labour.<l eID="gen2094" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2095"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: They were shattered, as east wind shatters<l eID="gen2095" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2096"/>the giant ships in pieces.<l eID="gen2096" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2097"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: What we heard, we now have seen<l eID="gen2097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2098"/>in the city of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen2098" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2099"/>the city of our God.<l eID="gen2099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2100"/>God will uphold her forever. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2100" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2086"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2101"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: We think, O God, of your love,<l eID="gen2102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2103"/>in the midst of your temple.<l eID="gen2103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: Your fame, O God, like your name, shall extend<l eID="gen2104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2105"/>to the ends of the earth.<l eID="gen2105" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2106"/>Victory fills your hand.<l eID="gen2106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: Let mount Zion be glad;<l eID="gen2107" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2108"/>let the daughters of Judah rejoice<l eID="gen2108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2109"/>because of your judgments.<l eID="gen2109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2110"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: Walk about Zion, go round her;<l eID="gen2110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2111"/>count her towers.<l eID="gen2111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2112"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: Set your mind on her ramparts,<l eID="gen2112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2113"/>consider her palaces;<l eID="gen2113" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2114"/>that you tell to the next generation<l eID="gen2114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2115"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: That such is God,<l eID="gen2115" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2116"/>our God he it is who shall guide us<l eID="gen2116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2117"/>for ever and ever.<l eID="gen2117" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2101"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.48"/> <div eID="gen2077" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv49"/><div sID="gen2118" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 49</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of the Korahites. A psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen2119"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv49"/> Hear this, you peoples all;<l eID="gen2120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2121"/>give ear, all you who live in the world<l eID="gen2121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: people of low degree and high,<l eID="gen2122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2123"/>the rich and the poor together.<l eID="gen2123" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2124"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: My mouth shall utter wisdom,<l eID="gen2124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2125"/>the thoughts of a seeing heart.<l eID="gen2125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
verses.text: I incline my ear to a proverb,<l eID="gen2126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2127"/>on the lyre I will open my riddle.<l eID="gen2127" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2119"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2128"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: Why should I be afraid in the days of misfortune,<l eID="gen2129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2130"/>when circled by wicked and cunning foes,<l eID="gen2130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: who put their trust in their wealth,<l eID="gen2131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2132"/>and boast of their boundless riches?<l eID="gen2132" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2128"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2133"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2134"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: For assuredly no one can ransom themselves,<l eID="gen2134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2135"/>or give to God the price of their life,<l eID="gen2135" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2136"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: for the ransom of a life is costly,<l eID="gen2136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2137"/>no payment is ever enough,<l eID="gen2137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: to keep them alive for ever and ever,<l eID="gen2138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2139"/>so as never to see the pit at all.<l eID="gen2139" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2133"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2140"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: But see it they shall. Even wise people die,<l eID="gen2141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2142"/>the fool and the brutish perish alike,<l eID="gen2142" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2143"/>and abandon their wealth to others.<l eID="gen2143" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: The grave is their everlasting home,<l eID="gen2144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2145"/>the place they shall live in for ever and ever,<l eID="gen2145" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2146"/>though after their own names they called whole lands.<l eID="gen2146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2147"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: Humans do not sustain their wealth,<l eID="gen2147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2148"/>like the beasts they perish.<l eID="gen2148" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2140"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2149"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2150"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: This is the fate of the confident fool,<l eID="gen2150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2151"/>and the end of those who are pleased with their portion. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2151" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2152"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: Like sheep they descend to Sheol<l eID="gen2152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2153"/>with Death for their shepherd;<l eID="gen2153" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2154"/>down they go straight to the grave,<l eID="gen2154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2155"/>and their form wastes away in their home below.<l eID="gen2155" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2149"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2156"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2157"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: But God will assuredly ransom my life<l eID="gen2157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2158"/>from the hand of Sheol;<l eID="gen2158" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2159"/>for he will receive me. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2160"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: So be not afraid when someone grows rich,<l eID="gen2160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2161"/>when the wealth of their house increases.<l eID="gen2161" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2162"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: Not a shred of it all can they take when they die,<l eID="gen2162" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2163"/>wealth cannot follow them down.<l eID="gen2163" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2164"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: Though they count themselves happy, when they are alive,<l eID="gen2164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2165"/>and win praise from people for faring so well,<l eID="gen2165" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2166"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: they must join their ancestors,<l eID="gen2166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2167"/>who see the light nevermore.<l eID="gen2167" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2168"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: Humans do not sustain their wealth,<l eID="gen2168" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2169"/>like the beasts they perish.<l eID="gen2169" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2156"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.49"/> <div eID="gen2118" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv50"/><div sID="gen2170" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 50</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen2171"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv50"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> God has spoken: He summons the earth<l eID="gen2172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2173"/>from sunrise to sunset.<l eID="gen2173" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2174"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: From Zion, perfection of beauty,<l eID="gen2174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2175"/>God’s glory shines forth.<l eID="gen2175" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2176"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: Our God comes, he cannot keep silence,<l eID="gen2176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2177"/>devouring fire is before him,<l eID="gen2177" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2178"/>and furious tempest around him.<l eID="gen2178" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2179"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: He summons the heavens above<l eID="gen2179" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2180"/>and the earth to judge his people.<l eID="gen2180" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2181"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: Gather to him his saints<l eID="gen2181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2182"/>by covenant-sacrifice bound to him;<l eID="gen2182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2183"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: that the heavens may declare his justice,<l eID="gen2183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2184"/>for a God of justice is he. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2184" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2171"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2185"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2186"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: “Hear, O my people, and I will speak,<l eID="gen2186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2187"/>and protest to you, O Israel:<l eID="gen2187" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2188"/>I am the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, your God.<l eID="gen2188" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2189"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: Not for your sacrifices will I reprove you<l eID="gen2189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2190"/>your burnt-offerings are ever before me<l eID="gen2190" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2191"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: Not a bullock will I take from your house,<l eID="gen2191" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2192"/>nor he-goats out of your folds;<l eID="gen2192" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2193"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: for all beasts of the forest are mine,<l eID="gen2193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2194"/>and the kine on a thousand hills.<l eID="gen2194" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2195"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: I know all the birds of the air,<l eID="gen2195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2196"/>all that moves on the fields is mine.<l eID="gen2196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: Were I hungry, I would not tell you,<l eID="gen2197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2198"/>for the world and its fulness are mine.<l eID="gen2198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2199"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: Am I such as to eat bulls’ flesh,<l eID="gen2199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2200"/>or drink the blood of goats?<l eID="gen2200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: Offer to God a thank-offering,<l eID="gen2201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2202"/>pay the Most High your vows.<l eID="gen2202" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2203"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: Summon me in the day of distress,<l eID="gen2203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2204"/>I will rescue you, so will you honour me.”<l eID="gen2204" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2185"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2205"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2206"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: But to the wicked God says:<l eID="gen2206" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2207"/>“What right have you to talk of my statutes,<l eID="gen2207" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2208"/>or take my covenant into your mouth<l eID="gen2208" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2209"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: While you yourself hate correction,<l eID="gen2209" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2210"/>and cast my words behind you?<l eID="gen2210" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2211"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: When you see a thief, you run with them;<l eID="gen2211" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2212"/>with adulterers you keep company.<l eID="gen2212" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2213"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: You let your mouth loose for evil,<l eID="gen2213" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2214"/>your tongue contrives deceit.<l eID="gen2214" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2215"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: You shamefully speak of your kin,<l eID="gen2215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2216"/>and slander your own mother's son.<l eID="gen2216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2217"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: And because I kept silence at this,<l eID="gen2217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2218"/>you did take me for one like yourself.<l eID="gen2218" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2219"/>But I will convict you and show you plainly.<l eID="gen2219" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2205"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2220"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2221"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:22
verses.text: Now you who forget God, mark this,<l eID="gen2221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2222"/>lest I rend you, past hope of deliverance.<l eID="gen2222" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2223"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:23
verses.text: Those who bring a thank-offering honour me;<l eID="gen2223" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2224"/>but to those who follow my way,<l eID="gen2224" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2225"/>I will show the salvation of God.”<l eID="gen2225" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2220"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.50"/> <div eID="gen2170" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv51"/><div sID="gen2226" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 51</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet come to him after he had been with Bathsheba.</title> <lg sID="gen2227"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv51"/> In your kindness, O God, be gracious to me,<l eID="gen2228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2229"/>in your own great pity blot out my transgressions.<l eID="gen2229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2230"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: Wash me clean of my guilt,<l eID="gen2230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2231"/>make me pure of my sin.<l eID="gen2231" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2227"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2232"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2233"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: For well I know my transgressions,<l eID="gen2233" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2234"/>my sin is ever before me.<l eID="gen2234" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2235"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: Against you, only you, have I sinned,<l eID="gen2235" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2236"/>and done that which is wrong in your sight:<l eID="gen2236" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2237"/>you therefore are just when you speak,<l eID="gen2237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2238"/>and clear when you utter judgment.<l eID="gen2238" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2239"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: See! In guilt was I brought to the birth,<l eID="gen2239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2240"/>and in sin did my mother conceive me.<l eID="gen2240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2241"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: It’s the innermost truth you desire,<l eID="gen2241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2242"/>give me therefore true wisdom of heart.<l eID="gen2242" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2232"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2243"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2244"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: Purge me clean with hyssop,<l eID="gen2244" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2245"/>wash me whiter than snow.<l eID="gen2245" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2246"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: Fill me with joy and gladness,<l eID="gen2246" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2247"/>let the bones you have broken rejoice.<l eID="gen2247" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2248"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: Hide your face from my sins,<l eID="gen2248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2249"/>and blot out my guilt altogether.<l eID="gen2249" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2243"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2250"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2251"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: Create me a clean heart, O God,<l eID="gen2251" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2252"/>put a new steadfast spirit within me.<l eID="gen2252" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2253"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: Cast me not forth from your presence,<l eID="gen2253" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2254"/>withdraw not your holy spirit.<l eID="gen2254" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2255"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: Give me back the joy of your help,<l eID="gen2255" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2256"/>with a willing spirit sustain me.<l eID="gen2256" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2250"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2257"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2258"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: I will teach your ways to transgressors,<l eID="gen2258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2259"/>and sinners shall turn to you.<l eID="gen2259" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2260"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: Save me from blood, O God,<l eID="gen2260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2261"/>and my tongue shall ring out your faithfulness.<l eID="gen2261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: Open my lips, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen2262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2263"/>and my mouth shall declare your praise.<l eID="gen2263" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2257"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2264"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2265"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: For in sacrifice you have no pleasure,<l eID="gen2265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2266"/>in gifts of burnt-offering no delight.<l eID="gen2266" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2267"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: The sacrifice pleasing to God<l eID="gen2267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2268"/>is a spirit that is broken;<l eID="gen2268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2269"/>a heart that is crushed, O God,<l eID="gen2269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2270"/>you will not despise.<l eID="gen2270" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2264"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2271"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2272"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: Do good in your pleasure to Zion,<l eID="gen2272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2273"/>build the walls of Jerusalem.<l eID="gen2273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2274"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
