verses.text: Then will you welcome the due forms of sacrifice,<l eID="gen2274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2275"/>then on your altars shall bullocks be offered.<l eID="gen2275" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2271"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.51"/> <div eID="gen2226" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv52"/><div sID="gen2276" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 52</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A maskil of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul that David had gone to Abimelech’s house.</title> <lg sID="gen2277"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv52"/> Why glory in mischief, man of power?<l eID="gen2278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2279"/>God’s kindness is all the day.<l eID="gen2279" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2280"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: Engulfing ruin you plot,<l eID="gen2280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2281"/>your tongue like a razor sharpened,<l eID="gen2281" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2282"/>you practiser of deceit.<l eID="gen2282" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2283"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: Evil, not good, you love,<l eID="gen2283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2284"/>and falsehood, not words of truth. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2284" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2285"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: But you love all words that devour,<l eID="gen2285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2286"/>and a tongue that is given to deceit.<l eID="gen2286" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2277"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2287"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2288"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: But God, on his part, shall destroy you forever,<l eID="gen2288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2289"/>grasp you and pluck you out of your tent,<l eID="gen2289" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2290"/>and root you out of the land of the living. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2290" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2291"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: Smitten with awe at the sight,<l eID="gen2291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2292"/>the righteous shall laugh at you.<l eID="gen2292" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2293"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: “Look” (they will say) “at the hero<l eID="gen2293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2294"/>who did not make God his stronghold,<l eID="gen2294" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2295"/>but trusted in his great wealth<l eID="gen2295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2296"/>and in the strength of his riches.”<l eID="gen2296" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2287"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2297"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2298"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:8
verses.text: But I am like a fresh olive-tree<l eID="gen2298" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2299"/>in the house of God.<l eID="gen2299" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2300"/>I trust in the kindness of God<l eID="gen2300" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2301"/>for ever and evermore.<l eID="gen2301" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2302"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:9
verses.text: I will render you thanks for ever<l eID="gen2302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2303"/>for what you have done.<l eID="gen2303" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2304"/>I will tell how good you are<l eID="gen2304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2305"/>in the presence of those who love you.<l eID="gen2305" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2297"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.52"/> <div eID="gen2276" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv53"/><div sID="gen2306" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 53</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On mahalath. A maskil of David.</title> <lg sID="gen2307"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv53"/> Fools say in their heart,<l eID="gen2308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2309"/>“There is no God.”<l eID="gen2309" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2310"/>Vile, hateful their life is;<l eID="gen2310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2311"/>not one does good.<l eID="gen2311" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2307"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2313"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: From heaven God looks out<l eID="gen2313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2314"/>on humans, to see<l eID="gen2314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2315"/>if any are wise,<l eID="gen2315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2316"/>and care for God.<l eID="gen2316" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2312"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2317"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2318"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: But all have turned bad,<l eID="gen2318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2319"/>the taint is on all;<l eID="gen2319" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2320"/>not one does good,<l eID="gen2320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2321"/>no, not one.<l eID="gen2321" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2317"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2322"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2323"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: Have they learned their lesson,<l eID="gen2323" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2324"/>those workers of evil?<l eID="gen2324" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2325"/>Who ate up my people,<l eID="gen2325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2326"/>eating, devouring,<l eID="gen2326" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2327"/>never calling to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen2327" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2322"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2328"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2329"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: Sore afraid will they be,<l eID="gen2329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2330"/>where no fear was;<l eID="gen2330" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2331"/>when God scatters the bones<l eID="gen2331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2332"/>of the godless people.<l eID="gen2332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2333"/>They will be put to shame,<l eID="gen2333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2334"/>when God rejects them.<l eID="gen2334" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2328"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2335"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2336"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: If only help from Zion<l eID="gen2336" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2337"/>would come for Israel!<l eID="gen2337" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2338"/>When God brings his people<l eID="gen2338" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2339"/>a change of fortune,<l eID="gen2339" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2340"/>how glad will be Jacob,<l eID="gen2340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2341"/>and Israel how joyful!<l eID="gen2341" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2335"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.53"/> <div eID="gen2306" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv54"/><div sID="gen2342" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 54</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, ‘David is in hiding among us’.</title> <lg sID="gen2343"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv54"/> Save me, O God, by your name,<l eID="gen2344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2345"/>by your power secure for me justice.<l eID="gen2345" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2346"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: Listen, O God, to my prayer,<l eID="gen2346" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2347"/>give ear to the words of my mouth.<l eID="gen2347" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2348"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: For proud men have risen against me,<l eID="gen2348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2349"/>and terrible men seek my life,<l eID="gen2349" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2350"/>men who do not set God before them. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2350" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2343"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2351"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2352"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: But see! God is my helper,<l eID="gen2352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2353"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is sustaining my life.<l eID="gen2353" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2354"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: Let their evil fall back on my foes:<l eID="gen2354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2355"/>cut them off in your faithfulness, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen2355" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2351"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2356"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2357"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: Then will I bring you glad sacrifice,<l eID="gen2357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2358"/>praising your gracious name;<l eID="gen2358" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2359"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
verses.text: for from all distress you have saved me,<l eID="gen2359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2360"/>and feasted my eyes on my foes.<l eID="gen2360" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2356"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.54"/> <div eID="gen2342" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv55"/><div sID="gen2361" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 55</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David.</title> <lg sID="gen2362"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv55"/> Listen, God, to my prayer.<l eID="gen2363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2364"/>Don’t hide yourself from my pleading.<l eID="gen2364" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2365"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: Hear me, and answer;<l eID="gen2365" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2366"/>for bitter is my lament.<l eID="gen2366" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2367"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: I am wild with the noise of the foe,<l eID="gen2367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2368"/>with the clamour of the ungodly;<l eID="gen2368" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2369"/>for they hurl disaster upon me,<l eID="gen2369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2370"/>and attack me with fury.<l eID="gen2370" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2371"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: My heart shudders within me,<l eID="gen2371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2372"/>terrors of deaths press on me,<l eID="gen2372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2373"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: fear and trembling attack me,<l eID="gen2373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2374"/>and horror wraps me round.<l eID="gen2374" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2375"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: O for the wings of a dove:<l eID="gen2375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2376"/>I would fly away and rest.<l eID="gen2376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2377"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: I would wander far away,<l eID="gen2377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2378"/>find refuge in the wilderness. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2378" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2379"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: I would find myself a shelter<l eID="gen2379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2380"/>from raging wind and tempest.<l eID="gen2380" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2362"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2381"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2382"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: Confuse them, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, upset their plans;<l eID="gen2382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2383"/>for I see violence and strife in the city.<l eID="gen2383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2384"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: By day and by night they make their rounds<l eID="gen2384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2385"/>on the city walls,<l eID="gen2385" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2386"/>while within is crime and trouble,<l eID="gen2386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2387"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
verses.text: within is ruin.<l eID="gen2387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2388"/>Her market-place is never free<l eID="gen2388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2389"/>of deceit and tyranny.<l eID="gen2389" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2381"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2390"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2391"/><hi type="italic">(The Treacherous Friend)</hi><l eID="gen2391" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen2390"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2392"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2393"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: The taunts were not those of a foe<l eID="gen2393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2394"/>that I could have borne;<l eID="gen2394" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2395"/>the disdain was not that of an enemy<l eID="gen2395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2396"/>I could have shunned them:<l eID="gen2396" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2397"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: but it was you, my equal,<l eID="gen2397" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2398"/>my dear and familiar friend.<l eID="gen2398" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2399"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:14
verses.text: We used to be so close,<l eID="gen2399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2400"/>together we walked in God’s house with the crowd.<l eID="gen2400" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2401"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:15
verses.text: May death suddenly take them,<l eID="gen2401" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2402"/>may they go down to Sheol alive,<l eID="gen2402" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2403"/>for evil lives in their homes and their hearts.<l eID="gen2403" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2392"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2404"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2405"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:16
verses.text: But I will call on God,<l eID="gen2405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2406"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will save me.<l eID="gen2406" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2407"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:17
verses.text: Evening and morning and noon<l eID="gen2407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2408"/>I lament and moan.<l eID="gen2408" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2409"/>He will hear my voice;<l eID="gen2409" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:18
verses.text: though I am attacked by many<l eID="gen2410" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2411"/>he will rescue me,<l eID="gen2411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2412"/>unharmed from the war.<l eID="gen2412" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2413"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:19
verses.text: God, who sits on his ancient throne<l eID="gen2413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2414"/>will hear and will humble them,<l eID="gen2414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2415"/>for they never change,<l eID="gen2415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2416"/>they never fear God. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2416" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2404"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2417"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2418"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:20
verses.text: My friend turned against me,<l eID="gen2418" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2419"/>betrayed his word.<l eID="gen2419" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2420"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:21
verses.text: His mouth was smoother than butter,<l eID="gen2420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2421"/>but war filled his heart.<l eID="gen2421" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2422"/>His words were softer than oil,<l eID="gen2422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2423"/>but sharper than swords.<l eID="gen2423" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2424"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:22
verses.text: Cast your burden on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen2424" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2425"/>and he will sustain you.<l eID="gen2425" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2426"/>He will never let the righteous<l eID="gen2426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2427"/>be shaken.<l eID="gen2427" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2428"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:23
verses.text: But you, God, will hurl them down<l eID="gen2428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2429"/>to the deepest pit.<l eID="gen2429" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2430"/>Bloody and treacherous people<l eID="gen2430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2431"/>will not live out half their days;<l eID="gen2431" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2432"/>but I will trust you.<l eID="gen2432" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2417"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.55"/> <div eID="gen2361" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv56"/><div sID="gen2433" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 56</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On jonath elem rehokim. Of David. A michtam, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.</title> <lg sID="gen2434"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv56"/> O God, be gracious to me,<l eID="gen2435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2436"/>for people trample upon me,<l eID="gen2436" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2437"/>all the day righting and pressing me.<l eID="gen2437" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2438"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: All the day enemies trample me;<l eID="gen2438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2439"/>many there be<l eID="gen2439" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2440"/>who contend with me bitterly.<l eID="gen2440" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2441"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: In the day of my terror<l eID="gen2441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2442"/>I trust in you.<l eID="gen2442" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2443"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: In God I maintain my cause,<l eID="gen2443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2444"/>in God I fearlessly trust.<l eID="gen2444" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2445"/>What can flesh do to me?<l eID="gen2445" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2434"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2446"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2447"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: They torture me all the day,<l eID="gen2447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2448"/>they ceaselessly plan to hurt me,<l eID="gen2448" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2449"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: banded together in secret,<l eID="gen2449" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2450"/>watching my every step,<l eID="gen2450" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2451"/>as those who hope for my death.<l eID="gen2451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2452"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: Pay them out for their sin, O God,<l eID="gen2452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2453"/>hurl down the strong in your anger.<l eID="gen2453" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2454"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: You yourself count my wanderings.<l eID="gen2454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2455"/>Put in your bottle my tears<l eID="gen2455" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2456"/>are they not in your book?<l eID="gen2456" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2457"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: Then shall my foes be turned back<l eID="gen2457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2458"/>in the day that I call.<l eID="gen2458" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2459"/>Of this I am sure,<l eID="gen2459" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2460"/>because God is for me.<l eID="gen2460" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2461"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: In God I maintain my cause,<l eID="gen2461" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2462"/>in the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I maintain my cause.<l eID="gen2462" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2463"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: In God I fearlessly trust,<l eID="gen2463" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2464"/>what can people do to me?<l eID="gen2464" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2446"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2465"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2466"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: Your vows are upon me, O God,<l eID="gen2466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2467"/>I will render thank-offerings to you;<l eID="gen2467" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2468"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:13
verses.text: because you have saved me from death,<l eID="gen2468" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2469"/>my feet from stumbling,<l eID="gen2469" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2470"/>to the end that I walk before God<l eID="gen2470" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2471"/>in the light of the living.<l eID="gen2471" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2465"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.56"/> <div eID="gen2433" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv57"/><div sID="gen2472" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 57</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Al tashheth. A michtam of David, when he fled from Saul into a cave.</title> <lg sID="gen2473"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv57"/> Be gracious, O God, be gracious to me,<l eID="gen2474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2475"/>for in you I take shelter.<l eID="gen2475" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2476"/>In your sheltering wings I take refuge,<l eID="gen2476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2477"/>till ruin be over past.<l eID="gen2477" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2478"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: I cry to the Most High God,<l eID="gen2478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2479"/>to the God who accomplishes for me.<l eID="gen2479" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2480"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: He will send me his succour from heaven,<l eID="gen2480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2481"/>he will thrust away those who would trample me. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2481" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2482"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: In the midst of lions I lie,<l eID="gen2482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2483"/>who devour human prey.<l eID="gen2483" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2484"/>Their teeth are spears and arrows,<l eID="gen2484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2485"/>and their tongue is a sharpened sword.<l eID="gen2485" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2486"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: Be exalted, God, o’er the heavens,<l eID="gen2486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2487"/>and your glory o’er all the earth.<l eID="gen2487" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2473"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2488"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2489"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: They set a net for my feet,<l eID="gen2489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2490"/>but in it was their own foot caught.<l eID="gen2490" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2491"/>Before me they dug a pit,<l eID="gen2491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2492"/>but they fell into it themselves. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2492" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2488"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2493"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2494"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: My heart is steadfast, O God,<l eID="gen2494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2495"/>my heart is steadfast.<l eID="gen2495" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2496"/>I would sing, I would make music;<l eID="gen2496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2497"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: awake, my soul.<l eID="gen2497" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2498"/>Awake, harp and lyre;<l eID="gen2498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2499"/>I would wake the dawn.<l eID="gen2499" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2500"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: I would praise you among the peoples, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen2500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2501"/>and make music among the nations to you;<l eID="gen2501" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2502"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: for great to heaven is your love,<l eID="gen2502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2503"/>and your faithfulness to the clouds.<l eID="gen2503" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2504"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: Be exalted, God, o’er the heavens,<l eID="gen2504" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2505"/>and your glory o’er all the earth.<l eID="gen2505" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2493"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.57"/> <div eID="gen2472" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv58"/><div sID="gen2506" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 58</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Al tashheth. Of David. A michtam.</title> <lg sID="gen2507"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv58"/> Do you speak what is right, you gods?<l eID="gen2508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2509"/>With equity judge you your people?<l eID="gen2509" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2510"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: In the land you practise iniquity --- all of you;<l eID="gen2510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2511"/>violence do you dispense with your hands.<l eID="gen2511" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2512"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: The wicked go astray from the womb<l eID="gen2512" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2513"/>liars take the wrong path from their birth.<l eID="gen2513" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2514"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: Venom have they like the venom of snakes,<l eID="gen2514" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2515"/>they are like the deaf adder that stops her ears,<l eID="gen2515" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2516"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: and refuses to listen to the voice of the charmer,<l eID="gen2516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2517"/>or binder of spells, no matter how cunning.<l eID="gen2517" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2507"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2518"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2519"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: O God, break to pieces the teeth in their mouth,<l eID="gen2519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2520"/>tear out the great teeth of the young lions, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen2520" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2521"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
verses.text: May they melt away like running water!<l eID="gen2521" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2522"/>Like tender grass, cut down may they be!<l eID="gen2522" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2523"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: Like the snail that dissolves on its crawling path,<l eID="gen2523" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2524"/>like the birth untimely which sees not the sunlight.<l eID="gen2524" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2525"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: Faster than a thorn-fire heats your pots,<l eID="gen2525" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2526"/>he will come with his tempest and sweep them away.<l eID="gen2526" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2527"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: The sight of such vengeance will gladden the righteous;<l eID="gen2527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2528"/>their feet they will wash in the blood of the wicked.<l eID="gen2528" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2529"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: People will say, “Yes, the just are rewarded:<l eID="gen2529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2530"/>yes, on the earth is a God who is judge.”<l eID="gen2530" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2518"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.58"/> <div eID="gen2506" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv59"/><div sID="gen2531" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 59</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Al tashheth. Of David. A michtam, when Saul sent men to watch his house in order to kill him.</title> <lg sID="gen2532"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv59"/> Save me, O God, from my enemies;<l eID="gen2533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2534"/>secure me from my assailants.<l eID="gen2534" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2535"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: Save me from those who do wrong,<l eID="gen2535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2536"/>save me from the bloodthisty.<l eID="gen2536" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2537"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: For see! They lay ambush for me,<l eID="gen2537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2538"/>strong men are banded against me<l eID="gen2538" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2539"/>not for sin or transgression of mine,<l eID="gen2539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2540"/>for no guilt of mine, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen2540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2541"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: they run and make ready. Awake!<l eID="gen2541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2542"/>Come forth to meet me, and see!<l eID="gen2542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2543"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: You, O <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen2543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2544"/>God of Israel, awake!<l eID="gen2544" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2545"/>And punish the proud, every one;<l eID="gen2545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2546"/>spare none of the traitors vile. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2546" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2532"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2547"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2548"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: At evening they come,<l eID="gen2548" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2549"/>and, howling like dogs,<l eID="gen2549" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2550"/>make their round in the city.<l eID="gen2550" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2551"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: Look at their venomous mouths,<l eID="gen2551" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2552"/>tongues like swords,<l eID="gen2552" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2553"/>they think no one<l eID="gen2553" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2554"/>hears them.<l eID="gen2554" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2555"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: But you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, laugh at them,<l eID="gen2555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2556"/>you mock all the insolent.<l eID="gen2556" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2557"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: My strength, I will sing to you,<l eID="gen2557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2558"/>for God is my sure retreat.<l eID="gen2558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2559"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: My God with his love will meet me,<l eID="gen2559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2560"/>and feast my eyes on my foes.<l eID="gen2560" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2547"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2561"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2562"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: Slay them not, lest my people forget,<l eID="gen2562" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2563"/>let your hosts keep them roaming and wandering.<l eID="gen2563" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2564"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: In their sinful speech snare them, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen2564" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2565"/>and may they be trapped in their pride,<l eID="gen2565" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2566"/>for the curses and lies that they utter.<l eID="gen2566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2567"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: In your wrath make a clean end of them,<l eID="gen2567" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2568"/>that people, to the ends of the earth,<l eID="gen2568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2569"/>may know that God rules in Jacob. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2569" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2561"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2570"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2571"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: At evening they come,<l eID="gen2571" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2572"/>and, howling like dogs,<l eID="gen2572" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2573"/>make their round in the city.<l eID="gen2573" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2574"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:15
verses.text: They roam about for a feast,<l eID="gen2574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2575"/>and snarl, if they get not their fill.<l eID="gen2575" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2576"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:16
verses.text: But I will sing of your might;<l eID="gen2576" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2577"/>I will ring out your love in the morning.<l eID="gen2577" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2578"/>For to me you have been a sure refuge,<l eID="gen2578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2579"/>a retreat in the day of my trouble.<l eID="gen2579" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2580"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:17
verses.text: My strength, I will sing praise to you,<l eID="gen2580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2581"/>for God is my sure retreat,<l eID="gen2581" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2582"/>my faithful God.<l eID="gen2582" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2570"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.59"/> <div eID="gen2531" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv60"/><div sID="gen2583" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 60</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On shushan eduth. A michtam of David (for teaching), when he fought with Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and defeated twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.</title> <lg sID="gen2584"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv60"/> O God, you have spurned and broken us,<l eID="gen2585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2586"/>routing us in your wrath --- restore us!<l eID="gen2586" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2587"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: You have shaken the land and cleft it;<l eID="gen2587" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2588"/>heal its tottering breaches.<l eID="gen2588" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2589"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: You have made your people drink hardship,<l eID="gen2589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2590"/>and given us wine of reeling.<l eID="gen2590" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2584"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2591"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2592"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: You have given those who fear you a banner,<l eID="gen2592" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2593"/>a rallying-place from the bow, <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2593" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2594"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: for the rescue of your beloved.<l eID="gen2594" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2595"/>Save by your right hand and answer us.<l eID="gen2595" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2591"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2596"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2597"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: God did solemnly swear:<l eID="gen2597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2598"/>“As victor will I divide Shechem,<l eID="gen2598" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2599"/>and mete out the valley of Succoth.<l eID="gen2599" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2600"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: Mine is Gilead, mine is Manasseh,<l eID="gen2600" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2601"/>Ephraim is the defence of my head,<l eID="gen2601" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2602"/>Judah my sceptre of rule,<l eID="gen2602" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2603"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: Moab the pot that I wash in,<l eID="gen2603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2604"/>Edom — I cast my shoe over it,<l eID="gen2604" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2605"/>I shout o’er Philistia in triumph.”<l eID="gen2605" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2596"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2606"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2607"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: O to be brought to the fortified city!<l eID="gen2607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2608"/>O to be led into Edom!<l eID="gen2608" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2609"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:10
verses.text: Have you not spurned us, O God?<l eID="gen2609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2610"/>You do not march forth with our armies.<l eID="gen2610" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2611"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:11
verses.text: Grant us help from the foe,<l eID="gen2611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2612"/>for human help is worthless.<l eID="gen2612" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2613"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:12
verses.text: With God we shall yet do bravely:<l eID="gen2613" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2614"/>he himself will tread down our foes.<l eID="gen2614" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2606"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.60"/> <div eID="gen2583" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv61"/><div sID="gen2615" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 61</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On stringed instruments. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen2616"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv61"/> Hear my cry, O God,<l eID="gen2617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2618"/>be attentive to my prayer.<l eID="gen2618" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2619"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: From the ends of the earth I call<l eID="gen2619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2620"/>unto you, when my heart is faint:<l eID="gen2620" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2621"/>lead me to the rock<l eID="gen2621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2622"/>that is high above me.<l eID="gen2622" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2623"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: For you are a refuge to me,<l eID="gen2623" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2624"/>a strong tower in face of the foe.<l eID="gen2624" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2616"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2625"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: O to be guest in your tent forever,<l eID="gen2626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2627"/>hiding beneath your sheltering wings! <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2628"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: For you, O God, do hear my vows,<l eID="gen2628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2629"/>and grant the desires of those who fear you.<l eID="gen2629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2630"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: Add many days to the life of the king;<l eID="gen2630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2631"/>may his years endure throughout all generations.<l eID="gen2631" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2632"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: In the presence of God be he throned forever;<l eID="gen2632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2633"/>may kindness and faithfulness watch over him.<l eID="gen2633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2634"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: And I will sing praise to your name forever,<l eID="gen2634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2635"/>paying my vows day after day.<l eID="gen2635" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2625"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.61"/> <div eID="gen2615" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv62"/><div sID="gen2636" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 62</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On jeduthun. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen2637"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv62"/> I wait alone in silence for God;<l eID="gen2638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2639"/>From him comes my help.<l eID="gen2639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2640"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: Yes, he is my rock, my help, my retreat,<l eID="gen2640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2641"/>I shall not be shaken too sorely.<l eID="gen2641" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2642"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: How long will you, all of you, batter a man,<l eID="gen2642" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2643"/>as one might a leaning wall?<l eID="gen2643" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2644"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: From his rank and prominance<l eID="gen2644" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2645"/>they are planning to topple him.<l eID="gen2645" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2646"/>They take pleasure in falsehood; they bless with their mouth,<l eID="gen2646" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2647"/>but inwardly they curse. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2647" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2637"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2648"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2649"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: I wait alone in silence for God;<l eID="gen2649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2650"/>for from him comes my hope.<l eID="gen2650" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2651"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: Yes, he is my rock, my help, my retreat,<l eID="gen2651" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2652"/>I shall not be shaken too sorely.<l eID="gen2652" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2653"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: On God rests my honour and safety,<l eID="gen2653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2654"/>in God is my strong rock, my refuge.<l eID="gen2654" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2655"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: Trust in him, all you people assembled,<l eID="gen2655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2656"/>pour out your heart in his presence;<l eID="gen2656" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2657"/>God is a refuge for us. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2657" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2648"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2658"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: The lowly are nought but a breath,<l eID="gen2659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2660"/>the lofty are but an illusion:<l eID="gen2660" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2661"/>in the balances up they go,<l eID="gen2661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2662"/>they are lighter than breath altogether.<l eID="gen2662" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2663"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: Trust not in gain of extortion,<l eID="gen2663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2664"/>set no vain hopes in robbery.<l eID="gen2664" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2665"/>As for wealth, if it bears fruit,<l eID="gen2665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2666"/>set not your heart upon it.<l eID="gen2666" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2658"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2667"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2668"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: One thing God has uttered,<l eID="gen2668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2669"/>two things there are which I heard<l eID="gen2669" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2670"/>that power belongs to God,<l eID="gen2670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2671"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: and to you, too, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, belongs kindness;<l eID="gen2671" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2672"/>for you requite each person<l eID="gen2672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2673"/>according to what they have done.<l eID="gen2673" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2667"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.62"/> <div eID="gen2636" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv63"/><div sID="gen2674" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 63</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.</title> <lg sID="gen2675"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv63"/> O God, my God, you, you do I seek:<l eID="gen2676" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2677"/>my heart thirsts for you,<l eID="gen2677" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2678"/>my body faints for you<l eID="gen2678" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2679"/>in a parched and waterless land.<l eID="gen2679" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2675"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2680"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2681"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: As I in the temple have seen you,<l eID="gen2681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2682"/>beholding your power and your glory,<l eID="gen2682" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2683"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: for better than life is your kindness:<l eID="gen2683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2684"/>my lips shall utter your praise.<l eID="gen2684" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2680"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2685"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2686"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: So, while I live, I will bless you,<l eID="gen2686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2687"/>and lift up my hands in your name.<l eID="gen2687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2688"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: As with marrow and fat am I feasted;<l eID="gen2688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2689"/>with joyful lips I will praise you.<l eID="gen2689" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2685"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2690"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2691"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: I call you to mind on my bed,<l eID="gen2691" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2692"/>and muse on you in the night watches;<l eID="gen2692" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2693"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: for you have been my help,<l eID="gen2693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2694"/>I joyfully sing in the shadow of your wings.<l eID="gen2694" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2695"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: I cling close after you,<l eID="gen2695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2696"/>your right hand holds me up.<l eID="gen2696" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2690"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2697"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2698"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: But those who seek after my life<l eID="gen2698" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2699"/>shall go down to the depths of the earth,<l eID="gen2699" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2700"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: given o’er to the power of the sword,<l eID="gen2700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2701"/>or as prey for jackals to devour.<l eID="gen2701" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2697"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2702"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2703"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: But the king shall rejoice in God:<l eID="gen2703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2704"/>all who own his allegiance will glory.<l eID="gen2704" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2705"/>For the mouth of the false shall be stopped.<l eID="gen2705" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2702"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.63"/> <div eID="gen2674" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv64"/><div sID="gen2706" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 64</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen2707"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv64"/> Hear, O my God, the voice of my lament:<l eID="gen2708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2709"/>guard my life from the foe who affrights me.<l eID="gen2709" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2710"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: Hide me from villains who secretly plot,<l eID="gen2710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2711"/>from the blustering throng of the workers of evil,<l eID="gen2711" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2712"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: who have sharpened their tongue like a sword,<l eID="gen2712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2713"/>and aimed bitter words like arrows,<l eID="gen2713" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2714"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: which from ambush they launch at the blameless,<l eID="gen2714" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2715"/>shooting swiftly and unafraid.<l eID="gen2715" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2707"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2716"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2717"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: They strengthen their wicked purpose,<l eID="gen2717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2718"/>they tell of the snares they have hidden,<l eID="gen2718" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2719"/>they say to themselves, “Who can see?”<l eID="gen2719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2720"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: They think out their crimes full cunningly<l eID="gen2720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2721"/>hidden deep in their crafty hearts.<l eID="gen2721" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2716"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2722"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2723"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: But God with his arrow will shoot them,<l eID="gen2723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2724"/>swiftly shall they be smitten.<l eID="gen2724" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2725"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: For their tongue he will bring them to ruin,<l eID="gen2725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2726"/>all will shudder with horror at the sight of them.<l eID="gen2726" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2722"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2727"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2728"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: Then every person, touched to awe,<l eID="gen2728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2729"/>as they ponder what God has wrought,<l eID="gen2729" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2730"/>will tell the tale of his deeds.<l eID="gen2730" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2731"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: In the <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall the righteous rejoice,<l eID="gen2731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2732"/>in him shall they take refuge;<l eID="gen2732" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2733"/>and all the true-hearted shall glory.<l eID="gen2733" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2727"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.64"/> <div eID="gen2706" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv65"/><div sID="gen2734" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 65</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A psalm of David. A song.</title> <lg sID="gen2735"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv65"/> It is seemly to praise you, O God, in Zion,<l eID="gen2736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2737"/>and to you shall the vow be performed in Jerusalem.<l eID="gen2737" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2738"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: O you who hear prayer,<l eID="gen2738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2739"/>unto you shall all flesh come.<l eID="gen2739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2740"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: Our sins are too mighty for us,<l eID="gen2740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2741"/>our transgressions you only can cover them.<l eID="gen2741" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2742"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: Happy the person whom you choose<l eID="gen2742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2743"/>to live beside you in your courts.<l eID="gen2743" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2744"/>O may we be filled with the joys<l eID="gen2744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2745"/>of your house, of your holy temple.<l eID="gen2745" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2735"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2746"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: In dread deeds you loyally answer us,<l eID="gen2747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2748"/>O God of our salvation,<l eID="gen2748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2749"/>whom all ends of the earth put their trust in,<l eID="gen2749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2750"/>and islands far away.<l eID="gen2750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2751"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: By your strength you establish the hills,<l eID="gen2751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2752"/>you are armed with might;<l eID="gen2752" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2753"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: you still the roaring of seas,<l eID="gen2753" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2754"/>and the turmoil of nations,<l eID="gen2754" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2755"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: so that those who live at earth’s bounds<l eID="gen2755" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2756"/>are awed at your signs:<l eID="gen2756" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2757"/>the lands of the sunrise and sunset<l eID="gen2757" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2758"/>you make to ring with joy.<l eID="gen2758" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2746"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2759"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2760"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: You visit and water the earth;<l eID="gen2760" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2761"/>you greatly enrich her<l eID="gen2761" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2762"/>with the river of God, which is full of water.<l eID="gen2762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2763"/>You prepare the corn thereof,<l eID="gen2763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2764"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: watering her furrows,<l eID="gen2764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2765"/>settling her ridges;<l eID="gen2765" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2766"/>you make her soft with showers,<l eID="gen2766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2767"/>and bless what grows thereon.<l eID="gen2767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2768"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: You crown the year with your goodness,<l eID="gen2768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2769"/>your chariot-tracks drip with fatness.<l eID="gen2769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2770"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: The desert pastures are lush,<l eID="gen2770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2771"/>the hills greened with joy.<l eID="gen2771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2772"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: The meadows are clothed with flocks,<l eID="gen2772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2773"/>the valleys are covered with corn;<l eID="gen2773" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2774"/>they shout to each other and sing.<l eID="gen2774" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2759"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.65"/> <div eID="gen2734" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv66"/><div sID="gen2775" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 66</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. A song. A psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen2776"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv66"/> Shout to God, all the earth,<l eID="gen2777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2778"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: sing praise to his glorious name,<l eID="gen2778" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2779"/>sing his glorious praise.<l eID="gen2779" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2780"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: Say to God, “How dread are your works,<l eID="gen2780" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2781"/>so great is your might that your enemies cringe to you.<l eID="gen2781" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2782"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: All the earth does homage to you,<l eID="gen2782" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2783"/>singing praises to you,<l eID="gen2783" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2784"/>singing praise to your name.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2784" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2776"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2785"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2786"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: Come and see what God has done,<l eID="gen2786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2787"/>awe-inspiring is he in his works among people.<l eID="gen2787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2788"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: He turns the sea into dry land,<l eID="gen2788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2789"/>and people cross the river on foot.<l eID="gen2789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2790"/>Let us therefore rejoice in him,<l eID="gen2790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2791"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: the mighty Ruler eternal,<l eID="gen2791" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2792"/>whose eyes keep watch on the nations,<l eID="gen2792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2793"/>that no rebel lift up his head. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2793" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2785"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2794"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2795"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: O bless our God, you peoples;<l eID="gen2795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2796"/>sound aloud his praise,<l eID="gen2796" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2797"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: who keeps us in life,<l eID="gen2797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2798"/>and keeps our feet from slipping.<l eID="gen2798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2799"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: For you, God, have tested us,<l eID="gen2799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2800"/>have tried us, as silver is tried.<l eID="gen2800" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2801"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: You did bring us into prison,<l eID="gen2801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2802"/>and put chains upon us,<l eID="gen2802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2803"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: you did let people ride over our head.<l eID="gen2803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2804"/>We went through fire and through water,<l eID="gen2804" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2805"/>but you led us out to a spacious place.<l eID="gen2805" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2794"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2806"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2807"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: I will enter your house with burnt-offerings,<l eID="gen2807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2808"/>I will pay to you my vows,<l eID="gen2808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2809"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: which my open lips have uttered,<l eID="gen2809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2810"/>arid my mouth has declared in my straits.<l eID="gen2810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2811"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: I will offer you offerings of fatlings,<l eID="gen2811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2812"/>with the odour of burning rams,<l eID="gen2812" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2813"/>I will sacrifice bullocks with goats. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2813" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2806"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2814"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2815"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: Come and hear my story<l eID="gen2815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2816"/>all who fear God ---<l eID="gen2816" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2817"/>of what he has done for me.<l eID="gen2817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2818"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: For my mouth had no sooner invoked him<l eID="gen2818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2819"/>than his praise was under my tongue.<l eID="gen2819" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2820"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: Had I cherished sin in my heart,<l eID="gen2820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2821"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> would never have listened.<l eID="gen2821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2822"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: But assuredly God has listened,<l eID="gen2822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2823"/>and attended to my loud prayer.<l eID="gen2823" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2814"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2824"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2825"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: Blessed be God, who turned not aside<l eID="gen2825" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2826"/>my prayer, nor withdrew his kindness from me.<l eID="gen2826" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2824"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.66"/> <div eID="gen2775" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv67"/><div sID="gen2827" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 67</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.</title> <lg sID="gen2828"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv67"/> Bless us, O God, with your favour,<l eID="gen2829" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2830"/>let the light of your face fall upon us; <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2830" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2831"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: that the world may know your way,<l eID="gen2831" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2832"/>and all nations your power to save.<l eID="gen2832" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2828"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2833"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2834"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: Let the peoples praise you, O God;<l eID="gen2834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2835"/>let the peoples all of them praise you.<l eID="gen2835" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2836"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: Let the nations ring out their joy;<l eID="gen2836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2837"/>for you govern the peoples with equity,<l eID="gen2837" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2838"/>and guide the nations on earth. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2838" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2839"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: Let the peoples praise you, O God,<l eID="gen2839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2840"/>let the peoples, all of them, praise you.<l eID="gen2840" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2833"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2841"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2842"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: The earth has yielded her increase<l eID="gen2842" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2843"/>by the blessing of God, our God.<l eID="gen2843" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2844"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: May this blessing of ours win people to him<l eID="gen2844" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2845"/>unto all the ends of the earth.<l eID="gen2845" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2841"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.67"/> <div eID="gen2827" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv68"/><div sID="gen2846" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 68</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David. A psalm. A song.</title> <lg sID="gen2847"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv68"/> God arises, his enemies scatter:<l eID="gen2848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2849"/>they who hate him flee before him.<l eID="gen2849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2850"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: As smoke before wind is driven,<l eID="gen2850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2851"/>as wax melts before fire,<l eID="gen2851" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2852"/>so before God vanish the wicked.<l eID="gen2852" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2853"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: But the righteous rejoice in God’s presence,<l eID="gen2853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2854"/>they exult with exceeding joy.<l eID="gen2854" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2847"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2855"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2856"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: Sing to God, make music to his name,<l eID="gen2856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2857"/>his name is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, praise him who rides on the clouds,<l eID="gen2857" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2858"/>and exult in his presence.<l eID="gen2858" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2859"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: Father of orphans, defender of widows,<l eID="gen2859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2860"/>is God in his holy abode.<l eID="gen2860" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2861"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: God brings home the lonely,<l eID="gen2861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2862"/>he leads forth the prisoner to comfort,<l eID="gen2862" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2863"/>so that none but the rebel lives cheerless.<l eID="gen2863" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2855"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2864"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2865"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: God, when you went in front of your people<l eID="gen2865" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2866"/>in your march through the desert, <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2866" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2867"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: earth shook, the heavens poured rain<l eID="gen2867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2868"/>at the presence of God, Sinai’s God<l eID="gen2868" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2869"/>at the presence of God, Israel’s God.<l eID="gen2869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2870"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: Rain in abundance, God, you did sprinkle,<l eID="gen2870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2871"/>restoring the languishing land of your heritage.<l eID="gen2871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2872"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: A dwelling therein your people found:<l eID="gen2872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2873"/>in your goodness, O God, you did care for the poor.<l eID="gen2873" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2864"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2874"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2875"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> spoke the glad tidings of victory,<l eID="gen2875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2876"/>a great army of women proclaim it:<l eID="gen2876" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2877"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: “Kings of armies they flee, they flee,<l eID="gen2877" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2878"/>and the housewife divides the spoil:<l eID="gen2878" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2879"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: dove’s wings covered with silver<l eID="gen2879" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2880"/>and pinions with shimmer of gold,<l eID="gen2880" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2881"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: set with stones, like snow upon Zalmon.”<l eID="gen2881" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2874"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2882"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2883"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan,<l eID="gen2883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2884"/>a mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.<l eID="gen2884" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2885"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: You high-peaked mountains, why look you askance<l eID="gen2885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2886"/>at the mountain which God has desired for his home<l eID="gen2886" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2887"/>whereon the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will live forever?<l eID="gen2887" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2888"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: The chariots of God are twice ten thousand:<l eID="gen2888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2889"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> came from Sinai, his holy place.<l eID="gen2889" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2890"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: You did mount the height with trains of your captives,<l eID="gen2890" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2891"/>and gifts that you had received from the people.<l eID="gen2891" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2892"/>The rebels shall live with the <divineName>Lord</divineName> God.<l eID="gen2892" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2882"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2893"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2894"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName> who sustains us daily,<l eID="gen2894" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2895"/>the God who is also our Saviour. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2895" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2896"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: Our God is a God who is Saviour.<l eID="gen2896" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2897"/>The ways of escape from death<l eID="gen2897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2898"/>are known to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> God.<l eID="gen2898" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2899"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: Yes, God will shatter the head of his foes<l eID="gen2899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2900"/>the rough scalp of those who strut on in their sins.<l eID="gen2900" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2901"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> said: “I will bring you home from Bashan,<l eID="gen2901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2902"/>home from the depths of the sea,<l eID="gen2902" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2903"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: that your feet you may bathe in blood,<l eID="gen2903" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2904"/>and your dogs lick their share of the foe.”<l eID="gen2904" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2893"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2905"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2906"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: In the temple appear God’s triumphal processions,<l eID="gen2906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2907"/>processions in praise of my king and my God,<l eID="gen2907" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2908"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: with singers in front, and minstrels behind,<l eID="gen2908" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2909"/>and maidens with timbrels between them, singing,<l eID="gen2909" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2910"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: “You of the well-spring of Israel,<l eID="gen2910" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2911"/>bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName> God in the dance.”<l eID="gen2911" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2912"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: There, in front, is Benjamin the little,<l eID="gen2912" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2913"/>the princes of Judah beside them,<l eID="gen2913" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2914"/>the princes of Zebulon, princes of Naphtali.<l eID="gen2914" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2905"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2915"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2916"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: God, show your strength,<l eID="gen2916" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2917"/>your godlike might,<l eID="gen2917" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2918"/>as you did in the past,<l eID="gen2918" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2919"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: from your temple that crowns Jerusalem.<l eID="gen2919" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2920"/>Kings shall bring tribute to you.<l eID="gen2920" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2921"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: Rebuke the beast of the reed,<l eID="gen2921" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2922"/>the herd of bulls, with the calves of the peoples.<l eID="gen2922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2923"/>Trample down the lovers of lies.<l eID="gen2923" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2924"/>Scatter the nations whose joy is in war.<l eID="gen2924" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2925"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: May they come from Egypt with gifts of oil,<l eID="gen2925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2926"/>Ethiopia haste with full hands to God.<l eID="gen2926" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2915"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2927"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2928"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: Sing to God, O you kingdoms of earth,<l eID="gen2928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2929"/>make melody to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen2929" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2930"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: Praise him who rides on the ancient heavens.<l eID="gen2930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2931"/>See! He utters his voice, his mighty voice.<l eID="gen2931" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2932"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: Ascribe strength to the God over Israel,<l eID="gen2932" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2933"/>whose strength and majesty live in the skies.<l eID="gen2933" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2934"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: Awe-inspiring is God in his holy place,<l eID="gen2934" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2935"/>it is Israel’s God<l eID="gen2935" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2936"/>who gives strength and might to his people.<l eID="gen2936" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen2937"/>Blessed be God.<l eID="gen2937" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen2927"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.68"/> <div eID="gen2846" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv69"/><div sID="gen2938" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 69</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On shoshannim. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen2939"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv69"/> Save me, O God; for the waters<l eID="gen2940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2941"/>are threatening my life.<l eID="gen2941" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2942"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: I am sunk in depths of mire,<l eID="gen2942" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2943"/>where ground there is none.<l eID="gen2943" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2944"/>I am come into deep deep waters,<l eID="gen2944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2945"/>the flood overwhelms me.<l eID="gen2945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2946"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: I am weary of crying, my throat is parched,<l eID="gen2946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2947"/>my eyes are wasted with waiting for God.<l eID="gen2947" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2939"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2948"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2949"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: More than the hairs of my head<l eID="gen2949" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2950"/>are those who wantonly hate me.<l eID="gen2950" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2951"/>More than my bones in number<l eID="gen2951" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2952"/>are those who are falsely my foes.<l eID="gen2952" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2953"/>That which I never robbed,<l eID="gen2953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2954"/>how am I then to restore?<l eID="gen2954" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2955"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: O God, you know my folly,<l eID="gen2955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2956"/>my guilt is not hidden from you.<l eID="gen2956" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2957"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: Through me let not any be shamed,<l eID="gen2957" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2958"/>who wait for you, <divineName>Lord</divineName> God of hosts.<l eID="gen2958" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2959"/>Through me let not those be confounded<l eID="gen2959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2960"/>who seek you, O God of Israel.<l eID="gen2960" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2961"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:7
verses.text: It’s in your cause that I have borne taunts,<l eID="gen2961" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2962"/>and my face has been covered with shame;<l eID="gen2962" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2963"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:8
verses.text: I became to my kindred a foreigner,<l eID="gen2963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2964"/>to my mother's sons a stranger.<l eID="gen2964" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2948"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2966"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:9
verses.text: It was zeal for your house that consumed me,<l eID="gen2966" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2967"/>and the insults they hurled at you fell upon me.<l eID="gen2967" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2968"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:10
verses.text: When I chastened myself with fasting,<l eID="gen2968" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2969"/>they took occasion to taunt me.<l eID="gen2969" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2970"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:11
verses.text: When I put on a garment of sackcloth,<l eID="gen2970" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2971"/>they made me the theme of a taunt-song.<l eID="gen2971" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2972"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:12
verses.text: Those who sit in the gate make sport of me<l eID="gen2972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2973"/>in the music of drunken songs.<l eID="gen2973" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2965"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2974"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2975"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:13
verses.text: But I pray to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen2975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2976"/>for a time of favour.<l eID="gen2976" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2977"/>In your great love answer me;<l eID="gen2977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2978"/>with your loyal help, save me<l eID="gen2978" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2979"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:14
verses.text: from sinking down in the mire.<l eID="gen2979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2980"/>Lift me out of the deep deep waters,<l eID="gen2980" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2981"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:15
verses.text: that the rushing flood may not drown me,<l eID="gen2981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2982"/>that the deep may not swallow me up,<l eID="gen2982" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2983"/>nor the pit close her mouth upon me.<l eID="gen2983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2984"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:16
verses.text: Answer me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in your gracious kindness,<l eID="gen2984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2985"/>turn to me in your great compassion.<l eID="gen2985" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2986"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:17
verses.text: Hide not your face from your servant,<l eID="gen2986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2987"/>for I am in trouble; O answer me speedily.<l eID="gen2987" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2988"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:18
verses.text: Draw near to me, redeem me;<l eID="gen2988" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2989"/>because of my enemies, ransom me.<l eID="gen2989" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2974"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2990"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2991"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:19
verses.text: You know how I am insulted;<l eID="gen2991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2992"/>in your sight are all my foes.<l eID="gen2992" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2993"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:20
verses.text: Insult has broken my heart,<l eID="gen2993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2994"/>past cure are my shame and confusion.<l eID="gen2994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2995"/>For pity I looked --- there was none!<l eID="gen2995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2996"/>And for comforters, but I found none.<l eID="gen2996" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2997"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:21
verses.text: Poison they gave me for food,<l eID="gen2997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen2998"/>and to slake my thirst they gave vinegar.<l eID="gen2998" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2990"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen2999"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3000"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:22
verses.text: May their table, outspread, be a trap to them,<l eID="gen3000" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3001"/>and their peace-offerings be a snare.<l eID="gen3001" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3002"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:23
verses.text: May their eyes be darkened and blind,<l eID="gen3002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3003"/>make their loins to shake without ceasing.<l eID="gen3003" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3004"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:24
verses.text: Pour your indignation upon them,<l eID="gen3004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3005"/>let your burning wrath overtake them.<l eID="gen3005" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3006"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:25
verses.text: May their camp be a desolation,<l eID="gen3006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3007"/>in their tents be there none to live.<l eID="gen3007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3008"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:26
verses.text: For those whom you struck, they persecute,<l eID="gen3008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3009"/>and those whom you wounded, they pain yet more.<l eID="gen3009" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3010"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:27
verses.text: Charge them with sin upon sin,<l eID="gen3010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3011"/>may they not be acquitted by you.<l eID="gen3011" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3012"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:28
verses.text: From the book of life be they blotted,<l eID="gen3012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3013"/>may their names not be written with the righteous.<l eID="gen3013" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen2999"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3014"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3015"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:29
verses.text: Lift me, O God, by your help<l eID="gen3015" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3016"/>above my pain and misery.<l eID="gen3016" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3017"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:30
verses.text: Then will I praise God in song<l eID="gen3017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3018"/>and magnify him with thanksgiving,<l eID="gen3018" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3019"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:31
verses.text: which shall please the <divineName>Lord</divineName> better than ox,<l eID="gen3019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3020"/>or than bullock with horns and hoofs.<l eID="gen3020" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3021"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:32
