verses.text: The oppressed shall rejoice at the sight.<l eID="gen3021" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3022"/>You who seek after God, let your heart revive.<l eID="gen3022" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3023"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:33
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> listens to the poor,<l eID="gen3023" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3024"/>he does not despise his prisoners.<l eID="gen3024" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3014"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3025"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3026"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:34
verses.text: Let the heavens and the earth sing his praises,<l eID="gen3026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3027"/>the seas, and all creatures that move in them.<l eID="gen3027" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3028"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:35
verses.text: For God will bring help to Zion,<l eID="gen3028" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3029"/>and build up the cities of Judah,<l eID="gen3029" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3030"/>his people shall live there in possession.<l eID="gen3030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3031"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:36
verses.text: His servants’ children shall have it for heritage,<l eID="gen3031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3032"/>and those who love him shall live therein.<l eID="gen3032" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3025"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.69"/> <div eID="gen2938" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv70"/><div sID="gen3033" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 70</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David. For commemoration.</title> <lg sID="gen3034"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv70"/> Quickly, God, deliver me,<l eID="gen3035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3036"/>hasten to help me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen3036" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3037"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: May those who are seeking my life,<l eID="gen3037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3038"/>be ashamed and confounded.<l eID="gen3038" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3039"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: May those who delight in my hurt<l eID="gen3039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3040"/>be defeated and brought to dishonour.<l eID="gen3040" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3041"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: But may all who seek after you<l eID="gen3041" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3042"/>rejoice and be glad in you.<l eID="gen3042" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3043"/>May all who love your salvation<l eID="gen3043" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3044"/>say, “Glory to God,” evermore.<l eID="gen3044" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3045"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: I am weak and needy:<l eID="gen3045" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3046"/>make haste, God, to me.<l eID="gen3046" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3047"/>You are my help and deliverer;<l eID="gen3047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3048"/><divineName>Lord</divineName>, don’t delay.<l eID="gen3048" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3034"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.70"/> <div eID="gen3033" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv71"/><div sID="gen3049" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 71</title> <lg sID="gen3050"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv71"/> In you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I take refuge,<l eID="gen3051" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3052"/>let me never be put to shame.<l eID="gen3052" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3053"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: In your faithfulness save me and rescue me,<l eID="gen3053" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3054"/>bend your ear to me and save me.<l eID="gen3054" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3055"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: Be to me a rock of defence,<l eID="gen3055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3056"/>a fortified house, to save me;<l eID="gen3056" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3057"/>for my rock and my fortress are you.<l eID="gen3057" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3050"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3058"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3059"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: Save me, my God, from the hand of the wicked,<l eID="gen3059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3060"/>from the grasp of the unjust and cruel.<l eID="gen3060" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3061"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: For you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are my hope,<l eID="gen3061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3062"/>in whom from my youth I have trusted.<l eID="gen3062" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3063"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: On you have I leaned from my birth;<l eID="gen3063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3064"/>from my mother’s womb it was you who did draw me.<l eID="gen3064" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3065"/>In you is my hope evermore.<l eID="gen3065" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3058"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3066"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3067"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: I have been as a wonder to many,<l eID="gen3067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3068"/>for you are my refuge and strength.<l eID="gen3068" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3069"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
verses.text: All the day long my mouth<l eID="gen3069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3070"/>is filled with your praise and your glory.<l eID="gen3070" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3071"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age;<l eID="gen3071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3072"/>when my strength is spent, forsake me not.<l eID="gen3072" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3073"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: For my foes whisper against me,<l eID="gen3073" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3074"/>they who watch me take counsel together;<l eID="gen3074" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3075"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: “God has left him,” they say: “pursue<l eID="gen3075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3076"/>and seize him, for he is helpless.”<l eID="gen3076" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3066"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3077"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3078"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: O God, be not far from me,<l eID="gen3078" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3079"/>haste, O my God, to my help.<l eID="gen3079" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3080"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: Put my foes to shame and dishonour,<l eID="gen3080" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3081"/>with insult and shame be they covered.<l eID="gen3081" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3082"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: But I will never stop hoping,<l eID="gen3082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3083"/>and more and yet more will I praise you.<l eID="gen3083" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3084"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: All the day long shall my mouth<l eID="gen3084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3085"/>tell your faithfulness and your salvation,<l eID="gen3085" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3086"/>though I know not how they may be counted.<l eID="gen3086" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3077"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3087"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3088"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: I will tell of the might of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3089"/>and your faithfulness praise, you alone.<l eID="gen3089" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3090"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: You have taught me, O God, from my youth,<l eID="gen3090" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3091"/>and till now have I told of your wonders.<l eID="gen3091" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3092"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: Even in old age and grey hair,<l eID="gen3092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3093"/>O God, do not forsake me.<l eID="gen3093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3094"/>Still would I tell of your might<l eID="gen3094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3095"/>unto all generations to come.<l eID="gen3095" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3087"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3096"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3097"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: Your power and your justice, O God,<l eID="gen3097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3098"/>extend as far as the heavens:<l eID="gen3098" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3099"/>for great are the things you have done.<l eID="gen3099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3100"/>Who is like you, O God?<l eID="gen3100" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3101"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: You have caused us to see troubles many,<l eID="gen3101" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3102"/>but you will revive us again.<l eID="gen3102" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3103"/>From the depths of the earth<l eID="gen3103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3104"/>you will bring me up again.<l eID="gen3104" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3105"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:21
verses.text: You will multiply my greatness,<l eID="gen3105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3106"/>and comfort me again.<l eID="gen3106" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3096"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3107"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:22
verses.text: So with harp I will praise you,<l eID="gen3108" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3109"/>and your faithfulness, O my God;<l eID="gen3109" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3110"/>and make music to you on the lyre,<l eID="gen3110" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3111"/>O you Holy One of Israel.<l eID="gen3111" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3112"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:23
verses.text: My lips shall ring out their joy,<l eID="gen3112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3113"/>my mouth shall sing praises to you;<l eID="gen3113" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3114"/>all of me, which you have redeemed.<l eID="gen3114" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3115"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:24
verses.text: Yes, all the day long shall my tongue<l eID="gen3115" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3116"/>utter your righteousness;<l eID="gen3116" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3117"/>for ashamed and confounded are they<l eID="gen3117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3118"/>who were seeking my hurt.<l eID="gen3118" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3107"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.71"/> <div eID="gen3049" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv72"/><div sID="gen3119" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 72</title> <title type="psalm">Of Solomon.</title> <lg sID="gen3120"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv72"/> Give the king, O God, your own spirit of justice<l eID="gen3121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3122"/>your spirit of right to the son of the king,<l eID="gen3122" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: that with right he may judge your people,<l eID="gen3123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3124"/>and your downtrodden ones with justice.<l eID="gen3124" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3120"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3125"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: May the mountains bear weal for the people,<l eID="gen3126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3127"/>and the hills yield fruits of justice.<l eID="gen3127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: The weak may he help to their rights,<l eID="gen3128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3129"/>may he save the sons of the needy<l eID="gen3129" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3130"/>and crush the oppressor in pieces.<l eID="gen3130" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3125"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3131"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3132"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: May he live as long as the sun,<l eID="gen3132" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3133"/>while the moon shines — for ages and ages.<l eID="gen3133" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3134"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: May he be like the rain on the meadow,<l eID="gen3134" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3135"/>like showers that water the earth.<l eID="gen3135" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3131"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3136"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3137"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: In his days may justice flourish,<l eID="gen3137" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3138"/>and welfare abound, till the moon be no more.<l eID="gen3138" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: May he reign from ocean to ocean,<l eID="gen3139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3140"/>from the river to the ends of the earth.<l eID="gen3140" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3136"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3142"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: May his foes bow down before him,<l eID="gen3142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3143"/>his enemies lick the dust.<l eID="gen3143" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: May tribute be rendered by kings<l eID="gen3144" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3145"/>of the isles and of Tarshish;<l eID="gen3145" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3146"/>may gifts be brought by the kings<l eID="gen3146" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3147"/>of Sheba and Seba.<l eID="gen3147" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3141"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3148"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: May all kings fall prostrate before him,<l eID="gen3149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3150"/>and all nations yield him their service.<l eID="gen3150" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3151"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: For he saves the poor when he cries,<l eID="gen3151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3152"/>the helpless and the downtrodden.<l eID="gen3152" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3148"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3153"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3154"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: He pities the weak and the poor,<l eID="gen3154" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3155"/>he saves the lives of the poor.<l eID="gen3155" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3156"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: He redeems them from wrong and from violence,<l eID="gen3156" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3157"/>for dear is their blood in his sight.<l eID="gen3157" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3153"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3158"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3159"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: Long may he live;<l eID="gen3159" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3160"/>and may gold of Sheba be given him;<l eID="gen3160" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3161"/>prayer, too, be made for him ceaselessly,<l eID="gen3161" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3162"/>all the day long may men bless him.<l eID="gen3162" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3158"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3163"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3164"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: May the land have abundance of corn,<l eID="gen3164" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3165"/>to the tops of the hills may it wave.<l eID="gen3165" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3166"/>May the fruit thereof flourish like Lebanon,<l eID="gen3166" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3167"/>may men spring from the city like grass of the earth.<l eID="gen3167" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3163"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3168"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3169"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: May his name be blessed forever,<l eID="gen3169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3170"/>may his fame endure as the sun.<l eID="gen3170" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3171"/>May all nations envy his blessedness,<l eID="gen3171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3172"/>all tribes of the earth call him happy.<l eID="gen3172" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3168"/> <lb/> <lb/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3173"/> <l level="3" sID="gen3174"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: <hi type="italic">Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName> God, Israel’s God,</hi><l eID="gen3174" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen3175"/><hi type="italic">who alone does wonders;</hi><l eID="gen3175" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen3176"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: <hi type="italic">And blest be forever his glorious name.</hi><l eID="gen3176" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen3177"/><hi type="italic">Let all the earth be filled with his glory.</hi><l eID="gen3177" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen3178"/><hi type="italic">Amen and Amen.</hi><l eID="gen3178" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen3173"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3179"/> <l level="3" sID="gen3180"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: Here end the prayers of David, son of Jesse.<l eID="gen3180" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen3179"/>  <div eID="gen3119" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Ps.72"/> <div eID="gen1831" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv73"/><div sID="gen3182" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 73</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3183"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv73"/> Yes, God is good to the upright,<l eID="gen3184" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3185"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> to the pure in heart.<l eID="gen3185" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3186"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: But my feet were almost gone,<l eID="gen3186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3187"/>my steps had nearly slipped,<l eID="gen3187" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3188"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: through envy of godless braggarts,<l eID="gen3188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3189"/>when I saw how well they fared.<l eID="gen3189" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3183"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3190"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3191"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: For never a pang have they,<l eID="gen3191" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3192"/>their body is sound and sleek.<l eID="gen3192" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3193"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: They have no trouble like mortals,<l eID="gen3193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3194"/>no share in human pain.<l eID="gen3194" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3195"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: So they wear their pride like a necklace,<l eID="gen3195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3196"/>they put on the garment of wrong,<l eID="gen3196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: their eyes stand out with fatness,<l eID="gen3197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3198"/>their heart swells with riotous fancies.<l eID="gen3198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3199"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: Their speech is mocking and evil,<l eID="gen3199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3200"/>condescending and crooked their speech.<l eID="gen3200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: They have set their mouth in the heavens,<l eID="gen3201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3202"/>while their tongue struts about on the earth.<l eID="gen3202" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3203"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: Small wonder that people resort to them,<l eID="gen3203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3204"/>and drink deep draughts of their lore.<l eID="gen3204" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3205"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: “How does God know?” they say,<l eID="gen3205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3206"/>“And has the Most High any knowledge?”<l eID="gen3206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3207"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: See! These are the godless,<l eID="gen3207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3208"/>with wealth and ease ever increasing.<l eID="gen3208" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3190"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3209"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3210"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: Yes, in vain have I kept my heart pure,<l eID="gen3210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3211"/>and washed my hands in innocence;<l eID="gen3211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3212"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: for all the day long was I plagued<l eID="gen3212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3213"/>not a morning but I was chastised.<l eID="gen3213" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3214"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: But to resolve to speak like they do<l eID="gen3214" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3215"/>would be treachery to your children.<l eID="gen3215" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3209"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3216"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3217"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: So I sought to understand it,<l eID="gen3217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3218"/>but a wearisome task it seemed:<l eID="gen3218" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3219"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: till I entered the holy world of God<l eID="gen3219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3220"/>and saw clearly their destiny.<l eID="gen3220" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3216"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3221"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3222"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: Yes, you set them on slippery places;<l eID="gen3222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3223"/>down to destruction you hurl them.<l eID="gen3223" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3224"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: One moment and then what a horror of ruin!<l eID="gen3224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3225"/>They are finished and ended in terrors.<l eID="gen3225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3226"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: Like a dream, when one wakes, shall they be,<l eID="gen3226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3227"/>whose phantoms the waker despises.<l eID="gen3227" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3221"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3228"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3229"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: So my bitterness of mind<l eID="gen3229" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3230"/>and the pain that stabbed my heart<l eID="gen3230" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3231"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: show how dull I was and stupid<l eID="gen3231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3232"/>just like a beast before you.<l eID="gen3232" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3228"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3233"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3234"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: But I am always with you,<l eID="gen3234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3235"/>you have hold of my right hand.<l eID="gen3235" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3236"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:24
verses.text: By a plan of yours you guide me<l eID="gen3236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3237"/>and will afterward take me to glory.<l eID="gen3237" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3233"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3238"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3239"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:25
verses.text: Whom have I in the heavens but you?<l eID="gen3239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3240"/>And on earth there is none I desire beside you.<l eID="gen3240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3241"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:26
verses.text: Though flesh and heart waste away,<l eID="gen3241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3242"/>yet God is the rock of my heart,<l eID="gen3242" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3243"/>yet God is my portion forever.<l eID="gen3243" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3238"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3244"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3245"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:27
verses.text: For see! Those who are far from you must perish,<l eID="gen3245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3246"/>you destroy all who are false to you.<l eID="gen3246" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3247"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:28
verses.text: But I am happy when close to God;<l eID="gen3247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3248"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God I have made my refuge,<l eID="gen3248" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3249"/>that I may recount all the things you have done.<l eID="gen3249" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3244"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.73"/> <div eID="gen3182" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv74"/><div sID="gen3250" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 74</title> <title type="psalm">A maskil of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3251"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv74"/> Why, O God, have you spurned us forever?<l eID="gen3252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3253"/>Why smokes your wrath against the sheep of your pasture?<l eID="gen3253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3254"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: Remember the community you purchased of old<l eID="gen3254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3255"/>to become by redemption the tribe of your heritage,<l eID="gen3255" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3256"/>Zion, the mountain you made your home.<l eID="gen3256" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3257"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: Rouse yourself, visit its ruins complete.<l eID="gen3257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3258"/>In the temple the foe has made havoc of all things.<l eID="gen3258" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3251"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3259"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3260"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: Like lions your enemies roared through your house,<l eID="gen3260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3261"/>replacing our symbols by signs of their own,<l eID="gen3261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: hacking, like woodsmen who lift<l eID="gen3262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3263"/>axes on thickets of trees,<l eID="gen3263" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3264"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: smashing with hatchets and hammers<l eID="gen3264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3265"/>all of its carved work together.<l eID="gen3265" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3266"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: They have set your temple on fire,<l eID="gen3266" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3267"/>to the very ground they have outraged<l eID="gen3267" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3268"/>the place where lives your name.<l eID="gen3268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3269"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: They have said in their heart, “Let us utterly crush them.”<l eID="gen3269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3270"/>They have burned all the houses of God in the land.<l eID="gen3270" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3259"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3271"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3272"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: No symbol of ours do we see any more:<l eID="gen3272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3273"/>no prophet is there any more,<l eID="gen3273" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3274"/>none is with us who knows how long.<l eID="gen3274" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3275"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: How long, O God, is the foe to insult?<l eID="gen3275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3276"/>Shall the enemy spurn your name forever?<l eID="gen3276" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3277"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: Why, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, do you hold back your hand,<l eID="gen3277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3278"/>why keep your right hand in the folds of your robe?<l eID="gen3278" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3271"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3279"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3280"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:12
verses.text: Yet God is our king from the ancient days,<l eID="gen3280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3281"/>in the midst of the earth working deeds of salvation.<l eID="gen3281" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3282"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:13
verses.text: It was you who did cleave the sea by your might,<l eID="gen3282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3283"/>and shatter the heads of the ocean monsters.<l eID="gen3283" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3284"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:14
verses.text: It was you who did crush many-headed Leviathan,<l eID="gen3284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3285"/>and give him as food to the beasts of the wilderness.<l eID="gen3285" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3286"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:15
verses.text: It was you who did cleave the fountains and torrents;<l eID="gen3286" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3287"/>it was you who did dry the perennial streams.<l eID="gen3287" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3288"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:16
verses.text: Yours is the day; yours, too, is the night,<l eID="gen3288" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3289"/>it was you who did establish the sun and the star.<l eID="gen3289" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3290"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:17
verses.text: It was you who did fix all the borders of earth:<l eID="gen3290" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3291"/>summer and winter it’s you who have made them.<l eID="gen3291" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3279"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3292"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3293"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:18
verses.text: Yet, for all this, the foe has insulted you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3294"/>and a nation of fools has reviled your name.<l eID="gen3294" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3295"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:19
verses.text: Do not give your dove to the beasts,<l eID="gen3295" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3296"/>do not forget your afflicted forever.<l eID="gen3296" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3297"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:20
verses.text: Look to the sleek ones - how full they are:<l eID="gen3297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3298"/>the dark places of earth are the dwellings of violence.<l eID="gen3298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3299"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:21
verses.text: O let not the downtrodden turn back ashamed:<l eID="gen3299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3300"/>let the poor and the needy sing praise to your name.<l eID="gen3300" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3292"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3301"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3302"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:22
verses.text: Arise, God, and defend your cause:<l eID="gen3302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3303"/>remember how fools all the day insult you.<l eID="gen3303" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3304"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:23
verses.text: Do not forget the uproar of your enemies,<l eID="gen3304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3305"/>the din of your foes that ascends evermore.<l eID="gen3305" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3301"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.74"/> <div eID="gen3250" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv75"/><div sID="gen3306" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 75</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader; al tashheth. A psalm of Asaph, a song.</title> <lg sID="gen3307"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv75"/> We praise you, God, we praise you:<l eID="gen3308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3309"/>we would call on your name and declare your wonders.<l eID="gen3309" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3307"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3310"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3311"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: “At the time I choose,<l eID="gen3311" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3312"/>I will judge fairly.<l eID="gen3312" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3313"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: Though earth melt and all her inhabitants,<l eID="gen3313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3314"/>it is I who keep steady her pillars.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3315"/>I say to the boasters, “Boast not “;<l eID="gen3315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3316"/>to the wicked, “Lift not up your horn:<l eID="gen3316" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3317"/>lift not your horn on high,<l eID="gen3317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3318"/>speak not boldly against the Rock.”<l eID="gen3318" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3310"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3319"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3320"/>For not from east nor west,<l eID="gen3320" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3321"/>not from desert nor mountains;<l eID="gen3321" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3322"/>but God himself is the judge,<l eID="gen3322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3323"/>humbling one and exalting another.<l eID="gen3323" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3319"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3324"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3325"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: In the hand of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is a cup<l eID="gen3325" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3326"/>foaming wine, richly spiced.<l eID="gen3326" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3327"/>Out of this he pours a draught,<l eID="gen3327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3328"/>and all the wicked of earth<l eID="gen3328" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3329"/>must drain it down to the dregs.<l eID="gen3329" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3324"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3330"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3331"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: But I will rejoice forever,<l eID="gen3331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3332"/>singing praise to the God of Jacob.<l eID="gen3332" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3333"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: I will hew all the horns of the wicked,<l eID="gen3333" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3334"/>but the horns of the just shall be lifted.<l eID="gen3334" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3330"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.75"/> <div eID="gen3306" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv76"/><div sID="gen3335" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 76</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. With instrumental music. A psalm of Asaph, a song.</title> <lg sID="gen3336"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv76"/> God has made himself known in Judah,<l eID="gen3337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3338"/>his name is great in Israel.<l eID="gen3338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3339"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: His tent is in Salem,<l eID="gen3339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3340"/>his dwelling in Zion.<l eID="gen3340" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3336"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3341"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3342"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: There he broke the lightning arrows,<l eID="gen3342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3343"/>shield, sword, and weapons of war. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3343" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3344"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: Terrible is your splendour<l eID="gen3344" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3345"/>on the everlasting mountains.<l eID="gen3345" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3341"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3346"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3347"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: Despoiled were the stout of heart;<l eID="gen3347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3348"/>in the sleep into which they had fallen,<l eID="gen3348" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3349"/>none of the warriors<l eID="gen3349" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3350"/>could lift a hand.<l eID="gen3350" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3346"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3351"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3352"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: At your rebuke, God of Jacob,<l eID="gen3352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3353"/>sank chariot and horse to sleep.<l eID="gen3353" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3354"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: Awful are you: who can stand<l eID="gen3354" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3355"/>before you, when once you are angry?<l eID="gen3355" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3351"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3356"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3357"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: The judgment you gave from heaven<l eID="gen3357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3358"/>frightened the earth into silence,<l eID="gen3358" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3359"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: when God arose to judgment<l eID="gen3359" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3360"/>to save the oppressed of the earth. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3360" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3356"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3361"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3362"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: The fiercest shall praise you,<l eID="gen3362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3363"/>to you shall the remnant hold festival.<l eID="gen3363" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3364"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: Vow and pay to <divineName>Lord</divineName> your God,<l eID="gen3364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3365"/>and let all who are round him bring presents.<l eID="gen3365" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3361"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3366"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3367"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: He lops off the courage of princes,<l eID="gen3367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3368"/>and with terror fills kings of the earth.<l eID="gen3368" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3366"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.76"/> <div eID="gen3335" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv77"/><div sID="gen3369" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 77</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On Jeduthun. Of Asaph, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen3370"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv77"/> Loudly will I lift my cry to God,<l eID="gen3371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3372"/>loudly to God, so he hears to me.<l eID="gen3372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3373"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I seek the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen3373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3374"/>in the night I lift my hands in prayer,<l eID="gen3374" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3375"/>refusing all comfort.<l eID="gen3375" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3370"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3376"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3377"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: When I think of God, I moan;<l eID="gen3377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3378"/>when I muse, my spirit is faint. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3378" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3379"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: When you hold my eyes awake,<l eID="gen3379" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3380"/>and I am restless and speechless,<l eID="gen3380" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3381"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: I think of the days of old,<l eID="gen3381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3382"/>call to mind distant years.<l eID="gen3382" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3383"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: I commune with my heart in the night,<l eID="gen3383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3384"/>I muse with inquiring spirit.<l eID="gen3384" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3385"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: “Will the <divineName>Lord</divineName> cast us off forever,<l eID="gen3385" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3386"/>will he be gracious no more?<l eID="gen3386" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3387"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: Has his love vanished forever?<l eID="gen3387" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3388"/>Is his faithfulness utterly gone?<l eID="gen3388" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3389"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious,<l eID="gen3389" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3390"/>or in anger withheld his compassion?” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3390" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3376"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3391"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3392"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: Then I said, “This it is that grieves me,<l eID="gen3392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3393"/>that the hand of the Most High has changed.’<l eID="gen3393" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3394"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: I will think of the deeds of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3395"/>and remember your wonders of old.<l eID="gen3395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3396"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: I will muse on all you have wrought,<l eID="gen3396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3397"/>and meditate on your deeds.<l eID="gen3397" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3398"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: Then your way, O God, was majestic:<l eID="gen3398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3399"/>what God was great as our God?<l eID="gen3399" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3400"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: You were a God who did marvels,<l eID="gen3400" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3401"/>you did show your power to the world<l eID="gen3401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3402"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: by your arm you rescued your people,<l eID="gen3402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3403"/>the children of Jacob and Joseph. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3403" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3391"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3404"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3405"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: The waters saw you, O God.<l eID="gen3405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3406"/>The waters saw you and shivered;<l eID="gen3406" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3407"/>to their depths they trembled.<l eID="gen3407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3408"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: Clouds poured torrents of water,<l eID="gen3408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3409"/>thunder rolled in the sky,<l eID="gen3409" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3410"/>your arrows sped to and fro.<l eID="gen3410" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3411"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: Loud was the roll of your thunder,<l eID="gen3411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3412"/>lightnings lit up the world.<l eID="gen3412" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3413"/>Earth quaked and trembled.<l eID="gen3413" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3414"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: In your way, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, through the sea,<l eID="gen3414" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3415"/>in your path through the mighty waters,<l eID="gen3415" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3416"/>your footsteps were all unseen.<l eID="gen3416" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3417"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: You did guide your folk like a flock<l eID="gen3417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3418"/>by the hand of Moses and Aaron.<l eID="gen3418" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3404"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.77"/> <div eID="gen3369" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv78"/><div sID="gen3419" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 78</title> <title type="psalm">A maskil of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3420"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv78"/> My people, give ear to my teaching:<l eID="gen3421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3422"/>bend your ears to the words of my mouth,<l eID="gen3422" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3423"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: as I open my mouth in a poem<l eID="gen3423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3424"/>on the riddling story of the past.<l eID="gen3424" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3420"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3425"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3426"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: What we have heard and known,<l eID="gen3426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3427"/>and what our ancestors have told us,<l eID="gen3427" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3428"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: we will not hide from their children.<l eID="gen3428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3429"/>We will tell to the next generation<l eID="gen3429" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3430"/>the praises and might of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3431"/>and the wonders that he has done.<l eID="gen3431" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3425"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3432"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3433"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: He set up a testimony in Jacob,<l eID="gen3433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3434"/>a law he appointed in Israel,<l eID="gen3434" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3435"/>which he commanded our ancestors<l eID="gen3435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3436"/>to make known to their children,<l eID="gen3436" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3437"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: that the next generation should know it,<l eID="gen3437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3438"/>that the children yet to be born<l eID="gen3438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3439"/>should arise and tell their children;<l eID="gen3439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3440"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: that in God they might put their confidence,<l eID="gen3440" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3441"/>and not forget God’s works;<l eID="gen3441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3442"/>but that they might keep his commandments,<l eID="gen3442" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3443"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: and not be like their ancestors,<l eID="gen3443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3444"/>a generation defiant and stubborn,<l eID="gen3444" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3445"/>a generation with heart unsteady,<l eID="gen3445" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3446"/>and spirit unfaithful towards God.<l eID="gen3446" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3432"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3447"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3448"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: Ephraimites, armed bowmen,<l eID="gen3448" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3449"/>turned back in the day of battle.<l eID="gen3449" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3450"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: They did not keep God’s covenant,<l eID="gen3450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3451"/>they refused to walk in his law.<l eID="gen3451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3452"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: They forgot what he had done,<l eID="gen3452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3453"/>and the wonders he had shown them.<l eID="gen3453" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3447"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3454"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3455"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: He did wonders before their ancestors<l eID="gen3455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3456"/>in the country of Zoan in Egypt.<l eID="gen3456" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3457"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: Through the sea which he split he brought them,<l eID="gen3457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3458"/>making waters stand up like a heap;<l eID="gen3458" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3459"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:14
verses.text: he led them by day with a cloud,<l eID="gen3459" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3460"/>all the night with a light of fire.<l eID="gen3460" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3454"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3461"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3462"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:15
verses.text: From the rocks which he split in the wilderness,<l eID="gen3462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3463"/>he gave them to drink as of ocean’s abundance.<l eID="gen3463" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3464"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:16
verses.text: He brought streams out of the rock,<l eID="gen3464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3465"/>and made water run down like rivers.<l eID="gen3465" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3461"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3466"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3467"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:17
verses.text: Yet they still went on sinning against him,<l eID="gen3467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3468"/>they defied the Most High in the desert.<l eID="gen3468" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3469"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:18
verses.text: They wilfully challenged God,<l eID="gen3469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3470"/>demanding the food that they longed for.<l eID="gen3470" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3471"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:19
verses.text: “Is God able,“ such was their challenge,<l eID="gen3471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3472"/>“to spread in the desert a table?<l eID="gen3472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3473"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:20
verses.text: From the rock that he struck there gushed water,<l eID="gen3473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3474"/>and torrents that overflowed;<l eID="gen3474" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3475"/>but can he also give bread,<l eID="gen3475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3476"/>or provide his people with meat?”<l eID="gen3476" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3466"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3477"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3478"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:21
verses.text: When the <divineName>Lord</divineName> heard this, he was furious,<l eID="gen3478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3479"/>and fire was kindled on Jacob,<l eID="gen3479" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3480"/>anger flared up against Israel.<l eID="gen3480" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3477"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3481"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3482"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:22
verses.text: For they put no trust in God,<l eID="gen3482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3483"/>no confidence in his help.<l eID="gen3483" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3484"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:23
verses.text: So he summoned the clouds above;<l eID="gen3484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3485"/>and, opening the doors of heaven,<l eID="gen3485" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3486"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:24
verses.text: he rained manna upon them for food,<l eID="gen3486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3487"/>and grain of heaven he gave them.<l eID="gen3487" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3488"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:25
verses.text: Everyone ate the bread of angels;<l eID="gen3488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3489"/>he sent them food to the full.<l eID="gen3489" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3481"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3490"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3491"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:26
verses.text: He launched the east wind in the heavens,<l eID="gen3491" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3492"/>and guided the south by his power.<l eID="gen3492" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3493"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:27
verses.text: He rained meat upon them like dust,<l eID="gen3493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3494"/>winged bird like the sand of the sea.<l eID="gen3494" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3495"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:28
verses.text: In the midst of their camp he dropped it,<l eID="gen3495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3496"/>all around their tents.<l eID="gen3496" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3490"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3497"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3498"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:29
verses.text: They ate and were more than filled;<l eID="gen3498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3499"/>he had brought them the thing they desired.<l eID="gen3499" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3500"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:30
verses.text: But the thing they desired became loathsome:<l eID="gen3500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3501"/>while their food was still in their mouths,<l eID="gen3501" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3502"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:31
verses.text: the wrath of God rose against them.<l eID="gen3502" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3503"/>He slew the stoutest among them,<l eID="gen3503" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3504"/>and laid low the young men of Israel.<l eID="gen3504" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3497"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3505"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3506"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:32
verses.text: Yet for all this they sinned yet more,<l eID="gen3506" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3507"/>and refused to believe in his wonders.<l eID="gen3507" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3508"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:33
verses.text: So he ended their days in a breath,<l eID="gen3508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3509"/>and their years in sudden dismay.<l eID="gen3509" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3510"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:34
verses.text: When he slew them, then they sought after him,<l eID="gen3510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3511"/>they turned and sought God with diligence.<l eID="gen3511" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3505"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3512"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3513"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:35
verses.text: They remembered that God was their rock,<l eID="gen3513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3514"/>and the Most High God their redeemer.<l eID="gen3514" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3515"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:36
verses.text: But they flattered him with their mouth,<l eID="gen3515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3516"/>and lied to him with their tongue.<l eID="gen3516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3517"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:37
verses.text: Their heart was not steady with him,<l eID="gen3517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3518"/>they were faithless to his covenant.<l eID="gen3518" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3512"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3519"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3520"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:38
verses.text: But he is full of pity:<l eID="gen3520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3521"/>he pardons sin and destroys not.<l eID="gen3521" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3522"/>Often he turns his anger away,<l eID="gen3522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3523"/>without stirring his wrath at all.<l eID="gen3523" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3524"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:39
verses.text: So he remembered that they were but flesh,<l eID="gen3524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3525"/>breath that passes and does not return.<l eID="gen3525" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3519"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3526"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3527"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:40
verses.text: But how often they rebelled in the desert,<l eID="gen3527" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3528"/>and caused him grief in the wilderness,<l eID="gen3528" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3529"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:41
verses.text: tempting God again and again,<l eID="gen3529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3530"/>provoking the Holy One of Israel.<l eID="gen3530" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3531"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:42
verses.text: They did not remember his strength,<l eID="gen3531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3532"/>nor the day he redeemed from the foe,<l eID="gen3532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3533"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:43
verses.text: how he set his signs in Egypt,<l eID="gen3533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3534"/>in the country of Zoan his wonders.<l eID="gen3534" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3526"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3535"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3536"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:44
verses.text: He turned their canals into blood,<l eID="gen3536" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3537"/>their streams undrinkable.<l eID="gen3537" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3538"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:45
verses.text: He sent forth flies, which devoured them;<l eID="gen3538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3539"/>frogs, too, which destroyed them.<l eID="gen3539" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3540"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:46
verses.text: Their crops he gave to the caterpillar,<l eID="gen3540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3541"/>and the fruits of their toil to the locust.<l eID="gen3541" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3542"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:47
verses.text: He slew their vines with hail,<l eID="gen3542" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3543"/>and their sycamore trees with frost.<l eID="gen3543" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3544"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:48
verses.text: He delivered their cattle to the hail,<l eID="gen3544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3545"/>and their flocks to bolts of fire.<l eID="gen3545" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3535"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3546"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3547"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:49
verses.text: He let loose his hot anger among them,<l eID="gen3547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3548"/>fury and wrath and distress,<l eID="gen3548" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3549"/>a band of destroying angels.<l eID="gen3549" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3550"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:50
verses.text: He cleared a path for his anger,<l eID="gen3550" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3551"/>did not spare them from death,<l eID="gen3551" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3552"/>but gave them over to pestilence.<l eID="gen3552" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3546"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3553"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3554"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:51
verses.text: He struck down all the first-born in Egypt,<l eID="gen3554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3555"/>the first fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham.<l eID="gen3555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3556"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:52
verses.text: He led forth his people like sheep,<l eID="gen3556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3557"/>he was guide to his flock in the desert.<l eID="gen3557" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3558"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:53
verses.text: Securely he led them, and free from fear,<l eID="gen3558" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3559"/>while their foes were drowned in the sea.<l eID="gen3559" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3553"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3560"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3561"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:54
verses.text: To his holy realm he brought them,<l eID="gen3561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3562"/>to the mountain his right hand had purchased.<l eID="gen3562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3563"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:55
verses.text: He drove out the nations before them,<l eID="gen3563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3564"/>and allotted their land for possession,<l eID="gen3564" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3565"/>and their tents for Israel to live in.<l eID="gen3565" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3560"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3566"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3567"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:56
verses.text: Yet they tempted and angered the Most High God,<l eID="gen3567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3568"/>they did not observe his decrees.<l eID="gen3568" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3569"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:57
verses.text: They drew back, false like their ancestors;<l eID="gen3569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3570"/>they failed like a treacherous bow.<l eID="gen3570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3571"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:58
verses.text: Their shrines stirred him to anger,<l eID="gen3571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3572"/>their idols moved him to jealousy.<l eID="gen3572" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3566"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3573"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3574"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:59
verses.text: When God heard of this, he was furious,<l eID="gen3574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3575"/>and he spurned Israel utterly.<l eID="gen3575" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3576"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:60
verses.text: He abandoned his home in Shiloh,<l eID="gen3576" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3577"/>the tent he had pitched among people.<l eID="gen3577" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3578"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:61
verses.text: He gave his strength up to captivity,<l eID="gen3578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3579"/>his glory to the hands of the foe.<l eID="gen3579" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3573"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3580"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3581"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:62
verses.text: He gave his people to the sword,<l eID="gen3581" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3582"/>he was furious with his own.<l eID="gen3582" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3583"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:63
verses.text: Fire devoured their young men,<l eID="gen3583" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3584"/>and their maidens had no marriage-song.<l eID="gen3584" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3585"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:64
verses.text: Their priests fell by the sword,<l eID="gen3585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3586"/>and their widows could not weep.<l eID="gen3586" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3580"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3587"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3588"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:65
verses.text: Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName> awoke as from sleep,<l eID="gen3588" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3589"/>like a warrior flushed with wine;<l eID="gen3589" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3590"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:66
verses.text: and he beat back his foes,<l eID="gen3590" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3591"/>putting them to perpetual scorn.<l eID="gen3591" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3592"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:67
verses.text: He disowned the tent of Joseph,<l eID="gen3592" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3593"/>he rejected the tribe of Ephraim;<l eID="gen3593" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3594"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:68
verses.text: but he chose the tribe of Judah,<l eID="gen3594" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3595"/>Mount Zion, which he loves.<l eID="gen3595" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3596"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:69
verses.text: And he built like the heights his sanctuary,<l eID="gen3596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3597"/>like the earth which he founded forever.<l eID="gen3597" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3587"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3598"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3599"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:70
verses.text: And he chose David his servant,<l eID="gen3599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3600"/>taking him from the sheepfolds.<l eID="gen3600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3601"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:71
verses.text: From the mother-ewes he brought him,<l eID="gen3601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3602"/>to be shepherd to Jacob his people,<l eID="gen3602" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3603"/>and to Israel his inheritance.<l eID="gen3603" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3604"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:72
verses.text: With upright heart did he shepherd them,<l eID="gen3604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3605"/>and with skilful hands did he guide them.<l eID="gen3605" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3598"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.78"/> <div eID="gen3419" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv79"/><div sID="gen3606" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 79</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3607"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv79"/> Heathen, O God, have come into your land,<l eID="gen3608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3609"/>defiling your holy temple,<l eID="gen3609" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3610"/>and laying Jerusalem in ruins.<l eID="gen3610" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3611"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: They have given the bodies of your dead servants<l eID="gen3611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3612"/>to the birds of the air to devour,<l eID="gen3612" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3613"/>and the flesh of your faithful to the beasts of the field.<l eID="gen3613" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3614"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: Round about Jerusalem<l eID="gen3614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3615"/>they have poured out their blood like water;<l eID="gen3615" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3616"/>and there was no one to bury them.<l eID="gen3616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3617"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: On every side our neighbours<l eID="gen3617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3618"/>revile us and mock us and jeer at us.<l eID="gen3618" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3607"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3619"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3620"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: How long will you be angry, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen3620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3621"/>Will your jealousy burn like fire forever?<l eID="gen3621" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3622"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you,<l eID="gen3622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3623"/>on the kingdoms that do not call on your name.<l eID="gen3623" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3624"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: For Jacob they devoured,<l eID="gen3624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3625"/>they have desolated his home.<l eID="gen3625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: Do not remember against us our ancestor's sins;<l eID="gen3626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3627"/>O meet us soon with your pity,<l eID="gen3627" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3628"/>for utterly weak are we.<l eID="gen3628" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3619"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3629"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3630"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: Help us, O God our saviour,<l eID="gen3630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3631"/>for the renown of your name:<l eID="gen3631" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3632"/>for your reputation deliver us<l eID="gen3632" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3633"/>and cover over our sins.<l eID="gen3633" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3634"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: Why should the nations say,<l eID="gen3634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3635"/>“Where is their God?”<l eID="gen3635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3636"/>Let revenge for the outpoured blood of your servants<l eID="gen3636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3637"/>be shown on the heathen before our eyes.<l eID="gen3637" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3638"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: May the groans of the prisoner come before you;<l eID="gen3638" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3639"/>free the children of death by your mighty arm.<l eID="gen3639" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3640"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: Pay our neighbours back sevenfold<l eID="gen3640" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3641"/>for the scorn they have heaped upon you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen3641" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3629"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3642"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3643"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: Then we, your people, the flock of your pasture,<l eID="gen3643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3644"/>will give thanks to you for evermore,<l eID="gen3644" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3645"/>and tell your praise to all generations.<l eID="gen3645" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3642"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.79"/> <div eID="gen3606" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv80"/><div sID="gen3646" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 80</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On shoshannim, eduth. Of Asaph, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen3647"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv80"/> Listen, Shepherd of Israel,<l eID="gen3648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3649"/>who leads Joseph like a flock of sheep;<l eID="gen3649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3650"/>from your throne on the cherubs shine forth<l eID="gen3650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3651"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: before Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin.<l eID="gen3651" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3652"/>Stir up your mighty power,<l eID="gen3652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3653"/>come to our help.<l eID="gen3653" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3654"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: God, restore us:<l eID="gen3654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3655"/>show us the light of your face,<l eID="gen3655" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3656"/>so we may be saved.<l eID="gen3656" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3647"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3657"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3658"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: O <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen3658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3659"/>how long is your anger to smoke,<l eID="gen3659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3660"/>despite the prayer of your people?<l eID="gen3660" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3661"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: You have fed them with bread of tears,<l eID="gen3661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3662"/>you have made them drink tears by the measure.<l eID="gen3662" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3663"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: The scorn of our neighbours you make us,<l eID="gen3663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3664"/>the laughing-stock of our foes.<l eID="gen3664" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3665"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: God of hosts, restore us:<l eID="gen3665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3666"/>show us the light of your face,<l eID="gen3666" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3667"/>so we may be saved.<l eID="gen3667" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3657"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3668"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3669"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: A vine out of Egypt you brought;<l eID="gen3669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3670"/>you did drive out the nations, and plant her;<l eID="gen3670" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3671"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: in the ground you did clear she struck root,<l eID="gen3671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3672"/>and she filled all the land.<l eID="gen3672" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3673"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
verses.text: The shade of her covered the mountains,<l eID="gen3673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3674"/>her branches the cedars of God.<l eID="gen3674" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3675"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: She sent forth her shoots to the sea,<l eID="gen3675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3676"/>and her branches as far as the River.<l eID="gen3676" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3677"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
verses.text: Why have you torn down her fences, and left her<l eID="gen3677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3678"/>to be plucked at by all who pass by,<l eID="gen3678" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3679"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: to be gnawed by the boar from the forest,<l eID="gen3679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3680"/>and devoured by the beasts of the field?<l eID="gen3680" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3668"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3681"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3682"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: O God of hosts, return:<l eID="gen3682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3683"/>look down from heaven and see<l eID="gen3683" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3684"/>and visit this vine, and restore her<l eID="gen3684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3685"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: the vine which your right hand has planted.<l eID="gen3685" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3686"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: She is burned with fire and cut down<l eID="gen3686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3687"/>before your stern face they are perishing.<l eID="gen3687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3688"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: Support the one you have chosen,<l eID="gen3688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3689"/>the one you have raised for yourself;<l eID="gen3689" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3690"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:18
verses.text: then from you we will never draw back.<l eID="gen3690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3691"/>Preserve us, and we will call on your name.<l eID="gen3691" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3692"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:19
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, God of hosts, restore us:<l eID="gen3692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3693"/>Show us the light of your face,<l eID="gen3693" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3694"/>so we may be saved.<l eID="gen3694" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3681"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.80"/> <div eID="gen3646" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv81"/><div sID="gen3695" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 81</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On the gittith. Of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3696"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv81"/> Sing aloud to God our strength,<l eID="gen3697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3698"/>shout for joy to the God of Jacob.<l eID="gen3698" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3699"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:2
verses.text: Raise a song, sound the timbrel,<l eID="gen3699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3700"/>sweet lyre and harp.<l eID="gen3700" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3701"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:3
verses.text: On the new moon blow the horn,<l eID="gen3701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3702"/>at the full moon, the day of our festival.<l eID="gen3702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3703"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:4
verses.text: For this is a statute for Israel,<l eID="gen3703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3704"/>a ruling of the God of Jacob,<l eID="gen3704" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3705"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:5
verses.text: a witness he set up in Joseph,<l eID="gen3705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3706"/>when he marched against Egypt’s land,<l eID="gen3706" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3707"/>where he heard an unknown language.<l eID="gen3707" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3696"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3708"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3709"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:6
verses.text: “I removed from your shoulder the burden,<l eID="gen3709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3710"/>and freed your hands from the basket.<l eID="gen3710" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3711"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:7
verses.text: At your call of distress I delivered you,<l eID="gen3711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3712"/>from the thundercloud I answered you.<l eID="gen3712" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3713"/>At Meribah’s waters I tested you. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3713" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3708"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3714"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3715"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:8
verses.text: Listen, my people, to my warning,<l eID="gen3715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3716"/>O Israel, if you would but listen<l eID="gen3716" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3717"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:9
verses.text: ‘There must not be a strange god among you,<l eID="gen3717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3718"/>you must bow to no foreign god.<l eID="gen3718" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3719"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:10
verses.text: I am the <divineName>Lord</divineName> your God<l eID="gen3719" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3720"/>who brought you up out of Egypt.<l eID="gen3720" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3721"/>Open your mouth, that I fill it.’<l eID="gen3721" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3714"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3722"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3723"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:11
verses.text: But my people did not listen to my voice,<l eID="gen3723" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3724"/>Israel would have none of me.<l eID="gen3724" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3725"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:12
verses.text: So to their own hard hearts I left them,<l eID="gen3725" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3726"/>to follow their own devices.<l eID="gen3726" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3727"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:13
verses.text: O that my people would listen,<l eID="gen3727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3728"/>that Israel would walk in my ways.<l eID="gen3728" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3729"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:14
verses.text: Soon would I humble their enemies,<l eID="gen3729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3730"/>and turn my hand on their foes.<l eID="gen3730" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3731"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:15
verses.text: Those who hate the <divineName>Lord</divineName> would cringe before him<l eID="gen3731" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3732"/>in everlasting terror.<l eID="gen3732" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3733"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:16
verses.text: But you would I feed with the richest wheat,<l eID="gen3733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3734"/>and with honey from the rock to your heart’s desire.”<l eID="gen3734" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3722"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.81"/> <div eID="gen3695" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv82"/><div sID="gen3735" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 82</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3736"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv82"/> God has taken his stand<l eID="gen3737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3738"/>in the divine assembly:<l eID="gen3738" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3739"/>in the midst of the gods he holds judgment.<l eID="gen3739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3740"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:2
verses.text: “How long will you crookedly judge,<l eID="gen3740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3741"/>and favour the wicked? <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3741" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3742"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:3
verses.text: Do right by the weak and the orphan,<l eID="gen3742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3743"/>acquit the innocent poor.<l eID="gen3743" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3744"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:4
verses.text: Rescue the weak and the needy,<l eID="gen3744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3745"/>save them from the hand of the wicked.<l eID="gen3745" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3736"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3746"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:5
verses.text: They have neither knowledge nor insight,<l eID="gen3747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3748"/>in darkness they walk to and fro,<l eID="gen3748" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3749"/>while the earth’s foundations totter.<l eID="gen3749" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3750"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:6
verses.text: It was I who appointed you gods,<l eID="gen3750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3751"/>children of the Most High all of you.<l eID="gen3751" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3752"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:7
verses.text: Yet like mortals you shall surely die,<l eID="gen3752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3753"/>you shall fall like any prince.”<l eID="gen3753" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3746"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3754"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3755"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:8
verses.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth,<l eID="gen3755" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3756"/>for all nations are yours by inheritance.<l eID="gen3756" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3754"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.82"/> <div eID="gen3735" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv83"/><div sID="gen3757" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 83</title> <title type="psalm">A song, a psalm of Asaph.</title> <lg sID="gen3758"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv83"/> Do not keep silent, O God:<l eID="gen3759" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3760"/>hold not your peace, be not still, God.<l eID="gen3760" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3761"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:2
verses.text: For see! Your enemies roar,<l eID="gen3761" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3762"/>those who hate you lift up their heads,<l eID="gen3762" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3763"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:3
verses.text: laying crafty plans for your people,<l eID="gen3763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3764"/>and plotting against those you treasure.<l eID="gen3764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3765"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:4
verses.text: “Come, let us wipe them out as a nation,<l eID="gen3765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3766"/>so Israel’s name will be mentioned no more.”<l eID="gen3766" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3758"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3767"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3768"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:5
verses.text: For, conspiring with one accord,<l eID="gen3768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3769"/>they have made a league against you<l eID="gen3769" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3770"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:6
verses.text: Tents of Edom, and Ishmaelites,<l eID="gen3770" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3771"/>Moab, and the Hagrites.<l eID="gen3771" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3772"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:7
verses.text: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek,<l eID="gen3772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3773"/>Philistia, with the people of Tyre;<l eID="gen3773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3774"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:8
