verses.text: Syria, too, is confederate,<l eID="gen3774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3775"/>they have strengthened the children of Lot. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3775" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3767"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3776"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3777"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:9
verses.text: Deal with them as you dealt with Midian,<l eID="gen3777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3778"/>with Sisera, with Jabin, at the torrent of Kishon,<l eID="gen3778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:10
verses.text: who at Endor were destroyed,<l eID="gen3779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3780"/>and became dung for the field.<l eID="gen3780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3781"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:11
verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb,<l eID="gen3781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3782"/>all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,<l eID="gen3782" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3783"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:12
verses.text: who said, “Let us take for ourselves<l eID="gen3783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3784"/>the meadows of God.”<l eID="gen3784" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3776"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3785"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3786"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:13
verses.text: Whirl them, my God, like dust,<l eID="gen3786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3787"/>like stubble before the wind.<l eID="gen3787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3788"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:14
verses.text: As the fire that kindles the forest,<l eID="gen3788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3789"/>as flame that sets mountains ablaze,<l eID="gen3789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3790"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:15
verses.text: so with your tempest pursue them,<l eID="gen3790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3791"/>terrify them with your hurricane.<l eID="gen3791" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3792"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:16
verses.text: Make them blush with shame;<l eID="gen3792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3793"/>until they seek your name, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen3793" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3794"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:17
verses.text: Everlasting shame and confusion,<l eID="gen3794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3795"/>disgrace and destruction be theirs.<l eID="gen3795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3796"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:18
verses.text: Teach those who you alone<l eID="gen3796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3797"/>are most high over all the earth.<l eID="gen3797" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3785"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.83"/> <div eID="gen3757" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv84"/><div sID="gen3798" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 84</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. On the gittith. Of the Korahites, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen3799"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv84"/> How dearly loved is the place where you live,<l eID="gen3800" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3801"/><divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts!<l eID="gen3801" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3802"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: How I long and yearn<l eID="gen3802" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3803"/>for the courts of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen3803" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3804"/>Now heart and flesh cry for joy<l eID="gen3804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3805"/>to the living God.<l eID="gen3805" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3799"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3806"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3807"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: Even the sparrow has found her a home<l eID="gen3807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3808"/>and the swallow a nest,<l eID="gen3808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3809"/>to lay her young,<l eID="gen3809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3810"/>near your altar,<l eID="gen3810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3811"/><divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen3811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3812"/>my king and my God.<l eID="gen3812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3813"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: Happy those who live in your house,<l eID="gen3813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3814"/>praising you evermore. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3814" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3806"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3815"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3816"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: Happy are those whose strength is in you,<l eID="gen3816" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3817"/>people with pilgrim hearts.<l eID="gen3817" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3818"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: As they pass through the valley of tears,<l eID="gen3818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3819"/>they make it a place of fountains,<l eID="gen3819" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3820"/>clothed with the blessings of early rain.<l eID="gen3820" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3821"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: From rampart to rampart on they march,<l eID="gen3821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3822"/>till at last God reveals himself in Zion.<l eID="gen3822" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3815"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3823"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3824"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, God of hosts, hear my prayer,<l eID="gen3824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3825"/>give ear, O God of Jacob. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3826"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: Behold, O God, our defender,<l eID="gen3826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3827"/>and look upon your anointed,<l eID="gen3827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3828"/>for better a single day in your courts<l eID="gen3828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3829"/>than a thousand in my own chambers:<l eID="gen3829" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3830"/>better stand at the door of the house of my God<l eID="gen3830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3831"/>than live in the tents of ungodliness,<l eID="gen3831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3832"/>for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is sun and shield,<l eID="gen3832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3833"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> gives grace and glory.<l eID="gen3833" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3834"/>He withholds no good thing from the life that is blameless.<l eID="gen3834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3835"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts,<l eID="gen3835" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3836"/>happy the person whose trust is in you.<l eID="gen3836" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3823"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.84"/> <div eID="gen3798" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv85"/><div sID="gen3837" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 85</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of the Korahites, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen3838"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv85"/> Once, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you did favour your land,<l eID="gen3839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3840"/>granting change of fortune to Jacob,<l eID="gen3840" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3841"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:2
verses.text: forgiving the guilt of your people,<l eID="gen3841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3842"/>pardoning all their sin, <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3843"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:3
verses.text: withdrawing all your fury,<l eID="gen3843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3844"/>turning from your hot anger.<l eID="gen3844" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3838"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3845"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3846"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:4
verses.text: Restore us, O God our saviour,<l eID="gen3846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3847"/>put away your displeasure against us.<l eID="gen3847" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3848"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:5
verses.text: Will you cherish your anger against us forever,<l eID="gen3848" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3849"/>prolonging your wrath to all generations?<l eID="gen3849" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3850"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:6
verses.text: Will you not revive us again,<l eID="gen3850" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3851"/>that your people may be glad in you?<l eID="gen3851" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3852"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:7
verses.text: Show us your kindness, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3852" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3853"/>grant us your salvation.<l eID="gen3853" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3845"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3854"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3855"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:8
verses.text: Let me hear what God the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will speak;<l eID="gen3855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3856"/>for he will speak of peace<l eID="gen3856" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3857"/>to his people, to those who love him,<l eID="gen3857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3858"/>and turn their hearts to him.<l eID="gen3858" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3859"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:9
verses.text: Soon those who fear him shall see how he saves,<l eID="gen3859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3860"/>and glory shall live in our land.<l eID="gen3860" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3854"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3861"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3862"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:10
verses.text: Kindness and loyalty meet;<l eID="gen3862" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3863"/>peace and righteousness kiss.<l eID="gen3863" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3864"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:11
verses.text: Loyalty springs from the earth;<l eID="gen3864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3865"/>righteousness looks from the sky.<l eID="gen3865" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3866"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:12
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall give all that is good,<l eID="gen3866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3867"/>our land yielding its increase,<l eID="gen3867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3868"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:13
verses.text: righteousness marching before him,<l eID="gen3868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3869"/>and peace on the path he treads.<l eID="gen3869" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3861"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.85"/> <div eID="gen3837" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv86"/><div sID="gen3870" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 86</title> <title type="psalm">A prayer of David.</title> <lg sID="gen3871"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv86"/> Incline your ear, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and answer me,<l eID="gen3872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3873"/>for I am afflicted and needy.<l eID="gen3873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3874"/>Guard me, for I am loyal:<l eID="gen3874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3875"/>save your servant, who trusts in you.<l eID="gen3875" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3876"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:3
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, be gracious to me, for you are my God;<l eID="gen3876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3877"/>I cry to you all the day.<l eID="gen3877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3878"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:4
verses.text: Gladden the heart of your servant;<l eID="gen3878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3879"/>for to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I set my hope.<l eID="gen3879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3880"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:5
verses.text: For you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are good and forgiving,<l eID="gen3880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3881"/>rich in love towards all who call on you.<l eID="gen3881" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3871"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3882"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3883"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:6
verses.text: Listen, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to my prayer;<l eID="gen3883" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3884"/>attend to my plea for mercy.<l eID="gen3884" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3885"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:7
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I call on you,<l eID="gen3885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3886"/>with assurance that you will answer me.<l eID="gen3886" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3887"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:8
verses.text: None of the gods is like you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3888"/>nor are any works like yours.<l eID="gen3888" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3889"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:9
verses.text: All the nations you have made<l eID="gen3889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3890"/>will come and bow down before you,<l eID="gen3890" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3891"/>giving glory, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to your name.<l eID="gen3891" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3892"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:10
verses.text: For great are you, and a doer of wonders;<l eID="gen3892" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3893"/>you alone are God.<l eID="gen3893" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3882"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3894"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3895"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:11
verses.text: Teach me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, your way,<l eID="gen3895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3896"/>that I may walk in your truth:<l eID="gen3896" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3897"/>so my heart shall rejoice in your name.<l eID="gen3897" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3898"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:12
verses.text: I will give you thanks, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3899"/>with all my heart, my God,<l eID="gen3899" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3900"/>I will honour your name forever.<l eID="gen3900" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3901"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:13
verses.text: For great is your love towards me,<l eID="gen3901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3902"/>from the depths of Sheol you have saved me.<l eID="gen3902" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3894"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3903"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3904"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:14
verses.text: Haughty men have risen up against me, O God,<l eID="gen3904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3905"/>a band of the violent seeking my life,<l eID="gen3905" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3906"/>who think nothing of you.<l eID="gen3906" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3907"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:15
verses.text: But you are a God of pity and grace,<l eID="gen3907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3908"/>patient and rich in kindness and faithfulness;<l eID="gen3908" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3909"/>turn to me with your grace, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen3909" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3910"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:16
verses.text: Grant your strength to your servant,<l eID="gen3910" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3911"/>and save the child of your handmaid.<l eID="gen3911" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3912"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:17
verses.text: Show me a sign of your favour,<l eID="gen3912" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3913"/>which those who hate me may see with confusion,<l eID="gen3913" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3914"/>since you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are my helper and comforter.<l eID="gen3914" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3903"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.86"/> <div eID="gen3870" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv87"/><div sID="gen3915" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 87</title> <title type="psalm">Of the Korahites, a psalm. A song.</title> <lg sID="gen3916"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv87"/> On the holy mountain stands<l eID="gen3917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3918"/>the city he founded.<l eID="gen3918" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3919"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:2
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> loves the gates of Zion<l eID="gen3919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3920"/>more than all the dwellings of Jacob.<l eID="gen3920" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3921"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:3
verses.text: Glorious things he is speaking of you,<l eID="gen3921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3922"/>you city of God. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3922" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3916"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3923"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3924"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:4
verses.text: “Among those who are mine I name Rahab and Babylon,<l eID="gen3924" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3925"/>Philistia, Tyre, Ethiopia,<l eID="gen3925" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3926"/>their people will say I was born in Zion.<l eID="gen3926" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3927"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:5
verses.text: As for Zion it will be said<l eID="gen3927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3928"/>each and all were born in her.”<l eID="gen3928" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3929"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName> will preserve her.<l eID="gen3929" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen3923"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3930"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3931"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:6
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall count, when enrolling the peoples,<l eID="gen3931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3932"/>“This one was born there, and that one was born there.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3933"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:7
verses.text: Singers and dancers alike will say<l eID="gen3933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3934"/>“All my springs are in you.”<l eID="gen3934" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3930"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.87"/> <div eID="gen3915" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv88"/><div sID="gen3935" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 88</title> <lg sID="gen3936"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv88"/> O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God,<l eID="gen3937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3938"/>I cry for help in the day-time,<l eID="gen3938" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3939"/>in the night my cry is before you;<l eID="gen3939" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3940"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:2
verses.text: let my prayer come into your presence,<l eID="gen3940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3941"/>incline your ear to my cry.<l eID="gen3941" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3936"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3942"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3943"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:3
verses.text: For I am sated with sorrow,<l eID="gen3943" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3944"/>my life draws near to Sheol.<l eID="gen3944" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3945"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:4
verses.text: I am counted with those who go down to the pit;<l eID="gen3945" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3946"/>without strength am I.<l eID="gen3946" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3942"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3947"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3948"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:5
verses.text: My home is among the dead,<l eID="gen3948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3949"/>like the slain that lie in the grave,<l eID="gen3949" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3950"/>whom you remember no more<l eID="gen3950" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3951"/>cut off as they are from your hand.<l eID="gen3951" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3947"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3952"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3953"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:6
verses.text: In the deepest pit you have put me,<l eID="gen3953" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3954"/>in shadows deep and dark.<l eID="gen3954" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3955"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:7
verses.text: Your wrath lies heavy upon me,<l eID="gen3955" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3956"/>waves of your anger roll over me. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3956" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3952"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3957"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3958"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:8
verses.text: You have put my friends far from me,<l eID="gen3958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3959"/>you have made them shun me.<l eID="gen3959" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3960"/>I am shut in, and cannot escape,<l eID="gen3960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3961"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:9
verses.text: my eyes are wasted with sorrow.<l eID="gen3961" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3962"/>I call on you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, every day,<l eID="gen3962" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3963"/>spreading my hands out to you.<l eID="gen3963" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3957"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3964"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3965"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:10
verses.text: For the dead can you work wonders?<l eID="gen3965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3966"/>Can the shades rise again to praise you? <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3966" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3967"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:11
verses.text: Can your kindness be told in the grave,<l eID="gen3967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3968"/>your faithfulness in the tomb?<l eID="gen3968" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3969"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:12
verses.text: Can your wonders be known in the darkness,<l eID="gen3969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3970"/>or your help in the land of forgetfulness?<l eID="gen3970" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3964"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3971"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3972"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:13
verses.text: I cry for help to you,<l eID="gen3972" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3973"/>in the morning my prayer comes before you.<l eID="gen3973" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3974"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:14
verses.text: Why, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, do you spurn me,<l eID="gen3974" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3975"/>and hide your face from me?<l eID="gen3975" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3976"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:15
verses.text: From my youth I am wretched and dying,<l eID="gen3976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3977"/>I am numbed by the terrors I bear.<l eID="gen3977" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3971"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3978"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3979"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:16
verses.text: The fires of your wrath have passed over me,<l eID="gen3979" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3980"/>your terrors destroy me,<l eID="gen3980" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3981"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:17
verses.text: surging around me forever,<l eID="gen3981" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3982"/>hemming me in altogether.<l eID="gen3982" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3983"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:18
verses.text: Those who love me you put far from me;<l eID="gen3983" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3984"/>the dark is my only friend.<l eID="gen3984" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3978"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.88"/> <div eID="gen3935" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv89"/><div sID="gen3985" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 89</title> <title type="psalm">A song. A psalm of the Korahites.</title> <lg sID="gen3986"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv89"/> I will sing evermore of the love of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen3987" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3988"/>proclaiming to all generations his faithfulness.<l eID="gen3988" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3989"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:2
verses.text: For your love you did promise to build up forever,<l eID="gen3989" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3990"/>your faithfulness firm as the heavens themselves.<l eID="gen3990" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3986"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3991"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3992"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:3
verses.text: “I have made with my chosen a covenant,<l eID="gen3992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3993"/>and sworn to David my servant,<l eID="gen3993" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3994"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:4
verses.text: to establish his seed forever,<l eID="gen3994" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3995"/>and to build up his throne to all ages.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen3995" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3991"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen3996"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3997"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:5
verses.text: Then the holy assembly in heaven<l eID="gen3997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen3998"/>praised your marvellous faithfulness, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen3998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3999"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:6
verses.text: For who in the skies may compare with the <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen3999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4000"/>Who is like the <divineName>Lord</divineName> among the gods?<l eID="gen4000" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen3996"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4001"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4002"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:7
verses.text: A God to be feared in the holy assembly,<l eID="gen4002" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4003"/>awful and great above all who are round him.<l eID="gen4003" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4004"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:8
verses.text: O <divineName>Lord</divineName> God of hosts, who is mighty as you?<l eID="gen4004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4005"/>Your strength and faithfulness, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, surround you.<l eID="gen4005" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4001"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4006"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4007"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:9
verses.text: You are the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of the raging sea:<l eID="gen4007" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4008"/>when its waves surge, it is you who still them.<l eID="gen4008" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4009"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:10
verses.text: It was you who did pierce and crush Rahab in pieces,<l eID="gen4009" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4010"/>and scatter your foes by your mighty arm.<l eID="gen4010" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4006"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4011"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4012"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:11
verses.text: Yours are the heavens, yours also the earth,<l eID="gen4012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4013"/>the world and its fulness, it’s you who did found them.<l eID="gen4013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4014"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:12
verses.text: The north and the south, it’s you have created them;<l eID="gen4014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4015"/>Tabor and Hermon shout praise to your name.<l eID="gen4015" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4011"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4016"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4017"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:13
verses.text: You have an arm with the might of a hero;<l eID="gen4017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4018"/>strong is your hand, high uplifted your right hand.<l eID="gen4018" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4019"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:14
verses.text: Justice and right are the base of your throne,<l eID="gen4019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4020"/>kindness and faithfulness ever attend you.<l eID="gen4020" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4016"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4021"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4022"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:15
verses.text: Happy the people who know the glad shout,<l eID="gen4022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4023"/>who walk, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, in the light of your face.<l eID="gen4023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4024"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:16
verses.text: They exult in your name all the day,<l eID="gen4024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4025"/>and your righteousness they extol.<l eID="gen4025" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4021"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4026"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4027"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:17
verses.text: For you are our strength and our pride.<l eID="gen4027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4028"/>Your favour will lift us to honour.<l eID="gen4028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4029"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:18
verses.text: For the holy <divineName>Lord</divineName> of Israel<l eID="gen4029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4030"/>keeps our defender and king.<l eID="gen4030" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4026"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4031"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4032"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:19
verses.text: In a vision of old you did speak<l eID="gen4032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4033"/>in this way to the one whom you loved,<l eID="gen4033" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4034"/>“A crown I have set on the hero<l eID="gen4034" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4035"/>I chose to be over the people<l eID="gen4035" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4031"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4036"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4037"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:20
verses.text: I found my servant David,<l eID="gen4037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4038"/>and anointed with holy oil.<l eID="gen4038" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4039"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:21
verses.text: My hand will be with him forever,<l eID="gen4039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4040"/>my arm will give him strength.<l eID="gen4040" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4036"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4042"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:22
verses.text: No enemy will dare to assail him,<l eID="gen4042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4043"/>nor the wicked to oppress him;<l eID="gen4043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4044"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:23
verses.text: but his foes I will shatter before him,<l eID="gen4044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4045"/>I will strike down those who hate him.<l eID="gen4045" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4041"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4046"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4047"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:24
verses.text: My loyal love shall attend him,<l eID="gen4047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4048"/>and I will lift him to honour.<l eID="gen4048" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4049"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:25
verses.text: I will set his hand on the sea,<l eID="gen4049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4050"/>and his right hand on the rivers.<l eID="gen4050" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4046"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4051"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4052"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:26
verses.text: As for him, he will call me ‘My father,<l eID="gen4052" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4053"/>my God, and my rock of salvation.’<l eID="gen4053" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4054"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:27
verses.text: And I will make him my first-born,<l eID="gen4054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4055"/>highest of kings on the earth.<l eID="gen4055" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4051"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4056"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4057"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:28
verses.text: My love will I keep for him ever,<l eID="gen4057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4058"/>my covenant with him shall stand fast.<l eID="gen4058" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4059"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:29
verses.text: His line will I make everlasting,<l eID="gen4059" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4060"/>and his throne as the days of the heavens.<l eID="gen4060" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4056"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4061"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4062"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:30
verses.text: If his children forsake my law,<l eID="gen4062" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4063"/>and walk not as I have ordained;<l eID="gen4063" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4064"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:31
verses.text: if they profane my statutes,<l eID="gen4064" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4065"/>and do not keep my commandments;<l eID="gen4065" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4061"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4066"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4067"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:32
verses.text: I will punish their sin with the rod,<l eID="gen4067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4068"/>their iniquity with scourges.<l eID="gen4068" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4069"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:33
verses.text: But my love will I not take from him,<l eID="gen4069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4070"/>nor will I belie my faithfulness.<l eID="gen4070" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4066"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4071"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4072"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:34
verses.text: I will not profane my covenant<l eID="gen4072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4073"/>by changing the word that has passed my lips.<l eID="gen4073" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4074"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:35
verses.text: Once have I solemnly sworn<l eID="gen4074" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4075"/>and I would not lie to David,<l eID="gen4075" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4071"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4076"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4077"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:36
verses.text: that his line should endure forever,<l eID="gen4077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4078"/>and his throne as the sun before me,<l eID="gen4078" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4079"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:37
verses.text: firm as the moon which for ever<l eID="gen4079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4080"/>and ever is fixed in the sky.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen4080" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4076"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4081"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4082"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:38
verses.text: But you have cast off in contempt,<l eID="gen4082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4083"/>and been furious with your anointed.<l eID="gen4083" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4084"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:39
verses.text: You have spurned the covenant with your servant,<l eID="gen4084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4085"/>and his sacred crown dashed to the ground.<l eID="gen4085" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4081"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4086"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4087"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:40
verses.text: You have broken down all his walls,<l eID="gen4087" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4088"/>and laid his bulwarks in ruins.<l eID="gen4088" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4089"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:41
verses.text: All who pass on their way despoil him,<l eID="gen4089" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4090"/>the scorn of his neighbours is he now.<l eID="gen4090" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4086"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4091"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4092"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:42
verses.text: You have given his foes the victory,<l eID="gen4092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4093"/>and made all his enemies glad.<l eID="gen4093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4094"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:43
verses.text: You have turned back his sword from the foe,<l eID="gen4094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4095"/>you did not lift him up in the battle.<l eID="gen4095" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4091"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4096"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4097"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:44
verses.text: The sceptre you took from his hand,<l eID="gen4097" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4098"/>and his throne you did hurl to the ground.<l eID="gen4098" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4099"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:45
verses.text: You have shortened the days of his youth,<l eID="gen4099" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4100"/>and covered him with shame. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen4100" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4096"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4101"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:46
verses.text: How long, <divineName>Lord</divineName> will you hide you forever?<l eID="gen4102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4103"/>How long are the fires of your wrath to burn?<l eID="gen4103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:47
verses.text: Remember, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the shortness of life<l eID="gen4104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4105"/>how fleeting you made all people.<l eID="gen4105" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4101"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4106"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:48
verses.text: Who can live without seeing death?<l eID="gen4107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4108"/>Who can rescue their life from the clutch of Sheol? <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen4108" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:49
verses.text: Where, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, is your kindness of old,<l eID="gen4109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4110"/>which you in your faithfulness swore to David?<l eID="gen4110" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4106"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4111"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4112"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:50
verses.text: Remember, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, how your servants are mocked,<l eID="gen4112" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4113"/>how I bear in my heart the scorn of all nations<l eID="gen4113" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4114"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:51
verses.text: The scorn which your enemies hurl, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4115"/>which they hurl at the footsteps of your anointed.<l eID="gen4115" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4111"/> <lb/> <lb/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4116"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4117"/><hi type="italic">Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for ever and ever.</hi><l eID="gen4117" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4118"/><hi type="italic">Amen and Amen.</hi><l eID="gen4118" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4116"/>  <div eID="gen3985" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Ps.89"/> <div eID="gen3181" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv90"/><div sID="gen4120" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 90</title> <title type="psalm">A prayer of Moses, the man of God.</title> <lg sID="gen4121"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv90"/> <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you have been a home to us<l eID="gen4122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4123"/>one generation after another.<l eID="gen4123" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4124"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:2
verses.text: Before the mountains were born,<l eID="gen4124" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4125"/>or the earth and the world were brought forth,<l eID="gen4125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4126"/>from everlasting to everlasting<l eID="gen4126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4127"/>you are God.<l eID="gen4127" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4121"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4128"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:3
verses.text: You bring us back to the dust,<l eID="gen4129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4130"/>you summon mortals to return.<l eID="gen4130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:4
verses.text: For you see a thousand years<l eID="gen4131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4132"/>as the passing of yesterday,<l eID="gen4132" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4133"/>as a watch in the night.<l eID="gen4133" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4128"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4134"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4135"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:5
verses.text: Your floods sweep them away;<l eID="gen4135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4136"/>they are like a dream,<l eID="gen4136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4137"/>or like grass which sprouts in the morning,<l eID="gen4137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:6
verses.text: which blossoms and sprouts in the morning,<l eID="gen4138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4139"/>but by evening is cut and withered.<l eID="gen4139" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4134"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4140"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:7
verses.text: For your anger consumes us,<l eID="gen4141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4142"/>the heat of your wrath confounds us.<l eID="gen4142" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4143"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:8
verses.text: Our sins you have set before you,<l eID="gen4143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4144"/>our secrets in the light of your face.<l eID="gen4144" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:9
verses.text: For through your wrath our days are declining,<l eID="gen4145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4146"/>we bring our years to an end as a sigh.<l eID="gen4146" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4140"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4147"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4148"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:10
verses.text: The span of our life is seventy years,<l eID="gen4148" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4149"/>or, if we are strong, maybe eighty;<l eID="gen4149" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4150"/>yet is their breadth but empty toil,<l eID="gen4150" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4151"/>for swiftly they go, and we fly away.<l eID="gen4151" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4147"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4152"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4153"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:11
verses.text: Who lays to heart the power of your anger?<l eID="gen4153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4154"/>Or who stands in reverent awe of your wrath?<l eID="gen4154" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4155"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:12
verses.text: O teach us to count our days<l eID="gen4155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4156"/>so our minds may learn wisdom.<l eID="gen4156" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4152"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4157"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4158"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:13
verses.text: Return, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>; why so long?<l eID="gen4158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4159"/>Relent on your servants.<l eID="gen4159" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4160"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:14
verses.text: Grant us your love to the full in the morning,<l eID="gen4160" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4161"/>that all our days we may shout for joy.<l eID="gen4161" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4157"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4162"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4163"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:15
verses.text: Make us glad for the days you have humbled us,<l eID="gen4163" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4164"/>for the evil years we have seen.<l eID="gen4164" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4165"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:16
verses.text: Let your servants see you in action,<l eID="gen4165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4166"/>show your majesty to their children.<l eID="gen4166" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4167"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:17
verses.text: Let the grace of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God be upon us,<l eID="gen4167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4168"/>uphold what our hands are striving to do.<l eID="gen4168" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4162"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.90"/> <div eID="gen4120" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv91"/><div sID="gen4169" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 91</title> <lg sID="gen4170"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv91"/> You whose home is the shelter of God Most High,<l eID="gen4171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4172"/>whose abode is the shadow of God Almighty,<l eID="gen4172" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4173"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: can say to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, “My refuge, my fortress,<l eID="gen4173" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4174"/>my God, in whom I trust,”<l eID="gen4174" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4170"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4175"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4176"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: For he saves you from fowler’s snare,<l eID="gen4176" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4177"/>from the yawning pit of destruction.<l eID="gen4177" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4178"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: He shelters you with his pinions,<l eID="gen4178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4179"/>and under his wings you may hide.<l eID="gen4179" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4175"/> <lb/> His truth will be a shield and buckler. <lb/> <lg sID="gen4180"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4181"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: You need not fear the terror of night,<l eID="gen4181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4182"/>nor the arrow that flies by day,<l eID="gen4182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4183"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: nor the plague that stalks in darkness,<l eID="gen4183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4184"/>nor the pestilence raging at noon.<l eID="gen4184" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4180"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4185"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4186"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: A thousand may fall at your side,<l eID="gen4186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4187"/>and ten thousand at your right hand:<l eID="gen4187" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4188"/>but it shall not draw near to you.<l eID="gen4188" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4185"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4189"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4190"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: You will only look on with your eyes,<l eID="gen4190" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4191"/>and see how the wicked are punished.<l eID="gen4191" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4192"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: As for you, the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is your refuge,<l eID="gen4192" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4193"/>you have made the Most High your defence.<l eID="gen4193" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4189"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4194"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4195"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: You will never be met by misfortune,<l eID="gen4195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4196"/>no plague shall come near your tent:<l eID="gen4196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4197"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: for he orders his angels to guard you,<l eID="gen4197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4198"/>wherever you go.<l eID="gen4198" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4194"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4199"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4200"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: They will carry you with their hands,<l eID="gen4200" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4201"/>lest you strike your foot on a stone.<l eID="gen4201" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4202"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: You will tread upon lions and adders,<l eID="gen4202" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4203"/>and trample young lions and dragons.<l eID="gen4203" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4199"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4204"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4205"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: “Because of their love for me, I will deliver them,<l eID="gen4205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4206"/>I will protect those who trust my name.<l eID="gen4206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4207"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: I will answer their cry and be with them in trouble,<l eID="gen4207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4208"/>bringing them forth into safety and honour.<l eID="gen4208" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4209"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: I will give them a life of many days,<l eID="gen4209" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4210"/>I will show them my salvation.”<l eID="gen4210" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4204"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.91"/> <div eID="gen4169" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv92"/><div sID="gen4211" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 92</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm. A song; for the sabbath day.</title> <lg sID="gen4212"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv92"/> It is good to give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4213" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4214"/>to sing praise to your name, O Most High,<l eID="gen4214" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4215"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:2
verses.text: to declare your love in the morning,<l eID="gen4215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4216"/>and your faithfulness in the night,<l eID="gen4216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4217"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:3
verses.text: with voice and a ten-stringed harp,<l eID="gen4217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4218"/>with music that throbs on the lyre.<l eID="gen4218" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4219"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:4
verses.text: For you make me glad by your deeds, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4220"/>at the work of your hands I will ring out my joy.<l eID="gen4220" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4212"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4221"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4222"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:5
verses.text: How great are your works, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen4222" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4223"/>how deep are your thoughts!<l eID="gen4223" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4224"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:6
verses.text: The insensitive cannot know,<l eID="gen4224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4225"/>nor can a fool understand,<l eID="gen4225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4226"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:7
verses.text: that, though the wicked flourish like grass,<l eID="gen4226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4227"/>and evil-doers all blossom,<l eID="gen4227" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4228"/>they will perish forever.<l eID="gen4228" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4221"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4229"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4230"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:8
verses.text: But you are exalted forever.<l eID="gen4230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4231"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:9
verses.text: For see! Your enemies, <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen4231" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4232"/>For see! Your enemies perish,<l eID="gen4232" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4233"/>all evil-doers are scattered.<l eID="gen4233" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4234"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:10
verses.text: But you lift me to honour,<l eID="gen4234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4235"/>and anoint me afresh with oil.<l eID="gen4235" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4236"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:11
verses.text: My eyes will feast on my foes,<l eID="gen4236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4237"/>and my ears will hear of the doom of the wicked.<l eID="gen4237" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4229"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4238"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4239"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:12
verses.text: The righteous will sprout like the palm,<l eID="gen4239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4240"/>will grow like a cedar of Lebanon.<l eID="gen4240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4241"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:13
verses.text: In the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> are they planted,<l eID="gen4241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4242"/>in the courts of our God they will sprout.<l eID="gen4242" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4243"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:14
verses.text: They will still bear fruit in old age,<l eID="gen4243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4244"/>all sappy and fresh will they be<l eID="gen4244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4245"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:15
verses.text: So they proclaim the <divineName>Lord</divineName> to be just,<l eID="gen4245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4246"/>my rock, in whom is no wrong.<l eID="gen4246" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4238"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.92"/> <div eID="gen4211" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv93"/><div sID="gen4247" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 93</title> <lg sID="gen4248"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv93"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> has taken his seat on the throne,<l eID="gen4249" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4250"/>clothed with majesty, armed with might.<l eID="gen4250" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4251"/>Now the world stands firm, to be shaken no more,<l eID="gen4251" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4252"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: firm stands your throne from all eternity.<l eID="gen4252" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4253"/>You are from everlasting.<l eID="gen4253" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4248"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4254"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4255"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: The floods, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, have lifted,<l eID="gen4255" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4256"/>the floods have lifted their voice,<l eID="gen4256" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4257"/>the floods lift up their roar.<l eID="gen4257" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4258"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: But more grand than the great roaring waters,<l eID="gen4258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4259"/>more grand than the ocean waves,<l eID="gen4259" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4260"/>grand on the height stands the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4260" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4254"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4261"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: What you have ordained is most sure;<l eID="gen4262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4263"/>most sure shall your house stand inviolate,<l eID="gen4263" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4264"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for ever and ever.<l eID="gen4264" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4261"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.93"/> <div eID="gen4247" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv94"/><div sID="gen4265" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 94</title> <lg sID="gen4266"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv94"/> <divineName>Lord</divineName>, God of vengeance,<l eID="gen4267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4268"/>God of vengeance, shine forth.<l eID="gen4268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4269"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:2
verses.text: Rise up, judge of the earth,<l eID="gen4269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4270"/>pay back the proud what they deserve.<l eID="gen4270" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4266"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4271"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4272"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:3
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, how long shall the wicked,<l eID="gen4272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4273"/>how long shall the wicked exult,<l eID="gen4273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4274"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:4
verses.text: with their blustering arrogant words,<l eID="gen4274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4275"/>their braggart and wicked speech,<l eID="gen4275" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4276"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:5
verses.text: crushing your people, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4276" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4277"/>and afflicting your heritage,<l eID="gen4277" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4278"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:6
verses.text: murdering widows and strangers,<l eID="gen4278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4279"/>slaying the fatherless?<l eID="gen4279" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4280"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:7
verses.text: They think that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> does not see,<l eID="gen4280" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4281"/>nor the God of Jacob regard it.<l eID="gen4281" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4271"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4282"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4283"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:8
verses.text: Take heed, you dullest of people;<l eID="gen4283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4284"/>when will you be wise, you fools?<l eID="gen4284" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4285"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:9
verses.text: Is he deaf, who planted the ear?<l eID="gen4285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4286"/>Is he blind, who fashioned the eye?<l eID="gen4286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4287"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:10
verses.text: Can he who trains nations not punish them<l eID="gen4287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4288"/>he who teaches knowledge to people?<l eID="gen4288" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4289"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:11
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> knows the thoughts of people,<l eID="gen4289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4290"/>that only a breath are they.<l eID="gen4290" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4282"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4291"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4292"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:12
verses.text: Happy are those whom you chasten,<l eID="gen4292" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4293"/>and teach out of your law,<l eID="gen4293" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4294"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:13
verses.text: keeping them calm in the day of misfortune,<l eID="gen4294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4295"/>till a pit be dug for the wicked.<l eID="gen4295" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4291"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4296"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4297"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:14
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will not leave his people,<l eID="gen4297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4298"/>he will not forsake his inheritance.<l eID="gen4298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4299"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:15
verses.text: For the righteous shall come to their rights,<l eID="gen4299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4300"/>and all true-hearted people shall follow them.<l eID="gen4300" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4296"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4301"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4302"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:16
verses.text: Who will rise up for me against those who do evil?<l eID="gen4302" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4303"/>Who will stand up for me against workers of wrong?<l eID="gen4303" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4304"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:17
verses.text: Were it not for the help of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4305"/>I would soon have gone to the silent grave.<l eID="gen4305" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4306"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:18
verses.text: When I thought that my foot was slipping,<l eID="gen4306" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4307"/>your kindness, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, held me up.<l eID="gen4307" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4308"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:19
verses.text: When with cares my heart was crowded,<l eID="gen4308" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4309"/>your comforts make me glad.<l eID="gen4309" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4301"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4310"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4311"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:20
verses.text: Can corrupt justice be your ally,<l eID="gen4311" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4312"/>framing mischief by statute?<l eID="gen4312" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4313"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:21
verses.text: They assail the life of the righteous,<l eID="gen4313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4314"/>and innocent blood condemn.<l eID="gen4314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4315"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:22
verses.text: But the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my sure retreat,<l eID="gen4315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4316"/>my God is the rock of my refuge.<l eID="gen4316" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4317"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:23
verses.text: He will bring back their sin upon them,<l eID="gen4317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4318"/>for their wickedness he will destroy them;<l eID="gen4318" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4319"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God will destroy them.<l eID="gen4319" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4310"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.94"/> <div eID="gen4265" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv95"/><div sID="gen4320" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 95</title> <lg sID="gen4321"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv95"/> Come! Let us ring out our joy to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4322" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4323"/>let us merrily shout to our rock of salvation.<l eID="gen4323" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4324"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: Before his face let us come with thanks,<l eID="gen4324" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4325"/>with songs of praise let us shout to him.<l eID="gen4325" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4321"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4326"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4327"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is a great God,<l eID="gen4327" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4328"/>king above all gods.<l eID="gen4328" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4329"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: In his hand are the depths of the earth,<l eID="gen4329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4330"/>the heights of the mountains are his.<l eID="gen4330" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4331"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: The sea is his, for he made it:<l eID="gen4331" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4332"/>the dry land was formed by his hands.<l eID="gen4332" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4326"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4333"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4334"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: Come! Let us worship and bow<l eID="gen4334" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4335"/>on our knees to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our creator.<l eID="gen4335" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4336"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: For he is our God; and we<l eID="gen4336" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4337"/>are the people he tends, the sheep in his care.<l eID="gen4337" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4333"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4338"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4339"/>If only you would heed his voice today:<l eID="gen4339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4340"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: “Do not harden your hearts as at Meribah,<l eID="gen4340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4341"/>or at Massah, that day in the desert,<l eID="gen4341" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4342"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: when your ancestors tempted and tried me,<l eID="gen4342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4343"/>though they had seen my deeds.<l eID="gen4343" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4338"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4344"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4345"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: For forty years I was filled with loathing<l eID="gen4345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4346"/>for that generation, so I said:<l eID="gen4346" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4347"/>‘A people with wandering hearts are they,<l eID="gen4347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4348"/>and ignorant of my ways.’<l eID="gen4348" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4349"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: So I solemnly swore to them in my anger,<l eID="gen4349" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4350"/>that never would they enter my place of rest.”<l eID="gen4350" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4344"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.95"/> <div eID="gen4320" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv96"/><div sID="gen4351" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 96</title> <lg sID="gen4352"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv96"/> Sing to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> a new song,<l eID="gen4353" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4354"/>sing to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, all the earth.<l eID="gen4354" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4355"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:2
verses.text: Sing to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, bless his name,<l eID="gen4355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4356"/>from day to day herald his victory.<l eID="gen4356" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4357"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:3
verses.text: Tell his glory among the nations,<l eID="gen4357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4358"/>his wonders among all peoples.<l eID="gen4358" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4352"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4359"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4360"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:4
verses.text: For great is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> and worthy all praise;<l eID="gen4360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4361"/>held in awe, above all gods:<l eID="gen4361" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4362"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:5
verses.text: for all the gods of the nations are idols,<l eID="gen4362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4363"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> created the heavens.<l eID="gen4363" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4364"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:6
verses.text: Before him are splendour and majesty,<l eID="gen4364" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4365"/>beauty and strength in his holy place.<l eID="gen4365" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4359"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4366"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4367"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:7
verses.text: Ascribe to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you tribes of the nations,<l eID="gen4367" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4368"/>ascribe to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> glory and strength.<l eID="gen4368" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4369"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:8
verses.text: Ascribe to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> the glory he manifests:<l eID="gen4369" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4370"/>bring you an offering, enter his courts.<l eID="gen4370" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4371"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:9
verses.text: Bow to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in holy array:<l eID="gen4371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4372"/>tremble before him, all the earth.<l eID="gen4372" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4366"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4373"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4374"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:10
verses.text: Say to the nations, “The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is king.”<l eID="gen4374" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4375"/>The world stands firm to be shaken no more.<l eID="gen4375" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4376"/>He will judge the peoples with equity.<l eID="gen4376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4377"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:11
verses.text: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice,<l eID="gen4377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4378"/>let the sea and its fulness thunder.<l eID="gen4378" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4373"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4379"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4380"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:12
verses.text: Let the field, and all that is in it, exult;<l eID="gen4380" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4381"/>let the trees of the forest ring out their joy<l eID="gen4381" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4382"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:13
verses.text: before the <divineName>Lord</divineName>: for he comes,<l eID="gen4382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4383"/>he comes to judge the earth.<l eID="gen4383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4384"/>He will judge the world with justice<l eID="gen4384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4385"/>and the nations with faithfulness.<l eID="gen4385" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4379"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.96"/> <div eID="gen4351" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv97"/><div sID="gen4386" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 97</title> <lg sID="gen4387"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv97"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is king, let the earth rejoice:<l eID="gen4388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4389"/>let her many isles be glad.<l eID="gen4389" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4390"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:2
verses.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him,<l eID="gen4390" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4391"/>justice and right are the base of his throne.<l eID="gen4391" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4392"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:3
verses.text: Fire goes before him,<l eID="gen4392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4393"/>and blazes around his steps,<l eID="gen4393" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4394"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:4
verses.text: his lightnings illumine the world:<l eID="gen4394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4395"/>the earth quakes at the sight.<l eID="gen4395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4396"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:5
verses.text: Mountains melt like wax<l eID="gen4396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4397"/>before the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of all the earth.<l eID="gen4397" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4398"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:6
verses.text: The heavens proclaim his justice,<l eID="gen4398" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4399"/>all nations behold his glory.<l eID="gen4399" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4387"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4400"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4401"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:7
verses.text: Shamed are all image-worshippers,<l eID="gen4401" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4402"/>who make a boast of their idols.<l eID="gen4402" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4403"/>All the gods bow before him.<l eID="gen4403" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4404"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:8
verses.text: Zion is glad at the tidings,<l eID="gen4404" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4405"/>the towns of Judah rejoice<l eID="gen4405" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4406"/>because of your judgments, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4406" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4407"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:9
verses.text: For you are most high over all the earth,<l eID="gen4407" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4408"/>greatly exalted above all gods.<l eID="gen4408" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4400"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4409"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:10
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> loves those who hate evil,<l eID="gen4410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4411"/>he guards the lives of the faithful:<l eID="gen4411" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4412"/>from the hand of the wicked he saves them.<l eID="gen4412" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4413"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:11
verses.text: Light arises for the righteous,<l eID="gen4413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4414"/>and joy for the upright in heart.<l eID="gen4414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4415"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:12
verses.text: Rejoice in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you righteous:<l eID="gen4415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4416"/>give thanks to his holy name.<l eID="gen4416" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4409"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.97"/> <div eID="gen4386" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv98"/><div sID="gen4417" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 98</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen4418"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv98"/> Sing a new song to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4420"/>for he has done wonders;<l eID="gen4420" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4421"/>his right hand and holy arm<l eID="gen4421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4422"/>have won him the victory.<l eID="gen4422" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4423"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:2
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> has made his victory known,<l eID="gen4423" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4424"/>and revealed to the eyes of the nations his righteousness.<l eID="gen4424" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4425"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:3
verses.text: Mindful he was of his kindness to Jacob,<l eID="gen4425" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4426"/>faithful he was to the house of Israel.<l eID="gen4426" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4427"/>All the ends of the earth have seen<l eID="gen4427" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4428"/>the victory of our God.<l eID="gen4428" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4418"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4429"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4430"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:4
verses.text: Shout, all the earth, to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen4430" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4431"/>break into cries and music.<l eID="gen4431" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4432"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:5
verses.text: Play on the lyre to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4432" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4433"/>on the lyre and with loud melody.<l eID="gen4433" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4434"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:6
verses.text: With trumpet and sound of horn,<l eID="gen4434" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4435"/>shout before the king.<l eID="gen4435" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4429"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4436"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4437"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:7
verses.text: Let the sea and its fulness roar,<l eID="gen4437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4438"/>the world and the dwellers upon it.<l eID="gen4438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4439"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:8
verses.text: Let the streams clap their hands,<l eID="gen4439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4440"/>let the hills shout for gladness together<l eID="gen4440" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4441"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:9
verses.text: before the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for he comes,<l eID="gen4441" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4442"/>he comes to judge the earth.<l eID="gen4442" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4443"/>He will judge the world with justice<l eID="gen4443" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4444"/>and the nations with equity.<l eID="gen4444" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4436"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.98"/> <div eID="gen4417" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv99"/><div sID="gen4445" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 99</title> <lg sID="gen4446"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv99"/> The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is king; let the nations tremble:<l eID="gen4447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4448"/>he is throned upon cherubs; let earth quake.<l eID="gen4448" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4449"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:2
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is great in Zion,<l eID="gen4449" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4450"/>he is high over all the nations.<l eID="gen4450" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4451"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:3
verses.text: Let them praise your great and terrible name.<l eID="gen4451" level="1"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4452"/>Holy is he.<l eID="gen4452" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4446"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4453"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4454"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:4
verses.text: You are a king who loves justice,<l eID="gen4454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4455"/>equity you have established:<l eID="gen4455" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4456"/>justice and right you have wrought for Jacob.<l eID="gen4456" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4457"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:5
verses.text: Exalt the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God,<l eID="gen4457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4458"/>bow down at his footstool.<l eID="gen4458" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4459"/>Holy is he.<l eID="gen4459" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4453"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4460"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4461"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:6
verses.text: Among his priests were Moses and Aaron,<l eID="gen4461" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4462"/>Samuel among those who called on his name.<l eID="gen4462" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4463"/>They called to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and he gave them answer.<l eID="gen4463" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4464"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:7
verses.text: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud,<l eID="gen4464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4465"/>they kept his commands and the statute he gave them.<l eID="gen4465" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4466"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:8
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God, you gave them answer.<l eID="gen4466" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4467"/>A God of forgiveness were you to them,<l eID="gen4467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4468"/>who suffered their deeds to go unpunished.<l eID="gen4468" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4469"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:9
verses.text: Exalt the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God;<l eID="gen4469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4470"/>bow down at his holy mountain.<l eID="gen4470" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4471"/>For holy is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God.<l eID="gen4471" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4460"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.99"/> <div eID="gen4445" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv100"/><div sID="gen4472" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 100</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of praise.</title> <lg sID="gen4473"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv100"/> Shout, all the earth, to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4475"/>Serve the <divineName>Lord</divineName> with gladness,<l eID="gen4475" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4476"/>approach him with ringing cries.<l eID="gen4476" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4477"/>Be sure that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> alone is God.<l eID="gen4477" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4478"/>It is he who has made us, and his we are<l eID="gen4478" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4479"/>his people, the sheep of his pasture.<l eID="gen4479" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4473"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4480"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4481"/>Enter his gates with thanksgiving,<l eID="gen4481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4482"/>his courts with praise.<l eID="gen4482" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4483"/>Give thanks to him, bless his name.<l eID="gen4483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4484"/>For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is good, his love is forever,<l eID="gen4484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4485"/>and to all ages endures his faithfulness.<l eID="gen4485" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4480"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.100"/> <div eID="gen4472" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv101"/><div sID="gen4486" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 101</title> <title type="psalm">Of David, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen4487"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv101"/> If kindness and justice I sing,<l eID="gen4488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4489"/>making melody to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4489" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4490"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:2
verses.text: I would look to the way that is blameless,<l eID="gen4490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4491"/>and make it my own.<l eID="gen4491" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4487"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4492"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4493"/>Within my own house I would walk<l eID="gen4493" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4494"/>with an innocent heart.<l eID="gen4494" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4495"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:3
verses.text: I would never direct my eyes<l eID="gen4495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4496"/>to a thing that is base.<l eID="gen4496" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4492"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4497"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4498"/>The impulse to stray I abhor<l eID="gen4498" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4499"/>it shall not cling to me.<l eID="gen4499" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4500"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:4
verses.text: Far from me be perverseness of heart,<l eID="gen4500" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4501"/>or kinship with evil.<l eID="gen4501" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4497"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4502"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4503"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:5
verses.text: Whoso slanders their neighbour in secret,<l eID="gen4503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4504"/>I bring them to silence:<l eID="gen4504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4505"/>haughty looks and proud hearts<l eID="gen4505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4506"/>I will not abide.<l eID="gen4506" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4502"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4507"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4508"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:6
verses.text: I will favour the true in the land,<l eID="gen4508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4509"/>they shall live in my court.<l eID="gen4509" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4510"/>Those who walk in a way that is blameless<l eID="gen4510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4511"/>shall be my attendant.<l eID="gen4511" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4507"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4512"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4513"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:7
verses.text: No one shall live in my house<l eID="gen4513" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4514"/>who practises guile.<l eID="gen4514" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4515"/>No one that speaks a lie<l eID="gen4515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4516"/>shall abide in my presence.<l eID="gen4516" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4512"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4517"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4518"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:8
