verses.text: Morn by morn I will wholly wipe out<l eID="gen4518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4519"/>all the bad in the land,<l eID="gen4519" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4520"/>and cut off from the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s own city<l eID="gen4520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4521"/>all workers of evil.<l eID="gen4521" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4517"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.101"/> <div eID="gen4486" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv102"/><div sID="gen4522" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 102</title> <lg sID="gen4523"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv102"/> Hear my prayer, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen4524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4525"/>let my cry for help come to you.<l eID="gen4525" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4526"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:2
verses.text: Hide not your face from me<l eID="gen4526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4527"/>in the day of my distress.<l eID="gen4527" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4528"/>Incline your ear to me:<l eID="gen4528" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4529"/>when I call, answer me speedily.<l eID="gen4529" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4523"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4530"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4531"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:3
verses.text: For my days pass away like smoke:<l eID="gen4531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4532"/>my bones are burned through as with fire.<l eID="gen4532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4533"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:4
verses.text: My heart is scorched, withered like grass;<l eID="gen4533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4534"/>I forget to eat my bread.<l eID="gen4534" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4535"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:5
verses.text: By reason of my loud groaning,<l eID="gen4535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4536"/>my flesh clings to my bones.<l eID="gen4536" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4530"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4537"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4538"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:6
verses.text: Like a desert-owl of the wilderness,<l eID="gen4538" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4539"/>like an owl among ruins am I.<l eID="gen4539" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4540"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:7
verses.text: I make my sleepless lament<l eID="gen4540" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4541"/>like a bird on the house-top alone.<l eID="gen4541" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4542"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:8
verses.text: All the day wild foes revile me,<l eID="gen4542" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4543"/>using my name for a curse.<l eID="gen4543" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4537"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4544"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4545"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:9
verses.text: For ashes have been my bread,<l eID="gen4545" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4546"/>and tears have been mixed with my cup.<l eID="gen4546" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4547"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:10
verses.text: Because of your passionate anger,<l eID="gen4547" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4548"/>you did raise me, then hurl me to the ground.<l eID="gen4548" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4549"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:11
verses.text: My days come to an end, shadows lengthen,<l eID="gen4549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4550"/>I wither like grass.<l eID="gen4550" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4544"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4551"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4552"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:12
verses.text: But you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are enthroned forever,<l eID="gen4552" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4553"/>your fame endures to all generations.<l eID="gen4553" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4554"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:13
verses.text: You will arise and have pity on Zion;<l eID="gen4554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4555"/>it’s time to be gracious; her hour has come.<l eID="gen4555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4556"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:14
verses.text: For even her stones are dear to your servants,<l eID="gen4556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4557"/>even the dust of her ruins they look on with love.<l eID="gen4557" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4551"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4558"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4559"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:15
verses.text: Then the nations will revere the name of the<divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen4559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4560"/>and all the kings of the earth his glory,<l eID="gen4560" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4561"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:16
verses.text: when the <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall have built up Zion,<l eID="gen4561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4562"/>and revealed himself in his glory,<l eID="gen4562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4563"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:17
verses.text: in response to the prayer of the destitute,<l eID="gen4563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4564"/>whose prayer he will not despise.<l eID="gen4564" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4558"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4565"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4566"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:18
verses.text: Let this be recorded for ages to come,<l eID="gen4566" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4567"/>that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> may be praised by a people yet unborn.<l eID="gen4567" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4568"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:19
verses.text: For he shall look down from his holy height,<l eID="gen4568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4569"/>from the heavens the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will gaze on the earth,<l eID="gen4569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4570"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:20
verses.text: to hear the groans of the prisoner,<l eID="gen4570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4571"/>to free those who are doomed to die;<l eID="gen4571" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4572"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:21
verses.text: that people may recount the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s fame in Zion,<l eID="gen4572" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4573"/>and the praise of him in Jerusalem,<l eID="gen4573" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4574"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:22
verses.text: when the nations are gathered together,<l eID="gen4574" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4575"/>and the kingdoms, to worship the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4575" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4565"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4576"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4577"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:23
verses.text: He has broken my strength on the way,<l eID="gen4577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4578"/>he has shortened my days.<l eID="gen4578" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4579"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:24
verses.text: I will say, “My God, take me not hence<l eID="gen4579" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4580"/>in the midst of my days.<l eID="gen4580" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4576"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4581"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4582"/>Your years endure age after age.<l eID="gen4582" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4583"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:25
verses.text: Of old you have founded the earth,<l eID="gen4583" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4584"/>and the heavens are the work of your hands.<l eID="gen4584" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4585"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:26
verses.text: They shall perish; but you do stand.<l eID="gen4585" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4586"/>They shall all wax old like a garment,<l eID="gen4586" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4587"/>and change as a robe you will change them.<l eID="gen4587" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4588"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:27
verses.text: But you are the same, your years are endless.<l eID="gen4588" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4589"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:28
verses.text: The children of your servants abide,<l eID="gen4589" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4590"/>evermore shall their seed be before you.”<l eID="gen4590" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4581"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.102"/> <div eID="gen4522" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv103"/><div sID="gen4591" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 103</title> <title type="psalm">Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen4592"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv103"/> O my soul, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen4593" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4594"/>and all that is in me, his holy name.<l eID="gen4594" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4595"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: O my soul, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen4595" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4596"/>and forget not one of his benefits.<l eID="gen4596" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4597"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: He pardons all your sins,<l eID="gen4597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4598"/>he heals all your diseases.<l eID="gen4598" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4599"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: He ransoms your life from the pit,<l eID="gen4599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4600"/>he crowns you with kindness and pity.<l eID="gen4600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4601"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: He gives you your heart’s desire,<l eID="gen4601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4602"/>renewing your youth like the eagle’s.<l eID="gen4602" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4592"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4603"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4604"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> executes justice -<l eID="gen4604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4605"/>and right for all who are wronged.<l eID="gen4605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4606"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: He revealed his ways to Moses,<l eID="gen4606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4607"/>his acts to the children of Israel.<l eID="gen4607" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4608"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: Full of pity and grace is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen4608" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4609"/>patient, and rich in kindness:<l eID="gen4609" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4610"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: he will not always chide,<l eID="gen4610" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4611"/>nor cherish his anger forever.<l eID="gen4611" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4612"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: Not after our sins has he dealt with us,<l eID="gen4612" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4613"/>nor requited us after our wickedness.<l eID="gen4613" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4603"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4614"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4615"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: For high as the heavens o’er the earth<l eID="gen4615" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4616"/>is his love over those who fear him.<l eID="gen4616" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4617"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: Far as is east from the west<l eID="gen4617" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4618"/>has he put our transgressions from us.<l eID="gen4618" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4619"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: As a father pities his children,<l eID="gen4619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4620"/>so the <divineName>Lord</divineName> pities those who fear him;<l eID="gen4620" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4621"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: for well he knows our frame,<l eID="gen4621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4622"/>he remembers that we are dust.<l eID="gen4622" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4614"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4623"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4624"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: A person's days are as grass;<l eID="gen4624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4625"/>blossoms like a flower of the meadow.<l eID="gen4625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: At the breath of the wind it is gone,<l eID="gen4626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4627"/>and the place thereof knows it no more.<l eID="gen4627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4628"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: But the love of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is eternal,<l eID="gen4628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4629"/>and his kindness to children’s children,<l eID="gen4629" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4630"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: to those who keep his covenant<l eID="gen4630" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4631"/>and mindfully do his behests.<l eID="gen4631" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4623"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4632"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4633"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> has set his throne in the heavens;<l eID="gen4633" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4634"/>the whole world is under his sway.<l eID="gen4634" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4635"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: Bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you angels of his,<l eID="gen4635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4636"/>mighty heroes performing his word.<l eID="gen4636" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4637"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: Bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, all you his hosts,<l eID="gen4637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4638"/>you servants who do his will.<l eID="gen4638" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4639"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: Bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, all you his works,<l eID="gen4639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4640"/>far as his sway extends.<l eID="gen4640" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4641"/>O my soul, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4641" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4632"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.103"/> <div eID="gen4591" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv104"/><div sID="gen4642" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 104</title> <lg sID="gen4643"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv104"/> Bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, O my soul.<l eID="gen4644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4645"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God, you are very great,<l eID="gen4645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4646"/>clad in awful splendour,<l eID="gen4646" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4647"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:2
verses.text: covered with robe of light.<l eID="gen4647" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4648"/>You stretch out the heavens like the cloth of a tent.<l eID="gen4648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4649"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:3
verses.text: He lays the beams of his chambers on water.<l eID="gen4649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4650"/>He takes dark clouds for his chariot,<l eID="gen4650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4651"/>and rides on the wings of the wind.<l eID="gen4651" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4652"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:4
verses.text: He takes the winds for his messengers,<l eID="gen4652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4653"/>the fire and the flame for his servants.<l eID="gen4653" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4643"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4654"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4655"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:5
verses.text: He founded the earth upon pillars,<l eID="gen4655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4656"/>to sustain it unshaken forever.<l eID="gen4656" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4657"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:6
verses.text: With the garment of ocean he covered it,<l eID="gen4657" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4658"/>waters towered over the mountains.<l eID="gen4658" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:7
verses.text: But at your rebuke they fled,<l eID="gen4659" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4660"/>scared by the roar of your thunder,<l eID="gen4660" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4661"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:8
verses.text: mountains rose, valleys sank down<l eID="gen4661" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4662"/>to the place appointed for them.<l eID="gen4662" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4663"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:9
verses.text: They dared not pass the bounds set for them,<l eID="gen4663" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4664"/>or cover the earth any more.<l eID="gen4664" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4654"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4665"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4666"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:10
verses.text: He sent brooks into the valleys,<l eID="gen4666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4667"/>they meander between the mountains.<l eID="gen4667" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4668"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:11
verses.text: The wild beasts all drink from them,<l eID="gen4668" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4669"/>and the wild asses quench their thirst.<l eID="gen4669" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4670"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:12
verses.text: The birds have their home by the banks,<l eID="gen4670" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4671"/>and sing in the branches.<l eID="gen4671" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4672"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:13
verses.text: From his chambers above he gives drink to the mountains,<l eID="gen4672" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4673"/>and satisfies earth with the vials of heaven.<l eID="gen4673" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4665"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4674"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4675"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:14
verses.text: He makes grass grow for the cattle,<l eID="gen4675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4676"/>and herbs for people.<l eID="gen4676" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4677"/>He brings bread out of the earth;<l eID="gen4677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4678"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:15
verses.text: wine, to gladden hearts;<l eID="gen4678" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4679"/>oil, to make faces shine;<l eID="gen4679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4680"/>bread, to strengthen hearts.<l eID="gen4680" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4681"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:16
verses.text: The trees of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> drink their fill<l eID="gen4681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4682"/>the cedars he planted on Lebanon,<l eID="gen4682" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4683"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:17
verses.text: where the little birds build their nest,<l eID="gen4683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4684"/>and the stork whose home is the cypress.<l eID="gen4684" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4685"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:18
verses.text: The high hills are for the wild goats,<l eID="gen4685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4686"/>and the rocks are for coneys to hide in.<l eID="gen4686" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4674"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4687"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4688"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:19
verses.text: He created the moon to mark seasons,<l eID="gen4688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4689"/>and told the sun when to set.<l eID="gen4689" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4690"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:20
verses.text: You make it dark: night comes,<l eID="gen4690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4691"/>when all the wild beasts creep out.<l eID="gen4691" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4692"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:21
verses.text: Young lions that roar for their prey,<l eID="gen4692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4693"/>seeking their meat from God.<l eID="gen4693" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4694"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:22
verses.text: At sunrise they slink away,<l eID="gen4694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4695"/>and lie down in their dens.<l eID="gen4695" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4696"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:23
verses.text: Then people go forth to their work,<l eID="gen4696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4697"/>and toil till evening.<l eID="gen4697" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4687"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4698"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4699"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:24
verses.text: How many, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, are your works,<l eID="gen4699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4700"/>all of them made in wisdom!<l eID="gen4700" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4701"/>The earth is filled with your creatures.<l eID="gen4701" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4702"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:25
verses.text: And there is the great broad sea,<l eID="gen4702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4703"/>where are countless things in motion,<l eID="gen4703" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4704"/>living creatures, both great and small.<l eID="gen4704" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4705"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:26
verses.text: There go the ships,<l eID="gen4705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4706"/>and the Leviathan you made to play there.<l eID="gen4706" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4698"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4707"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4708"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:27
verses.text: They all look in hope to you,<l eID="gen4708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4709"/>to give them their food in due season.<l eID="gen4709" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4710"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:28
verses.text: And you give with open hand;<l eID="gen4710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4711"/>they gather and eat to their heart’s desire.<l eID="gen4711" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4712"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:29
verses.text: When you hide your face, they are terrified;<l eID="gen4712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4713"/>when you take their breath away,<l eID="gen4713" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4714"/>they die and go back to their dust.<l eID="gen4714" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4715"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:30
verses.text: But a breath from your lips creates them,<l eID="gen4715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4716"/>and renews the face of the earth.<l eID="gen4716" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4707"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4717"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4718"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:31
verses.text: May the glory of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> be forever,<l eID="gen4718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4719"/>may the <divineName>Lord</divineName> rejoice in his works.<l eID="gen4719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4720"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:32
verses.text: A glance of his makes the earth tremble,<l eID="gen4720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4721"/>a touch of his makes the hills smoke.<l eID="gen4721" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4722"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:33
verses.text: I will sing to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> while I live,<l eID="gen4722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4723"/>I will play to my God while I am.<l eID="gen4723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4724"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:34
verses.text: May my musing be sweet to him.<l eID="gen4724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4725"/>for I rejoice in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4725" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4726"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:35
verses.text: But may sinners be swept from the earth,<l eID="gen4726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4727"/>and the wicked vanish forever.<l eID="gen4727" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4728"/>O my soul, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4728" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4729"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen4729" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4717"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.104"/> <div eID="gen4642" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv105"/><div sID="gen4730" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 105</title> <lg sID="gen4731"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv105"/> Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, call on his name:<l eID="gen4732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4733"/>make known his deeds among the nations.<l eID="gen4733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4734"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:2
verses.text: Sing to him, make music to him,<l eID="gen4734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4735"/>tell of all his wondrous works.<l eID="gen4735" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4736"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:3
verses.text: Make your boast in his holy name,<l eID="gen4736" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4737"/>be glad at heart, you who seek the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4737" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4738"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:4
verses.text: Seek after the <divineName>Lord</divineName> and his strength,<l eID="gen4738" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4739"/>seek his face evermore.<l eID="gen4739" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4740"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:5
verses.text: Remember the wonders he did,<l eID="gen4740" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4741"/>his portents, the judgments he uttered.<l eID="gen4741" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4731"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4742"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4743"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:7
verses.text: He is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God:<l eID="gen4743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4744"/>in all the earth are his judgments.<l eID="gen4744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4745"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:8
verses.text: He remembers forever his covenant,<l eID="gen4745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4746"/>his promise for a thousand generations<l eID="gen4746" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:9
verses.text: The covenant he made with Abraham,<l eID="gen4747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4748"/>the oath he swore to Isaac,<l eID="gen4748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4749"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:10
verses.text: and confirmed as a statute to Jacob,<l eID="gen4749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4750"/>a pact everlasting to Israel<l eID="gen4750" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4751"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:11
verses.text: to give them the land of Canaan<l eID="gen4751" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4752"/>as the lot which they should inherit.<l eID="gen4752" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4742"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4753"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4754"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:12
verses.text: And when they were very few,<l eID="gen4754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4755"/>few and but pilgrims therein,<l eID="gen4755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4756"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:13
verses.text: wandering from nation to nation,<l eID="gen4756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4757"/>journeying from people to people,<l eID="gen4757" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4758"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:14
verses.text: he allowed no one to oppress them,<l eID="gen4758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4759"/>even punishing kings for their sakes.<l eID="gen4759" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4760"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:15
verses.text: He forbade them to touch his anointed,<l eID="gen4760" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4761"/>or do any hurt to his prophets.<l eID="gen4761" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4753"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4762"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4763"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:16
verses.text: When he called down famine on the land,<l eID="gen4763" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4764"/>and cut off the bread which sustained them,<l eID="gen4764" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4765"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:17
verses.text: he sent before them a man,<l eID="gen4765" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4766"/>Joseph, who was sold as a slave.<l eID="gen4766" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4767"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:18
verses.text: His feet were galled with fetters,<l eID="gen4767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4768"/>he was laid in chains of iron,<l eID="gen4768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4769"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:19
verses.text: till the time that his word came to pass,<l eID="gen4769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4770"/>the word of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> that had tried him.<l eID="gen4770" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4762"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4771"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4772"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:20
verses.text: The king sent and freed him,<l eID="gen4772" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4773"/>the ruler of nations released him.<l eID="gen4773" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4774"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:21
verses.text: He made him lord of his household,<l eID="gen4774" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4775"/>and ruler of all his possessions,<l eID="gen4775" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4776"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:22
verses.text: to admonish his princes at will<l eID="gen4776" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4777"/>and instruct his elders in wisdom.<l eID="gen4777" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4771"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4778"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:23
verses.text: Thus Israel came into Egypt,<l eID="gen4779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4780"/>Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.<l eID="gen4780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4781"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:24
verses.text: His people he made very fruitful,<l eID="gen4781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4782"/>and mightier than their foes.<l eID="gen4782" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4783"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:25
verses.text: He inspired them to hate his people,<l eID="gen4783" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4784"/>and to deal with his servants craftily.<l eID="gen4784" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4778"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4785"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4786"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:26
verses.text: He sent his servant Moses,<l eID="gen4786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4787"/>and Aaron whom he had chosen,<l eID="gen4787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4788"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:27
verses.text: portents he wrought in Egypt,<l eID="gen4788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4789"/>and signs in the land of Ham.<l eID="gen4789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4790"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:28
verses.text: Darkness he sent, and it fell:<l eID="gen4790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4791"/>yet they gave no heed to his word.<l eID="gen4791" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4785"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4792"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4793"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:29
verses.text: He turned their waters into blood,<l eID="gen4793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4794"/>thus causing their fish to die.<l eID="gen4794" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4795"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:30
verses.text: Their land was alive with frogs,<l eID="gen4795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4796"/>swarming even in the royal chambers.<l eID="gen4796" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4797"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:31
verses.text: At his command came flies,<l eID="gen4797" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4798"/>and lice in all their borders.<l eID="gen4798" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4799"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:32
verses.text: He gave them hail for rain<l eID="gen4799" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4800"/>and fire that flashed through the land,<l eID="gen4800" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4801"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:33
verses.text: smiting their vines and figs,<l eID="gen4801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4802"/>breaking the trees of their border.<l eID="gen4802" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4792"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4803"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4804"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:34
verses.text: At his command came locusts,<l eID="gen4804" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4805"/>young locusts beyond all counting,<l eID="gen4805" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4806"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:35
verses.text: which ate every herb in the land,<l eID="gen4806" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4807"/>ate up, too, the fruit of their ground.<l eID="gen4807" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4808"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:36
verses.text: He struck down in their land all the first-born,<l eID="gen4808" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4809"/>the firstlings of all their strength<l eID="gen4809" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4810"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:37
verses.text: Then forth he led Israel with silver and gold,<l eID="gen4810" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4811"/>and among his tribes not one was weary.<l eID="gen4811" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4803"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4812"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4813"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:38
verses.text: Egypt was glad when they left,<l eID="gen4813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4814"/>for terror had fallen upon them.<l eID="gen4814" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4815"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:39
verses.text: He spread out a cloud to screen them,<l eID="gen4815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4816"/>and fire to give light in the night.<l eID="gen4816" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4817"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:40
verses.text: He sent quails at their entreaty,<l eID="gen4817" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4818"/>and heavenly bread in abundance.<l eID="gen4818" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4819"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:41
verses.text: He opened the rock; waters gushed:<l eID="gen4819" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4820"/>in the desert they ran like a river.<l eID="gen4820" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4821"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:42
verses.text: For he remembered his holy promise<l eID="gen4821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4822"/>to Abraham his servant.<l eID="gen4822" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4812"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4823"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4824"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:43
verses.text: So he led out his people with joy,<l eID="gen4824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4825"/>his elect with a ringing cry.<l eID="gen4825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4826"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:44
verses.text: And he gave them the lands of the nations,<l eID="gen4826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4827"/>the fruit of their toil for possession,<l eID="gen4827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4828"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:45
verses.text: that so they might keep his statutes,<l eID="gen4828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4829"/>and be of his laws observant.<l eID="gen4829" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4830"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen4830" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4823"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.105"/> <div eID="gen4730" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv106"/><div sID="gen4831" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 106</title> <lg sID="gen4832"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv106"/> Hallelujah!<l eID="gen4833" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4834"/>Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his goodness,<l eID="gen4834" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4835"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen4835" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4836"/>Who can describe his heroic deeds,<l eID="gen4836" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4837"/>or publish all his praise?<l eID="gen4837" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4838"/>Happy they who act justly,<l eID="gen4838" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4839"/>and do righteousness evermore.<l eID="gen4839" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4832"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4840"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4841"/>Remember me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, as you remember your people,<l eID="gen4841" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4842"/>and visit me with your gracious help.<l eID="gen4842" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4843"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:5
verses.text: May I see the good fortune of your elect,<l eID="gen4843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4844"/>may I share in the joy of your nation,<l eID="gen4844" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4845"/>and in the pride of your heritage.<l eID="gen4845" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4840"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4846"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4847"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:6
verses.text: We, like our fathers, have sinned,<l eID="gen4847" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4848"/>we have done perversely and wickedly<l eID="gen4848" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4849"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:7
verses.text: In the land of Egypt our fathers,<l eID="gen4849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4850"/>all heedless of your wonders,<l eID="gen4850" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4851"/>and unmindful of your great kindness,<l eID="gen4851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4852"/>at the Red Sea defied the Most High.<l eID="gen4852" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4853"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:8
verses.text: But true to his name he saved them,<l eID="gen4853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4854"/>in order to show his might.<l eID="gen4854" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4855"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:9
verses.text: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried;<l eID="gen4855" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4856"/>they marched through the depths as through desert,<l eID="gen4856" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4857"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:10
verses.text: saved from the hand of the hostile,<l eID="gen4857" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4858"/>redeemed from the hand of the foe.<l eID="gen4858" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4859"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:11
verses.text: The waters covered their enemies:<l eID="gen4859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4860"/>not one of them was left.<l eID="gen4860" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4861"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:12
verses.text: So then they believed in his words,<l eID="gen4861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4862"/>and began to sing his praise.<l eID="gen4862" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4846"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4863"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4864"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:13
verses.text: But soon they forgot his deeds:<l eID="gen4864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4865"/>they did not wait for his counsel.<l eID="gen4865" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4866"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:14
verses.text: Their greed was ravenous in the desert;<l eID="gen4866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4867"/>they put God to the test in the wilderness.<l eID="gen4867" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4868"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:15
verses.text: He gave them the thing they had asked for,<l eID="gen4868" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4869"/>but sent wasting disease among them.<l eID="gen4869" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4863"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4870"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4871"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:16
verses.text: The camp grew jealous of Moses<l eID="gen4871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4872"/>and of Aaron, holy one of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4872" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4873"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:17
verses.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan,<l eID="gen4873" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4874"/>and covered Abiram’s company.<l eID="gen4874" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4875"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:18
verses.text: Fire broke out on their company,<l eID="gen4875" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4876"/>flame kindled upon the wicked.<l eID="gen4876" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4870"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4877"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4878"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:19
verses.text: They made a calf in Horeb,<l eID="gen4878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4879"/>and bowed to the molten image.<l eID="gen4879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4880"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:20
verses.text: They exchanged their glorious God<l eID="gen4880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4881"/>for the image of ox that eats grass.<l eID="gen4881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4882"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:21
verses.text: They forgot the God who had saved them<l eID="gen4882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4883"/>by mighty deeds in Egypt<l eID="gen4883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4884"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:22
verses.text: Wonders in the land of Ham,<l eID="gen4884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4885"/>terrors by the Red Sea.<l eID="gen4885" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4886"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:23
verses.text: So he vowed, and would have destroyed them,<l eID="gen4886" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4887"/>but for Moses his elect,<l eID="gen4887" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4888"/>who stepped into the breach before him,<l eID="gen4888" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4889"/>to divert his deadly wrath.<l eID="gen4889" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4877"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4890"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4891"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:24
verses.text: They spurned the delightsome land,<l eID="gen4891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4892"/>they refused to believe in his word.<l eID="gen4892" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4893"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:25
verses.text: They grumbled in their tents,<l eID="gen4893" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4894"/>would not listen to the voice of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen4894" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4895"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:26
verses.text: So he swore with uplifted hand<l eID="gen4895" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4896"/>to lay them low in the wilderness;<l eID="gen4896" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4897"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:27
verses.text: to disperse their seed among heathen,<l eID="gen4897" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4898"/>to scatter them over the world.<l eID="gen4898" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4890"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4899"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4900"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:28
verses.text: Then they joined them to Baal of Peor,<l eID="gen4900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4901"/>and ate what was offered the dead.<l eID="gen4901" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4902"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:29
verses.text: They provoked him to wrath by their deeds,<l eID="gen4902" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4903"/>and plague broke out among them.<l eID="gen4903" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4904"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:30
verses.text: Then Phinehas stood between,<l eID="gen4904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4905"/>and so the plague was stayed;<l eID="gen4905" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4906"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:31
verses.text: and it was counted to him for righteousness<l eID="gen4906" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4907"/>unto all generations forever.<l eID="gen4907" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4899"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4908"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4909"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:32
verses.text: They angered him at the waters of Meribah,<l eID="gen4909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4910"/>through them it went ill with Moses.<l eID="gen4910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4911"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:33
verses.text: They rebelled against his spirit,<l eID="gen4911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4912"/>and he uttered speech that was rash.<l eID="gen4912" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4908"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4913"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4914"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:34
verses.text: They did not destroy the nations,<l eID="gen4914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4915"/>as the <divineName>Lord</divineName> had commanded them;<l eID="gen4915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4916"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:35
verses.text: but they mingled with the heathen,<l eID="gen4916" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4917"/>and learned to do as they did.<l eID="gen4917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4918"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:36
verses.text: Their idol gods they worshipped,<l eID="gen4918" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4919"/>and they were ensnared by them.<l eID="gen4919" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4920"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:37
verses.text: They sacrificed their sons<l eID="gen4920" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4921"/>and their daughters to the demons.<l eID="gen4921" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4922"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:38
verses.text: They poured out innocent blood<l eID="gen4922" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4923"/>the blood of their sons and daughters<l eID="gen4923" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4924"/>whom they offered to Canaan’s idols,<l eID="gen4924" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4925"/>and the land was polluted with blood.<l eID="gen4925" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4926"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:39
verses.text: They became unclean by their works,<l eID="gen4926" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4927"/>and adulterous in their deeds.<l eID="gen4927" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4928"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:40
verses.text: Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s fury was on his people,<l eID="gen4928" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4929"/>filled with horror at his inheritance.<l eID="gen4929" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4930"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:41
verses.text: He delivered them to the heathen,<l eID="gen4930" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4931"/>to the sway of those who hated them.<l eID="gen4931" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4932"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:42
verses.text: Their enemies oppressed them,<l eID="gen4932" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4933"/>and subdued them under their hand.<l eID="gen4933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4934"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:43
verses.text: Many a time he saved them,<l eID="gen4934" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4935"/>but they rebelled at his counsel,<l eID="gen4935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4936"/>and were brought low by their wrongdoing.<l eID="gen4936" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4937"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:44
verses.text: Yet he looked upon their distress,<l eID="gen4937" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4938"/>when he heard their cry.<l eID="gen4938" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4939"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:45
verses.text: He remembered his covenant,<l eID="gen4939" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4940"/>and, in his great kindness, relented.<l eID="gen4940" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4941"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:46
verses.text: He caused them to be pitied<l eID="gen4941" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4942"/>by all who carried them captive.<l eID="gen4942" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4913"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4943"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4944"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:47
verses.text: Save us, O <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God,<l eID="gen4944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4945"/>and gather us out of the nations,<l eID="gen4945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4946"/>to give thanks to your holy name,<l eID="gen4946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4947"/>and to make our boast of your praise.<l eID="gen4947" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4943"/> <lb/> <lb/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4948"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4949"/><hi type="italic">Blessed be the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the God of Israel,</hi><l eID="gen4949" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4950"/><hi type="italic">from everlasting to everlasting.</hi><l eID="gen4950" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4951"/><hi type="italic">And let all the people say “Amen.”</hi><l eID="gen4951" level="3"/> <l level="3" sID="gen4952"/><hi type="italic">Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.</hi><l eID="gen4952" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen4948"/>  <div eID="gen4831" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Ps.106"/> <div eID="gen4119" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv107"/><div sID="gen4954" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 107</title> <lg sID="gen4955"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv107"/> Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his goodness<l eID="gen4956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4957"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen4957" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4958"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:2
verses.text: Let this be the song of the ransomed,<l eID="gen4958" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4959"/>whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has redeemed from distress,<l eID="gen4959" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4960"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:3
verses.text: gathering them from all lands,<l eID="gen4960" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4961"/>east, west, north, and south.<l eID="gen4961" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4955"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4962"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4963"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:4
verses.text: In the wastes of the desert some wandered,<l eID="gen4963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4964"/>finding no way to a city inhabited.<l eID="gen4964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4965"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:5
verses.text: Full of hunger and thirst,<l eID="gen4965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4966"/>their spirit failed.<l eID="gen4966" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4967"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:6
verses.text: Then they cried to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in their trouble,<l eID="gen4967" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4968"/>and he saved them from their distresses,<l eID="gen4968" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4969"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:7
verses.text: guiding them straight on the way,<l eID="gen4969" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4970"/>till they reached an inhabited city.<l eID="gen4970" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4971"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:8
verses.text: Let them thank the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his kindness,<l eID="gen4971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4972"/>for his wonderful deeds for people;<l eID="gen4972" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4973"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:9
verses.text: for the thirsty he satisfies,<l eID="gen4973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4974"/>and the hungry he fills with good things.<l eID="gen4974" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4962"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4975"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4976"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:10
verses.text: Some sat in darkness and gloom<l eID="gen4976" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4977"/>prisoners in irons and misery,<l eID="gen4977" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4978"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:11
verses.text: for rebelling against God’s word,<l eID="gen4978" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4979"/>and spurning the Most High’s counsel.<l eID="gen4979" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4980"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:12
verses.text: Their heart was bowed with toil;<l eID="gen4980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4981"/>there was no one to help when they stumbled.<l eID="gen4981" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4982"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:13
verses.text: Then they cried to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in their trouble,<l eID="gen4982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4983"/>and he saved them from their distresses.<l eID="gen4983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4984"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:14
verses.text: Out of darkness and gloom he brought them,<l eID="gen4984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4985"/>and burst their chains.<l eID="gen4985" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4986"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:15
verses.text: Let them praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his kindness,<l eID="gen4986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4987"/>for his wonderful deeds for people.<l eID="gen4987" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4988"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:16
verses.text: For he shattered the gates of bronze,<l eID="gen4988" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4989"/>and broke bars of iron.<l eID="gen4989" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4975"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen4990"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4991"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:17
verses.text: Some were sick from their wicked ways,<l eID="gen4991" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4992"/>and suffering because of their sins.<l eID="gen4992" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4993"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:18
verses.text: All manner of food they hated;<l eID="gen4993" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4994"/>they had come to the gates of death.<l eID="gen4994" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4995"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:19
verses.text: Then they cried to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in their trouble,<l eID="gen4995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4996"/>and he saved them from their distresses.<l eID="gen4996" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4997"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:20
verses.text: He sent his word and healed them,<l eID="gen4997" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen4998"/>and delivered their life from the pit.<l eID="gen4998" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4999"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:21
verses.text: Let them praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his kindness,<l eID="gen4999" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5000"/>for his wonderful deeds for people.<l eID="gen5000" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5001"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:22
verses.text: Let them offer to him thankofferings,<l eID="gen5001" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5002"/>and with joy tell what things he has done.<l eID="gen5002" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen4990"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5003"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5004"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:23
verses.text: Some crossed the sea in ships,<l eID="gen5004" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5005"/>doing business in great waters.<l eID="gen5005" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5006"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:24
verses.text: They have seen what the <divineName>Lord</divineName> can do,<l eID="gen5006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5007"/>and his wonderful deeds on the deep.<l eID="gen5007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5008"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:25
verses.text: At his command rose a tempest,<l eID="gen5008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5009"/>which lifted the waves on high.<l eID="gen5009" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5010"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:26
verses.text: Up to heaven they went, down to the depths;<l eID="gen5010" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5011"/>their courage failed them.<l eID="gen5011" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5012"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:27
verses.text: They staggered and reeled like drunkards;<l eID="gen5012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5013"/>all their skills useless.<l eID="gen5013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5014"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:28
verses.text: Then they cried to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> in their trouble,<l eID="gen5014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5015"/>and he saved them from their distresses.<l eID="gen5015" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5016"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:29
verses.text: He stilled the storm to a whisper,<l eID="gen5016" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5017"/>and the waves of the sea were hushed.<l eID="gen5017" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5018"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:30
verses.text: They were glad, because it was quiet;<l eID="gen5018" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5019"/>they were led to the haven they longed for.<l eID="gen5019" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5020"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:31
verses.text: Let them praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for his kindness,<l eID="gen5020" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5021"/>for his wonderful deeds for people.<l eID="gen5021" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5022"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:32
verses.text: Where the people assemble, extol him,<l eID="gen5022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5023"/>and praise him in council of elders.<l eID="gen5023" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5003"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5024"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5025"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:33
verses.text: He turns streams into a wilderness,<l eID="gen5025" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5026"/>springs of water into thirsty land,<l eID="gen5026" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5027"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:34
verses.text: fruitful land into a salt waste,<l eID="gen5027" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5028"/>because of the sin of the people.<l eID="gen5028" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5029"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:35
verses.text: A desert he makes pools of water,<l eID="gen5029" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5030"/>a land of drought into springs of water.<l eID="gen5030" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5031"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:36
verses.text: He settles the hungry therein,<l eID="gen5031" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5032"/>they establish a city to live in.<l eID="gen5032" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5033"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:37
verses.text: They sow fields and plant vineyards,<l eID="gen5033" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5034"/>which furnish a fruitful yield.<l eID="gen5034" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5035"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:38
verses.text: By his blessing they multiply greatly,<l eID="gen5035" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5036"/>and he lets not their cattle decrease.<l eID="gen5036" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5024"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5037"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5038"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:39
verses.text: Yet when they are bowed and diminished<l eID="gen5038" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5039"/>by oppression, misfortune, or sorrow,<l eID="gen5039" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5040"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:40
verses.text: he pours contempt upon princes,<l eID="gen5040" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5041"/>and on trackless wastes leads them astray<l eID="gen5041" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5042"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:41
verses.text: He lifts the poor out of misery,<l eID="gen5042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5043"/>and makes families fruitful as flocks.<l eID="gen5043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5044"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:42
verses.text: At this sight shall the upright be glad,<l eID="gen5044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5045"/>and all wicked mouths shall be stopped.<l eID="gen5045" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5046"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:43
verses.text: Let those who are wise observe this,<l eID="gen5046" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5047"/>and consider the love of the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5047" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5037"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.107"/> <div eID="gen4954" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv108"/><div sID="gen5048" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 108</title> <title type="psalm">A song. A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen5049"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv108"/> My heart is steadfast, O God,<l eID="gen5050" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5051"/>my heart is steadfast.<l eID="gen5051" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5052"/>I would sing, I would make music;<l eID="gen5052" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5053"/>awake, my soul.<l eID="gen5053" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5054"/>Awake, harp and lyre;<l eID="gen5054" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5055"/>I would wake the dawn.<l eID="gen5055" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5056"/>I would praise you among the peoples, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen5056" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5057"/>make music among the nations to you.<l eID="gen5057" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5058"/>For great to heaven is your love,<l eID="gen5058" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5059"/>and your faithfulness to the clouds.<l eID="gen5059" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5060"/>Be exalted, O God, o’er the heavens,<l eID="gen5060" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5061"/>and your glory o’er all the earth.<l eID="gen5061" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5049"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5062"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5063"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:6
verses.text: So those you love may be rescued,<l eID="gen5063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5064"/>save by your right hand and answer us.<l eID="gen5064" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5065"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: God did solemnly swear:<l eID="gen5065" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5066"/>“As victor will I divide Shechem,<l eID="gen5066" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5067"/>portion out the valley of Succoth.<l eID="gen5067" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5068"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: Mine is Gilead, mine is Manasseh,<l eID="gen5068" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5069"/>Ephraim is my helmet,<l eID="gen5069" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5070"/>Judah my sceptre of rule,<l eID="gen5070" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5071"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: Moab the pot that I wash in,<l eID="gen5071" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5072"/>on Edom I hurl my sandal,<l eID="gen5072" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5073"/>I shout o’er Philistia in triumph.”<l eID="gen5073" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5062"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5074"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5075"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: O to be brought to the fortified city!<l eID="gen5075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5076"/>O to be led into Edom!<l eID="gen5076" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5077"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: Have you not spurned us, O God?<l eID="gen5077" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5078"/>You do not march forth with our armies.<l eID="gen5078" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5074"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5079"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5080"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: Grant us help from the foe,<l eID="gen5080" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5081"/>for human help is worthless.<l eID="gen5081" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5082"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: With God we shall yet do bravely,<l eID="gen5082" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5083"/>he himself will tread down our foes.<l eID="gen5083" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5079"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.108"/> <div eID="gen5048" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv109"/><div sID="gen5084" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 109</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen5085"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv109"/> O God whom I praise, keep not silence;<l eID="gen5086" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5087"/>for their wicked mouths they have opened against me,<l eID="gen5087" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5088"/>they speak to me with tongues that are false,<l eID="gen5088" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5089"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: they beset me with words of hatred,<l eID="gen5089" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5090"/>and fight without cause against me.<l eID="gen5090" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5091"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: My love they requite with hostility,<l eID="gen5091" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5092"/>while for them I lift up my prayer.<l eID="gen5092" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5093"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: Evil for good they reward me,<l eID="gen5093" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5094"/>and hatred for my love.<l eID="gen5094" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5085"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5095"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5096"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: “Set over him one who is godless,” they say,<l eID="gen5096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5097"/>“an opponent at his right hand.<l eID="gen5097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5098"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: From his trial let him come forth guilty,<l eID="gen5098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5099"/>may his prayer be counted as sin.<l eID="gen5099" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5100"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:8
verses.text: Grant that his days may be few,<l eID="gen5100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5101"/>that his office be seized by another.<l eID="gen5101" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:9
verses.text: Grant that his children be fatherless,<l eID="gen5102" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5103"/>and that his wife be a widow.<l eID="gen5103" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:10
verses.text: Up and down may his children go begging,<l eID="gen5104" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5105"/>expelled from their desolate home.<l eID="gen5105" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5106"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:11
verses.text: May all that he owns be seized by the creditor<l eID="gen5106" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5107"/>may strangers plunder the fruits of his toil.<l eID="gen5107" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5095"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5108"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:12
verses.text: May none extend to him kindness,<l eID="gen5109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5110"/>or pity his fatherless children.<l eID="gen5110" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5111"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:13
verses.text: His descendants be doomed to destruction!<l eID="gen5111" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5112"/>Blotted out be his name in one generation!<l eID="gen5112" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5113"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:14
verses.text: May his father’s guilt be remembered,<l eID="gen5113" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5114"/>and his mother’s sin not blotted out:<l eID="gen5114" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5115"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:15
verses.text: on record always before the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5115" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5116"/>and his memory root from the earth;<l eID="gen5116" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5117"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:16
verses.text: for he gave no thought to show kindness,<l eID="gen5117" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5118"/>but pursued the poor and the needy,<l eID="gen5118" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5119"/>drove the downhearted to death.<l eID="gen5119" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5108"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5120"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5121"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:17
verses.text: May the curses he loved light upon him,<l eID="gen5121" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5122"/>may the blessings he loathed be afar.<l eID="gen5122" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:18
verses.text: Like a garment he clothed him with curses;<l eID="gen5123" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5124"/>may they pierce to his inwards like water,<l eID="gen5124" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5125"/>and cling to his bones like oil.<l eID="gen5125" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:19
verses.text: Let them be like the robe he wraps round him,<l eID="gen5126" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5127"/>like the belt he wears every day.”<l eID="gen5127" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:20
verses.text: Be this the reward of my adversaries,<l eID="gen5128" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5129"/>of those who speak evil against me.<l eID="gen5129" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5120"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5130"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:21
verses.text: But you, <divineName>Lord</divineName> my <divineName>God</divineName>,<l eID="gen5131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5132"/>be true to your name,<l eID="gen5132" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5133"/>deal kindly with me;<l eID="gen5133" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5134"/>in your gracious kindness<l eID="gen5134" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5135"/>save me.<l eID="gen5135" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5136"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:22
verses.text: For I am poor and needy,<l eID="gen5136" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5137"/>and my heart is wounded within me.<l eID="gen5137" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:23
verses.text: I am gone like a lengthening shadow,<l eID="gen5138" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5139"/>I am shaken off like a locust.<l eID="gen5139" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5140"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:24
verses.text: My knees totter from fasting,<l eID="gen5140" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5141"/>my flesh is shrivelled and spare.<l eID="gen5141" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5142"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:25
verses.text: They heap insults upon me:<l eID="gen5142" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5143"/>when they see me, they shake their head.<l eID="gen5143" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5130"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5144"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:26
verses.text: Help me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my God,<l eID="gen5145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5146"/>and save me in your kindness.<l eID="gen5146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5147"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:27
verses.text: Teach them that this is your hand,<l eID="gen5147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5148"/>and your own doing, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5148" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:28
verses.text: Let them curse, if only you bless.<l eID="gen5149" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5150"/>Put my assailants to shame,<l eID="gen5150" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5151"/>and make your servant glad.<l eID="gen5151" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5152"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:29
verses.text: My opponents be clothed with dishonour,<l eID="gen5152" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5153"/>and wrapped in a robe of shame.<l eID="gen5153" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5144"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5154"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5155"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:30
verses.text: I give thanks to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, with loud voice,<l eID="gen5155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5156"/>I give praise in the midst of the throng;<l eID="gen5156" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5157"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:31
verses.text: for he stands by the poor, at his right hand,<l eID="gen5157" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5158"/>to save them from those who condemn them.<l eID="gen5158" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5154"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.109"/> <div eID="gen5084" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv110"/><div sID="gen5159" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 110</title> <title type="psalm">Of David, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen5160"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv110"/> This said the <divineName>Lord</divineName> concerning my lord,<l eID="gen5161" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5162"/>“Sit at my right hand,<l eID="gen5162" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5163"/>till I set your foot on the neck of your foes.”<l eID="gen5163" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5160"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5164"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5165"/>On Zion the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is wielding<l eID="gen5165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5166"/>your sceptre of might, and charges you<l eID="gen5166" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5167"/>To rule over the foes that surround you.<l eID="gen5167" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5164"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5168"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5169"/>The day that you march to battle<l eID="gen5169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5170"/>your people will follow you gladly<l eID="gen5170" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5171"/>young warriors in holy array,<l eID="gen5171" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5172"/>like dew-drops, born of the morning.<l eID="gen5172" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5168"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5173"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5174"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName> has sworn and will not repent,<l eID="gen5174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5175"/>“As for you, you are priest for ever<l eID="gen5175" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5176"/>as Melchizedek was.”<l eID="gen5176" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5173"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5177"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5178"/>By your side will the <divineName>Lord</divineName> shatter kings<l eID="gen5178" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5179"/>on the day of his wrath.<l eID="gen5179" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5180"/>He will execute judgment<l eID="gen5180" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5181"/>filling the valleys with dead,<l eID="gen5181" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5182"/>the broad fields with shattered heads.<l eID="gen5182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5183"/>He will drink of the brook by the way,<l eID="gen5183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5184"/>and march onward with uplifted head.<l eID="gen5184" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5177"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.110"/> <div eID="gen5159" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv111"/><div sID="gen5185" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 111</title> <lg sID="gen5186"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv111"/> Hallelujah. I will thank the <divineName>Lord</divineName> with all my heart,<l eID="gen5187" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5188"/>in the assembled congregation of his people.<l eID="gen5188" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5189"/>Great are the things that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has done,<l eID="gen5189" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5190"/>worthy of study by those who love them.<l eID="gen5190" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5191"/>Majestic and glorious is his work,<l eID="gen5191" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5192"/>and his righteousness abides forever.<l eID="gen5192" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5193"/>For his marvellous deeds he has won renown;<l eID="gen5193" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5194"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is gracious and full of compassion.<l eID="gen5194" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5195"/>Food he gives to those who fear him,<l eID="gen5195" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5196"/>always he remembers his covenant.<l eID="gen5196" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5197"/>His mighty works he has shown to his people,<l eID="gen5197" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5198"/>in giving to them the nations for heritage.<l eID="gen5198" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5199"/>All that he does is faithful and right,<l eID="gen5199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5200"/>all his behests are firm and sure.<l eID="gen5200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: They are established for ever and ever,<l eID="gen5201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5202"/>executed with truth and uprightness.<l eID="gen5202" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5203"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: To his people he sent redemption,<l eID="gen5203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5204"/>he has appointed his covenant forever.<l eID="gen5204" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5205"/>His name is holy and awe-inspiring.<l eID="gen5205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5206"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: The fear of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is the beginning of wisdom<l eID="gen5206" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5207"/>those who keep it are wise indeed.<l eID="gen5207" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5208"/>His praise abides for ever and ever.<l eID="gen5208" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5186"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.111"/> <div eID="gen5185" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv112"/><div sID="gen5209" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 112</title> <lg sID="gen5210"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv112"/> Hallelujah. Happy are those who fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5211" level="3"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5212"/>and greatly delight in his commandments.<l eID="gen5212" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5213"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: Mighty on earth shall be their seed;<l eID="gen5213" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5214"/>a blessing shall rest on the race of the upright.<l eID="gen5214" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5215"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: Wealth and riches are in their houses,<l eID="gen5215" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5216"/>their prosperity stands forever.<l eID="gen5216" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5217"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: To the upright arises light in the darkness;<l eID="gen5217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5218"/>full of favour and pity and kindness are they.<l eID="gen5218" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5219"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: It is well with those who show pity and lend,<l eID="gen5219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5220"/>who support all their affairs upon justice.<l eID="gen5220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5221"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: For they will never be shaken;<l eID="gen5221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5222"/>the just will be forever remembered.<l eID="gen5222" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5223"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: They will not be afraid of evil tidings,<l eID="gen5223" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5224"/>with steady heart they trust the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5224" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5225"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: Their heart is firm and unafraid:<l eID="gen5225" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5226"/>they know they will feast their eyes on their enemies.<l eID="gen5226" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5227"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: With lavish hands they give to the poor,<l eID="gen5227" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5228"/>and their prosperity stands forever.<l eID="gen5228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5229"/>They are lifted to heights of triumph and honour.<l eID="gen5229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5230"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:10
verses.text: The sight of them fills the wicked with anger:<l eID="gen5230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5231"/>grinding their teeth with dispair.<l eID="gen5231" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5232"/>The hopes of the wicked will come to nothing.<l eID="gen5232" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5210"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.112"/> <div eID="gen5209" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv113"/><div sID="gen5233" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 113</title> <lg sID="gen5234"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv113"/> Hallelujah.<l eID="gen5235" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5236"/>Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you his servants,<l eID="gen5236" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5237"/>praise the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5237" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5238"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: The name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> be blessed<l eID="gen5238" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5239"/>from now and for evermore.<l eID="gen5239" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5240"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: From sunrise to sunset<l eID="gen5240" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5241"/>is the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> to be praised.<l eID="gen5241" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5234"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5242"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5243"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: High is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> above all nations,<l eID="gen5243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5244"/>above the heavens is his glory.<l eID="gen5244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5245"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: Who is like the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God,<l eID="gen5245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5246"/>seated on high?<l eID="gen5246" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5242"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5247"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5248"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: He raises the weak from the dust,<l eID="gen5248" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5249"/>he lifts the poor from the dunghill,<l eID="gen5249" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5250"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: and sets them beside the princes,<l eID="gen5250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5251"/>even the princes of his people.<l eID="gen5251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5252"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: He gives the childless woman a home,<l eID="gen5252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5253"/>and makes her the happy mother of children.<l eID="gen5253" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5254"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen5254" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen5247"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.113"/> <div eID="gen5233" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv114"/><div sID="gen5255" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 114</title> <lg sID="gen5256"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv114"/> When Israel went out of Egypt,<l eID="gen5257" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5258"/>Jacob’s house from a barbarous people,<l eID="gen5258" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5259"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
