verses.text: God chose Judah for himself,<l eID="gen5259" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5260"/>Israel became his kingdom.<l eID="gen5260" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5256"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5261"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: The sea saw it, and fled,<l eID="gen5262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5263"/>Jordan river ran backwards.<l eID="gen5263" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5264"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: Mountains skipped like rams,<l eID="gen5264" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5265"/>hills like the young of the flock.<l eID="gen5265" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5261"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5266"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5267"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: Why, sea, do you flee?<l eID="gen5267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5268"/>Jordan, why run backwards?<l eID="gen5268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5269"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: Mountains, why skip ram-like?<l eID="gen5269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5270"/>Why, hills, like the young of the flock?<l eID="gen5270" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5266"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5271"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5272"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:7
verses.text: Earth, tremble before the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5272" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5273"/>at the presence of Jacob’s God,<l eID="gen5273" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5274"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:8
verses.text: who turns rocks into pools of water,<l eID="gen5274" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5275"/>and flint into fountains of water.<l eID="gen5275" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5271"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.114"/> <div eID="gen5255" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv115"/><div sID="gen5276" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 115</title> <lg sID="gen5277"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv115"/> Not to us, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, not to us,<l eID="gen5278" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5279"/>but to your name give glory,<l eID="gen5279" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5280"/>for your kindness’ and faithfulness’ sake.<l eID="gen5280" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5281"/>Why should the heathen say,<l eID="gen5281" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5282"/>“Where is now their God?”<l eID="gen5282" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5283"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:3
verses.text: Our God he is in heaven;<l eID="gen5283" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5284"/>whatever he wishes, he does.<l eID="gen5284" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5285"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:4
verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold,<l eID="gen5285" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5286"/>made by human hands.<l eID="gen5286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5287"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:5
verses.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak;<l eID="gen5287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5288"/>they have eyes, but cannot see.<l eID="gen5288" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5289"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:6
verses.text: They have ears, but cannot hear;<l eID="gen5289" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5290"/>they have noses, but cannot smell.<l eID="gen5290" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5291"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:7
verses.text: They have hands, but cannot feel;<l eID="gen5291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5292"/>they have feet, but cannot walk:<l eID="gen5292" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5293"/>no sound comes from their throats.<l eID="gen5293" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5294"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:8
verses.text: Their makers become like them,<l eID="gen5294" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5295"/>so do all who trust in them.<l eID="gen5295" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5277"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5296"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5297"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:9
verses.text: O Israel, trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen5297" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5298"/>he is their help and their shield.<l eID="gen5298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5299"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:10
verses.text: House of Aaron, trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen5299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5300"/>he is their help and their shield.<l eID="gen5300" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5301"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:11
verses.text: You who fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5301" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5302"/>he is their help and their shield.<l eID="gen5302" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5296"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5303"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5304"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:12
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName>, mindful of us, will bless us:<l eID="gen5304" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5305"/>he will bless the house of Israel,<l eID="gen5305" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5306"/>he will bless the house of Aaron.<l eID="gen5306" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5307"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:13
verses.text: He will bless those who fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5307" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5308"/>the small and the great together.<l eID="gen5308" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5303"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5309"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5310"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:14
verses.text: May the <divineName>Lord</divineName> add to your numbers<l eID="gen5310" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5311"/>to you and to your children.<l eID="gen5311" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5312"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:15
verses.text: Blessed be you of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5312" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5313"/>creator of heaven and earth.<l eID="gen5313" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5309"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5314"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5315"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:16
verses.text: The heavens are the heavens of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5316"/>but the earth has he given to people.<l eID="gen5316" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5317"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:17
verses.text: The dead cannot praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5317" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5318"/>nor those who go down into silence.<l eID="gen5318" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5319"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:18
verses.text: But we will bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5319" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5320"/>from now and for evermore.<l eID="gen5320" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5321"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen5321" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen5314"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.115"/> <div eID="gen5276" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv116"/><div sID="gen5322" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 116</title> <lg sID="gen5323"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv116"/> I love the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for he hears<l eID="gen5324" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5325"/>my voice, my pleas for mercy.<l eID="gen5325" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5326"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:2
verses.text: For he has inclined his ear to me:<l eID="gen5326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5327"/>I will call upon him as long as I live.<l eID="gen5327" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5323"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5328"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5329"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:3
verses.text: About me were snares of death,<l eID="gen5329" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5330"/>the anguish of Sheol was upon me:<l eID="gen5330" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5331"/>distress and sorrow were mine.<l eID="gen5331" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5332"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:4
verses.text: Then I called on the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen5332" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5333"/>“I beseech you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, deliver me.”<l eID="gen5333" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5328"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5334"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5335"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:5
verses.text: Gracious and just is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5336"/>compassionate is our God.<l eID="gen5336" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5337"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:6
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> preserves the simple;<l eID="gen5337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5338"/>when I was drooping, he saved me.<l eID="gen5338" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5339"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:7
verses.text: Be at peace, my heart, once more,<l eID="gen5339" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5340"/>for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has been good to you.<l eID="gen5340" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5334"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5341"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5342"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:8
verses.text: You have rescued me from death,<l eID="gen5342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5343"/>my eyes from tears,<l eID="gen5343" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5344"/>my feet from stumbling.<l eID="gen5344" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5345"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:9
verses.text: Before the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I will walk<l eID="gen5345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5346"/>in the land of the living.<l eID="gen5346" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5341"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5347"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5348"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:10
verses.text: I held fast my faith, though I said,<l eID="gen5348" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5349"/>“Ah me! I am sore afflicted“,<l eID="gen5349" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5350"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:11
verses.text: though in my alarm I said,<l eID="gen5350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5351"/>“Everyone is a liar.”<l eID="gen5351" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5347"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5352"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5353"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:12
verses.text: What shall I render the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5353" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5354"/>for all his bounty to me?<l eID="gen5354" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5355"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:13
verses.text: I will lift up the cup of salvation,<l eID="gen5355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5356"/>and call on the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5356" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5357"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:14
verses.text: I will pay my vows to the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5358"/>in the presence of all his people.<l eID="gen5358" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5352"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5359"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5360"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:15
verses.text: Grave in the eyes of the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5360" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5361"/>is the death of his loyal and loved ones.<l eID="gen5361" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5362"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:16
verses.text: Ah, <divineName>Lord</divineName>! I am your servant,<l eID="gen5362" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5363"/>your servant, child of your handmaid.<l eID="gen5363" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5364"/>You have loosened my bonds.<l eID="gen5364" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5359"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5365"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5366"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:17
verses.text: I will offer to you a thank-offering,<l eID="gen5366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5367"/>and call on the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5367" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5368"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:18
verses.text: I will pay my vows to the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5369"/>in the presence of all his people,<l eID="gen5369" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5370"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:19
verses.text: in the courts of the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5370" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5371"/>in the midst of you, O Jerusalem.<l eID="gen5371" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5372"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen5372" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen5365"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.116"/> <div eID="gen5322" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv117"/><div sID="gen5373" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 117</title> <lg sID="gen5374"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv117"/> Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, all you nations:<l eID="gen5375" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5376"/>laud him, all you peoples.<l eID="gen5376" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5377"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:2
verses.text: For his mighty love is over us:<l eID="gen5377" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5378"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is faithful forever.<l eID="gen5378" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5379"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen5379" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen5374"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.117"/> <div eID="gen5373" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv118"/><div sID="gen5380" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 118</title> <lg sID="gen5381"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv118"/> Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his goodness,<l eID="gen5382" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5383"/>his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen5383" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5384"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:2
verses.text: Let the house of Israel now say:<l eID="gen5384" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5385"/>his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen5385" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5386"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:3
verses.text: Let the house of Aaron now say:<l eID="gen5386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5387"/>his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen5387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5388"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:4
verses.text: Let those who fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName> now say:<l eID="gen5388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5389"/>his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen5389" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5381"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5390"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5391"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:5
verses.text: Out of straits I called on the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5391" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5392"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> answered and gave me room.<l eID="gen5392" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5393"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:6
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is mine; I am fearless.<l eID="gen5393" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5394"/>What can people do to me?<l eID="gen5394" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5395"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:7
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is mine, as my help:<l eID="gen5395" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5396"/>I shall feast my eyes on my foes.<l eID="gen5396" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5397"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:8
verses.text: It is better to hide in the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5397" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5398"/>than to trust in mortals.<l eID="gen5398" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5399"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:9
verses.text: It is better to hide in the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5400"/>than to put any trust in princes.<l eID="gen5400" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5401"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:10
verses.text: Everywhere heathen swarmed round me;<l eID="gen5401" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5402"/>in the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I cut them down.<l eID="gen5402" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5403"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:11
verses.text: They swarmed, swarmed around me;<l eID="gen5403" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5404"/>in the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I cut them down,<l eID="gen5404" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5405"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:12
verses.text: they swarmed around me like bees,<l eID="gen5405" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5406"/>they blazed like a fire of thorns:<l eID="gen5406" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5407"/>in the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> I cut them down.<l eID="gen5407" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5390"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5408"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5409"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:13
verses.text: Sore they pushed me, to make me fall;<l eID="gen5409" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5410"/>but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> gave me his help.<l eID="gen5410" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5411"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:14
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is my strength and my song,<l eID="gen5411" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5412"/>and he is become my salvation.<l eID="gen5412" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5413"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: Hark! In the tents of the righteous<l eID="gen5413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5414"/>glad cries of victory are ringing.<l eID="gen5414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5415"/>The hand of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has wrought bravely,<l eID="gen5415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5416"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: the hand of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is exalted,<l eID="gen5416" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5417"/>the hand of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has wrought bravely.<l eID="gen5417" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5408"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5418"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5419"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: I shall not die: nay, I shall live,<l eID="gen5419" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5420"/>to declare the works of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5420" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5421"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: Though the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has chastened me sore,<l eID="gen5421" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5422"/>he has not given me over to death.<l eID="gen5422" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5418"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5423"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5424"/><hi type="italic">(The Procession arrives at the Temple)</hi><l eID="gen5424" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5423"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5425"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5426"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: “Open to me the gates of victory.<l eID="gen5426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5427"/>I would enter therein and give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.”<l eID="gen5427" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5425"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5428"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5429"/><hi type="italic">(The Welcome)</hi><l eID="gen5429" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5428"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5430"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5431"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: “This is the gate of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen5431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5432"/>the righteous may enter therein;”<l eID="gen5432" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5430"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5433"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5434"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: I thank you because you have heard me,<l eID="gen5434" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5435"/>and are become my salvation.<l eID="gen5435" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5433"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5436"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5437"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: The stone which the builders despised<l eID="gen5437" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5438"/>is become the head-stone of the corner.<l eID="gen5438" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5439"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: This has been wrought by the <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen5439" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5440"/>it is marvellous in our eyes.<l eID="gen5440" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5436"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5441"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5442"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: This day is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s own creation:<l eID="gen5442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5443"/>in it let us joy and be glad.<l eID="gen5443" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5444"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, save us, we pray,<l eID="gen5444" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5445"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, prosper, we pray.<l eID="gen5445" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5441"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5446"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5447"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: Blessed is the one who enters<l eID="gen5447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5448"/>in the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5448" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5449"/>From the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> we bless you.<l eID="gen5449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5450"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is God,<l eID="gen5450" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5451"/>he has given us light.<l eID="gen5451" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5452"/>Wreathe the dance with boughs,<l eID="gen5452" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5453"/>till they touch the horns of the altar.<l eID="gen5453" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5454"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: You are my God, I will thank you;<l eID="gen5454" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5455"/>O my God, I will exalt you.<l eID="gen5455" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5456"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
verses.text: Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his goodness:<l eID="gen5456" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5457"/>his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen5457" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5446"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.118"/> <div eID="gen5380" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv119"/><div sID="gen5458" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 119</title> <lg sID="gen5459"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv119"/> Happy they whose life is blameless,<l eID="gen5460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5461"/>who walk by the law of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5461" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5462"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: Happy they who keep his charges,<l eID="gen5462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5463"/>and seek him with all their hearts;<l eID="gen5463" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5464"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: who have done no wrong,<l eID="gen5464" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5465"/>but walk in his ways.<l eID="gen5465" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5466"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: You yourself have appointed your precepts<l eID="gen5466" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5467"/>to be kept with diligence.<l eID="gen5467" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5459"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5468"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5469"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: O to be steadily guided<l eID="gen5469" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5470"/>in the keeping of your statutes!<l eID="gen5470" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5471"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: Then unashamed shall I be,<l eID="gen5471" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5472"/>when I look towards all your commandments.<l eID="gen5472" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5473"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: I will thank you with heart unfeigned,<l eID="gen5473" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5474"/>when I learn your righteous judgments.<l eID="gen5474" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5475"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: I will observe your statutes:<l eID="gen5475" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5476"/>O forsake me not utterly.<l eID="gen5476" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5468"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5477"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5478"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: How can a young person keep their life pure?<l eID="gen5478" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5479"/>By giving heed to your word.<l eID="gen5479" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5480"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: With all my heart have I sought you,<l eID="gen5480" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5481"/>let me not stray from your commandments.<l eID="gen5481" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5482"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: In my heart have I treasured your word,<l eID="gen5482" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5483"/>to keep from sinning against you.<l eID="gen5483" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5484"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: Blessed are you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>;<l eID="gen5484" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5485"/>teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen5485" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5486"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: With my lips have I rehearsed<l eID="gen5486" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5487"/>all the judgments of your mouth.<l eID="gen5487" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5488"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: I delight in the way of your charges,<l eID="gen5488" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5489"/>more than in riches of all sorts.<l eID="gen5489" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5490"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: I will muse upon your precepts,<l eID="gen5490" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5491"/>and look to your paths.<l eID="gen5491" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5492"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: In your statutes I delight,<l eID="gen5492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5493"/>I will not forget your word.<l eID="gen5493" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5477"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5494"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5495"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: Grant that your servant may live,<l eID="gen5495" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5496"/>and I will observe your word.<l eID="gen5496" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5497"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: Open my eyes, that I see<l eID="gen5497" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5498"/>wondrous things out of your law.<l eID="gen5498" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5499"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: But a guest am I on the earth:<l eID="gen5499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5500"/>hide not your commandments from me.<l eID="gen5500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5501"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: My heart is crushed with longing<l eID="gen5501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5502"/>for your ordinances, at all times.<l eID="gen5502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5503"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: You rebuke the proud, the accursed,<l eID="gen5503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5504"/>who wander from your commandments.<l eID="gen5504" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5505"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: Roll away from me scorn and contempt,<l eID="gen5505" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5506"/>for I have observed your charges.<l eID="gen5506" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5507"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
verses.text: Though princes sit plotting against me,<l eID="gen5507" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5508"/>your servant will muse on your statutes.<l eID="gen5508" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5509"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: Your charges are my delight,<l eID="gen5509" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5510"/>they are my counsellors.<l eID="gen5510" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5494"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5511"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5512"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: I lie grovelling in the dust;<l eID="gen5512" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5513"/>revive me, as you have promised.<l eID="gen5513" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5514"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: I told of my ways, you made answer;<l eID="gen5514" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5515"/>teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen5515" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5516"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: Grant me insight into your precepts,<l eID="gen5516" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5517"/>and I will muse on your wonders.<l eID="gen5517" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5518"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: I am overcome with sorrow;<l eID="gen5518" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5519"/>raise me up, as you have promised.<l eID="gen5519" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5520"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: Put the way of falsehood from me,<l eID="gen5520" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5521"/>and graciously grant me your law.<l eID="gen5521" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5522"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: I have chosen the way of fidelity,<l eID="gen5522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5523"/>your ordinances I long for.<l eID="gen5523" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5524"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: I hold fast to your charges:<l eID="gen5524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5525"/>O put me not, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to shame.<l eID="gen5525" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5526"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: I will run in the way of your commandments,<l eID="gen5526" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5527"/>for you give me room of heart.<l eID="gen5527" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5511"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5528"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5529"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: Teach me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the way of your statutes,<l eID="gen5529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5530"/>and I will keep it to the end,<l eID="gen5530" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5531"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: instruct me to keep your law,<l eID="gen5531" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5532"/>and I will observe it with all my heart.<l eID="gen5532" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5533"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: Guide me in the path of your commandments,<l eID="gen5533" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5534"/>for therein do I delight.<l eID="gen5534" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5535"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: Incline my heart to your charges,<l eID="gen5535" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5536"/>and not to greed of gain.<l eID="gen5536" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5537"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: Turn away my eyes from vain sights,<l eID="gen5537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5538"/>revive me by your word.<l eID="gen5538" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5539"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: Confirm to your servant the promise<l eID="gen5539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5540"/>which is given to those who fear you.<l eID="gen5540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5541"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: Remove the reproach which I dread,<l eID="gen5541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5542"/>because your judgments are good.<l eID="gen5542" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5543"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: Behold, I long for your precepts.<l eID="gen5543" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5544"/>Quicken me in your righteousness.<l eID="gen5544" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5528"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5545"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5546"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: Visit me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, with your love<l eID="gen5546" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5547"/>and salvation, as you have promised.<l eID="gen5547" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5548"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: So shall I answer my slanderers,<l eID="gen5548" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5549"/>for my trust is in your word.<l eID="gen5549" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5550"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: Snatch not from my mouth the word of truth,<l eID="gen5550" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5551"/>for in your judgments I hope.<l eID="gen5551" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5552"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: I will keep your law continually,<l eID="gen5552" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5553"/>for ever and evermore.<l eID="gen5553" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5554"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: So shall I walk in wide spaces,<l eID="gen5554" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5555"/>for I give my mind to your precepts.<l eID="gen5555" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5556"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: I will speak of your charge before kings,<l eID="gen5556" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5557"/>and will not be ashamed thereof.<l eID="gen5557" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5558"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: Your commandments are my delight,<l eID="gen5558" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5559"/>I love them exceedingly.<l eID="gen5559" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5560"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: I will lift up my hands to your commandments,<l eID="gen5560" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5561"/>and muse upon your statutes.<l eID="gen5561" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5545"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5562"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5563"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: Remember your word to your servant,<l eID="gen5563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5564"/>on which you have made me to hope.<l eID="gen5564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5565"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: This is my comfort in trouble,<l eID="gen5565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5566"/>that your word gives life to me.<l eID="gen5566" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5567"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: The arrogant utterly scorn me,<l eID="gen5567" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5568"/>but I have not declined from your law.<l eID="gen5568" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5569"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: When I think of your judgments of old,<l eID="gen5569" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5570"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I take to me comfort.<l eID="gen5570" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5571"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: I am seized with glowing anger<l eID="gen5571" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5572"/>at the wicked who forsake your law.<l eID="gen5572" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5573"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: Your statutes have been to me songs<l eID="gen5573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5574"/>in the house of my pilgrimage.<l eID="gen5574" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5575"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: I remember your name in the night,<l eID="gen5575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5576"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName> and observe your law.<l eID="gen5576" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5577"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: My lot has been this,<l eID="gen5577" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5578"/>that I have kept your precepts.<l eID="gen5578" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5562"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5579"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5580"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: My portion are you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen5580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5581"/>I have promised to keep your words.<l eID="gen5581" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5582"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: I entreat you with all my heart;<l eID="gen5582" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5583"/>grant me your promised favour.<l eID="gen5583" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5584"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: I have thought upon my ways,<l eID="gen5584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5585"/>and turned my feet to your charges.<l eID="gen5585" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5586"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: I hasted and tarried not<l eID="gen5586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5587"/>to give heed to your commandments.<l eID="gen5587" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5588"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: Though the godless have wound their cords round me,<l eID="gen5588" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5589"/>I have not forgotten your law.<l eID="gen5589" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5590"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: At midnight I rise to praise you<l eID="gen5590" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5591"/>because of your righteous judgments.<l eID="gen5591" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5592"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: With all those who fear you I company,<l eID="gen5592" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5593"/>aid with those who observe your precepts.<l eID="gen5593" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5594"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: The earth, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, is full of your kindness;<l eID="gen5594" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5595"/>teach me your Statutes.<l eID="gen5595" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5579"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5596"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5597"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: Well have you dealt with your servant,<l eID="gen5597" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5598"/>as you have promised, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5598" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5599"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: Teach me discretion and knowledge,<l eID="gen5599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5600"/>for I have believed your commandments.<l eID="gen5600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5601"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: Till trouble came I was a wanderer,<l eID="gen5601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5602"/>but now I observe your word.<l eID="gen5602" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5603"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: You are good and do good;<l eID="gen5603" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5604"/>teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen5604" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5605"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: The proud have forged lies against me,<l eID="gen5605" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5606"/>but I keep your precepts with all my heart.<l eID="gen5606" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5607"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: Their heart is gross like fat,<l eID="gen5607" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5608"/>but I delight in your law.<l eID="gen5608" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5609"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: It was good for me to be humbled,<l eID="gen5609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5610"/>that I should learn your statutes.<l eID="gen5610" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5611"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: The law of your mouth is better to me<l eID="gen5611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5612"/>than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.<l eID="gen5612" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5596"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5613"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5614"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me;<l eID="gen5614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5615"/>make me wise to learn your commandments.<l eID="gen5615" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5616"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: Those who fear you shall see me with joy,<l eID="gen5616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5617"/>for in your word have I hoped.<l eID="gen5617" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5618"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: I know, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, that your judgments are right,<l eID="gen5618" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5619"/>and in faithfulness you have afflicted me.<l eID="gen5619" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5620"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: Let your love be a comfort to me,<l eID="gen5620" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5621"/>for so have you promised your servant.<l eID="gen5621" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5622"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: Visit me with your quickening pity,<l eID="gen5622" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5623"/>for your law is my delight.<l eID="gen5623" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5624"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: Put the proud to shame, who have wronged me falsely:<l eID="gen5624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5625"/>I will muse on your precepts.<l eID="gen5625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: Let those turn to me who fear you,<l eID="gen5626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5627"/>that they may learn your charges.<l eID="gen5627" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5628"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: Let my heart be sound in your statutes,<l eID="gen5628" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5629"/>that I may not be put to shame.<l eID="gen5629" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5613"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5630"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5631"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: My long for you to rescue me,<l eID="gen5631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5632"/>I put my hope in your word.<l eID="gen5632" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5633"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: My eyes pine away for your promise:<l eID="gen5633" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5634"/>saying, “When will you comfort me?”<l eID="gen5634" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5635"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: Though shrivelled like wine-skin in smoke,<l eID="gen5635" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5636"/>your statutes I have not forgotten.<l eID="gen5636" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5637"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: How few are the days of your servant!<l eID="gen5637" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5638"/>When will you judge those who harass me?<l eID="gen5638" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5639"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: Proud people have dug for me pits<l eID="gen5639" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5640"/>people who do not conform to your law.<l eID="gen5640" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5641"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: All your commandments are trusty.<l eID="gen5641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5642"/>With falsehood they harass me: help me.<l eID="gen5642" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5643"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: They had nearly made an end of me,<l eID="gen5643" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5644"/>yet I did not forget your precepts.<l eID="gen5644" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5645"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: Spare me in your kindness,<l eID="gen5645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5646"/>and I will observe the charge of your mouth.<l eID="gen5646" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5630"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5647"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5648"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: Forever, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, is your word<l eID="gen5648" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5649"/>fixed firmly in the heavens.<l eID="gen5649" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5650"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: Your truth endures age after age;<l eID="gen5650" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5651"/>it is established on earth, and it stands.<l eID="gen5651" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5652"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: By your appointment they stand this day,<l eID="gen5652" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5653"/>for all are your servants.<l eID="gen5653" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5654"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: Had not your law been my joy,<l eID="gen5654" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5655"/>in my misery then had I perished.<l eID="gen5655" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5656"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: I will never forget your precepts,<l eID="gen5656" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5657"/>for through them you have put life in me.<l eID="gen5657" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5658"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: I am yours, O save me,<l eID="gen5658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5659"/>for I give my mind to your precepts.<l eID="gen5659" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5660"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: The wicked lay wait to destroy me,<l eID="gen5660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5661"/>but I give heed to your charge.<l eID="gen5661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5662"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: I have seen a limit to all things:<l eID="gen5662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5663"/>but your commandment is spacious exceedingly.<l eID="gen5663" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5647"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5664"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5665"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: O how I love your law!<l eID="gen5665" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5666"/>All the day long I muse on it.<l eID="gen5666" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5667"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies:<l eID="gen5667" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5668"/>for it is mine forever.<l eID="gen5668" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5669"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: I am prudent above all my teachers,<l eID="gen5669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5670"/>for your charges are my meditation.<l eID="gen5670" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5671"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: I have insight more than the aged,<l eID="gen5671" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5672"/>because I observe your precepts.<l eID="gen5672" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5673"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: I refrain my foot from all wicked ways,<l eID="gen5673" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5674"/>that I may keep your word.<l eID="gen5674" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5675"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: I turn not aside from your judgments,<l eID="gen5675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5676"/>for you yourself are my teacher.<l eID="gen5676" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5677"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: How sweet are your words to my taste,<l eID="gen5677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5678"/>sweeter than honey to my mouth!<l eID="gen5678" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5679"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: Insight I win through your precepts,<l eID="gen5679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5680"/>therefore every false way I hate.<l eID="gen5680" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5664"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5681"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5682"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet,<l eID="gen5682" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5683"/>and a light to my path.<l eID="gen5683" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5684"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: I have sworn an oath, and will keep it,<l eID="gen5684" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5685"/>to observe your righteous judgments.<l eID="gen5685" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5686"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: I am afflicted sorely:<l eID="gen5686" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5687"/>revive me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, as you said.<l eID="gen5687" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5688"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: Accept, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my willing praise,<l eID="gen5688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5689"/>and teach me your judgments.<l eID="gen5689" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5690"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: My life is in ceaseless peril;<l eID="gen5690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5691"/>but I do not forget your law.<l eID="gen5691" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5692"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: The wicked set traps for me,<l eID="gen5692" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5693"/>yet I do not stray from your precepts.<l eID="gen5693" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5694"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: In your charges are my everlasting inheritance,<l eID="gen5694" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5695"/>they are the joy of my heart.<l eID="gen5695" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5696"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: I am resolved to perform your statutes<l eID="gen5696" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5697"/>forever, to the utmost.<l eID="gen5697" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5681"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5698"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5699"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: I hate people of divided heart,<l eID="gen5699" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5700"/>but your law do I love.<l eID="gen5700" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5701"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: You are my shelter and shield:<l eID="gen5701" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5702"/>in your word do I hope.<l eID="gen5702" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5703"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: Begone, you wicked people,<l eID="gen5703" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5704"/>I will keep the commands of my God.<l eID="gen5704" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5705"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: Uphold me and spare me, as you have promised:<l eID="gen5705" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5706"/>O disappoint me not.<l eID="gen5706" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5707"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: Hold me up, and I shall be saved:<l eID="gen5707" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5708"/>and your statutes shall be my unceasing delight.<l eID="gen5708" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5709"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: All who swerve from your statutes you spurn:<l eID="gen5709" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5710"/>their cunning is in vain.<l eID="gen5710" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5711"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: All the wicked of earth you count as dross,<l eID="gen5711" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5712"/>therefore I love your charges.<l eID="gen5712" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5713"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: My flesh, for fear of you, shudders,<l eID="gen5713" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5714"/>and I stand in awe of your judgments.<l eID="gen5714" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5698"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5715"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5716"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: Justice and right have I practised,<l eID="gen5716" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5717"/>do not leave me to my oppressors.<l eID="gen5717" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5718"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: Be your servant’s surety for good:<l eID="gen5718" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5719"/>“Let not the proud oppress me.<l eID="gen5719" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5720"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: My eyes pine for your salvation,<l eID="gen5720" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5721"/>and for your righteous promise.<l eID="gen5721" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5722"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: Deal in your love with your servant,<l eID="gen5722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5723"/>and teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen5723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5724"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: Your servant am I; instruct me,<l eID="gen5724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5725"/>that I may know your charges.<l eID="gen5725" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5726"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: It is time for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> to act:<l eID="gen5726" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5727"/>they have violated your law.<l eID="gen5727" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5728"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: Therefore I love your commandments<l eID="gen5728" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5729"/>above gold, above fine gold.<l eID="gen5729" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5730"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: So by all your precepts I guide me,<l eID="gen5730" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5731"/>and every false way I hate.<l eID="gen5731" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5715"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5732"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5733"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: Your decrees are wonderful,<l eID="gen5733" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5734"/>gladly I keep them.<l eID="gen5734" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5735"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: When your word is unfolded, light breaks;<l eID="gen5735" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5736"/>it imparts to the simple wisdom.<l eID="gen5736" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5737"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: With open mouth I pant<l eID="gen5737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5738"/>with longing for your commandments.<l eID="gen5738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5739"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: Turn to me with your favour,<l eID="gen5739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5740"/>as is just to those who love you.<l eID="gen5740" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5741"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: Steady my steps by your word,<l eID="gen5741" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5742"/>so that sin have no power over me.<l eID="gen5742" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5743"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: Set me free from those who oppress me,<l eID="gen5743" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5744"/>and I shall observe your precepts.<l eID="gen5744" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5745"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: Shine with your face on your servant,<l eID="gen5745" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5746"/>and teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen5746" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: My eyes run down with rills of water,<l eID="gen5747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5748"/>because your law is not kept.<l eID="gen5748" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5732"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5749"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5750"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: Righteous are you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5750" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5751"/>and right are your ordinances.<l eID="gen5751" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5752"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: The laws you has ordered are just,<l eID="gen5752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5753"/>and trusty exceedingly.<l eID="gen5753" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5754"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: My jealousy has undone me,<l eID="gen5754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5755"/>that my foes have forgotten your words.<l eID="gen5755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5756"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: Your word has been tested well;<l eID="gen5756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5757"/>and your servant loves it.<l eID="gen5757" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5758"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: I am little and held in contempt,<l eID="gen5758" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5759"/>but your precepts I have not forgotten.<l eID="gen5759" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5760"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: Just is your justice forever,<l eID="gen5760" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5761"/>and trusty is your law.<l eID="gen5761" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5762"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: Stress and strain are upon me,<l eID="gen5762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5763"/>but your commandments are my delight.<l eID="gen5763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5764"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: Right are your charges forever,<l eID="gen5764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5765"/>instruct me that I may live.<l eID="gen5765" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5749"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5766"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5767"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: With my whole heart I cry; O answer me.<l eID="gen5767" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5768"/>I would keep your statutes, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5768" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5769"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: I cry to you: O save me,<l eID="gen5769" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5770"/>and I will observe your charges.<l eID="gen5770" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5771"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: Ere the dawn I cry for your help:<l eID="gen5771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5772"/>in your word do I hope.<l eID="gen5772" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5773"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: Awake I meet the night-watches,<l eID="gen5773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5774"/>to muse upon your sayings.<l eID="gen5774" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5775"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: Hear my voice in your kindness:<l eID="gen5775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5776"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, by your judgments revive me.<l eID="gen5776" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5777"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: Near me are wicked tormentors,<l eID="gen5777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5778"/>who are far from thoughts of your law;<l eID="gen5778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: but near, too, are you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5779" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5780"/>and all your commandments are trusty.<l eID="gen5780" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5781"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: Long have I known from your charges<l eID="gen5781" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5782"/>that you have founded them for all time.<l eID="gen5782" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5766"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5783"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5784"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: Look on my misery, and rescue me;<l eID="gen5784" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5785"/>for I do not forget your law.<l eID="gen5785" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5786"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: Defend my cause and redeem me:<l eID="gen5786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5787"/>revive me, as you have promised.<l eID="gen5787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5788"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: Salvation is far from the wicked,<l eID="gen5788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5789"/>for their mind is not in your statutes.<l eID="gen5789" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5790"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: Great is your pity, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>:’<l eID="gen5790" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5791"/>Revive me, as you have ordained.<l eID="gen5791" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5792"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: My foes and tormentors are many,<l eID="gen5792" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5793"/>but I have not declined from your charges.<l eID="gen5793" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5794"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: I behold the traitors with loathing,<l eID="gen5794" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5795"/>for they do not observe your word.<l eID="gen5795" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5796"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: Behold how I love your precepts:<l eID="gen5796" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5797"/>revive me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>!, in your kindness.<l eID="gen5797" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5798"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: The sum of your word is truth,<l eID="gen5798" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5799"/>all your laws are just and eternal.<l eID="gen5799" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5783"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5800"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5801"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: Princes have harassed me wantonly:<l eID="gen5801" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5802"/>but my heart stands in awe of your word.<l eID="gen5802" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5803"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: Over your word I rejoice<l eID="gen5803" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5804"/>as one who finds great spoil.<l eID="gen5804" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5805"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: Falsehood I hate and abhor,<l eID="gen5805" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5806"/>but your law do I love.<l eID="gen5806" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5807"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: Seven times a day do I praise you<l eID="gen5807" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5808"/>because of your righteous judgments.<l eID="gen5808" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5809"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: Right well do they fare who love your law:<l eID="gen5809" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5810"/>they go on their way without stumbling.<l eID="gen5810" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5811"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: I hope for your salvation;<l eID="gen5811" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5812"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName> I do your commandments.<l eID="gen5812" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5813"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: I observe your charges:<l eID="gen5813" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5814"/>I love them greatly.<l eID="gen5814" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5815"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: I observe your precepts and charges:<l eID="gen5815" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5816"/>all my ways are before you.<l eID="gen5816" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5800"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5817"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5818"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: Let my cry come before you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen5818" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5819"/>give me insight, as you have promised.<l eID="gen5819" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5820"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: Let my prayer enter into your presence:<l eID="gen5820" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5821"/>deliver me, as you have said.<l eID="gen5821" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5822"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: My lips shall be fountains of praise,<l eID="gen5822" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5823"/>that you teach me your statutes.<l eID="gen5823" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5824"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: My tongue shall sing of your word,<l eID="gen5824" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5825"/>for all your commandments are right.<l eID="gen5825" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5826"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: Let your hand be ready to help me,<l eID="gen5826" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5827"/>for your precepts have been my choice.<l eID="gen5827" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5828"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: I long, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for your salvation,<l eID="gen5828" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5829"/>and your law is my delight.<l eID="gen5829" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5830"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: Revive me that I may praise you,<l eID="gen5830" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5831"/>and let your precepts help me.<l eID="gen5831" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5832"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: I have strayed like a wandering sheep<l eID="gen5832" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5833"/>seek your servant, because<l eID="gen5833" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5834"/>I do not forget your commandments.<l eID="gen5834" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5817"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.119"/> <div eID="gen5458" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv120"/><div sID="gen5835" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 120</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen5836"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv120"/> In distress I cried to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5837" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5838"/>and he answered me.<l eID="gen5838" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5839"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: “Deliver me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5839" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5840"/>from the lip that is false<l eID="gen5840" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5841"/>and the tongue that is crafty.”<l eID="gen5841" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5836"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5842"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5843"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: What shall he give to you,<l eID="gen5843" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5844"/>you tongue that is crafty?<l eID="gen5844" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5845"/>What yet shall he give to you?<l eID="gen5845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5846"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: Arrows of warrior, sharpened,<l eID="gen5846" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5847"/>with glowing broom coals together.<l eID="gen5847" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5842"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5848"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5849"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: Woe is me that I sojourn in Meshech,<l eID="gen5849" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5850"/>that I live by the tents of Kedar.<l eID="gen5850" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5851"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: Already too long have I dwelt<l eID="gen5851" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5852"/>among those who hate peace.<l eID="gen5852" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5853"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: I am for peace:<l eID="gen5853" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5854"/>but when I speak of it,<l eID="gen5854" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5855"/>they are for war.<l eID="gen5855" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5848"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.120"/> <div eID="gen5835" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv121"/><div sID="gen5856" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 121</title> <div eID="gen5856" type="section"/> <div sID="gen5857" type="section"/> <title>A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen5858"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv121"/> I will lift up my eyes to the mountains.<l eID="gen5859" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5860"/>O whence shall help for me come?<l eID="gen5860" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5861"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: From the <divineName>Lord</divineName> comes help to me<l eID="gen5861" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5862"/>the creator of heaven and earth.<l eID="gen5862" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5858"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5863"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5864"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: Your foot he will not let totter:<l eID="gen5864" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5865"/>he who guards you will not sleep.<l eID="gen5865" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5866"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: The guardian of Israel<l eID="gen5866" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5867"/>will neither slumber nor sleep.<l eID="gen5867" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5863"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5868"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5869"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is he who guards you<l eID="gen5869" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5870"/>your shelter upon your right hand.<l eID="gen5870" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5871"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: The sun by day shall not strike you,<l eID="gen5871" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5872"/>nor the moon by night.<l eID="gen5872" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5868"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5873"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5874"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: From all evil the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will guard you,<l eID="gen5874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5875"/>he will guard your life.<l eID="gen5875" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5876"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> will guard your going and coming<l eID="gen5876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5877"/>from now and for evermore.<l eID="gen5877" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5873"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.121"/> <div eID="gen5857" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv122"/><div sID="gen5878" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 122</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen5879"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv122"/> I was glad when they said to me,<l eID="gen5880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5881"/>“We will go to the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.”<l eID="gen5881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5882"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: Now we are standing,<l eID="gen5882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5883"/>within your gates, O Jerusalem.<l eID="gen5883" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5879"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5884"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5885"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: O Jerusalem, built close-packed,<l eID="gen5885" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5886"/>like a city without breach or gap,<l eID="gen5886" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5887"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: to you do the tribes come,<l eID="gen5887" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5888"/>the tribes of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5888" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5889"/>as the law has ordained for Israel,<l eID="gen5889" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5890"/>there to give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5890" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5891"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:5
verses.text: There once stood thrones of justice<l eID="gen5891" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5892"/>even thrones of the household of David.<l eID="gen5892" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5884"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5893"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5894"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:6
verses.text: Pray that all may be well with Jerusalem,<l eID="gen5894" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5895"/>and well with those who love you,<l eID="gen5895" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5896"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:7
verses.text: well within your ramparts,<l eID="gen5896" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5897"/>and well within your palaces.<l eID="gen5897" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5893"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5898"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5899"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:8
verses.text: For the sake of my brethren and friends,<l eID="gen5899" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5900"/>I will wish you now prosperity:<l eID="gen5900" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5901"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:9
verses.text: for the sake of the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5901" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5902"/>our God, I will seek your good.<l eID="gen5902" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5898"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.122"/> <div eID="gen5878" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv123"/><div sID="gen5903" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 123</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen5904"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv123"/> I Lift up my eyes to you,<l eID="gen5905" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5906"/>who are throned in the heavens.<l eID="gen5906" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5907"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: As the eyes of a servant<l eID="gen5907" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5908"/>turn to the hand of his master,<l eID="gen5908" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5909"/>or the eyes of a maid<l eID="gen5909" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5910"/>to the hand of her mistress,<l eID="gen5910" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5911"/>so do our eyes turn<l eID="gen5911" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5912"/>to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> our God,<l eID="gen5912" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5913"/>until he is gracious to us.<l eID="gen5913" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen5904"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5914"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5915"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: Be gracious, be gracious to us, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen5915" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5916"/>Scorn enough, and more, have we borne<l eID="gen5916" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5917"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: More than enough have we borne<l eID="gen5917" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5918"/>of derision from those at their ease,<l eID="gen5918" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5919"/>of scorn from those who are haughty.<l eID="gen5919" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5914"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.123"/> <div eID="gen5903" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv124"/><div sID="gen5920" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 124</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen5921"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv124"/> “Had it not been the <divineName>Lord</divineName> who was for us”<l eID="gen5922" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5923"/>let Israel say<l eID="gen5923" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5924"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: “Had it not been the <divineName>Lord</divineName> who was for us<l eID="gen5924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5925"/>when enemies rose against us,<l eID="gen5925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5926"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: then alive they’d have swallowed us up,<l eID="gen5926" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5927"/>when their anger was kindled against us.<l eID="gen5927" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5928"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: Then the waters would’ve swept us away,<l eID="gen5928" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5929"/>and the torrent passed over us clean:<l eID="gen5929" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5930"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: then most sure would’ve passed over us clean<l eID="gen5930" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5931"/>the wild seething waters.”<l eID="gen5931" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5921"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5932"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5933"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:6
verses.text: Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName> who has given us not<l eID="gen5933" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5934"/>to be torn by their teeth.<l eID="gen5934" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5935"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:7
verses.text: We are like a bird just escaped<l eID="gen5935" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5936"/>from the snare of the fowler.<l eID="gen5936" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5932"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5937"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5938"/>The snare is broken,<l eID="gen5938" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5939"/>and we are escaped.<l eID="gen5939" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5940"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:8
verses.text: Our help is the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5940" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5941"/>the Creator of heaven and earth.<l eID="gen5941" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5937"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.124"/> <div eID="gen5920" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv125"/><div sID="gen5942" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 125</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen5943"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv125"/> Those who trust in the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen5944" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5945"/>are like Mount Zion,<l eID="gen5945" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5946"/>that cannot be moved,<l eID="gen5946" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5947"/>but abides forever.<l eID="gen5947" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5948"/>Round Jerusalem are the mountains,<l eID="gen5948" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5949"/>and the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is round his people<l eID="gen5949" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5950"/>from now and for evermore.<l eID="gen5950" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5943"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5951"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5952"/>For he will not suffer<l eID="gen5952" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5953"/>the sceptre of wrong<l eID="gen5953" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5954"/>to rest on the land<l eID="gen5954" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5955"/>allotted to the righteous;<l eID="gen5955" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5956"/>else the righteous might put forth<l eID="gen5956" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5957"/>their own hand to evil.<l eID="gen5957" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5951"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5958"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5959"/>Do good, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5959" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5960"/>to the good,<l eID="gen5960" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5961"/>and to the true-hearted.<l eID="gen5961" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5958"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5962"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5963"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: But those who swerve<l eID="gen5963" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5964"/>into crooked ways<l eID="gen5964" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5965"/>will the <divineName>Lord</divineName> lead away<l eID="gen5965" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5966"/>with the workers of evil.<l eID="gen5966" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5962"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5967"/> <l level="3" sID="gen5968"/>Peace be upon Israel.<l eID="gen5968" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen5967"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.125"/> <div eID="gen5942" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv126"/><div sID="gen5969" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 126</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen5970"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv126"/> When the <divineName>Lord</divineName> turned the fortunes of Zion,<l eID="gen5971" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5972"/>we were like dreamers.<l eID="gen5972" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5973"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter,<l eID="gen5973" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5974"/>our tongue with glad shouts;<l eID="gen5974" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5975"/>then among the nations they said,<l eID="gen5975" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5976"/>“The <divineName>Lord</divineName> has dealt greatly with them.”<l eID="gen5976" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5977"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> had dealt greatly with us,<l eID="gen5977" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5978"/>and we were rejoicing.<l eID="gen5978" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5970"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5979"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5980"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: Turn our fortunes, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen5980" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5981"/>as the streams in the Negreb.<l eID="gen5981" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5982"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: They who sow in tears<l eID="gen5982" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5983"/>shall reap with glad shouts.<l eID="gen5983" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5984"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:6
verses.text: Forth they fare, with their burden of seed,<l eID="gen5984" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5985"/>and they weep as they go.<l eID="gen5985" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5986"/>But home, home, with glad shouts they shall come<l eID="gen5986" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5987"/>with their arms full of sheaves.<l eID="gen5987" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5979"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.126"/> <div eID="gen5969" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv127"/><div sID="gen5988" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 127</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of Solomon.</title> <lg sID="gen5989"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv127"/> Unless the <divineName>Lord</divineName> builds the house,<l eID="gen5990" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5991"/>those who build it labour in vain.<l eID="gen5991" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5992"/>Unless the <divineName>Lord</divineName> guards the city,<l eID="gen5992" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5993"/>the watchman wakes in vain.<l eID="gen5993" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5989"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen5994"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5995"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: In vain you rise early,<l eID="gen5995" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5996"/>and finish so late,<l eID="gen5996" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5997"/>and so eat sorrow’s bread;<l eID="gen5997" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5998"/>for he cares for his loved ones<l eID="gen5998" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen5999"/>in their sleep.<l eID="gen5999" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen5994"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6000"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6001"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
