verses.text: Children are a gift of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6001" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6002"/>the fruit of the womb, a reward.<l eID="gen6002" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6003"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: Like arrows, by warriors wielded,<l eID="gen6003" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6004"/>are the children of youth.<l eID="gen6004" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6000"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6005"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6006"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: Happy the man who has filled<l eID="gen6006" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6007"/>his quiver full of them.<l eID="gen6007" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6008"/>He shall not be ashamed when he speaks<l eID="gen6008" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6009"/>with enemies in the gate.<l eID="gen6009" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6005"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.127"/> <div eID="gen5988" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv128"/><div sID="gen6010" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 128</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen6011"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv128"/> Happy all who fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6012" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6013"/>who walk in his ways.<l eID="gen6013" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6014"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: You will eat what your hands have toiled for,<l eID="gen6014" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6015"/>and be happy and prosperous!<l eID="gen6015" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6011"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6016"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6017"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: Like a fruitful vine shall your wife be<l eID="gen6017" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6018"/>in the innermost room of your house:<l eID="gen6018" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6019"/>your children, like olive shoots,<l eID="gen6019" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6020"/>round about your table.<l eID="gen6020" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6016"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6021"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6022"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: See! This is the blessing<l eID="gen6022" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6023"/>of the man who fears the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6023" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6024"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall bless you from Zion.<l eID="gen6024" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6025"/>You will see Jerusalem nourish<l eID="gen6025" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6026"/>all the days of your life.<l eID="gen6026" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6027"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: You will see your children’s children.<l eID="gen6027" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6021"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6028"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6029"/>Peace upon Israel.<l eID="gen6029" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6028"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.128"/> <div eID="gen6010" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv129"/><div sID="gen6030" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 129</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen6031"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv129"/> “Sore have they vexed me from youth”<l eID="gen6032" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6033"/>thus let Israel say<l eID="gen6033" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6034"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: “Sore have they vexed me from youth,<l eID="gen6034" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6035"/>but they have not prevailed against me.<l eID="gen6035" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6031"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6036"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6037"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: The ploughers ploughed on my back,<l eID="gen6037" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6038"/>they made their furrows long.<l eID="gen6038" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6039"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: But the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, who is righteous, has cut<l eID="gen6039" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6040"/>the cords of the wicked.”<l eID="gen6040" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6036"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6042"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: Let all who are haters of Zion<l eID="gen6042" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6043"/>be put to shame and defeated.<l eID="gen6043" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6044"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: May they be as the grass on the house-top,<l eID="gen6044" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6045"/>which withers before it shoots up;<l eID="gen6045" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6041"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6046"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6047"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: which fills not the arms of the reaper,<l eID="gen6047" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6048"/>nor the lap of the binder of sheaves,<l eID="gen6048" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6049"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: whereof no one says as they pass,<l eID="gen6049" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6050"/>“The blessing of God be upon you.”<l eID="gen6050" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6046"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6051"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6052"/>In the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> we bless you.<l eID="gen6052" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6051"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.129"/> <div eID="gen6030" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv130"/><div sID="gen6053" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 130</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen6054"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv130"/> Out of the depths<l eID="gen6055" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6056"/>I call to you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6056" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6057"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, hear my voice:<l eID="gen6057" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6058"/>give heed with your ears<l eID="gen6058" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6059"/>to my loud plea.<l eID="gen6059" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6054"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6060"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6061"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: If you should mark sin, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6061" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6062"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, who could stand?<l eID="gen6062" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6063"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:4
verses.text: But with you is forgiveness,<l eID="gen6063" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6064"/>that you may be feared.<l eID="gen6064" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6060"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6065"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6066"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:5
verses.text: I wait for the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6066" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6067"/>I wait for his word,<l eID="gen6067" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6068"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:6
verses.text: I look for the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen6068" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6069"/>more than watchman for morning,<l eID="gen6069" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6070"/>than watchman for morning.<l eID="gen6070" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6065"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6071"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6072"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:7
verses.text: Israel, hope in the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen6072" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6073"/>with the <divineName>Lord</divineName> there is love<l eID="gen6073" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6074"/>with him plenteous redemption.<l eID="gen6074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6075"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:8
verses.text: And he redeems Israel<l eID="gen6075" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6076"/>from all his iniquities.<l eID="gen6076" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6071"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.130"/> <div eID="gen6053" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv131"/><div sID="gen6077" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 131</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6078"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv131"/> O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my heart is not haughty,<l eID="gen6079" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6080"/>my eyes are not lofty,<l eID="gen6080" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6081"/>I walk not among great things,<l eID="gen6081" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6082"/>things too wonderful for me.<l eID="gen6082" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6078"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6083"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6084"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: Yes, I have soothed and stilled myself,<l eID="gen6084" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6085"/>like a weaned child on his mother’s lap;<l eID="gen6085" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6086"/>like a weaned child am I.<l eID="gen6086" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6083"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6087"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6088"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: O Israel, hope in the <divineName>Lord</divineName><l eID="gen6088" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6089"/>from now and for evermore.<l eID="gen6089" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6087"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.131"/> <div eID="gen6077" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv132"/><div sID="gen6090" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 132</title> <lg sID="gen6091"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv132"/> Remember, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, David<l eID="gen6092" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6093"/>all his sufferings,<l eID="gen6093" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6094"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: the oath that he swore to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6094" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6095"/>and his vow to the Strong One of Jacob,<l eID="gen6095" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6096"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: never to enter his tent,<l eID="gen6096" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6097"/>never to lie on his bed,<l eID="gen6097" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6098"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:4
verses.text: never to give his eyes sleep<l eID="gen6098" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6099"/>or his eyelids slumber,<l eID="gen6099" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6100"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:5
verses.text: till he had found a place for the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6100" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6101"/>for the Strong One of Jacob to live in.<l eID="gen6101" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6091"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6102"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6103"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:6
verses.text: We heard of it in Ephrathah,<l eID="gen6103" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6104"/>in the fields of Jaar we found it.<l eID="gen6104" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6105"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:7
verses.text: We went to the place where he dwelt,<l eID="gen6105" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6106"/>we bowed ourselves low at his footstool.<l eID="gen6106" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:8
verses.text: “Arise, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and enter your resting-place,<l eID="gen6107" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6108"/>you and your mighty ark.<l eID="gen6108" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:9
verses.text: Let your priests wear a garment of righteousness,<l eID="gen6109" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6110"/>your faithful shout aloud for joy.<l eID="gen6110" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6111"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:10
verses.text: For the sake of David your servant,<l eID="gen6111" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6112"/>do not reject your Anointed.”<l eID="gen6112" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6102"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6113"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6114"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:11
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> swore an oath to David<l eID="gen6114" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6115"/>an oath that he will not break;<l eID="gen6115" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6116"/>“I will set on your throne<l eID="gen6116" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6117"/>a prince of your line.<l eID="gen6117" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:12
verses.text: If your sons keep my covenant<l eID="gen6118" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6119"/>and the statutes I teach them,<l eID="gen6119" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6120"/>then their sons, too, forever,<l eID="gen6120" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6121"/>will sit on your throne.”<l eID="gen6121" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:13
verses.text: For the choice of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is Zion;<l eID="gen6122" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6123"/>she is the home of his heart.<l eID="gen6123" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6113"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6124"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:14
verses.text: “This is forever my resting-place,<l eID="gen6125" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6126"/>this is the home of my heart.<l eID="gen6126" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6127"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:15
verses.text: I will royally bless her provision,<l eID="gen6127" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6128"/>and give bread to her poor in abundance.<l eID="gen6128" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:16
verses.text: Her priests I will clothe with salvation;<l eID="gen6129" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6130"/>her faithful will shout for joy.<l eID="gen6130" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:17
verses.text: There will I raise up for David<l eID="gen6131" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6132"/>a dynasty of power.<l eID="gen6132" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6133"/>I have set my anointed a lamp<l eID="gen6133" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6134"/>that shall never go out.<l eID="gen6134" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6135"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:18
verses.text: Robes of shame I will put on his foes,<l eID="gen6135" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6136"/>but on his head a glittering crown.”<l eID="gen6136" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6124"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.132"/> <div eID="gen6090" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv133"/><div sID="gen6137" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 133</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6138"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv133"/> Behold! How good and how pleasant<l eID="gen6139" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6140"/>is the dwelling of brothers together!<l eID="gen6140" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: Like precious oil on the head<l eID="gen6141" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6142"/>that ran down on the beard,<l eID="gen6142" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6143"/>the beard of Aaron, running<l eID="gen6143" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6144"/>over the collar of his robe:<l eID="gen6144" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: like the dew upon Hermon which falls<l eID="gen6145" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6146"/>on the mountains of Zion.<l eID="gen6146" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6147"/>For there has the <divineName>Lord</divineName> ordained blessing ---<l eID="gen6147" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6148"/>life that is endless.<l eID="gen6148" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6138"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.133"/> <div eID="gen6137" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv134"/><div sID="gen6149" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 134</title> <title type="psalm">A song of ascents.</title> <lg sID="gen6150"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv134"/> Attend! Bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6151" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6152"/>all you the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s servants,<l eID="gen6152" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6153"/>who stand by night<l eID="gen6153" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6154"/>in the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6154" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6155"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: Lift your hands to the holy place,<l eID="gen6155" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6156"/>bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6156" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6150"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6157"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6158"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> who made heaven and earth,<l eID="gen6158" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6159"/>bless you from Zion.<l eID="gen6159" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6157"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.134"/> <div eID="gen6149" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv135"/><div sID="gen6160" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 135</title> <lg sID="gen6161"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv135"/> Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6162" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6163"/>Praise the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6163" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6164"/>Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you his servants,<l eID="gen6164" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6165"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: who stand in the house of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6165" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6166"/>in the courts of the house of our God.<l eID="gen6166" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6167"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, for the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is good:<l eID="gen6167" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6168"/>‘Sing praise to his name it is pleasant.<l eID="gen6168" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6169"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> for himself chose Jacob,<l eID="gen6169" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6170"/>Israel as his own special treasure.<l eID="gen6170" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6161"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6171"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6172"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: For I know that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is great,<l eID="gen6172" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6173"/>that our <divineName>Lord</divineName> is above all gods.<l eID="gen6173" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6174"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: All that he wills he does<l eID="gen6174" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6175"/>in the heavens and on the earth,<l eID="gen6175" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6176"/>in the seas and in all the abysses.<l eID="gen6176" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6177"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: Clouds he brings up from the ends of the earth,<l eID="gen6177" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6178"/>lightnings he makes for the rain,<l eID="gen6178" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6179"/>wind he brings out of his storehouses.<l eID="gen6179" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6171"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6180"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6181"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: The first-born of Egypt he struck,<l eID="gen6181" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6182"/>both humans and animals.<l eID="gen6182" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6183"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: Signs and wonders he sent<l eID="gen6183" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6184"/>into your midst, O Egypt,<l eID="gen6184" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6185"/>upon Pharaoh and all his servants.<l eID="gen6185" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6186"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: Many nations he struck,<l eID="gen6186" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6187"/>mighty kings he slew<l eID="gen6187" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6188"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: Sihon, king of the Amorites,<l eID="gen6188" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6189"/>Og, king of Bashan,<l eID="gen6189" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6190"/>and all the kingdoms of Canaan.<l eID="gen6190" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6191"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: He gave their land for possession,<l eID="gen6191" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6192"/>possession to Israel his people.<l eID="gen6192" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6180"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6193"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6194"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: Your name, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, is forever;<l eID="gen6194" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6195"/>your memorial world without end.<l eID="gen6195" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6196"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> secures right for his people,<l eID="gen6196" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6197"/>and takes pity upon his servants.<l eID="gen6197" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6193"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6198"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6199"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: The idols of heathen are silver<l eID="gen6199" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6200"/>made by human hands.<l eID="gen6200" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6201"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak:<l eID="gen6201" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6202"/>they have eyes, but cannot see.<l eID="gen6202" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6203"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: They have ears, but cannot hear:<l eID="gen6203" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6204"/>there is no breath in their mouths.<l eID="gen6204" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6205"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: Their makers become like them,<l eID="gen6205" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6206"/>so do all who trust in them.<l eID="gen6206" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6198"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6207"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6208"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: House of Israel, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen6208" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6209"/>house of Araon, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6209" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6210"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: House of Levi, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen6210" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6211"/>you who fear the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, bless the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6211" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6212"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName> out of Zion,<l eID="gen6212" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6213"/>who lives in Jerusalem.<l eID="gen6213" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6214"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6214" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6207"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.135"/> <div eID="gen6160" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv136"/><div sID="gen6215" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 136</title> <lg sID="gen6216"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv136"/> Give thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> for his goodness:<l eID="gen6217" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6218"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6218" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6219"/>Give thanks to the God of gods:<l eID="gen6219" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6220"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6220" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6221"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords:<l eID="gen6221" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6222"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6222" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6216"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6223"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6224"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: To him who alone does great wonders:<l eID="gen6224" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6225"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6225" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6226"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: Whose wisdom created the heavens:<l eID="gen6226" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6227"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6227" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6228"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: Who spread forth the earth on the waters:<l eID="gen6228" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6229"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6229" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6230"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: Who made great lights:<l eID="gen6230" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6231"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6231" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6232"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: The sun to rule over the day:<l eID="gen6232" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6233"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6233" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6234"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: Moon and stars to rule over the night:<l eID="gen6234" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6235"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6235" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6223"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6236"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6237"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:10
verses.text: Who struck the first-born of Egypt:<l eID="gen6237" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6238"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6238" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6239"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:11
verses.text: And brought Israel out from their midst:<l eID="gen6239" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6240"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6240" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6241"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:12
verses.text: With strong hand and outstretched arm:<l eID="gen6241" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6242"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6242" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6243"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:13
verses.text: Who cut the Red Sea in pieces:<l eID="gen6243" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6244"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6244" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6245"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:14
verses.text: And brought Israel right through the midst:<l eID="gen6245" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6246"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6246" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6247"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:15
verses.text: And shook Pharaoh with all his host into the sea<l eID="gen6247" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6248"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6248" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6236"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6250"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:16
verses.text: Who led his people through the desert:<l eID="gen6250" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6251"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6251" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6252"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:17
verses.text: Who struck down great kings:<l eID="gen6252" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6253"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6253" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6254"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:18
verses.text: And slew noble kings:<l eID="gen6254" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6255"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6255" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6256"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:19
verses.text: Sihon, king of the Amorites:<l eID="gen6256" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6257"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6257" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6258"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:20
verses.text: And Og, king of Bashan:<l eID="gen6258" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6259"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6259" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6260"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:21
verses.text: Who gave their land for possession:<l eID="gen6260" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6261"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6261" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6262"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:22
verses.text: Possession to Israel his servant:<l eID="gen6262" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6263"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6263" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6249"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6264"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6265"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:23
verses.text: Who remembered our low estate:<l eID="gen6265" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6266"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6266" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6267"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:24
verses.text: And rescued us from our foes:<l eID="gen6267" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6268"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6268" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6269"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:25
verses.text: Who gives to all flesh food:<l eID="gen6269" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6270"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6270" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6271"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:26
verses.text: Give thanks to the God of heaven:<l eID="gen6271" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6272"/>for his kindness endures forever.<l eID="gen6272" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6264"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.136"/> <div eID="gen6215" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv137"/><div sID="gen6273" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 137</title> <lg sID="gen6274"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv137"/> By the waters of Babylon there we sat,<l eID="gen6275" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6276"/>and we wept at the thought of Zion.<l eID="gen6276" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6277"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: There on the poplars we hung our harps.<l eID="gen6277" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6278"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: For there our captors called for a song:<l eID="gen6278" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6279"/>our tormentors, rejoicing, saying:<l eID="gen6279" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6280"/>“Sing us one of the songs of Zion.”<l eID="gen6280" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6274"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6281"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6282"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: How can we sing the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s song<l eID="gen6282" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6283"/>in the foreigner’s land?<l eID="gen6283" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6284"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: If I forget you, Jerusalem,<l eID="gen6284" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6285"/>may my right hand wither.<l eID="gen6285" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6286"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: May my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth,<l eID="gen6286" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6287"/>if I am unmindful of you,<l eID="gen6287" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6288"/>or don’t set Jerusalem<l eID="gen6288" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6289"/>above my chief joy.<l eID="gen6289" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6281"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6290"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6291"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: Remember the Edomites, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6291" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6292"/>the day of Jerusalem’s fall,<l eID="gen6292" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6293"/>when they said, “Lay her bare, lay her bare,<l eID="gen6293" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6294"/>right down to her very foundation.”<l eID="gen6294" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6290"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6295"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6296"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: Babylon, despoiler,<l eID="gen6296" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6297"/>happy are they who pay you back<l eID="gen6297" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6298"/>for all you have done to us.<l eID="gen6298" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6299"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:9
verses.text: Happy be they who seize and dash<l eID="gen6299" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6300"/>your children against the rocks.<l eID="gen6300" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6295"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.137"/> <div eID="gen6273" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv138"/><div sID="gen6301" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 138</title> <title type="psalm">Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6302"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv138"/> I will thank you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, with all my heart:<l eID="gen6303" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6304"/>in the sight of the gods I will sing your praise.<l eID="gen6304" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6305"/>And, prostrate before your holy temple,<l eID="gen6305" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6306"/>will praise your name for your constant love.<l eID="gen6306" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6307"/>For you have exulted your promise above all.<l eID="gen6307" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6302"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6308"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6309"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: When I called you, you answered;<l eID="gen6309" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6310"/>you gave me strength, you inspired me.<l eID="gen6310" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6311"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6311" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6312"/>when they shall have heard the words you have uttered;<l eID="gen6312" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6313"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: and they shall sing of the ways of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6313" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6314"/>and tell of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>’s transcendent glory.<l eID="gen6314" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6315"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: For, high though the <divineName>Lord</divineName> is, he looks on the lowly,<l eID="gen6315" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6316"/>and strikes down the haughty from far away.<l eID="gen6316" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6308"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6317"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6318"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: Though my way be distressful, yet you preserve me:<l eID="gen6318" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6319"/>you lay your hand on my angry foes,<l eID="gen6319" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6320"/>and your right hand gives me victory.<l eID="gen6320" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6321"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> will accomplish all that which concerns me.<l eID="gen6321" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6322"/>Your kindness, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, endures forever.<l eID="gen6322" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6323"/>O do not abandon the work of your hands.<l eID="gen6323" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6317"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.138"/> <div eID="gen6301" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv139"/><div sID="gen6324" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 139</title> <title type="psalm">For the leader. Of David, a psalm.</title> <lg sID="gen6325"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv139"/> O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you search and know me;<l eID="gen6326" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6327"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: when I sit, when I rise you know it,<l eID="gen6327" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6328"/>you perceive my thoughts from afar.<l eID="gen6328" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6325"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6329"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6330"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: When I walk, when I lie you sift it,<l eID="gen6330" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6331"/>familiar with all my ways.<l eID="gen6331" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6332"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: There is not a word on my tongue,<l eID="gen6332" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6333"/>but see! <divineName>Lord</divineName>, you know it all.<l eID="gen6333" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6329"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6334"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6335"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: Behind and before you beset me,<l eID="gen6335" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6336"/>upon me you lay your hand.<l eID="gen6336" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6337"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: It’s too wonderful for me to know<l eID="gen6337" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6338"/>too lofty I cannot attain it.<l eID="gen6338" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6334"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6339"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6340"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: Whither shall I go from your spirit?<l eID="gen6340" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6341"/>Or whither shall I flee from your face?<l eID="gen6341" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6342"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: If I climb up to heaven, you are there:<l eID="gen6342" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6343"/>or make Sheol my bed, you are there.<l eID="gen6343" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6339"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6344"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6345"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: If I lift up the wings of the morning<l eID="gen6345" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6346"/>and fly to the end of the sea,<l eID="gen6346" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6347"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: there also your hand would grasp me,<l eID="gen6347" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6348"/>and your right hand take hold of me.<l eID="gen6348" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6344"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6349"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6350"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: If I say, “Let the darkness cover me,<l eID="gen6350" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6351"/>and night be the light about me,”<l eID="gen6351" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6352"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: The dark is not dark for you,<l eID="gen6352" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6353"/>but night is as light as the day.<l eID="gen6353" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6349"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6354"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6355"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: For you did put me together;<l eID="gen6355" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6356"/>in my mother’s womb you did weave me.<l eID="gen6356" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6357"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
verses.text: I give you praise for my fashioning<l eID="gen6357" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6358"/>so full of awe, so wonderful.<l eID="gen6358" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6359"/>Your works are wonderful.<l eID="gen6359" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6354"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6360"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6361"/>You knew me right well;<l eID="gen6361" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6362"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:15
verses.text: my bones were not hidden from you,<l eID="gen6362" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6363"/>when I was made in secret,<l eID="gen6363" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6364"/>and woven in the depths of the earth.<l eID="gen6364" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6360"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6365"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6366"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:16
verses.text: Your eyes saw all my days:<l eID="gen6366" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6367"/>they stood on your book every one<l eID="gen6367" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6368"/>written down, before they were fashioned,<l eID="gen6368" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6369"/>while none of them yet was mine.<l eID="gen6369" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6365"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6370"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6371"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:17
verses.text: But how far, O God, beyond measure<l eID="gen6371" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6372"/>are your thoughts! How mighty their sum!<l eID="gen6372" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6373"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:18
verses.text: Should I count, they are more than the sand.<l eID="gen6373" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6374"/>When I wake, I am still with you.<l eID="gen6374" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6370"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6375"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6376"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:19
verses.text: Will you slay the wicked, O God!<l eID="gen6376" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6377"/>And remove from me people of blood,<l eID="gen6377" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6378"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:20
verses.text: who maliciously defy you<l eID="gen6378" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6379"/>and take your name in vain.<l eID="gen6379" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6375"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6380"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6381"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:21
verses.text: Do I not hate those who hate you, <divineName>Lord</divineName>?<l eID="gen6381" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6382"/>Do I not loathe those who resist you?<l eID="gen6382" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6383"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:22
verses.text: With perfect hatred I hate them,<l eID="gen6383" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6384"/>I count them my enemies.<l eID="gen6384" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6380"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6385"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6386"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:23
verses.text: Search me, O God, know my heart:<l eID="gen6386" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6387"/>test me, and know my thoughts,<l eID="gen6387" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6388"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:24
verses.text: and see if guile be in me;<l eID="gen6388" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6389"/>and lead me in the way everlasting.<l eID="gen6389" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6385"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.139"/> <div eID="gen6324" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv140"/><div sID="gen6390" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 140</title> <lg sID="gen6391"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv140"/> Rescue me, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, from evil people;<l eID="gen6392" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6393"/>from people of violence guard me<l eID="gen6393" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6394"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:2
verses.text: from those who plot evil in their heart,<l eID="gen6394" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6395"/>and stir up war continually:<l eID="gen6395" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6396"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:3
verses.text: who make their tongue as sharp as a serpent’s,<l eID="gen6396" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6397"/>and under whose lips is the poison of adders. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen6397" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6391"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6398"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6399"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:4
verses.text: Preserve me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, from the hands of the wicked,<l eID="gen6399" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6400"/>from the violent guard me<l eID="gen6400" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6401"/>from those who are plotting to trip up my feet.<l eID="gen6401" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6402"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:5
verses.text: The proud have hidden a trap for me,<l eID="gen6402" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6403"/>cords they have spread as a net for my feet:<l eID="gen6403" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6404"/>snares they have set at the side of my track. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen6404" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6398"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6405"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6406"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:6
verses.text: I have said to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, “My God are you;<l eID="gen6406" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6407"/>give ear, <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to my loud plea.<l eID="gen6407" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6408"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:7
verses.text: O <divineName>Lord</divineName> my <divineName>Lord</divineName>, my Saviour mighty,<l eID="gen6408" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6409"/>you did cover my head in the day of battle.<l eID="gen6409" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6410"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:8
verses.text: Grant not, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, the desires of the wicked;<l eID="gen6410" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6411"/>and what they have purposed, promote you not.” <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen6411" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6405"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6412"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6413"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:9
verses.text: Let them not lift up their heads against me.<l eID="gen6413" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6414"/>May the mischief they prate bring themselves to destruction,<l eID="gen6414" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6415"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:10
verses.text: may he rain upon them coals of fire,<l eID="gen6415" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6416"/>may he strike them down swiftly, to rise no more,<l eID="gen6416" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6417"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:11
verses.text: no place in the land may there be for the slanderer:<l eID="gen6417" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6418"/>may the violent be hunted from sorrow to sorrow.<l eID="gen6418" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6412"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6419"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6420"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:12
verses.text: I know that the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will do right by the weak,<l eID="gen6420" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6421"/>and will execute justice for those who are needy.<l eID="gen6421" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6422"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:13
verses.text: Surely the righteous shall praise your name,<l eID="gen6422" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6423"/>and they who are upright shall live in your presence.<l eID="gen6423" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6419"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.140"/> <div eID="gen6390" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv141"/><div sID="gen6424" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 141</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6425"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv141"/> <divineName>Lord</divineName>, I call to you: hasten, to me,<l eID="gen6426" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6427"/>give ear to my voice, when I call to you.<l eID="gen6427" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6428"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:2
verses.text: Let my prayer be presented as incense before you,<l eID="gen6428" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6429"/>and my uplifted hands as the evening meal-offering.<l eID="gen6429" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6425"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6430"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6431"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:3
verses.text: Set, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, a watch on my mouth,<l eID="gen6431" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6432"/>put a guard on the door of my lips.<l eID="gen6432" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6433"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:4
verses.text: Incline not my heart to an evil matter,<l eID="gen6433" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6434"/>to busy myself in deeds of wickedness,<l eID="gen6434" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6435"/>in company with workers of evil:<l eID="gen6435" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6436"/>never may I partake of their dainties.<l eID="gen6436" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6430"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6437"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6438"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:5
verses.text: A wound or reproof from a good person in kindness<l eID="gen6438" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6439"/>is oil which my head shall never refuse.<l eID="gen6439" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6440"/>In their misfortune my prayer is still with them.<l eID="gen6440" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6437"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6441"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6442"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:6
verses.text: Abandoned they are to the hands of their judges:<l eID="gen6442" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6443"/>they shall learn that my words are true.<l eID="gen6443" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6441"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6444"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6445"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:7
verses.text: Like stones on a country road cleft and broken<l eID="gen6445" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6446"/>so lie our bones scattered for Death to devour.<l eID="gen6446" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6447"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:8
verses.text: But my eyes are turned towards you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6447" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6448"/>Do not pour out my life, for in you I take refuge.<l eID="gen6448" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6449"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:9
verses.text: Keep me safe from the trap they have laid for me,<l eID="gen6449" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6450"/>from the snares of the workers of trouble.<l eID="gen6450" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6451"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:10
verses.text: Into their own nets let wicked people fall;<l eID="gen6451" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6452"/>while I pass by in safety.<l eID="gen6452" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6444"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.141"/> <div eID="gen6424" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv142"/><div sID="gen6453" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 142</title> <title type="psalm">A maskil of David, while he was in the cave, a prayer.</title> <lg sID="gen6454"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv142"/> Loudly I cry to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen6455" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6456"/>to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> plead loudly for mercy,<l eID="gen6456" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6457"/>I pour my complaint before him,<l eID="gen6457" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6458"/>I tell my troubles to him.<l eID="gen6458" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6454"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6459"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6460"/>When my spirit is faint within me,<l eID="gen6460" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6461"/>my path is known to you.<l eID="gen6461" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6462"/>In the way I am wont to walk in,<l eID="gen6462" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6463"/>they have hidden a trap for me.<l eID="gen6463" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6459"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6464"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6465"/>I look to the right and the left;<l eID="gen6465" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6466"/>but not a friend have I.<l eID="gen6466" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6467"/>No place of refuge is left me,<l eID="gen6467" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6468"/>not a man to care for me.<l eID="gen6468" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6464"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6469"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6470"/>So I cry to you, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>:<l eID="gen6470" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6471"/>I say, “My refuge are you,<l eID="gen6471" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6472"/>all I have in the land of the living.”<l eID="gen6472" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6469"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6473"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6474"/>Attend to my piercing cry,<l eID="gen6474" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6475"/>for very weak am I.<l eID="gen6475" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6476"/>Save me from those who pursue me,<l eID="gen6476" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6477"/>for they are too strong for me.<l eID="gen6477" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6473"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6478"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6479"/>Free me from prison,<l eID="gen6479" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6480"/>that I may give thanks to your name,<l eID="gen6480" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6481"/>for the righteous are patiently waiting<l eID="gen6481" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6482"/>till you show your bounty to me.<l eID="gen6482" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6478"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.142"/> <div eID="gen6453" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv143"/><div sID="gen6483" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 143</title> <title type="psalm">A psalm of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6484"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv143"/> Listen, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, to my prayer;<l eID="gen6485" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6486"/>give ear to my plea.<l eID="gen6486" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6487"/>In your faithfulness give me answer,<l eID="gen6487" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6488"/>and in your righteousness.<l eID="gen6488" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6489"/>With your servant O enter you not into judgment,<l eID="gen6489" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6490"/>for in your sight can no one alive be justified.<l eID="gen6490" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6484"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6491"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6492"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: For the enemy persecutes me,<l eID="gen6492" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6493"/>crushing my life to the ground,<l eID="gen6493" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6494"/>making me live in the darkness,<l eID="gen6494" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6495"/>as those who have long been dead.<l eID="gen6495" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6496"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: My spirit is faint within me,<l eID="gen6496" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6497"/>my heart is bewildered within me.<l eID="gen6497" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6491"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6498"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6499"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: I remember the days of old,<l eID="gen6499" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6500"/>and brood over all you have done,<l eID="gen6500" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6501"/>musing on all that your hands have wrought.<l eID="gen6501" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6502"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: I spread out my hands to you:<l eID="gen6502" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6503"/>I thirst for you,<l eID="gen6503" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6504"/>like parched earth. <hi type="italic">(Selah)</hi><l eID="gen6504" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6498"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6505"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6506"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: Answer me soon, <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6506" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6507"/>because my spirit is spent.<l eID="gen6507" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6508"/>Hide not your face from me,<l eID="gen6508" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6509"/>else become I like those who go down to the pit.<l eID="gen6509" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6510"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: Let me learn of your love in the morning,<l eID="gen6510" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6511"/>for my trust is in you.<l eID="gen6511" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6512"/>Teach me the way I should go:<l eID="gen6512" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6513"/>for my heart longs for you.<l eID="gen6513" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6505"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6514"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6515"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: Save me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, from my foes:<l eID="gen6515" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6516"/>for to you I have fled for refuge.<l eID="gen6516" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6517"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: Teach me to do your will,<l eID="gen6517" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6518"/>for you yourself are my God.<l eID="gen6518" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6519"/>Guide me by your good spirit,<l eID="gen6519" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6520"/>O <divineName>Lord</divineName>, on a way that is smooth.<l eID="gen6520" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6514"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6521"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6522"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: Be true to your name <divineName>Lord</divineName>, spare me,<l eID="gen6522" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6523"/>bring me out of distress in your faithfulness.<l eID="gen6523" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6524"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: In your kindness extinguish my enemies,<l eID="gen6524" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6525"/>and all those who vex me destroy;<l eID="gen6525" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6526"/>for I am your servant.<l eID="gen6526" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6521"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.143"/> <div eID="gen6483" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv144"/><div sID="gen6527" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 144</title> <title type="psalm">Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6528"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv144"/> Blest be the <divineName>Lord</divineName> my rock,<l eID="gen6529" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6530"/>who trains my hands for war,<l eID="gen6530" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6531"/>my fingers for fighting.<l eID="gen6531" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6532"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:2
verses.text: My rock and my fortress,<l eID="gen6532" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6533"/>my tower, my deliverer,<l eID="gen6533" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6534"/>my shield, behind whom I take refuge,<l eID="gen6534" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6535"/>who lays nations low at my feet.<l eID="gen6535" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6528"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6536"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6537"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:3
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, what are mortals<l eID="gen6537" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6538"/>that you care for them,<l eID="gen6538" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6539"/>humans,<l eID="gen6539" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6540"/>that you think of them?<l eID="gen6540" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6541"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:4
verses.text: They are like a breath,<l eID="gen6541" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6542"/>their days as a shadow that passes.<l eID="gen6542" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6536"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6543"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6544"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:5
verses.text: <divineName>Lord</divineName>, bow your heavens and come down:<l eID="gen6544" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6545"/>touch the hills, so that they smoke.<l eID="gen6545" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6546"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:6
verses.text: Flash forth lightning and scatter them,<l eID="gen6546" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6547"/>your arrows send forth and confound them.<l eID="gen6547" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6543"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6548"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6549"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:7
verses.text: Stretch out your hand from on high;<l eID="gen6549" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6550"/>pluck me out of the mighty waters,<l eID="gen6550" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6551"/>out of the hands of foreigners,<l eID="gen6551" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6552"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:8
verses.text: who speak with the mouth of falsehood,<l eID="gen6552" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6553"/>and lift their right hand to swear lies.<l eID="gen6553" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6548"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6554"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6555"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:9
verses.text: O God, a new song I would sing you,<l eID="gen6555" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6556"/>on a ten-stringed harp make you music.<l eID="gen6556" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6557"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:10
verses.text: For to kings you give the victory,<l eID="gen6557" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6558"/>and David your servant you save.<l eID="gen6558" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6559"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:11
verses.text: Snatch me from the cruel sword,<l eID="gen6559" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6560"/>rescue me from the hand of foreigners,<l eID="gen6560" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6561"/>who speak with the mouth of falsehood,<l eID="gen6561" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6562"/>and lift their right hand to swear lies.<l eID="gen6562" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6563"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:12
verses.text: May our sons in their youth<l eID="gen6563" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6564"/>be as plants well tended:<l eID="gen6564" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6565"/>our daughters like cornices<l eID="gen6565" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6566"/>carved as in palaces.<l eID="gen6566" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6554"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6567"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6568"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:13
verses.text: May our barns be bursting<l eID="gen6568" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6569"/>with produce of all kinds.<l eID="gen6569" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6570"/>In the fields may our sheep bear<l eID="gen6570" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6571"/>by thousands and ten thousands.<l eID="gen6571" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6567"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6572"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6573"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:14
verses.text: May our cattle be fat,<l eID="gen6573" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6574"/>our walls unbreached,<l eID="gen6574" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6575"/>may no cry of distress<l eID="gen6575" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6576"/>ring in our streets.<l eID="gen6576" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6572"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6577"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6578"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:15
verses.text: Happy the people<l eID="gen6578" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6579"/>who fares so well:<l eID="gen6579" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6580"/> and so fares the people<l eID="gen6580" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6581"/>whose God is the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6581" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6577"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.144"/> <div eID="gen6527" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv145"/><div sID="gen6582" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 145</title> <title type="psalm">A song of praise. Of David.</title> <lg sID="gen6583"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv145"/> I will exalt you, my God, O king:<l eID="gen6584" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6585"/>I will bless your name for ever and ever.<l eID="gen6585" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6586"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:2
verses.text: I will bless you every day:<l eID="gen6586" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6587"/>I will praise your name for ever and ever.<l eID="gen6587" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6583"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6588"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6589"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:3
verses.text: Great is the <divineName>Lord</divineName> and worthy all praise,<l eID="gen6589" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6590"/>his greatness is unsearchable.<l eID="gen6590" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6591"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:4
verses.text: One age to another shall praise your deeds,<l eID="gen6591" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6592"/>declaring the mighty things you have done.<l eID="gen6592" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6588"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6593"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6594"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:5
verses.text: Of your glorious majesty they shall tell,<l eID="gen6594" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6595"/>and I will muse of your many wonders.<l eID="gen6595" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6596"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:6
verses.text: Of the might of your terrible acts they shall speak,<l eID="gen6596" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6597"/>and the tale of your great deeds I will tell.<l eID="gen6597" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6593"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6598"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6599"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:7
verses.text: The fame of your abundant goodness<l eID="gen6599" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6600"/>and righteousness they shall pour forth in song.<l eID="gen6600" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6601"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:8
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is full of grace and pity,<l eID="gen6601" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6602"/>patient and rich in loving-kindness.<l eID="gen6602" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6598"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6603"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6604"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:9
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is good to all the world,<l eID="gen6604" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6605"/>and his pity is over all things that he made.<l eID="gen6605" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6606"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:10
verses.text: All your works give you thanks, O <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6606" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6607"/>and you are blessed of those who love you.<l eID="gen6607" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6603"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6608"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6609"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:11
verses.text: They shall speak of your glorious kingdom,<l eID="gen6609" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6610"/>and of your might shall they discourse,<l eID="gen6610" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6611"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:12
verses.text: making known to people his mighty acts,<l eID="gen6611" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6612"/>and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.<l eID="gen6612" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6608"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6613"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6614"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:13
verses.text: Yours is a kingdom that lives through all ages:<l eID="gen6614" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6615"/>through all generations extends your dominion.<l eID="gen6615" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6616"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is faithful in all that he promises,<l eID="gen6616" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6617"/>gracious is he in all that he does.<l eID="gen6617" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6613"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6618"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6619"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:14
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> upholds all who fall;<l eID="gen6619" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6620"/>he lifts up all who are bowed down.<l eID="gen6620" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6621"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:15
verses.text: The eyes of all look in hope to you,<l eID="gen6621" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6622"/>and you give them their food in due season.<l eID="gen6622" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6618"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6623"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6624"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:16
verses.text: You yourself open your hand,<l eID="gen6624" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6625"/>and fill with your favour all things that live.<l eID="gen6625" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6626"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:17
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is righteous in all his ways,<l eID="gen6626" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6627"/>gracious is he in all that he does.<l eID="gen6627" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6623"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6628"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6629"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:18
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is near to all who call him,<l eID="gen6629" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6630"/>to all who call upon him in truth.<l eID="gen6630" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6631"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:19
verses.text: He will fulfil the desires of those who fear him;<l eID="gen6631" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6632"/>he will hear their cry for help and save them.<l eID="gen6632" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6628"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6633"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6634"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:20
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> is the keeper of all who love him,<l eID="gen6634" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6635"/>but all the wicked will he destroy.<l eID="gen6635" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6636"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:21
verses.text: My mouth will utter the praise of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6636" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6637"/>and all life will bless his holy name<l eID="gen6637" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6638"/>for ever and ever.<l eID="gen6638" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6633"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.145"/> <div eID="gen6582" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv146"/><div sID="gen6639" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 146</title> <lg sID="gen6640"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv146"/> My soul, praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6641" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6642"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:2
verses.text: I will praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, while I live;<l eID="gen6642" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6643"/>I will sing to my God, while I am.<l eID="gen6643" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6640"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6644"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6645"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:3
verses.text: Put not your trust in princes<l eID="gen6645" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6646"/>mortals, in whom is no help.<l eID="gen6646" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6647"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:4
verses.text: When their breath goes out,<l eID="gen6647" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6648"/>they go back to the dust:<l eID="gen6648" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6649"/>on that very day<l eID="gen6649" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6650"/>their purposes perish.<l eID="gen6650" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6651"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:5
verses.text: Happy those whose help<l eID="gen6651" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6652"/>is the God of Jacob:<l eID="gen6652" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6653"/>whose hope is set<l eID="gen6653" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6654"/>on the <divineName>Lord</divineName> their God,<l eID="gen6654" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6655"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:6
verses.text: the Creator of heaven and earth,<l eID="gen6655" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6656"/>the sea, and all that is in them.<l eID="gen6656" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6644"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6657"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6658"/>He remains eternally loyal.<l eID="gen6658" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6659"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:7
verses.text: For the wronged he executes justice;<l eID="gen6659" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6660"/>he gives bread to the hungry;<l eID="gen6660" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6661"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> releases the prisoners.<l eID="gen6661" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6662"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:8
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> gives sight to the blind:<l eID="gen6662" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6663"/>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> raises those who are bowed.<l eID="gen6663" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6664"/>The <divineName>Lord</divineName> loves the righteous.<l eID="gen6664" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6665"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:9
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> preserves the stranger,<l eID="gen6665" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6666"/>upholds the widow and orphan,<l eID="gen6666" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6667"/>but the wicked he leads to disaster.<l eID="gen6667" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6657"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6668"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6669"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:10
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> shall reign forever,<l eID="gen6669" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6670"/>your God, O Zion, to all generations.<l eID="gen6670" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6671"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6671" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6668"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.146"/> <div eID="gen6639" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv147"/><div sID="gen6672" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 147</title> <lg sID="gen6673"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv147"/> Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6674" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6675"/>It is good to sing praise to our God,<l eID="gen6675" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6676"/>for praise is sweet and seemly.<l eID="gen6676" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6677"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:2
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> builds up Jerusalem,<l eID="gen6677" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6678"/>the outcasts of Israel he gathers.<l eID="gen6678" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6679"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:3
verses.text: He heals the broken in heart,<l eID="gen6679" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6680"/>and binds up their wounds.<l eID="gen6680" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6681"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:4
verses.text: He counts the numberless stars,<l eID="gen6681" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6682"/>he gives names to them all.<l eID="gen6682" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6683"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:5
verses.text: Great is our <divineName>Lord</divineName>, rich in power,<l eID="gen6683" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6684"/>and measureless is his wisdom.<l eID="gen6684" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6685"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:6
verses.text: The <divineName>Lord</divineName> lifts up the down-trodden,<l eID="gen6685" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6686"/>the wicked he brings to the ground.<l eID="gen6686" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6673"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6687"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6688"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:7
verses.text: Sing songs of thanks to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6688" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6689"/>and play on the lyre to our God.<l eID="gen6689" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6690"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:8
verses.text: For he covers the sky with clouds,<l eID="gen6690" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6691"/>he prepares rain for the earth,<l eID="gen6691" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6692"/>makes grass to grow on the mountains.<l eID="gen6692" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6693"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:9
verses.text: He gives the cattle their food<l eID="gen6693" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6694"/>the young ravens when they cry.<l eID="gen6694" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6695"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:10
verses.text: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse,<l eID="gen6695" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6696"/>his joy is not in the speed of a runner;<l eID="gen6696" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6697"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:11
verses.text: but the <divineName>Lord</divineName> has his pleasure in those who fear him,<l eID="gen6697" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6698"/>in those who wait for his kindness.<l eID="gen6698" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6687"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6699"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6700"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:12
verses.text: Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, then, O Jerusalem:<l eID="gen6700" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6701"/>sing praise to your God, O Zion.<l eID="gen6701" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6702"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:13
verses.text: For he strengthens the bars of your gates,<l eID="gen6702" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6703"/>and blesses your children within you.<l eID="gen6703" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6704"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:14
verses.text: He brings peace to your borders,<l eID="gen6704" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6705"/>and choicest of wheat in abundance.<l eID="gen6705" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6706"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:15
verses.text: He sends his command to the earth:<l eID="gen6706" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6707"/>his word runs very swiftly.<l eID="gen6707" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6708"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:16
verses.text: Snow he gives like wool,<l eID="gen6708" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6709"/>frost he scatters like ashes.<l eID="gen6709" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6710"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:17
verses.text: He casts forth his ice like morsels:<l eID="gen6710" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6711"/>who can stand before his cold?<l eID="gen6711" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6712"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:18
verses.text: He sends forth his word, and melts them:<l eID="gen6712" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6713"/>his wind blows the waters flow.<l eID="gen6713" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6699"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6714"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6715"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:19
verses.text: He declares his word to Jacob,<l eID="gen6715" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6716"/>his statutes and judgments to Israel.<l eID="gen6716" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6717"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:20
verses.text: No other nation did he do this for,<l eID="gen6717" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6718"/>they know nothing of his judgments.<l eID="gen6718" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6719"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6719" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6714"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.147"/> <div eID="gen6672" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv148"/><div sID="gen6720" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 148</title> <lg sID="gen6721"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv148"/> Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName> from the heavens,<l eID="gen6722" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6723"/>praise him in the heights.<l eID="gen6723" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6724"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: Praise him, all his angels;<l eID="gen6724" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6725"/>praise him, all his hosts.<l eID="gen6725" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6721"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6726"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6727"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: Praise him, sun and moon;<l eID="gen6727" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6728"/>praise him, all stars of light.<l eID="gen6728" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6729"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: Praise him, you highest heavens,<l eID="gen6729" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6730"/>and you waters above the heavens.<l eID="gen6730" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6726"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6731"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6732"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: Let them praise the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6732" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6733"/>for at his command they were made.<l eID="gen6733" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6734"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: And he fixed them for ever and ever<l eID="gen6734" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6735"/>by a law which they dare not transgress.<l eID="gen6735" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6731"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6736"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6737"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: Praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName> from the earth:<l eID="gen6737" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6738"/>you depths, with your monsters, all.<l eID="gen6738" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6739"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: Fire, hail, snow and ice,<l eID="gen6739" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6740"/>and stormy wind doing his word.<l eID="gen6740" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6736"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6741"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6742"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: All you mountains and hills,<l eID="gen6742" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6743"/>all you fruit trees and cedars,<l eID="gen6743" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6744"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: all you wild beasts and tame,<l eID="gen6744" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6745"/>creeping things, birds on the wing.<l eID="gen6745" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6741"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6746"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6747"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: All you kings and nations of earth;<l eID="gen6747" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6748"/>all you princes and judges of earth:<l eID="gen6748" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6749"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: young men and maidens together,<l eID="gen6749" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6750"/>old men and children together.<l eID="gen6750" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6746"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6751"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6752"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: Let them praise the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>,<l eID="gen6752" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6753"/>for his name alone is exalted.<l eID="gen6753" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6754"/>Over heaven and earth is his glory.<l eID="gen6754" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6755"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
