verses.text: He has lifted his people to honour.<l eID="gen6755" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6756"/>Wherefore this chorus of praise from his saints,<l eID="gen6756" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6757"/>from Israel, the people who stand in his fellowship.<l eID="gen6757" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6758"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6758" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6751"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.148"/> <div eID="gen6720" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv149"/><div sID="gen6759" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 149</title> <lg sID="gen6760"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv149"/> Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6761" level="3"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6762"/>Sing to the <divineName>Lord</divineName> a new song,<l eID="gen6762" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6763"/>sound his praise where the faithful are gathered.<l eID="gen6763" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6764"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:2
verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in its maker,<l eID="gen6764" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6765"/>sons of Zion exult in their king.<l eID="gen6765" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6766"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:3
verses.text: Let them praise his name in the dance,<l eID="gen6766" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6767"/>making music with lyre and with timbrel.<l eID="gen6767" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6768"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:4
verses.text: For the <divineName>Lord</divineName> delights in his people,<l eID="gen6768" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6769"/>adorning the humble with victory.<l eID="gen6769" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6760"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6770"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6771"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:5
verses.text: Let the faithful exult and extol him<l eID="gen6771" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6772"/>with glad ringing cries all night long.<l eID="gen6772" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6773"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:6
verses.text: High praises of God in their mouth,<l eID="gen6773" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6774"/>and a two-edged sword in their hand:<l eID="gen6774" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6775"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:7
verses.text: on the heathen to execute vengeance,<l eID="gen6775" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6776"/>and chastisement sore on the nations,<l eID="gen6776" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6777"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:8
verses.text: binding their kings with chains,<l eID="gen6777" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6778"/>and their nobles with fetters of iron,<l eID="gen6778" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6779"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:9
verses.text: to execute on them the doom that is written.<l eID="gen6779" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6770"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6780"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6781"/>This is the glory of all his faithful.<l eID="gen6781" level="2"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6782"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6782" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6780"/>  <chapter eID="Ps.149"/> <div eID="gen6759" type="section"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv150"/><div sID="gen6783" type="section"/> <title>Psalm 150</title> <lg sID="gen6784"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv150"/> Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6786"/>Praise God in his holy place.<l eID="gen6786" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6787"/>Praise him in the sky, his stronghold.<l eID="gen6787" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6788"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:2
verses.text: Praise him for his deeds of power.<l eID="gen6788" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6789"/>Praise him for his boundless greatness.<l eID="gen6789" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6784"/> <lb/> <lg sID="gen6790"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6791"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:3
verses.text: Praise him with blast of horn;<l eID="gen6791" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6792"/>praise him with harp and lyre.<l eID="gen6792" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6793"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:4
verses.text: Praise him with timbrel and dance;<l eID="gen6793" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6794"/>praise him with strings and pipe.<l eID="gen6794" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6795"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:5
verses.text: Praise him with resounding cymbals,<l eID="gen6795" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6796"/>praise him with clashing cymbals.<l eID="gen6796" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6797"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:6
verses.text: Let all that has breath praise the <divineName>Lord</divineName>.<l eID="gen6797" level="1"/> <l level="3" sID="gen6798"/>Hallelujah.<l eID="gen6798" level="3"/> <lg eID="gen6790"/>  <div eID="gen6783" type="section"/> <div eID="gen4953" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Ps.150"/> <div eID="gen1" osisID="Ps" type="book"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:1
verses.text: A genealogy of Jesus Christ, a descendant of David and Abraham.

verses.name: Matthew 1:2
verses.text: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac of Jacob, Jacob of Judah and his brothers,

verses.name: Matthew 1:3
verses.text: Judah of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez of Hezron, Hezron of Ram,

verses.name: Matthew 1:4
verses.text: Ram of Amminadab, Amminadab of Nashon, Nashon of Salmon,

verses.name: Matthew 1:5
verses.text: Salmon of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed of Jesse,

verses.name: Matthew 1:6
verses.text: Jesse of David the King. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother was Uriah’s widow,

verses.name: Matthew 1:7
verses.text: Solomon of Rehoboam, Rehoboam of Abijah, Abijah of Asa,

verses.name: Matthew 1:8
verses.text: Asa of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat of Jehoram, Jehoram of Uzziah,

verses.name: Matthew 1:9
verses.text: Uzziah of Jotham, Jotham of Ahaz, Ahaz of Hezekiah,

verses.name: Matthew 1:10
verses.text: Hezekiah of Manasseh, Manasseh of Ammon, Ammon of Josiah,

verses.name: Matthew 1:11
verses.text: Josiah of Jeconiah and his brothers, at the time of the Exile to Babylon.

verses.name: Matthew 1:12
verses.text: After the Exile to Babylon — Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel of Zerubbabel,

verses.name: Matthew 1:13
verses.text: Zerubbabel of Abiud, Abiud of Eliakim, Eliakim of Azor,

verses.name: Matthew 1:14
verses.text: Azor of Zadok, Zadok of Achim, Achim of Eliud,

verses.name: Matthew 1:15
verses.text: Eliud of Eleazar, Eleazar of Matthan, Matthan of Jacob,

verses.name: Matthew 1:16
verses.text: Jacob of Joseph, the husband of Mary, who was the mother of Jesus, who is called ‘Christ’.

verses.name: Matthew 1:17
verses.text: So the whole number of generations from Abraham to David is fourteen; from David to the Exile to Babylon fourteen; and from the Exile to Babylon to the Christ fourteen.

verses.name: Matthew 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv151"/><div sID="gen6801" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv151"/> This is how Jesus Christ was born: <div sID="gen6802" type="paragraph"/> His mother Mary was engaged to Joseph, but, before the marriage took place, she found herself to be pregnant by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.name: Matthew 1:19
verses.text: Her husband, Joseph, was a religious man and, since he did not want to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to put an end to their engagement privately.

verses.name: Matthew 1:20
verses.text: He had been thinking this over, when an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream. <div eID="gen6802" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6803" type="paragraph"/> “Joseph, son of David,” the angel said, “do not be afraid to take Mary for your wife, for her child has been conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.name: Matthew 1:21
verses.text: She will give birth to a son; name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.”  <div eID="gen6803" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv152"/><div sID="gen6804" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv152"/> All this happened in fulfillment of these words of the Lord in the prophet, where he says — <lg sID="gen6805"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6806"/>

verses.name: Matthew 1:23
verses.text: ‘The virgin will conceive and will give birth to a son, and they will give him the name Immanuel’<l eID="gen6806" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6805"/> — a word which means ‘God is with us.’

verses.name: Matthew 1:24
verses.text: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had directed him.

verses.name: Matthew 1:25
verses.text: He made Mary his wife, but they did not sleep together until after the birth of her son; and to this son he gave the name Jesus.  <div eID="gen6804" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.1"/> <div eID="gen6801" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv153"/><div sID="gen6807" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv153"/> After the birth of Jesus at Bethlehem in Judea, in the reign of King Herod, some astrologers from the East arrived in Jerusalem, asking:

verses.name: Matthew 2:2
verses.text: “Where is the newborn king of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

verses.name: Matthew 2:3
verses.text: When King Herod heard of this, he was much troubled, and so, too, was all Jerusalem.

verses.name: Matthew 2:4
verses.text: He called together all the chief priests and teachers of the law in the nation, and questioned them as to where the Christ was to be born.

verses.name: Matthew 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv154"/><div sID="gen6808" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv154"/> “At Bethlehem in Judea,” was their answer; “for it is said in the prophet — <lg sID="gen6809"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6810"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:6
verses.text: ‘And you, Bethlehem in Judah’s land,<l eID="gen6810" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6811"/>are in no way least among the chief cities of Judah;<l eID="gen6811" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6812"/>for out of you will come a ruler —<l eID="gen6812" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6813"/>who will shepherd my people Israel.’”<l eID="gen6813" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6809"/>  <div eID="gen6808" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv155"/><div sID="gen6814" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv155"/> Then Herod secretly sent for the astrologers, and found out from them the date of the appearance of the star;

verses.name: Matthew 2:8
verses.text: and, sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and make careful inquiries about the child, and, as soon as you have found him, bring me word so that I, too, can go and worship him.”

verses.name: Matthew 2:9
verses.text: The astrologers heard what the king had to say, and then continued their journey. The star which they had seen in the east led them on, until it reached, and stood over, the place where the child was.

verses.name: Matthew 2:10
verses.text: At the sight of the star they were filled with joy.

verses.name: Matthew 2:11
verses.text: Entering the house, they saw the child with his mother, Mary, and fell at his feet and worshipped him. Then they opened their treasure chests, and offered to the child presents of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

verses.name: Matthew 2:12
verses.text: But afterwards, having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their own country by another road.  <div eID="gen6814" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv156"/><div sID="gen6815" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv156"/> After they had left, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, and said: <div eID="gen6815" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6816" type="paragraph"/> “Get up, take the child and his mother, and seek refuge in Egypt; and stay there until I tell you to return, for Herod is about to search for the child, to put him to death.”

verses.name: Matthew 2:14
verses.text: Joseph woke up, and taking the child and his mother by night, went into Egypt,

verses.name: Matthew 2:15
verses.text: and there he stayed until Herod’s death; in fulfillment of these words of the Lord in the prophet, where he says — <lg sID="gen6817"/> <l sID="gen6818"/>‘Out of Egypt I called my Son.’<l eID="gen6818"/> <lg eID="gen6817"/>  <div eID="gen6816" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv157"/><div sID="gen6819" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv157"/> When Herod found out that the astrologers had tricked him, he flew into a rage. He sent and put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and the whole of that neighborhood, who were two years old or under, guided by the date which he had learned from the astrologers.

verses.name: Matthew 2:17
verses.text: Then were fulfilled these words spoken in the prophet Jeremiah, where he says — <lg sID="gen6820"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6821"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:18
verses.text: ‘A voice was heard in Ramah,<l eID="gen6821" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6822"/>weeping and mourning loudly;<l eID="gen6822" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6823"/>Rachel, weeping for her children,<l eID="gen6823" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6824"/>refusing all comfort for they were dead.’<l eID="gen6824" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6820"/>  <div eID="gen6819" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv158"/><div sID="gen6825" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv158"/> But, on the death of Herod, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, and said:

verses.name: Matthew 2:20
verses.text: “Get up, take the child and his mother, and go into the Land of Israel, for those who sought to take the child’s life are dead.”

verses.name: Matthew 2:21
verses.text: He woke up, and taking the child and his mother, went into the Land of Israel.

verses.name: Matthew 2:22
verses.text: But, hearing that Archelaus had succeeded his father Herod as king of Judea, he was afraid to go back there; and having been warned in a dream, he went into the part of the country called Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 2:23
verses.text: There he settled in the town of Nazareth, in fulfillment of these words in the prophets — ‘He will be called a Nazarene.’  <div eID="gen6825" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6807" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Matt.2"/> <div eID="gen6800" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:1
verses.text: About that time John the Baptist first appeared, proclaiming in the wilderness of Judea:

verses.name: Matthew 3:2
verses.text: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.”

verses.name: Matthew 3:3
verses.text: John was the one who was spoken of in the prophet Isaiah, where he says — <lg sID="gen6827"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6828"/>‘The voice of one crying aloud in the wilderness:<l eID="gen6828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6829"/>“Make ready the way of the Lord,<l eID="gen6829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6830"/>make his paths straight.”’<l eID="gen6830" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6827"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv159"/><div sID="gen6831" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv159"/> John’s clothes were made of camels’ hair, with a leather strap around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

verses.name: Matthew 3:5
verses.text: At that time Jerusalem, and all Judea, as well as the whole district of the Jordan, went out to him

verses.name: Matthew 3:6
verses.text: and were baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.  <div eID="gen6831" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv160"/><div sID="gen6832" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv160"/> But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to receive his baptism, he said to them: <div eID="gen6832" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6833" type="paragraph"/> “You children of snakes! Who has prompted you to seek refuge from the coming judgment?

verses.name: Matthew 3:8
verses.text: Let your life, then, prove your repentance;

verses.name: Matthew 3:9
verses.text: and do not think that you can say among yourselves ‘Abraham is our ancestor,’ for I tell you that out of these stones God is able to raise descendants for Abraham!

verses.name: Matthew 3:10
verses.text: Already the axe is lying at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that fails to bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.name: Matthew 3:11
verses.text: I, indeed, baptize you with water to teach repentance; but he who is coming after me is more powerful than I, and I am not fit even to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

verses.name: Matthew 3:12
verses.text: His winnowing-fan is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing-floor, and store his grain in the barn, but the chaff he will burn with a fire that cannot be put out.”  <div eID="gen6833" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv161"/><div sID="gen6834" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv161"/> Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.

verses.name: Matthew 3:14
verses.text: But John tried to prevent him. <div eID="gen6834" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen6835" type="paragraph"/> “I need to be baptized by you,” he said, “so why have you come to me?”  <div eID="gen6835" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv162"/><div sID="gen6836" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv162"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“This is the way it should be for now,” </q>Jesus answered, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“because we should do everything that God requires.” </q>So John agreed.  <div eID="gen6836" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv163"/><div sID="gen6837" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv163"/> After the baptism of Jesus, and just as he came up from the water, the heavens opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and resting on him,

verses.name: Matthew 3:17
verses.text: and from the heavens there came a voice which said: “This is my dearly loved son, who brings me great joy.”  <div eID="gen6837" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.3"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv164"/><div sID="gen6838" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv164"/> Then Jesus was led up into the wilderness by the Spirit to be tempted by the devil.

verses.name: Matthew 4:2
verses.text: And, after he had fasted for forty days and forty nights, he became hungry.

verses.name: Matthew 4:3
verses.text: The Tempter came to him, and said: <lg sID="gen6839"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6840"/>“If you are God’s Son, tell these stones to become loaves of bread.”<l eID="gen6840" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6839"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:4
verses.text: But Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Scripture says — <lg sID="gen6841"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6842"/>‘It is not on bread alone that a person is to live, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’” </q><l eID="gen6842" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6841"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:5
verses.text: Then the devil took him to the Holy City, and, placing him on the parapet of the temple, said to him:

verses.name: Matthew 4:6
verses.text: “If you are God’s Son, throw yourself down, for scripture says — <lg sID="gen6843"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6844"/>‘He will give his angels commands about you,<l eID="gen6844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6845"/>and on their hands they will lift you up,<l eID="gen6845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6846"/>so you do not even strike your foot against a stone.’”<l eID="gen6846" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6843"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Scripture also says,” </q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus"> <lg sID="gen6847"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6848"/>“You must not tempt the Lord your God.’” </q><l eID="gen6848" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6847"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:8
verses.text: The third time, the devil took Jesus to a very high mountain, and, showing him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor, said to him: <lg sID="gen6849"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6850"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:9
verses.text: “All these I will give you, if you will fall at my feet and worship me.”<l eID="gen6850" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6849"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:10
verses.text: Then Jesus said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go away, Satan! For scripture says — <lg sID="gen6851"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6852"/>‘You must worship the Lord your God, and worship him only.’” </q><l eID="gen6852" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6851"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:11
verses.text: Then the devil left him alone, and angels came and helped him.  <div eID="gen6838" type="section"/> <div eID="gen6826" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv165"/><div sID="gen6853" type="majorSection"/> <title>The Work in Galilee</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv165"/> When Jesus heard that John had been arrested, he returned to Galilee.

verses.name: Matthew 4:13
verses.text: Afterwards, leaving Nazareth, he went and settled at Capernaum, which is by the side of the Sea, within the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali;

verses.name: Matthew 4:14
verses.text: in fulfillment of these words in the prophet Isaiah — <lg sID="gen6854"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6855"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:15
verses.text: ‘The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali,<l eID="gen6855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6856"/>the land of the Road by the Sea, and beyond the Jordan,<l eID="gen6856" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6857"/>with Galilee of the Gentiles —<l eID="gen6857" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6858"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:16
verses.text: The people who were living in darkness<l eID="gen6858" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6859"/>have seen a great light,<l eID="gen6859" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6860"/>and, for those who were living in the shadow-land of death,<l eID="gen6860" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6861"/>a light has dawned!’<l eID="gen6861" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6854"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv166"/><div sID="gen6862" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv166"/> At that time Jesus began to proclaim — <lg sID="gen6863"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6864"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">“Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.” </q><l eID="gen6864" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen6863"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv167"/><div sID="gen6865" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv167"/> As Jesus was walking along the shore of the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers — Simon, also known as Peter, and his brother Andrew — casting a net into the Sea; for they were fishermen.  <div eID="gen6865" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv168"/><div sID="gen6866" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv168"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Come and follow me,” </q>Jesus said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and I will teach you to fish for people.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 4:20
verses.text: The two men left their nets at once and followed him.

verses.name: Matthew 4:21
verses.text: Going further on, he saw two other men who were also brothers, James, Zebedee’s son, and his brother John, in their boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus called them,

verses.name: Matthew 4:22
verses.text: and they at once left their boat and their father, and followed him.  <div eID="gen6866" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv169"/><div sID="gen6867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv169"/> Jesus went all through Galilee, teaching in their Synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and curing every kind of disease and every kind of sickness among the people;

verses.name: Matthew 4:24
verses.text: and his fame spread all through Syria. They brought to him all who were ill with any form of disease, or who were suffering pain — any who were either possessed by demons, or were lunatic, or paralyzed; and he cured them.

verses.name: Matthew 4:25
verses.text: He was followed by large crowds from Galilee, the district of the Ten Towns, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan.  <div eID="gen6867" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv170"/><div sID="gen6868" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6868" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.4"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:1
verses.text: On seeing the crowds of people, Jesus went up the hill; and, when he had taken his seat, his disciples came up to him;

verses.name: Matthew 5:2
verses.text: and he began to teach them, saying <lg sID="gen6869"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6870"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Blessed are the poor in spirit, </q><l eID="gen6870" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6871"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.</q><l eID="gen6871" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6872"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are the mourners, </q><l eID="gen6872" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6873"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for they will be comforted.</q><l eID="gen6873" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6874"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are the gentle, </q><l eID="gen6874" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6875"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for they will inherit the earth.</q><l eID="gen6875" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6876"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, </q><l eID="gen6876" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6877"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for they will be satisfied.</q><l eID="gen6877" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6878"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are the merciful, </q><l eID="gen6878" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6879"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for they will find mercy.</q><l eID="gen6879" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6880"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are the pure in heart, </q><l eID="gen6880" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6881"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for they will see God.</q><l eID="gen6881" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6882"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are the peacemakers, </q><l eID="gen6882" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6883"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for they will be called children of God.</q><l eID="gen6883" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6884"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are those who have been persecuted in the cause of righteousness, </q><l eID="gen6884" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6885"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.</q><l eID="gen6885" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6869"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed are you when people insult you, and persecute you, and say all kinds of evil lies about you because of me.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Be glad and rejoice, because your reward in heaven will be great; this is the way they persecuted the prophets who lived before you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv170"/><div sID="gen6886" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv170"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">You are salt for the world. But if salt becomes tasteless, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, but is thrown away, and trampled underfoot.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is you who are the light of the world. A town that stands on a hill cannot be hidden.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">People do not light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on the lamp-stand, where it gives light to everyone in the house.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let your light so shine before the eyes of others so that, seeing your good actions, they will praise your Father who is in heaven.</q>  <div eID="gen6886" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv171"/><div sID="gen6887" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv171"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not think that I have come to do away with the law or the prophets; I have not come to do away with them, but to complete them.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For I tell you, until the heavens and the earth disappear, not even the smallest letter, nor one stroke of a letter, will disappear from the law until all is done.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Whoever, therefore, breaks one of these commandments, even the least of them, and teaches others to do so, will be the least esteemed in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever keeps them, and teaches others to do so, will be esteemed great in the kingdom of heaven.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Indeed I tell you that, unless you obey God's commands better than of the teachers of the law, and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.</q>  <div eID="gen6887" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv172"/><div sID="gen6888" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv172"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">You have heard that to our ancestors it was said — ‘You must not commit murder,’ and ‘Whoever commits murder will be brought to trial.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I say to you that anyone who is angry at their brother or sister will be brought to trial; and whoever insults their brother or sister will be brought before the High Council, while whoever calls them a fool will be in danger of the fires of Gehenna.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore, when presenting your gift at the altar, if even there you remember that your brother or sister has something against you,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">leave your gift there, before the altar, go and be reconciled to them, first, then come and present your gift.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Be ready to make friends with your opponent, even when you meet them on your way to the court; otherwise they might hand you over to the judge, and the judge to the judicial officer, and you will be thrown into prison.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I tell you, you will not come out until you have paid the last cent.</q>  <div eID="gen6888" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv173"/><div sID="gen6889" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv173"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">You have heard that it was said — ‘You must not commit adultery.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I say to you that anyone who looks at a woman and desires her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If your right eye causes you to sin, take it out and throw it away. It would be best for you to lose one part of your body, and not to have the whole of it thrown into Gehenna.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It would be best for you to lose one part of your body, and not to have the whole of it go down to Gehenna.</q>  <div eID="gen6889" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv174"/><div sID="gen6890" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv174"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">It was also said — ‘Let anyone who divorces his wife serve her with a notice of separation.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I say to you that anyone who divorces his wife, except on the ground of some serious sexual sin, leads to her committing adultery; while anyone who marries her after her divorce is guilty of adultery.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Again, you have heard that our ancestors were told — ‘Do not break your oaths, keep your vows to the Lord.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I say to you that you must not swear at all, either by heaven, since that is God’s throne,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">or by the earth, since that is his footstool, or by Jerusalem, since that is the city of the Great King.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Nor should you swear by your head, since you cannot make a single hair either white or black.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let your words be simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything beyond this comes from what is evil.</q>  <div eID="gen6890" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv175"/><div sID="gen6891" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv175"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">You have heard that it was said — ‘An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:39
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I say to you that you must not resist those who wrong you; but, if anyone strikes you on the right cheek, turn the other to them also.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:40
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If someone sues you for your shirt, let them have your cloak as well.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:41
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you are forced to carry a soldier's pack for one mile, carry it two.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Give to anyone who asks and, if someone wants to borrow from you, do not turn them away.</q>  <div eID="gen6891" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 5:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv176"/><div sID="gen6892" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv176"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">You have heard that it was said — ‘You must love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But what I tell you is this: love your enemies, and pray for those who persecute you,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:45
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">so that you may become children of your Father who is in heaven; for he causes his sun to rise on bad and good alike, and sends rain on the righteous and on the unrighteous.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, if you love only those who love you, what reward will you have? Even the tax-gatherers do this!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, if you only welcome your brothers and sisters, what are you doing more than others? Even the Gentiles do this!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 5:48
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You, then, must become perfect — as your heavenly Father is perfect.</q>  <div eID="gen6892" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv177"/><div sID="gen6893" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6893" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.5"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:1
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Take care not to perform your religious duties in public in order to be seen by others; if you do, your Father who is in heaven has no reward for you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore, when you do acts of charity, do not have a trumpet blown in front of you, as hypocrites do in the Synagogues and in the streets so that people will praise them. There, I tell you, is their reward!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, when you do acts of charity, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">so that your charity may be secret; and your Father, who sees what is in secret, will reward you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv177"/><div sID="gen6894" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv177"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, when you pray, you are not to behave as hypocrites do. They like to pray standing in the Synagogues and at the corners of the streets, so that people will see them. There, I tell you, is their reward!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, when one of you prays, let them go into their own room, shut the door, and pray to their Father who dwells in secret; and their Father, who sees what is secret, will reward them.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">When praying, do not repeat the same words over and over again, as is done by the Gentiles, who think that by using many words they will obtain a hearing.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not imitate them; for God, your Father, knows what you need before you ask him.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You, therefore, should pray like this — <lg sID="gen6895"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6896"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Our Father, who is in heaven,<l eID="gen6896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6897"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">may your name be held holy,</q><l eID="gen6897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6898"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">your kingdom come, your will be done — </q><l eID="gen6898" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6899"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">on earth, as in heaven.</q><l eID="gen6899" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6900"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Give us today </q><l eID="gen6900" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6901"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">the bread that we will need;</q><l eID="gen6901" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6902"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and forgive us our wrong-doings, </q><l eID="gen6902" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6903"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">as we have forgiven those who have wronged us;</q><l eID="gen6903" level="2"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6904"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and take us not into temptation, </q><l eID="gen6904" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen6905"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">but deliver us from evil.’</q><l eID="gen6905" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen6895"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, if you forgive others their offenses, your heavenly Father will forgive you also;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but, if you do not forgive others their offenses, not even your Father will forgive your offenses.</q>  <div eID="gen6894" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv178"/><div sID="gen6906" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv178"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, when you fast, do not put on gloomy looks, as hypocrites do who disfigure their faces so that they may be seen by people to be fasting. That, I tell you, is their reward!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, when one of you fasts, let them anoint their head and wash their face,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">so that they may not be seen by people to be fasting, but by their Father who dwells in secret; and their Father, who sees what is secret, will reward them.</q>  <div eID="gen6906" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv179"/><div sID="gen6907" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv179"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not store up treasures for yourselves on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But store up treasures for yourselves in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves do not break in or steal.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The lamp of the body is the eye. If your eye is unclouded, your whole body will be lit up;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but, if your eye is diseased, your whole body will be darkened. And, if the inner light is darkness, how intense must that darkness be!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">No one can serve two masters, for either they will hate one and love the other, or else they will attach themselves to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and Money.</q>  <div eID="gen6907" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv180"/><div sID="gen6908" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv180"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">This is why I say to you: Do not be anxious about your life — what you can get to eat or drink, or about your body — what you can get to wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Look at the wild birds — they neither sow, nor reap, nor gather into barns; and yet your heavenly Father feeds them! Are not you more precious than they?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But which of you, by being anxious, can prolong their life a single moment?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And why be anxious about clothing? Study the wild lilies, and how they grow. They neither toil nor spin;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his splendor was not robed like one of these.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If God so clothes even the grass of the field, which is living today and tomorrow will be thrown into the oven, will not he much more clothe you, you of little faith?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not then ask anxiously ‘What can we get to eat?’ or ‘What can we get to drink?’ or ‘What can we get to wear?’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">All these are the things for which the nations are seeking, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them all.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But first seek his kingdom and the righteousness that he requires, and then all these things will be added for you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 6:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will bring its own anxieties. Every day has trouble enough of its own.</q>  <div eID="gen6908" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv181"/><div sID="gen6909" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6909" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.6"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:1
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not judge and you will not be judged.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, just as you judge others, you will yourselves be judged, and the standard that you use will be used for you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your friend’s eye, while you pay no attention at all to the plank of wood in yours?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">How will you say to your friend ‘Let me take out the speck from your eye,’ when all the time there is a plank in your own?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Hypocrite! Take out the plank from your own eye first, and then you will see clearly how to take out the speck from your friend’s.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv181"/><div sID="gen6910" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv181"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not give what is sacred to dogs; they will turn and maul you. Do not throw your pearls before pigs; they will trample them underfoot.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Ask, and it will be given to you; search, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For the person who asks receives, the person who searches finds, and to the door will be opened to the person who knocks.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Who among you, when their child asks them for bread, will give them a stone,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">or when they ask for a fish, will give them a snake?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you, then, wicked though you are, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give what is good to those who ask him!</q>  <div eID="gen6910" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv182"/><div sID="gen6911" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv182"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do to others whatever you would wish them to do to you; for that is the teaching of both the law and the prophets.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Go in by the small gate. Broad and spacious is the road who leads to destruction, and those that go in by it are many;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for small is the gate, and narrow the road, who leads to life, and those that find it are few.</q>  <div eID="gen6911" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv183"/><div sID="gen6912" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv183"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Beware of false teachers — people who come to you in the guise of sheep, but at heart they are ravenous wolves.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">By the fruit of their lives you will know them. Do people pick grapes from thorn bushes, or figs from thistles?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">So, too, every sound tree bears good fruit, while a worthless tree bears bad fruit.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">A sound tree cannot produce bad fruit, nor can a worthless tree bear good fruit.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Every tree that fails to bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">So it is by the fruit of their lives that you will know such people.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Not everyone who says to me ‘Master! Master!’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">On ‘that day’ many will say to me ‘Master, Master, was not it in your name that we taught, and in your name that we drove out demons, and in your name that we did many miracles?’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And then I will say to them plainly ‘I never knew you. Go from my presence, you who live in sin.’</q>  <div eID="gen6912" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv184"/><div sID="gen6913" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv184"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everyone, therefore, who listens to this teaching of mine and acts on it may be compared to a prudent person, who built their house on the rock.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The rain poured down, the rivers rose, the winds blew and beat on that house, but it did not fall, for its foundations were on the rock.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everyone who listens to this teaching of mine and does not act on it may be compared to a foolish person, who built their house on the sand.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 7:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The rain poured down, the rivers rose, the winds blew and struck against that house, and it fell; and great was its downfall.” </q>  <div eID="gen6913" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv185"/><div sID="gen6914" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv185"/> By the time that Jesus had finished speaking, the crowd was filled with amazement at his teaching.

verses.name: Matthew 7:29
verses.text: For he taught them like one who had authority, and not like their teachers of the law.  <div eID="gen6914" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.7"/> <div eID="gen6862" type="section"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv186"/><div sID="gen6915" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv186"/> When Jesus had come down from the hill, great crowds followed him.

verses.name: Matthew 8:2
verses.text: He saw a leper who came up, and bowed to the ground before him, and said: “Master, if only you are willing, you are able to make me clean.”

verses.name: Matthew 8:3
verses.text: Stretching out his hand, Jesus touched him, saying as he did so: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am willing; become clean.” </q>Instantly he was made clean from his leprosy;

verses.name: Matthew 8:4
verses.text: and then Jesus said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Be careful not to say a word to anyone, but go and show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift directed by Moses, as evidence of your cure.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 8:5
verses.text: After Jesus had entered Capernaum, a captain in the Roman army came up to him, entreating his help.

verses.name: Matthew 8:6
verses.text: “Sir,” he said, “my manservant is lying ill at my house with a stroke of paralysis, and is suffering terribly.”

verses.name: Matthew 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv187"/><div sID="gen6916" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv187"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I will come and cure him,” </q>answered Jesus.

verses.name: Matthew 8:8
verses.text: “Sir,” the captain went on, “I am unworthy to receive you under my roof; but only speak, and my manservant will be cured.

verses.name: Matthew 8:9
verses.text: For I myself am a man under the orders of others, with soldiers under me; and, if I say to one of them ‘Go,’ he goes, and to another ‘Come,’ he comes, and to my slave ‘Do this,’ he does it.”

verses.name: Matthew 8:10
verses.text: Jesus was surprised to hear this, and said to those who were following him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Never I tell you, in any Israelite have I met with such faith as this!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 8:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yes, and many will come in from East and West and take their places beside Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 8:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">while the heirs to the kingdom will be ‘banished into the darkness’ outside; there, there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 8:13
verses.text: Then Jesus said to the captain: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go now, and it will be according to your faith.” </q>And the man was cured that very hour.  <div eID="gen6916" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv188"/><div sID="gen6917" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv188"/> When Jesus went into Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law prostrated with fever.

verses.name: Matthew 8:15
verses.text: On his taking her hand, the fever left her, and she rose and began to take care of him.

verses.name: Matthew 8:16
verses.text: In the evening the people brought to Jesus many who were possessed by demons; and he drove out the spirits with a word, and cured all who were ill,

verses.name: Matthew 8:17
verses.text: in fulfillment of these words in the prophet Isaiah — ‘He took our infirmities on himself, and bore the burden of our diseases.’  <div eID="gen6917" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv189"/><div sID="gen6918" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv189"/> Seeing a crowd around him, Jesus gave orders to go across.

verses.name: Matthew 8:19
verses.text: A teacher of the law came up to him, and said: “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”  <div eID="gen6918" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv190"/><div sID="gen6919" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv190"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Foxes have holes,” </q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and wild birds their nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 8:21
verses.text: “Master,” said another, who was a disciple, “let me first go and bury my father.”

verses.name: Matthew 8:22
verses.text: But Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their dead.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 8:23
verses.text: Then he got into the boat, followed by his disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 8:24
verses.text: Suddenly so great a storm came up on the Sea, that the waves broke right over the boat. But Jesus was asleep;

verses.name: Matthew 8:25
verses.text: and the disciples came and roused him. “Master,” they cried, “save us; we are lost!”  <div eID="gen6919" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv191"/><div sID="gen6920" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv191"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Why are you so timid?” </q>he said. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You of little faith!” </q>Then Jesus rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and a great calm followed.

verses.name: Matthew 8:27
verses.text: The men were amazed, and exclaimed: “What kind of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!”  <div eID="gen6920" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv192"/><div sID="gen6921" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv192"/> On getting to the other side — the country of the Gadarenes — Jesus met two men who were possessed by demons, coming out of the tombs. They were so violent that no one was able to pass that way.

verses.name: Matthew 8:29
verses.text: Suddenly they shrieked out: “What do you want with us, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before our time?”

verses.name: Matthew 8:30
verses.text: A long way off, there was a drove of many pigs, feeding;

verses.name: Matthew 8:31
verses.text: and the foul spirits began begging Jesus: “If you drive us out, send us into the drove of pigs.”  <div eID="gen6921" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 8:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv193"/><div sID="gen6922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv193"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go,” </q>he said. The spirits came out, and entered the pigs; and the whole drove rushed down the steep slope into the Sea, and died in the water.

verses.name: Matthew 8:33
verses.text: At this the men who tended them ran away and went to the town, carrying the news of all that had occurred, and of what had happened to the possessed men.

verses.name: Matthew 8:34
verses.text: At the news the whole town went out to meet Jesus, and, when they saw him, they entreated him to go away from their neighborhood.  <div eID="gen6922" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv194"/><div sID="gen6923" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6923" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.8"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:1
verses.text: Afterwards Jesus got into a boat, and, crossing over, came to his own city.

verses.name: Matthew 9:2
verses.text: There some people brought to him a paralyzed man on a bed. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Courage, child! Your sins are forgiven.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:3
verses.text: Then some of the teachers of the law said to themselves: “This man is blaspheming!”

verses.name: Matthew 9:4
verses.text: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus exclaimed: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Why do your cherish such wicked thoughts?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Which, I ask, is the easier? — to say ‘Your sins are forgiven’? Or to say ‘Get up, and walk’?</q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But to show you that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins” </q>— then he said to the paralyzed man — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Get up, take up your bed, and return to your home.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:7
verses.text: The man got up and went to his home.

verses.name: Matthew 9:8
verses.text: When the crowd saw this, they were awe-struck, and praised God for giving such power to human beings.

verses.name: Matthew 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv194"/><div sID="gen6924" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv194"/> As Jesus went along, he saw a man, called Matthew, sitting in the tax office, and said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Follow me.” </q>Matthew got up and followed him.  <div eID="gen6924" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv195"/><div sID="gen6925" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv195"/> And, later on, when he was having dinner in the house, a number of tax-gatherers and outcasts came in and took their places at the table with Jesus and his disciples.

verses.name: Matthew 9:11
verses.text: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples: “Why does your teacher eat in the company of tax-gatherers and outcasts?”

verses.name: Matthew 9:12
verses.text: On hearing this, Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It is not those who are healthy who need a doctor, but those who are ill.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Go and learn what this means — ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice’; for I did not come to call the religious, but the outcast.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:14
verses.text: Then John’s disciples came to Jesus, and asked: “Why do we and the Pharisees fast while your disciples do not?”

verses.name: Matthew 9:15
verses.text: Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Can the groom’s friends mourn as long as the groom is with them? But the days will come, when the groom will be taken away from them, and they will fast then.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Nobody ever puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for such a patch tears away from the garment, and a worse tear is made.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Nor do people put new wine into old wine-skins; for, if they do, the skins burst, and the wine runs out, and the skins are lost; but they put new wine into fresh skins, and so both are preserved.” </q>  <div eID="gen6925" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv196"/><div sID="gen6926" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv196"/> While Jesus was saying this, a synagogue leader came up and bowed to the ground before him. “My daughter,” he said, “Has just died; but come and place your hand on her, and she will be restored to life.”

verses.name: Matthew 9:19
verses.text: So Jesus rose and followed him, and his disciples went also.

verses.name: Matthew 9:20
verses.text: But meanwhile a woman, who had been suffering from hemorrhage for twelve years, came up behind and touched the tassel of his cloak.

verses.name: Matthew 9:21
verses.text: “If I only touch his cloak,” she said to herself, “I will get well.”

verses.name: Matthew 9:22
verses.text: Turning and seeing her, Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Courage, daughter! Your faith has delivered you.” </q>And at that very moment she became well.

verses.name: Matthew 9:23
verses.text: When Jesus reached the leader’s house, seeing the flute players, and a number of people all in confusion,

verses.name: Matthew 9:24
verses.text: he said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go away, the little girl is not dead; she is asleep.” </q>They began to laugh at him;

verses.name: Matthew 9:25
verses.text: but, when the people had been sent out, Jesus went in, and took the little girl’s hand, and she rose.

verses.name: Matthew 9:26
verses.text: The report of this spread through all that part of the country.  <div eID="gen6926" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv197"/><div sID="gen6927" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv197"/> As Jesus was passing on from there, he was followed by two blind men, who kept calling out: “Take pity on us, Son of David!”

verses.name: Matthew 9:28
verses.text: When he had gone indoors, the blind men came up to him; and Jesus asked them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you believe that I am able to do this?” </q>“Yes, Master!” they answered.

verses.name: Matthew 9:29
verses.text: Then he touched their eyes, and said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It will be according to your faith.” </q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:30
verses.text: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus sternly cautioned them. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“See that no one knows of it,” </q>he said.

verses.name: Matthew 9:31
verses.text: But the men went out, and spread the news about him through all that part of the country.

verses.name: Matthew 9:32
verses.text: Just as they were going out, some people brought up to Jesus a dumb man who was possessed by a demon;

verses.name: Matthew 9:33
verses.text: and, as soon as the demon had been driven out, the dumb man spoke. The people were astonished at this, and exclaimed: “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

verses.name: Matthew 9:34
verses.text: But the Pharisees said: “He drives out the demons by the help of the chief of the demons.”  <div eID="gen6927" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv198"/><div sID="gen6928" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv198"/> Jesus went around all the towns and the villages, teaching in their Synagogues, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and curing every kind of disease and every kind of sickness.

verses.name: Matthew 9:36
verses.text: But, when he saw the crowds, his heart was moved with compassion for them, because they were distressed and harassed, ‘like sheep without a shepherd’;

verses.name: Matthew 9:37
verses.text: and he said to his disciples: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“The harvest is abundant, but the laborers are few.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 9:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore pray to the owner of the harvest to send laborers to gather in his harvest.” </q>  <div eID="gen6928" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv199"/><div sID="gen6929" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6929" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.9"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:1
verses.text: Calling his twelve Disciples to him, Jesus gave them authority over foul spirits, so that they could drive them out, as well as the power of curing every kind of disease and every kind of sickness.

verses.name: Matthew 10:2
verses.text: The names of the twelve apostles are these: First Simon, also known as Peter, and his brother Andrew; James the son of Zebedee, and his brother John;

verses.name: Matthew 10:3
verses.text: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax-gather; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

verses.name: Matthew 10:4
verses.text: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot — the apostle who betrayed him.

verses.name: Matthew 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv199"/><div sID="gen6930" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv199"/> These twelve Jesus sent out as his messengers, after giving them these instructions — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do not go to the Gentiles, nor enter any Samaritan town,</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but make your way rather to the lost sheep of Israel.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">On your way proclaim that the kingdom of heaven is at hand.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Cure the sick, raise the dead, make the lepers clean, drive out demons. You have received free of cost, give free of cost.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not provide yourselves with gold, or silver, or coins in your purses;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">not even with a bag for the journey, or a change of clothes, or sandals, or even a staff; for the worker is worth his food.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Whatever town or village you visit, find out who is worthy in that place, and remain there until you leave.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As you enter the house, greet it.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Then, if the house is worthy, let your blessing rest on it, but, if it is unworthy, let your blessing return on yourselves.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If no one welcomes you, or listens to what you say, as you leave that house or that town, shake off its dust from your feet.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I tell you, the doom of the land of Sodom and Gomorrah will be more bearable in the ‘day of judgment’ than the doom of that town.</q>  <div eID="gen6930" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv200"/><div sID="gen6931" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv200"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Remember, I am sending you out as my messengers like sheep among wolves. So be as wise as snakes, and as blameless as doves.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Be on your guard against others, for they will betray you to courts of law, and scourge you in their Synagogues;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake so that you may witness for me before them and the nations.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Whenever they betray you, do not be anxious as to how you will speak or what you will say, for what you will say will be given you at the moment;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for it will not be you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father that speaks within you.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Brother will betray brother to death, and the father his child; and children will turn against their parents, and cause them to be put to death;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you will be hated by everyone because of me. Yet the person who endures to the end will be saved.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, when they persecute you in one town, escape to the next; for, I tell you, you will not have come to the end of the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">A scholar is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is enough for a scholar to be treated like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not, therefore, be afraid of them. There is nothing concealed which will not be revealed, nor anything hidden which will not become known.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">What I tell you in the dark, say again in the light; and what is whispered in your ear, proclaim on the housetops.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not be afraid of those who kill the body, but are unable to kill the soul; rather be afraid of him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Are not two sparrows sold for a one copper coin? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father’s knowledge.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">While as for you, even the hairs of your head are numbered.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not, therefore, be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everyone, therefore, who will publicly acknowledge me, I, too, will acknowledge before my Father who is in heaven;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but, if anyone publicly disowns me, I, too, will disown him before my Father who is in heaven.</q>  <div eID="gen6931" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv201"/><div sID="gen6932" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv201"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not imagine that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I have come to bring, not peace, but the sword.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For I have come to set — ‘a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">A person’s enemies will be the members of their own household.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Anyone who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and anyone who loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Anyone who does not take their cross and follow in my steps is not worthy of me.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:39
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who has found their life will lose it, while the person who, for my sake, has lost their life will find it.</q>  <div eID="gen6932" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 10:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv202"/><div sID="gen6933" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv202"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">Anyone who welcomes you is welcoming me; and anyone who welcomes me is welcoming him who sent me as his messenger.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:41
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who welcomes a prophet, because they are a prophet, will receive a prophet’s reward; and anyone who welcomes a good person, because they are a good person, will receive a good person’s reward.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 10:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, if anyone gives but a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because they are a disciple, I tell you that they will assuredly not lose their reward.” </q>  <div eID="gen6933" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv203"/><div sID="gen6934" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen6934" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Matt.10"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:1
verses.text: After Jesus had finished giving directions to his twelve Disciples, he left that place in order to teach and preach in their towns.

verses.name: Matthew 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv203"/><div sID="gen6935" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv203"/> Now John had heard in prison what the Christ was doing, and he sent a message by his disciples,

verses.name: Matthew 11:3
verses.text: and asked — ” Are you ‘the coming one,’ or are we to look for someone else?”

verses.name: Matthew 11:4
verses.text: The answer of Jesus to the question was — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go and report to John what you hear and see — </q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">the blind recover their sight and the lame walk, the lepers are made clean and the deaf hear, the dead, too, are raised to life, and the good news is told to the poor.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Blessed is the person who finds no hindrance in me.” </q>  <div eID="gen6935" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv204"/><div sID="gen6936" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv204"/> While John’s disciples were going back, Jesus began to say to the crowds with reference to John:

verses.name: Matthew 11:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What did you go out into the wilderness to look at? A reed waving in the wind? If not, what did you go out to see? A man richly dressed? Why, those who wear rich things are to be found in the courts of kings!</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">What, then, did you go for? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and far more than a prophet.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">This is the man of whom scripture says — ‘I am sending my messenger ahead of you, and he will prepare your way before you.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I tell you, no one born of a woman has yet appeared who is greater than John the Baptist; and yet the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">From the time of John the Baptist to this very hour, the kingdom of heaven has been taken by force, and people using force have been seizing it.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For the teaching of all the prophets and of the law continued until the time of John;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and — if you are ready to accept it — John is himself the Elijah who was destined to come.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let him who has ears hear.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But to what will I compare the present generation? It is like little children sitting in the market-places and calling out to their playmates — </q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘We have played the flute for you, but you have not danced; We have wailed, but you have not mourned.’</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, when John came, neither eating nor drinking, people said ‘He has a demon in him’;</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and now that the Son of Man has come, eating and drinking, they are saying ‘Here is a glutton and a wine-drinker, a friend of tax-gatherers and outcasts!’ And yet wisdom is vindicated by her actions.” </q>  <div eID="gen6936" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv205"/><div sID="gen6937" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv205"/> Then Jesus began to reproach the towns in which most of his miracles had been done, because they had not repented:

verses.name: Matthew 11:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Alas for you, Chorazin! Alas for you, Bethsaida! For, if the miracles which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet, I tell you, the doom of Tyre and Sidon will be more bearable in the ‘day of judgment’ than yours.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And you, Capernaum! Will you ‘exalt yourself to heaven’? ‘You will go down to the place of death.’ For, if the miracles which have been done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have been standing to this day.</q>

verses.name: Matthew 11:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet, I tell you, the doom of Sodom will be more bearable in the ‘day of judgment’ than yours.” </q>
