verses.name: Luke 18:23
verses.text: But the man became greatly distressed on hearing this, for he was extremely rich.

verses.name: Luke 18:24
verses.text: Seeing this, Jesus said to his disciples: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“How hard it is for the wealthy to enter the kingdom of God!</q>

verses.name: Luke 18:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is easier, indeed, for a camel to get through a needle’s eye than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God!”</q>  <div eID="gen7546" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv616"/><div sID="gen7547" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv616"/> “Then who can be saved?” asked those who heard this.

verses.name: Luke 18:27
verses.text: But Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What is impossible with people is possible with God.”</q>  <div eID="gen7547" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv617"/><div sID="gen7548" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv617"/> “But we,” said Peter, “we left what belonged to us and followed you.”  <div eID="gen7548" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv618"/><div sID="gen7549" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv618"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I tell you,”</q>he answered, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“that there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,</q>

verses.name: Luke 18:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">who will not receive many times as much in the present, and in the age that is coming eternal life.”</q>  <div eID="gen7549" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7544" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv619"/><div sID="gen7550" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv619"/> Gathering the Twelve around him, Jesus said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Listen! We are going up to Jerusalem; and there everything that is written in the prophets will be done to the Son of Man.</q>

verses.name: Luke 18:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For he will be given up to the Gentiles, mocked, insulted and spat on;</q>

verses.name: Luke 18:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">they will scourge him, and then put him to death; and on the third day he will rise again.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 18:34
verses.text: The apostles did not comprehend any of this; his meaning was unintelligible to them, and they did not understand what he was saying.  <div eID="gen7550" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 18:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv620"/><div sID="gen7551" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv620"/> As Jesus was getting near Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside, begging.

verses.name: Luke 18:36
verses.text: Hearing a crowd going by, the man asked what was the matter;

verses.name: Luke 18:37
verses.text: and, when people told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing,

verses.name: Luke 18:38
verses.text: he shouted out: “Jesus, Son of David, take pity on me!”

verses.name: Luke 18:39
verses.text: Those who were in front kept telling him to be quiet, but he continued to call out the louder: “Son of David, take pity on me!”

verses.name: Luke 18:40
verses.text: Then Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. And, when he had come close up to him, Jesus asked him:

verses.name: Luke 18:41
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What do you want me to do for you?”</q> <div sID="gen7552" type="paragraph"/> “Master,” he said, “I want to recover my sight.”

verses.name: Luke 18:42
verses.text: And Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Recover your sight, your faith has delivered you.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 18:43
verses.text: Instantly he recovered his sight, and began to follow Jesus, praising God. And all the people, on seeing it, gave glory to God.  <div eID="gen7552" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.18"/> <div eID="gen7551" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv621"/><div sID="gen7553" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv621"/> Jesus entered Jericho and made his way through the town.

verses.name: Luke 19:2
verses.text: There was a man there, known by the name of Zacchaeus, who was a commissioner of taxes and a rich man.

verses.name: Luke 19:3
verses.text: He tried to see what Jesus was like; but, being short, he was unable to do so because of the crowd.

verses.name: Luke 19:4
verses.text: So he ran on ahead and climbed into a mulberry tree, to see Jesus, for he knew that he must pass that way.

verses.name: Luke 19:5
verses.text: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Zacchaeus, be quick and come down, for I must stop at your house today.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:6
verses.text: So Zacchaeus got down quickly, and joyfully welcomed him.

verses.name: Luke 19:7
verses.text: On seeing this, everyone began to complain: “He has gone to stay with a man who is an outcast.”

verses.name: Luke 19:8
verses.text: But Zacchaeus stood forward and said to the Master: “Listen, Master! I will give half my property to the poor, and, if I have defrauded anyone of anything, I will give him back four times as much.”

verses.name: Luke 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv622"/><div sID="gen7554" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv622"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“salvation has come to this house today,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“for even this man is a son of Abraham.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The Son of Man has come to ‘search for those who are lost’ and to save them.”</q>  <div eID="gen7554" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv623"/><div sID="gen7555" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv623"/> As the people were listening to this, Jesus went on to tell them a parable. He did so because he was near Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God was going to be proclaimed at once.

verses.name: Luke 19:12
verses.text: He said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“A nobleman once went to a distant country to receive his appointment to a kingdom and then return.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He called ten of his servants and gave them ten pounds of silver each, and told them to trade with them during his absence.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But his subjects hated him and sent envoys after him to say ‘We will not have this man as our king.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">On his return, after having been appointed king, he directed that the servants to whom he had given his money should be summoned, so that he might learn what amount of trade they had done.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The first came up, and said ‘Sir, your ten pounds have made a hundred.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Well done, good servant!’ exclaimed the master. ‘As you have proved trustworthy in a very small matter, I appoint you governor over ten towns.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">When the second came, he said ‘Your ten pounds, Sir, have produced fifty.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">So the master said to him ‘And you I appoint over five towns.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Another servant also came and said ‘Sir, here are your ten pounds; I have kept them put away in a handkerchief.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For I was afraid of you, because you are a stern man. You take what you have not planted, and reap what you have not sown.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The master answered ‘Out of your own mouth I judge you, you worthless servant. You knew that I am a stern man, that I take what I have not planted, and reap what I have not sown?</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Then why did not you put my money into a bank? And I, on my return, could have claimed it with interest.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Take away from him the ten pounds,’ he said to those standing by, ‘and give them to the one who has the hundred.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘But, Sir,’ they said, ‘he has a hundred pounds already!’</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘I tell you,’ he answered, ‘that, to him who has, more will be given, but, from him who has nothing, even what he has will be taken away.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But as for my enemies, these men who would not have me as their king, bring them here and put them to death in my presence.’”</q>  <div eID="gen7555" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv624"/><div sID="gen7556" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv624"/> After saying this, Jesus went on in front, going up to Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen7556" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7553" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7469" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv625"/><div sID="gen7557" type="majorSection"/> <title>The Last Days</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv625"/> It was when Jesus had almost reached Bethphage and Bethany, near the Mount of Olives, that he sent on two of the disciples.

verses.name: Luke 19:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go to the village facing us,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and, when you get there, you will find a foal tethered, which no one has yet ridden; untie it and lead it here.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, if anybody asks you ‘Why are you untying it?,’ you are to say this — ‘The Master wants it.’”</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:32
verses.text: So the two who were sent went and found it as Jesus had told them.

verses.name: Luke 19:33
verses.text: While they were untying the foal, the owners asked them — “Why are you untying the foal?”

verses.name: Luke 19:34
verses.text: And the two disciples answered — “The Master wants it.”

verses.name: Luke 19:35
verses.text: Then they led it back to Jesus, and threw their cloaks on the foal and put Jesus on it.

verses.name: Luke 19:36
verses.text: As he went along, the people kept spreading their cloaks in the road.

verses.name: Luke 19:37
verses.text: When he had almost reached the place where the road led down the Mount of Olives, everyone of the many disciples began in their joy to praise God loudly for all the miracles that they had seen: <lg sID="gen7558"/> <l sID="gen7559"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:38
verses.text: “Blessed is He who comes —<l eID="gen7559"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7560"/>Our king — in the name of the Lord!<l eID="gen7560" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7561"/>Peace in heaven,<l eID="gen7561"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7562"/>And glory on high.”<l eID="gen7562" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7558"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:39
verses.text: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to him: “Teacher, restrain your disciples.”

verses.name: Luke 19:40
verses.text: But Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I tell you that if they are silent, the stones will call out.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv626"/><div sID="gen7563" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv626"/> When he drew near, on seeing the city, he wept over it, and said:

verses.name: Luke 19:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If only you had known, while yet there was time — even you — the things that make for peace! But now they have been hidden from your sight.</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:43
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For a time is coming when your enemies will surround you with earthworks, and encircle you, and hem you in on all sides;</q>

verses.name: Luke 19:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">they will trample you down and your children within you, and they will not leave in you one stone on another, because you did not know ‘the time of your visitation.’”</q>  <div eID="gen7563" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv627"/><div sID="gen7564" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv627"/> Jesus went into the Temple Courts and began to drive out those who were selling,

verses.name: Luke 19:46
verses.text: saying as he did so: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Scripture says — ‘My house will be a house of prayer’; but you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”</q>  <div eID="gen7564" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 19:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv628"/><div sID="gen7565" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv628"/> Jesus continued to teach each day in the Temple Courts; but the chief priests and teachers of the law were eager to take his life, and so also were the leaders of the people.

verses.name: Luke 19:48
verses.text: Yet they could not see what to do, for the people all hung on his words.  <chapter eID="Luke.19"/> <div eID="gen7565" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv629"/><div sID="gen7566" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv629"/> On one of these days, when Jesus was teaching the people in the Temple Courts and telling the good news, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, joined by the councillors, confronted him,

verses.name: Luke 20:2
verses.text: and addressing him, said: “Tell us what authority you have to do these things. Who is it who has given you this authority?”

verses.name: Luke 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv630"/><div sID="gen7567" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv630"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I, too,”</q>said Jesus in reply, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“will ask you one question. Give me an answer to it.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is about John’s baptism — was it of divine or of human origin?”</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:5
verses.text: But they began arguing together: “If we say ‘divine,’ he will say ‘Why did not you believe him?’

verses.name: Luke 20:6
verses.text: But, if we say ‘human,’ the people will all stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

verses.name: Luke 20:7
verses.text: So they answered that they did not know its origin.

verses.name: Luke 20:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Then I,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“refuse to tell you what authority I have to do these things.”</q>  <div eID="gen7567" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv631"/><div sID="gen7568" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv631"/> But Jesus began to tell the people this parable — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“A man once planted a vineyard, and then let it out to tenants, and went abroad for a long while.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">At the proper time he sent a servant to the tenants, so that they could give him a share of the produce of the vineyard. The tenants, however, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The owner afterwards sent another servant; but the tenants beat and insulted this man too, and sent him away empty-handed.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He sent a third; but they wounded this man also, and threw him outside.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘What should I do?’ said the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my son, who is very dear to me. Perhaps they will respect him.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, on seeing him, the tenants consulted with one another. ‘Here is the heir!’ they said. ‘Let us kill him, and then the inheritance will become ours.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">So they threw him outside the vineyard and killed him. Now what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He will come and put those tenants to death, and will let the vineyard to others.”</q> <div eID="gen7568" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7569" type="paragraph"/> “heaven forbid!” they exclaimed when they heard it.

verses.name: Luke 20:17
verses.text: But Jesus looked at them and said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What then is the meaning of this passage? — <lg sID="gen7570"/> <l sID="gen7571"/>‘The stone which the builders despised has now itself become the corner-stone.’</q><l eID="gen7571"/> <lg eID="gen7570"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everyone who falls on that stone will be dashed to pieces, while anyone on whom it falls — it will scatter him as dust.”</q>  <div eID="gen7569" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv632"/><div sID="gen7572" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv632"/> After this the teachers of the law and the chief priest were eager to lay hands on Jesus then and there, but they were afraid of the people; for they saw that it was at them that he had aimed this parable.

verses.name: Luke 20:20
verses.text: Having watched their opportunity, they afterwards sent some spies, who pretended to be good men, to catch Jesus in the course of conversation, and so enable them to give him up to the Governor’s jurisdiction and authority.

verses.name: Luke 20:21
verses.text: These spies asked Jesus a question. They said: “Teacher, we know that you are right in what you say and teach, and that you do not take any account of a person’s position, but teach the way of God honestly;

verses.name: Luke 20:22
verses.text: are we right in paying tribute to the Emperor or not?”

verses.name: Luke 20:23
verses.text: Seeing through their deceitfulness, Jesus said to them:

verses.name: Luke 20:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Show me a coin. Whose head and title are on it?”</q>  <div eID="gen7572" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv633"/><div sID="gen7573" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv633"/> “The Emperor’s,” they said; and Jesus replied: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Well then, pay to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, and to God what belongs to God.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:26
verses.text: They could not lay hold of this answer before the people; and, in their wonder at his reply, they held their tongues.  <div eID="gen7573" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7566" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv634"/><div sID="gen7574" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv634"/> Presently there came up some Sadducees, who maintain that there is no resurrection. Their question was this —

verses.name: Luke 20:28
verses.text: “Teacher, Moses laid down for us in his writings that — <lg sID="gen7575"/> <l sID="gen7576"/>‘Should a man’s married brother die, and should he be childless, the man should take the widow as his wife, and raise up a family for his brother.’<l eID="gen7576"/> <lg eID="gen7575"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:29
verses.text: Well, there were once seven brothers; of whom the eldest, after taking a wife, died childless.

verses.name: Luke 20:30
verses.text: The second and third brothers both took her as their wife;

verses.name: Luke 20:31
verses.text: and so, too, did all seven — dying without children.

verses.name: Luke 20:32
verses.text: The woman herself was the last to die.

verses.name: Luke 20:33
verses.text: About the woman, then — at the resurrection, whose wife is she to be, all seven brothers having had her as their wife?”

verses.name: Luke 20:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv635"/><div sID="gen7577" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv635"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“The men and women of this world,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“marry and are given in marriage;</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but, for those who are thought worthy to attain to that other world and the resurrection from the dead, there is no marrying or being married,</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">nor indeed can they die again, for they are like angels and, having shared in the resurrection, they are God’s children.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As to the fact that the dead rise, even Moses indicated that, in the passage about the Bush, when he calls the Lord — <lg sID="gen7578"/> <l sID="gen7579"/>‘The God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’</q><l eID="gen7579"/> <lg eID="gen7578"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Now he is not God of dead people, but of living. For in his sight all are alive.”</q>  <div eID="gen7577" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv636"/><div sID="gen7580" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv636"/> “Well said, teacher!” exclaimed some of the teachers of the law,

verses.name: Luke 20:40
verses.text: for they did not venture to question him any further.

verses.name: Luke 20:41
verses.text: But Jesus said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“How is it that people say that the Christ is to be David’s son?</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For David, in the book of Psalms, says himself — <lg sID="gen7581"/> <l sID="gen7582"/>‘The Lord said to my lord: “Sit at my right hand,</q><l eID="gen7582"/> <l sID="gen7583"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:43
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">until I put your enemies as a stool for your feet.”’</q><l eID="gen7583"/> <lg eID="gen7581"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">David, then, calls him ‘lord,’ so how is he David’s son?”</q>  <div eID="gen7580" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 20:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv637"/><div sID="gen7584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv637"/> While all the people were listening, Jesus said to the disciples:

verses.name: Luke 20:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Be on your guard against the teachers of the law, who delight to walk about in long robes, and like to be greeted in the streets with respect, and to have the best seats in the Synagogues, and places of honor at dinner.</q>

verses.name: Luke 20:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">These are the men who rob widows of their houses, and make a pretense of saying long prayers. Their sentence will be all the heavier.”</q>  <div eID="gen7584" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv638"/><div sID="gen7585" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7585" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.20"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:1
verses.text: Looking up, Jesus saw the rich people putting their gifts into the chests for the Temple offerings.

verses.name: Luke 21:2
verses.text: He saw, too, a widow in poor circumstances putting two small coins into them.

verses.name: Luke 21:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I tell you”</q>, he said <q marker="" who="Jesus">“that this poor widow has put in more than all the others;</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for everyone else here put in something from what he had to spare, while she, in her need, has put in all she had to live on.”</q>  <div eID="gen7574" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv638"/><div sID="gen7586" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv638"/> When some of them spoke about the Temple being decorated with beautiful stones and offerings, Jesus said:

verses.name: Luke 21:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“As for these things that you are looking at, a time is coming when not one stone will be left on another here, which will not be thrown down.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:7
verses.text: So the disciples questioned Jesus: “But, teacher, when will this be? And what sign will there be when this is near?”

verses.name: Luke 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv639"/><div sID="gen7587" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv639"/> And Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“See that you are not led astray; for many will take my name, and come saying ‘I am He,’ and ‘The time is close at hand.’ Do not follow them.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, when you hear of wars and disturbances, do not be terrified, for these things must occur first; but the end will not be at once.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:10
verses.text: Then he said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“‘Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom,’</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And there will be great earthquakes, and plagues and famines in various places, and there will be terrible appearances and signs in the heavens.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Before all this, they will lay hands on you and persecute you, and they will betray you to Synagogues and put you in prison, when you will be brought before kings and governors for the sake of my name.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Then will be your opportunity of witnessing for me.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Make up your minds, therefore, not to prepare your defense;</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for I will myself give you words, and a wisdom which all your opponents together will be unable to resist or defy.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You will be betrayed even by your parents and brothers and sisters and sisters and relations and friends, and they will cause some of you to be put to death,</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you will be hated by everyone because of me my name.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet not a single hair of your heads will be lost!</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">By your endurance you will win yourselves life.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As soon, however, as you see Jerusalem surrounded by armed camps, then you may know that the hour of her desecration is at hand.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Then those of you who are in Judea must take refuge in the mountains, those who are in Jerusalem must leave at once, and those who are in the country places must not go into it.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For these are to be the days of vengeance, when all that scripture says will be fulfilled.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Alas for pregnant women, and for those who are nursing infants in those days! For there will be great suffering in the land, and anger against this people.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be taken prisoners to every land, and ‘Jerusalem will be under the heel of the Gentiles,’ until their day is over — as it will be.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">There will be signs, too, in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth despair among the nations, in their dismay at the roar of the sea and the surge.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">People’s hearts will fail them through dread of what is coming upon the world; for ‘the forces of the heavens will be convulsed.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Then will be seen the ‘Son of Man coming in a cloud’ with power and great glory.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, when these things begin to occur, look upwards and lift your heads, for your deliverance will be at hand.”</q>  <div eID="gen7587" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv640"/><div sID="gen7588" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv640"/> Then he taught them a lesson , saying — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Look at the fig tree and all the other trees.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As soon as they shoot, you know, as you look at them, without being told, that summer is near.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And so may you, as soon as you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I tell you that even the present generation will not pass away until all has taken place.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The heavens and the earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Be on your guard or your minds will become dulled by debauches or drunkenness or the anxieties of life, and 'that day' will close on you suddenly like a trap.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For come it will on all who are living upon the face of the whole earth.</q>

verses.name: Luke 21:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Be on the watch at all times, and pray that you may have strength to escape all that is destined to happen, and to stand in the presence of the Son of Man.”</q>  <div eID="gen7588" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7586" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 21:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv641"/><div sID="gen7589" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv641"/> During the days, Jesus continued to teach in the Temple Courts, but he went out and spent the nights on the hill called the ‘Mount of Olives.’

verses.name: Luke 21:38
verses.text: And all the people would get up early in the morning and come to listen to him in the Temple Courts.  <chapter eID="Luke.21"/> <div eID="gen7589" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv642"/><div sID="gen7590" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv642"/> The feast of the unleavened bread, known as the Passover, was near.

verses.name: Luke 22:2
verses.text: The chief priest and the teachers of the law were looking for an opportunity of destroying Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

verses.name: Luke 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv643"/><div sID="gen7591" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv643"/> Now Satan took possession of Judas, who was known as Iscariot, and who belonged to the Twelve;

verses.name: Luke 22:4
verses.text: and he went and discussed with the chief priests and officers in charge at the Temple the best way of betraying Jesus to them.

verses.name: Luke 22:5
verses.text: They were glad of this, and agreed to pay him.

verses.name: Luke 22:6
verses.text: So Judas assented, and looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them, in the absence of a crowd.  <div eID="gen7591" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv644"/><div sID="gen7592" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv644"/> When the day of the Festival of the unleavened bread came, on which the Passover lambs had to be killed,

verses.name: Luke 22:8
verses.text: Jesus sent forward Peter and John, saying to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go and make preparations for our eating the Passover.”</q>  <div eID="gen7592" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv645"/><div sID="gen7593" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv645"/> “Where do you wish us to make preparations?” they asked.

verses.name: Luke 22:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Listen,”</q>he answered, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“when you have got into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you; follow him into whatever house he enters;</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you will say to the owner of the house ‘The teacher says to you — Where is the room where I am to eat the Passover with my disciples?’</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The man will show you a large upstairs room, set out; there make preparations.”</q>  <div eID="gen7593" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv646"/><div sID="gen7594" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv646"/> So Peter and John went on, and found everything just as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.  <div eID="gen7594" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv647"/><div sID="gen7595" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv647"/> When the time came, Jesus took his place at the table, and the apostles with him.

verses.name: Luke 22:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have most earnestly wished,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For I tell you that I will not eat it again, until it has had its fulfillment in the kingdom of God.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:17
verses.text: Then, on receiving a cup, after saying the thanksgiving, he said:

verses.name: Luke 22:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Take this and share it among you. For I tell you that I will not, after today, drink of the juice of the grape, until the kingdom of God has come.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:19
verses.text: Then Jesus took some bread, and, after saying the thanksgiving, broke it and gave to them, with the words: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“This is my body.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet see! The hand of the man who is betraying me is beside me on the table!</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">True, the Son of Man is passing, by the way ordained for him, yet alas for that man by whom he is being betrayed!”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:23
verses.text: Then they began questioning one another which of them it could be who was going to do this.  <div eID="gen7595" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv648"/><div sID="gen7596" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv648"/> And a dispute arose among them as to which of them was to be regarded as the greatest.

verses.name: Luke 22:25
verses.text: Jesus, however, said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their oppressors are styled ‘Benefactors.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But with you it must not be so. No, let the greatest among you become like the youngest, and him who leads like him who serves.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Which is the greater — the master at the table or his servant? Is not it the master at the table? Yet I myself am among you as one who serves.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You are the men who have stood by me in my trials;</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and, just as my Father has assigned me a kingdom, I assign you places,</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and be seated on twelve thrones as judges of the twelve tribes of Israel.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Simon! Simon! listen. Satan demanded leave to sift you all like wheat,</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but I prayed for you, Simon, that your faith should not fail. And you, when you have returned to me, are to strengthen the others.”</q>  <div eID="gen7596" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv649"/><div sID="gen7597" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv649"/> “Master,” said Peter, “with you I am ready to go both to prison and to death.”  <div eID="gen7597" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv650"/><div sID="gen7598" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv650"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I tell you, Peter,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“the cock will not crow today until you have disowned all knowledge of me three times.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:35
verses.text: Then he said to them all: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“When I sent you out as my messengers, without either purse, or bag, or sandals, were you in need of anything?”</q> <div eID="gen7598" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7599" type="paragraph"/> “No; nothing,” they answered.

verses.name: Luke 22:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Now, however,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“he who has a purse must take it and his bag as well; and he who has not must sell his cloak and buy a sword.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, I tell you, that passage of scripture must be fulfilled in me, which says — ‘He was counted among the godless’; indeed all that refers to me is finding its fulfillment.”</q>  <div eID="gen7599" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv651"/><div sID="gen7600" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv651"/> “Master,” they exclaimed, “look, here are two swords!” <div eID="gen7600" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7601" type="paragraph"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Enough!”</q>said Jesus.  <div eID="gen7601" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7590" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv652"/><div sID="gen7602" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv652"/> Jesus then went out, and made his way as usual to the Mount of Olives, followed by his disciples.

verses.name: Luke 22:40
verses.text: And, when he reached the spot, he said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Pray that you may not fall into temptation.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:41
verses.text: Then he withdrew about a stone’s throw, and knelt down and began to pray.

verses.name: Luke 22:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Father,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“if it is your pleasure, spare me this cup; only, not my will but your be done.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:43
verses.text: Presently there appeared to him an angel from heaven, who strengthened him.

verses.name: Luke 22:44
verses.text: And, as his anguish became intense, he prayed still more earnestly, while his sweat was like great drops of blood falling on the ground.

verses.name: Luke 22:45
verses.text: Then he rose from praying, and came to the disciples and found them sleeping for sorrow.

verses.name: Luke 22:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Why are you asleep?”</q>he asked them. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Rise and pray so that you don't fall into temptation.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:47
verses.text: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared in sight, led by the man called Judas, who was one of the Twelve. Judas approached Jesus, to kiss him;

verses.name: Luke 22:48
verses.text: on which Jesus said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Judas, is it by a kiss that you betray the Son of Man?”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:49
verses.text: But when those who were around Jesus saw what was going to happen, they exclaimed: “Master, should we use our swords?”

verses.name: Luke 22:50
verses.text: And one of them struck the high priest’s servant and cut off his right ear;

verses.name: Luke 22:51
verses.text: on which Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Let me at least do this”; and, touching his ear, he healed the wound.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:52
verses.text: Then, turning to the chief priests and officers in charge at the Temple and councillors, who had come for him, he said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Have you come out, as if after a robber, with swords and clubs?</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:53
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">When I was with you day after day in the Temple Courts, you did not lay hands on me; but now your time has come, and the power of darkness.”</q>  <div eID="gen7602" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv653"/><div sID="gen7603" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv653"/> Those who had taken Jesus prisoner took him away into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.

verses.name: Luke 22:55
verses.text: But, when they had lit a fire in the centre of the courtyard and had all sat down there, Peter seated himself in the middle of them.

verses.name: Luke 22:56
verses.text: Presently a maidservant saw him sitting near the blaze of the fire. She looked carefully at him and said: “Why, this man was one of his companions!”

verses.name: Luke 22:57
verses.text: But Peter denied it. “I do not know him,” he replied.

verses.name: Luke 22:58
verses.text: A little while afterwards some one else — a man — saw him and said: “Why, you are one of them!” <div sID="gen7604" type="paragraph"/> “No,” Peter said, “I am not.”

verses.name: Luke 22:59
verses.text: About an hour later another man declared positively: “This man also was certainly with him. Why, he is a Galilean!”

verses.name: Luke 22:60
verses.text: But Peter said: “I do not know what you are speaking about.” Instantly, while he was still speaking, a cock crowed.

verses.name: Luke 22:61
verses.text: And the Master turned and looked at Peter; and Peter remembered the words that the Master had said to him — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Before a cock has crowed today, you will disown me three times”;</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:62
verses.text: and he went outside and wept bitterly.  <div eID="gen7604" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7603" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv654"/><div sID="gen7605" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv654"/> The men who held Jesus kept making sport of him and beating him.

verses.name: Luke 22:64
verses.text: They blindfolded him and then questioned him. “Now play the prophet,” they said; “who was it that struck you?”

verses.name: Luke 22:65
verses.text: And they heaped many other insults on him.  <div eID="gen7605" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv655"/><div sID="gen7606" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv655"/> At daybreak the National Council met — both the chief priests and the teachers of the law — and took Jesus before their High Council.

verses.name: Luke 22:67
verses.text: “If you are the Christ,” they said, “tell us so.” <div sID="gen7607" type="paragraph"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If I tell you,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“you will not believe me;</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:68
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and, if I question you, you will not answer.</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:69
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But from this hour ‘the Son of Man will be seated on the right hand of God Almighty.’”</q>  <div eID="gen7607" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 22:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv656"/><div sID="gen7608" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv656"/> “Are you, then, the Son of God?” they all asked. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It is true,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 22:71
verses.text: At this they exclaimed: “Why do we want any more evidence? We have heard it ourselves from his own lips!”  <div eID="gen7608" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv657"/><div sID="gen7609" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7609" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Luke.22"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:1
verses.text: Then they all rose in a body and led Jesus before Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:2
verses.text: And they began to accuse him: “This is a man whom we found misleading our people, preventing them from paying taxes to the Emperor, and giving out that he himself is ‘Christ, a king.’”

verses.name: Luke 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv657"/><div sID="gen7610" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv657"/> “Are you the king of the Jews?” Pilate asked him. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It is true,”</q>replied Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:4
verses.text: But Pilate, turning to the chief priests and the people, said: “I do not see anything to find fault with in this man.”

verses.name: Luke 23:5
verses.text: But they insisted: “He is stirring up the people by his teaching all through Judea; he began with Galilee and has now come here.”

verses.name: Luke 23:6
verses.text: Hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean;

verses.name: Luke 23:7
verses.text: and, having satisfied himself that Jesus came under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who also was at Jerusalem at the time.

verses.name: Luke 23:8
verses.text: When Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly pleased, for he had been wanting to see him for a long time, having heard a great deal about him; and he was hoping to see some sign given by him.

verses.name: Luke 23:9
verses.text: So he questioned him at some length, but Jesus made no reply.

verses.name: Luke 23:10
verses.text: Meanwhile the chief priests and the teachers of the law stood by and vehemently accused him.

verses.name: Luke 23:11
verses.text: And Herod, with his soldiers, treated Jesus with scorn; he mocked him by throwing a gorgeous robe around him, and then sent him back to Pilate.

verses.name: Luke 23:12
verses.text: And Herod and Pilate became friends that very day, for before that there had been ill-will between them.  <div eID="gen7610" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv658"/><div sID="gen7611" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv658"/> So Pilate summoned the chief priests, and the leading men, and the people,

verses.name: Luke 23:14
verses.text: and said to them: “You brought this man before me charged with misleading the people; and yet, for my part, though I examined him before you, I did not find this man to blame for any of the things of which you accuse him;

verses.name: Luke 23:15
verses.text: nor did Herod either; for he has sent him back to us. And, as a fact, he has not done anything deserving death;

verses.name: Luke 23:16
verses.text: so I will have him scourged, and then release him.”

verses.name: Luke 23:18
verses.text: But they began to shout as one man: “Kill this fellow, but release Barabbas for us.”

verses.name: Luke 23:19
verses.text: (Barabbas was a man who had been put in prison for a riot that had broken out in the city and for murder.)

verses.name: Luke 23:20
verses.text: Pilate, however, wanting to release Jesus, called to them again;

verses.name: Luke 23:21
verses.text: but they kept calling out: “Crucify, crucify him!”  <div eID="gen7611" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv659"/><div sID="gen7612" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv659"/> “Why, what harm has this man done?” Pilate said to them for the third time. “I have found nothing in him for which he could be condemned to death. So I will have him scourged, and then release him.”

verses.name: Luke 23:23
verses.text: But they persisted in loudly demanding his crucifixion; and their clamor gained the day.

verses.name: Luke 23:24
verses.text: Pilate decided that their demand should be granted.

verses.name: Luke 23:25
verses.text: He released the man who had been put in prison for riot and murder, as they demanded, and gave Jesus up to be dealt with as they pleased.  <div eID="gen7612" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7606" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv660"/><div sID="gen7613" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv660"/> And, as they were leading Jesus away, they laid hold of Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and they put the cross on his shoulders, for him to carry it behind Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:27
verses.text: There was a great crowd of people following him, many being women who were beating their breasts and wailing for him.

verses.name: Luke 23:28
verses.text: So Jesus turned and said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Women of Jerusalem, do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.</q>

verses.name: Luke 23:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">A time, I tell you, is coming, when it will be said — ‘Happy are the women who are barren, and those who have never borne children or nursed them!’</q>

verses.name: Luke 23:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">At that time people will begin to say to the mountains ‘Fall on us,’ and to the hills ‘Cover us.’</q>

verses.name: Luke 23:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If what you see is done while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”</q>

verses.name: Luke 23:32
verses.text: There were two others also, criminals, led out to be executed with Jesus.

verses.name: Luke 23:33
verses.text: When they had reached the place called ‘The Skull,’ there they crucified Jesus and the criminals, one on the right, and one on the left.

verses.name: Luke 23:34
verses.text: Then Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Father, forgive them; they do not know what they are doing.”</q>His clothes they divided among them by casting lots.

verses.name: Luke 23:35
verses.text: Meanwhile the people stood looking on. Even the leading men said with a sneer: “He saved others, let him save himself, if he is God’s Christ, his chosen one.”

verses.name: Luke 23:36
verses.text: The soldiers, too, came up in mockery, bringing him common wine,

verses.name: Luke 23:37
verses.text: and saying as they did so: “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself.”

verses.name: Luke 23:38
verses.text: Above him were the words — <lg sID="gen7614"/> <l sID="gen7615"/>‘THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.’<l eID="gen7615"/> <lg eID="gen7614"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:39
verses.text: One of the criminals who were hanging beside Jesus railed at him. “Are not you the Christ? Save yourself and us,” he said.

verses.name: Luke 23:40
verses.text: But the other rebuked him. “Have not you,” he said, “any fear of God, now that you are under the same sentence?

verses.name: Luke 23:41
verses.text: And we justly so, for we are only reaping our deserts, but this man has not done anything wrong.

verses.name: Luke 23:42
verses.text: Jesus,” he went on, “do not forget me when you have come to your kingdom.”

verses.name: Luke 23:43
verses.text: And Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I tell you, this very day you will be with me in Paradise.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 23:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv661"/><div sID="gen7616" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv661"/> It was nearly midday, when a darkness came over the whole country, lasting until three in the afternoon,

verses.name: Luke 23:45
verses.text: the sun being eclipsed; and the Temple curtain was torn down the middle.

verses.name: Luke 23:46
verses.text: Then Jesus, with a loud cry, said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.”</q>And with these words he expired.

verses.name: Luke 23:47
verses.text: The Roman captain, on seeing what had happened, praised God, exclaiming: “This must have been a good man!”

verses.name: Luke 23:48
verses.text: All the people who had collected to see the sight watched what occurred, and then went home beating their breasts.

verses.name: Luke 23:49
verses.text: All the friends of Jesus had been standing at a distance, with the women who accompanied him from Galilee, watching all this.  <div eID="gen7616" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7613" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 23:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv662"/><div sID="gen7617" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv662"/> Now there was a man of the name of Joseph, who was a member of the Council, and who bore a good and upright character.

verses.name: Luke 23:51
verses.text: (This man had not assented to the decision and action of the Council.) He belonged to Ramah, a town in Judea, and lived in expectation of the kingdom of God.

verses.name: Luke 23:52
verses.text: He now went to see Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus;

verses.name: Luke 23:53
verses.text: and, when he had taken it down, he wrapped it in a linen sheet, and laid him in a tomb cut out of stone, in which no one had yet been buried.

verses.name: Luke 23:54
verses.text: It was the Preparation day, and just before the Sabbath began.

verses.name: Luke 23:55
verses.text: The women who had accompanied Jesus from Galilee followed, and saw the tomb and how the body of Jesus was laid,

verses.name: Luke 23:56
verses.text: and then went home, and prepared spices and perfumes.  <div eID="gen7617" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7557" type="majorSection"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv663"/><div sID="gen7618" type="majorSection"/> <title>The Risen Life During the Sabbath they rested, as directed by the commandment.</title> <chapter eID="Luke.23"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:1
verses.text: But very early on the first day of the week they went to the tomb, taking with them the spices that they had prepared.

verses.name: Luke 24:2
verses.text: They found that the stone had been rolled away from the tomb;

verses.name: Luke 24:3
verses.text: and, on going into it, they could not find the body .

verses.name: Luke 24:4
verses.text: While they were at a loss to account for this, all at once two men stood beside them, in dazzling clothing.

verses.name: Luke 24:5
verses.text: But, when in their fear the women bowed their faces to the ground, the men said to them: “Why are you looking among the dead for him who is living?

verses.name: Luke 24:6
verses.text: Remember how he spoke to you before he left Galilee —

verses.name: Luke 24:7
verses.text: How he said that the Son of Man must be betrayed into the hands of wicked men, and be crucified, and rise again on the third day.”

verses.name: Luke 24:8
verses.text: Then they remembered the words of Jesus,

verses.name: Luke 24:9
verses.text: and, on returning from the tomb, they told all this to the Eleven and to all the rest.

verses.name: Luke 24:10
verses.text: There were Mary of Magdala, and Joanna, and Mary, the mother of James. The other women, too, spoke about this to the apostles.

verses.name: Luke 24:11
verses.text: What they said seemed to the apostles mere nonsense, and they did not believe them.

verses.name: Luke 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv663"/><div sID="gen7619" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv663"/> It happened that very day that two of the disciples were going to a village called Emmaus, which was about seven miles from Jerusalem,

verses.name: Luke 24:14
verses.text: talking together, as they went, about all that had just taken place.

verses.name: Luke 24:15
verses.text: While they were talking about these things and discussing them, Jesus himself came up and went on their way with them;

verses.name: Luke 24:16
verses.text: but their eyes were blinded so that they could not recognize him.

verses.name: Luke 24:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What is this that you are saying to each other as you walk along?”</q>Jesus asked. They stopped, with sad looks on their faces,

verses.name: Luke 24:18
verses.text: and then one of them, whose name was Cleopas, said to Jesus: “Are you staying by yourself at Jerusalem, that you have not heard of the things that have happened there within the last few days?”

verses.name: Luke 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv664"/><div sID="gen7620" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv664"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What things do you mean?”</q>asked Jesus. “Why, about Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered, “who, in the eyes of God and all the people, was a prophet, whose power was felt in both his words and actions;

verses.name: Luke 24:20
verses.text: and how the chief priests and our leading men gave him up to be sentenced to death, and afterwards crucified him.

verses.name: Luke 24:21
verses.text: But we were hoping that he was the Destined Deliverer of Israel; yes, and besides all this, it is now three days since these things occurred.

verses.name: Luke 24:22
verses.text: And what is more, some of the women among us have greatly astonished us. They went to the tomb at daybreak

verses.name: Luke 24:23
verses.text: And, not finding the body of Jesus there, came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels who told them that he was alive.

verses.name: Luke 24:24
verses.text: So some of our number went to the tomb and found everything just as the women had said; but they did not see Jesus.”  <div eID="gen7620" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv665"/><div sID="gen7621" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv665"/> Then Jesus said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Foolish men, slow to accept all that the prophets have said!</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Was not the Christ bound to undergo this suffering before entering into his glory?”</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:27
verses.text: Then, beginning with Moses and all the prophets, he explained to them all through the scriptures the passages that referred to himself.

verses.name: Luke 24:28
verses.text: When they got near the village to which they were walking, Jesus appeared to be going further;

verses.name: Luke 24:29
verses.text: but they pressed him not to do so. “Stay with us,” they said, “for it is getting towards evening, and the sun in already low.” So Jesus went in to stay with them.

verses.name: Luke 24:30
verses.text: After he had taken his place at the table with them, he took the bread and said the blessing, and broke it, and gave it to them.

verses.name: Luke 24:31
verses.text: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him; but he disappeared from their sight.

verses.name: Luke 24:32
verses.text: “How our hearts glowed,” the disciples said to each other, “while he was talking to us on the road, and when he explained the scriptures to us!”  <div eID="gen7621" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv666"/><div sID="gen7622" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv666"/> Then they immediately got up and returned to Jerusalem, where they found the Eleven and their companions all together,

verses.name: Luke 24:34
verses.text: who told them that the Master had really risen, and had appeared to Simon.

verses.name: Luke 24:35
verses.text: So they also related what had happened during their walk, and how they had recognized Jesus at the breaking of the bread.

verses.name: Luke 24:36
verses.text: While they were still talking about these things, Jesus himself stood among them.

verses.name: Luke 24:37
verses.text: In their terror and alarm they thought they saw a spirit,

verses.name: Luke 24:38
verses.text: but Jesus said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Why are you so startled? And why do doubts arise in your minds?</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:39
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Look at my hands and my feet, and you will know that it is I. Feel me, and look at me, for a spirit has not flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:41
verses.text: While they were still unable to believe it all, overcome with joy, and were wondering if it were true, Jesus said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Have you anything here to eat?”</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:42
verses.text: They handed him a piece of broiled fish,

verses.name: Luke 24:43
verses.text: and he took it and ate it before their eyes.

verses.name: Luke 24:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“This is what I told you,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“when I was still with you — that everything that had been written about me in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the Psalms, must be fulfilled.”</q>  <div eID="gen7622" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv667"/><div sID="gen7623" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv667"/> Then he enabled them to understand the meaning of the scriptures, saying to them:

verses.name: Luke 24:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Scripture says that the Christ should suffer, and that he should rise again from the dead on the third day,</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and that repentance for forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed on his authority to all the nations — beginning at Jerusalem.</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:48
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You yourselves are to be witnesses to all this.</q>

verses.name: Luke 24:49
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And now I am myself about to send you that which my Father has promised. But you must remain in the city until you have been invested with power from above.”</q>  <div eID="gen7623" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7619" type="section"/>

verses.name: Luke 24:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv668"/><div sID="gen7624" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv668"/> After this, Jesus led them out as far as Bethany, and there raised his hands and blessed them.

verses.name: Luke 24:51
verses.text: As he was in the act of blessing them, he left them.

verses.name: Luke 24:52
verses.text: They returned to Jerusalem full of joy;

verses.name: Luke 24:53
verses.text: and they were constantly in the Temple Courts, blessing God.  <div eID="gen7624" type="section"/> <div eID="gen7618" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Luke.24"/> <div eID="gen7260" osisID="Luke" type="book"/>

verses.name: John 1:1
verses.text: In the beginning the Word was;<l eID="gen7628"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7629"/>and the Word was with God;<l eID="gen7629" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7630"/>and the Word was God.<l eID="gen7630" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7627"/> <lg sID="gen7631"/> <l sID="gen7632"/>

verses.name: John 1:2
verses.text: He was in the beginning with God;<l eID="gen7632"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7633"/>

verses.name: John 1:3
verses.text: through him all things came into being,<l eID="gen7633" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7634"/>and nothing came into being apart from him.<l eID="gen7634" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7635"/>

verses.name: John 1:4
verses.text: That which came into being in him was life;<l eID="gen7635"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7636"/>and the life was the light of humanity;<l eID="gen7636" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7637"/>

verses.name: John 1:5
verses.text: and the light shines in the darkness,<l eID="gen7637" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7638"/>and the darkness never overpowered it.<l eID="gen7638" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7631"/> <lg sID="gen7639"/> <l sID="gen7640"/>

verses.name: John 1:6
verses.text: There appeared a man sent from God, whose name was John;<l eID="gen7640"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7641"/>

verses.name: John 1:7
verses.text: he came as a witness — to bear witness to the light<l eID="gen7641" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7642"/>so that through him everyone might believe.<l eID="gen7642" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7643"/>

verses.name: John 1:8
verses.text: He was not the light,<l eID="gen7643"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7644"/>but he came to bear witness to the light.<l eID="gen7644" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7639"/> <lg sID="gen7645"/> <l sID="gen7646"/>

verses.name: John 1:9
verses.text: That was the true light which enlightens everyone coming into the world.<l eID="gen7646"/> <l sID="gen7647"/>

verses.name: John 1:10
verses.text: He was in the world;<l eID="gen7647"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7648"/>and through him the world came into being —<l eID="gen7648" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7649"/>yet the world did not know him.<l eID="gen7649" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7645"/> <lg sID="gen7650"/> <l sID="gen7651"/>

verses.name: John 1:11
verses.text: He came to his own —<l eID="gen7651"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7652"/>yet his own did not receive him.<l eID="gen7652" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7653"/>

verses.name: John 1:12
verses.text: But to all who did receive him he gave power to become children of God —<l eID="gen7653"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7654"/>to those who believe in his name.<l eID="gen7654" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7655"/>

verses.name: John 1:13
verses.text: For not to natural conception, nor to human instincts, nor to human will did they owe the new life,<l eID="gen7655"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7656"/>but to God.<l eID="gen7656" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7650"/> <lg sID="gen7657"/> <l sID="gen7658"/>

verses.name: John 1:14
verses.text: And the Word became human, and lived among us,<l eID="gen7658"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7659"/>(We saw his glory — the glory of the Only Son sent from the Father),<l eID="gen7659" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7660"/>full of love and truth.<l eID="gen7660" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7661"/>

verses.name: John 1:15
verses.text: (John bears witness to him; he cried aloud — for it was he who spoke —<l eID="gen7661"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7662"/>“‘He who is coming’ after me is now before me,<l eID="gen7662" level="2"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7663"/>for he was ever first”);<l eID="gen7663" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7664"/>

verses.name: John 1:16
verses.text: out of his fullness we have all received some gift,<l eID="gen7664"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7665"/>gift after gift of love;<l eID="gen7665" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7666"/>

verses.name: John 1:17
verses.text: for the law was given through Moses,<l eID="gen7666"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7667"/>love and truth came through Jesus Christ.<l eID="gen7667" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7668"/>

verses.name: John 1:18
verses.text: No one has ever yet seen God;<l eID="gen7668"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7669"/>God the Only Son, who is ever with the Father —<l eID="gen7669" level="2"/> <l sID="gen7670"/>He has revealed him.<l eID="gen7670"/> <lg eID="gen7657"/>  <div eID="gen7626" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: John 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv669"/><div sID="gen7671" type="majorSection"/> <title>The Preparation</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv669"/> When the religious authorities in Jerusalem sent some Priests and Levites to ask John — “Who are you?”,

verses.name: John 1:20
verses.text: he told them clearly and simply: “I am not the Christ.”

verses.name: John 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv670"/><div sID="gen7672" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv670"/> “What then?” they asked. “Are you Elijah?” <div eID="gen7672" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7673" type="paragraph"/> “No,” he said, “I am not.” <div eID="gen7673" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7674" type="paragraph"/> “Are you ‘the prophet’?” He answered, “No.”  <div eID="gen7674" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv671"/><div sID="gen7675" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv671"/> “Who then are you?” they continued; “tell us so that we have an answer to give to those who have sent us. What do you say about yourself?”  <div eID="gen7675" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv672"/><div sID="gen7676" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv672"/> “I,” he answered, “am — <lg sID="gen7677"/> <l sID="gen7678"/>‘The voice of one crying aloud in the wilderness — “make a straight road for the Lord”’,<l eID="gen7678"/> <lg eID="gen7677"/> as the prophet Isaiah said.”  <div eID="gen7676" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv673"/><div sID="gen7679" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv673"/> These men had been sent from the Pharisees;

verses.name: John 1:25
verses.text: and their next question was: “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ or Elijah or ‘the prophet’?”

verses.name: John 1:26
verses.text: John’s answer was — “I baptize with water, but among you stands one whom you do not know;

verses.name: John 1:27
verses.text: he is coming after me, yet I am not worthy even to unfasten his sandal.”

verses.name: John 1:28
verses.text: This happened at Bethany, across the Jordan, where John was baptizing.  <div eID="gen7679" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv674"/><div sID="gen7680" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv674"/> The next day John saw Jesus coming towards him, and exclaimed: “Here is the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.name: John 1:30
verses.text: I was taking about him when I said ‘After me there is coming a man who ranks ahead of me, because before I was born he already was.’

verses.name: John 1:31
verses.text: I did not know who he was, but I have come baptizing with water to make him known to Israel.”

verses.name: John 1:32
verses.text: John also said: <div eID="gen7680" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7681" type="paragraph"/> “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven like a dove and rest on him.

verses.name: John 1:33
verses.text: I myself did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water, he said to me ‘He on whom you see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him — he it is who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’

verses.name: John 1:34
verses.text: This I have seen myself, and I have declared my belief that he is the Son of God.”  <div eID="gen7681" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv675"/><div sID="gen7682" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv675"/> The next day, when John was standing with two of his disciples,

verses.name: John 1:36
verses.text: he looked at Jesus as he passed and exclaimed: “There is the Lamb of God!”

verses.name: John 1:37
verses.text: The two disciples heard him say this, and followed Jesus.

verses.name: John 1:38
verses.text: But Jesus turned around, and saw them following. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What are you looking for?”</q>he asked. “Rabbi,” they answered (or, as we should say, ‘teacher’), “where are you staying?”

verses.name: John 1:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv676"/><div sID="gen7683" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv676"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Come, and you will see,”</q>he replied. So they went, and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him. <div eID="gen7683" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7684" type="paragraph"/> It was then about four in the afternoon.

verses.name: John 1:40
verses.text: One of the two, who heard what John said and followed Jesus, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

verses.name: John 1:41
verses.text: He first found his own brother Simon, and said to him: “We have found the Messiah!” (a word which means ‘Christ,’ or ‘Consecrated’.)

verses.name: John 1:42
verses.text: Then he brought him to Jesus. Looking straight at him, Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You are Simon, the son of John; you will be called Cephas”</q>(which means ‘Peter,’ or ‘Rock’).

verses.name: John 1:43
verses.text: The following day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. He found Philip, and said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Follow me.”</q>

verses.name: John 1:44
verses.text: Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.

verses.name: John 1:45
verses.text: He found Nathanael and said to him: “We have found him of whom Moses wrote in the law, and of whom the prophets also wrote — Jesus of Nazareth, Joseph’s son!”  <div eID="gen7684" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv677"/><div sID="gen7685" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv677"/> “Can anything good come out of Nazareth?” asked Nathanael. “Come and see,” replied Philip.

verses.name: John 1:47
verses.text: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming towards him, he said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit!”</q>  <div eID="gen7685" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv678"/><div sID="gen7686" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv678"/> “How do you know me?” asked Nathanael. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Even before Philip called you,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”</q>  <div eID="gen7686" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv679"/><div sID="gen7687" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv679"/> “Rabbi,” Nathanael exclaimed, “you are the Son of God, you are king of Israel!”  <div eID="gen7687" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 1:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv680"/><div sID="gen7688" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv680"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you believe in me,”</q>asked Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“because I told you that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than those!</q>

verses.name: John 1:51
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you,”</q>he added, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“you will all see heaven open, and ‘the angels of God ascending and descending’ on the Son of Man.”</q>  <div eID="gen7688" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7682" type="section"/> <chapter eID="John.1"/> <div eID="gen7671" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: John 2:1
verses.text: Two days after this there was a wedding at Cana in Galilee, and Jesus’ mother was there.

verses.name: John 2:2
verses.text: Jesus himself, too, with his disciples, was invited to the wedding.

verses.name: John 2:3
verses.text: And, when the wine ran short, his mother said to him: “They have no wine left.”

verses.name: John 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv681"/><div sID="gen7690" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv681"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What do you want with me?”</q>answered Jesus. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“My time has not come yet.”</q>

verses.name: John 2:5
verses.text: His mother said to the servants: “Do whatever he tells you.”

verses.name: John 2:6
verses.text: There were standing there six stone water-jars, in accordance with the Jewish rule of ‘purification,’ each holding twenty or thirty gallons.  <div eID="gen7690" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv682"/><div sID="gen7691" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv682"/> Jesus said to the servants: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Fill the water-jars with water.”</q>

verses.name: John 2:8
verses.text: And, when they had filled them to the brim, he added: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Now take some out, and carry it to the Master of the feast.”</q>The servants did so.

verses.name: John 2:9
verses.text: And, when the Master of the feast had tasted the water which had now become wine, not knowing where it had come from — although the servants who had taken out the water knew —

verses.name: John 2:10
verses.text: He called the groom and said to him: “Everyone puts good wine on the table first, and inferior wine afterwards, when his guests have drunk freely; but you have kept back the good wine till now!”

verses.name: John 2:11
verses.text: This, the first sign of his mission, Jesus gave at Cana in Galilee, and by it revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.  <div eID="gen7691" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv683"/><div sID="gen7692" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv683"/> After this, Jesus went down to Capernaum — he, his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; but they stayed there only a few days.  <div eID="gen7692" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv684"/><div sID="gen7693" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv684"/> Then, as the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 2:14
verses.text: In the Temple Courts he found people who were selling bullocks, sheep, and pigeons, and the money changers at their counters.

verses.name: John 2:15
