verses.text: So he made a whip of cords, and drove them all out of the Temple Courts, and the sheep and bullocks as well; he scattered the money of the money changers, and overturned their tables,

verses.name: John 2:16
verses.text: and said to the pigeon-dealers: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Take these things away. Do not turn my Father’s house into a market house.”</q>

verses.name: John 2:17
verses.text: His disciples remembered that scripture said — ‘Passion for your house will consume me.’

verses.name: John 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv685"/><div sID="gen7694" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv685"/> Then some of the religious authorities asked Jesus: “What sign are you going to show us, since you act in this way?”  <div eID="gen7694" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv686"/><div sID="gen7695" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv686"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Destroy this temple,”</q>was his answer, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and I will raise it in three days.”</q>  <div eID="gen7695" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv687"/><div sID="gen7696" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv687"/> “This Temple,” the authorities replied, “has been forty-six years in building, and are you going to ‘raise it in three days’?”

verses.name: John 2:21
verses.text: But Jesus was speaking of his body as a temple.

verses.name: John 2:22
verses.text: Afterwards, when he had risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this; and they believed the passage of scripture, and the words which Jesus had spoken.  <div eID="gen7696" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7693" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv688"/><div sID="gen7697" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv688"/> While Jesus was in Jerusalem, during the Passover Festival, many came to trust in him, when they saw the signs of his mission that he was giving.

verses.name: John 2:24
verses.text: But Jesus did not put himself in their power because he knew what was in their hearts.

verses.name: John 2:25
verses.text: He did not need anyone to tell him about people because he could read what was in them..  <chapter eID="John.2"/> <div eID="gen7697" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv689"/><div sID="gen7698" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv689"/> Now there was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, who was a leading man among his people.

verses.name: John 3:2
verses.text: This man came to Jesus by night, and said to him: “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God; for no one could give such signs as you are giving, unless God were with him.”

verses.name: John 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv690"/><div sID="gen7699" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv690"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>exclaimed Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“unless a person is reborn, they cannot see the kingdom of God.”</q>  <div eID="gen7699" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv691"/><div sID="gen7700" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv691"/> “How can a person,” asked Nicodemus, “be born when they are old? Can they be born a second time?”  <div eID="gen7700" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv692"/><div sID="gen7701" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv692"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“unless a person owes their birth to water and Spirit, they cannot enter the kingdom of God.</q>

verses.name: John 3:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">All that owes its birth to human nature is human, and all that owes its birth to the Spirit is spiritual.</q>

verses.name: John 3:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not wonder at my telling you that you all need to be reborn.</q>

verses.name: John 3:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The wind blows wherever it wants, and you can hear the sound it makes, but you do not know where it comes from, or where it goes; it is the same with everyone who owes his birth to the Spirit.”</q>  <div eID="gen7701" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv693"/><div sID="gen7702" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv693"/> “How can that be?” asked Nicodemus.

verses.name: John 3:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“What! You a teacher of Israel,”</q>exclaimed Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and yet do not understand this!</q>

verses.name: John 3:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you that we speak of what we know, and state what we have seen; and yet you do not accept our statements.</q>

verses.name: John 3:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If, when I tell you earthly things, you do not believe me, how will you believe me when I tell you of heavenly things?</q>

verses.name: John 3:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">No one has ascended to heaven, except him who descended from heaven — the Son of Man himself.</q>

verses.name: John 3:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, as Moses lifted up the snake<note>A bronze snake on a pole, see Num 21:9</note>. in the desert, so must the Son of Man be lifted up;</q>

verses.name: John 3:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">so that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life.”</q>  <div eID="gen7702" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv694"/><div sID="gen7703" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv694"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">For God so loved the world, that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him may not be lost, but have eternal life.</q>

verses.name: John 3:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but so that the world might be saved through him.</q>

verses.name: John 3:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who believes in him escapes condemnation, while the person who does not believe in him is already condemned, because they have not believed in the only Son of God.</q>

verses.name: John 3:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The ground of their condemnation is this, that though the light has come into the world, people preferred the darkness to the light, because their actions were wicked.</q>

verses.name: John 3:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For the person who lives an evil life hates the light, and will not come to it, fearing that their actions will be exposed;</q>

verses.name: John 3:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but the person who lives by the truth comes into the light, so it can be clearly seen that God is in all they do.</q>  <div eID="gen7703" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7698" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv695"/><div sID="gen7704" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv695"/> After this, Jesus went with his disciples into the country parts of Judea; and there he stayed with them, and baptized.

verses.name: John 3:23
verses.text: John, also, was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there were many streams there; and people were constantly coming and being baptized.

verses.name: John 3:24
verses.text: (For John had not yet been imprisoned).

verses.name: John 3:25
verses.text: Now a discussion arose between some of John’s disciples and a fellow Jew on the subject of ‘purification;’

verses.name: John 3:26
verses.text: and the disciples came to John and said: “Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, and to whom you have yourself borne testimony — he, also, is baptizing, and everybody is going to him.”

verses.name: John 3:27
verses.text: John’s answer was — “A person can gain nothing but what is given them from heaven.

verses.name: John 3:28
verses.text: You are yourselves witnesses that I said ‘I am not the Christ,’ but ‘I have been sent before him as a messenger.’

verses.name: John 3:29
verses.text: It is the groom who has the bride; but the groom’s friend, who stands by and listens to him, is filled with joy when he hears the groom’s voice. This joy I have felt to the full.

verses.name: John 3:30
verses.text: He must become greater, and I less.”

verses.name: John 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv696"/><div sID="gen7705" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv696"/> He who comes from above is above all others; but a child of earth is earthly, and his teaching is earthly, too. He who comes from heaven is above all others.

verses.name: John 3:32
verses.text: He states what he has seen and what he heard, and yet no one accepts his statement.

verses.name: John 3:33
verses.text: They who did accept his statement confirm the fact that God is true.

verses.name: John 3:34
verses.text: For he whom God sent as his messenger gives us God’s own teaching, for God does not limit the gift of the Spirit.

verses.name: John 3:35
verses.text: The Father loves his Son, and has put everything in his hands.

verses.name: John 3:36
verses.text: The person who believes in the Son has eternal life, while a person who rejects the Son will not even see that life, but remains under ‘God’s displeasure.’  <div eID="gen7705" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.3"/> <div eID="gen7704" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv697"/><div sID="gen7706" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv697"/> Now, when the Master heard that the Pharisees had been told that he was making and baptizing more disciples than John

verses.name: John 4:2
verses.text: (Though it was not Jesus himself, but his disciples, who baptized),

verses.name: John 4:3
verses.text: he left Judea, and set out again for Galilee.

verses.name: John 4:4
verses.text: He had to pass through Samaria,

verses.name: John 4:5
verses.text: and, on his way, he came to a Samaritan town called Shechem, near the plot of land that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.name: John 4:6
verses.text: Jacob’s Spring was there, and Jesus, being tired after his journey, sat down beside the spring, just as he was. It was then about midday.

verses.name: John 4:7
verses.text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water; and Jesus said to her — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Give me some to drink,”</q>

verses.name: John 4:8
verses.text: For his disciples had gone into the town to buy food.

verses.name: John 4:9
verses.text: “How is it,” replied the Samaritan woman, “that you who are a Jew ask for water from a Samaritan woman like me?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans).

verses.name: John 4:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If you knew of the gift of God,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and who it is that is saying to you ‘Give me some water,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you ‘living water’.”</q>

verses.name: John 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv698"/><div sID="gen7707" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv698"/> “You have no bucket, Sir, and the well is deep,” she said; “where did you get that ‘living water?’

verses.name: John 4:12
verses.text: Surely you are not greater than our ancestor Jacob who gave us the well, and used to drink from it himself, and his sons, and his cattle!”  <div eID="gen7707" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv699"/><div sID="gen7708" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv699"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“All who drink of this water,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“will be thirsty again;</q>

verses.name: John 4:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but whoever once drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst any more; but the water that I will give him will become a spring welling up within him — a source of eternal life.”</q>  <div eID="gen7708" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv700"/><div sID="gen7709" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv700"/> “Give me this water, Sir,” said the woman, “so that I may not be thirsty, nor have to come all the way here to draw water.”  <div eID="gen7709" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv701"/><div sID="gen7710" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv701"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go and call your husband,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and then come back.”</q>  <div eID="gen7710" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv702"/><div sID="gen7711" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv702"/> “I have no husband,” answered the woman. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You are right in saying ‘I have no husband,’”</q>replied Jesus,

verses.name: John 4:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“For you have had five husbands, and the man with whom you are now living is not your husband; in saying that, you have spoken the truth.”</q>  <div eID="gen7711" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv703"/><div sID="gen7712" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv703"/> “I see, Sir, that you are a prophet!” exclaimed the woman.

verses.name: John 4:20
verses.text: “It was on this mountain that our ancestors worshiped; and yet you Jews say that the proper place for worship is in Jerusalem.”  <div eID="gen7712" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv704"/><div sID="gen7713" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv704"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Believe me,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“a time is coming when it will be neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem that you will worship the Father.</q>

verses.name: John 4:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You Samaritans do not know what you worship; we know what we worship, for salvation comes from the Jews.</q>

verses.name: John 4:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But a time is coming, indeed it is already here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father spiritually and truly; for such are the worshipers that the Father desires.</q>

verses.name: John 4:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">God is Spirit; and those who worship him must worship spiritually and truly.”</q>  <div eID="gen7713" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv705"/><div sID="gen7714" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv705"/> “I know,” answered the woman, “that the Messiah, who is called the Christ, is coming; when once he has come, he will tell us everything.”  <div eID="gen7714" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv706"/><div sID="gen7715" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv706"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am he,”</q>Jesus said to her, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I who am speaking to you.”</q>

verses.name: John 4:27
verses.text: At this moment his disciples came up, and were surprised to find him talking with a woman; but none of them asked ‘What do you want?’ or ‘Why are you talking with her?’

verses.name: John 4:28
verses.text: So the woman, leaving her pitcher, went back to the town, and said to the people:

verses.name: John 4:29
verses.text: “Come and see someone who has told me everything that I have done. Can he be the Christ?”

verses.name: John 4:30
verses.text: And the people left the town and went to see Jesus.  <div eID="gen7715" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv707"/><div sID="gen7716" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv707"/> Meanwhile the disciples kept saying to him: “Take something to eat, Rabbi.”  <div eID="gen7716" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv708"/><div sID="gen7717" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv708"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have food to eat,”</q>he answered, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“of which you know nothing.”</q>  <div eID="gen7717" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv709"/><div sID="gen7718" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv709"/> “Can anyone have brought him anything to eat?” the disciples said to one another.

verses.name: John 4:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“My food,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“is to do the will of him who sent me, and to complete his work.</q>

verses.name: John 4:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not you say that it still wants four months to harvest? Why, look up, and see how white the fields are for harvest!</q>

verses.name: John 4:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Already the reaper is receiving wages and gathering in sheaves for eternal life, so that sower and reaper rejoice together.</q>

verses.name: John 4:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For here the proverb holds good — ‘One sows, another reaps.’</q>

verses.name: John 4:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have sent you to reap that on which you have spent no labor; others have labored, and you have reaped the results of their labor.”</q>  <div eID="gen7718" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 4:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv710"/><div sID="gen7719" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv710"/> Many from that town came to believe in Jesus — Samaritans though they were — because the woman had said: ‘He has told me everything that I have done.’

verses.name: John 4:40
verses.text: And, when these Samaritans had come to Jesus, they begged him to stay with them, and he stayed there two days.

verses.name: John 4:41
verses.text: But far more came to believe in him because of what he said himself,

verses.name: John 4:42
verses.text: and they said to the woman: “It is no longer because of what you say that we believe in him, for we have heard him ourselves and know that he really is the Savior of the world.”  <div eID="gen7719" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7706" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 4:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv711"/><div sID="gen7720" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv711"/> After these two days Jesus went on to Galilee;

verses.name: John 4:44
verses.text: for he himself declared that ‘a prophet is not honored in his own country.’

verses.name: John 4:45
verses.text: When he entered Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him, for they had seen all that he did at Jerusalem during the Festival, at which they also had been present.

verses.name: John 4:46
verses.text: So Jesus came again to Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. Now there was one of the king’s officers whose son was lying ill at Capernaum.

verses.name: John 4:47
verses.text: When this man heard that Jesus had returned from Judea to Galilee, he went to him, and begged him to come down and cure his son; for he was at the point of death.

verses.name: John 4:48
verses.text: Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Unless you all see signs and wonders, you will not believe.”</q>

verses.name: John 4:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv712"/><div sID="gen7721" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv712"/> “Sir,” said the officer, “come down before my child dies.” And Jesus answered: “Go, your son is living.”

verses.name: John 4:50
verses.text: The man believed what Jesus said to him, and went;

verses.name: John 4:51
verses.text: and, while he was on his way down, his servants met him, and told him that his child was living.

verses.name: John 4:52
verses.text: So he asked them at what time the boy began to get better. “It was yesterday, about one o’clock,” they said, “that the fever left him.”

verses.name: John 4:53
verses.text: By this the father knew that it was at the very time when Jesus had said to him <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Your son is living’</q>; and he himself, with all his household, believed in Jesus.

verses.name: John 4:54
verses.text: This was the second occasion on which Jesus gave a sign of his mission on coming from Judea to Galilee.  <div eID="gen7721" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.4"/> <div eID="gen7720" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv713"/><div sID="gen7722" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv713"/> Sometime after this there was a Jewish Festival; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 5:2
verses.text: There is in Jerusalem, near the sheep-gate, a bath with five colonnades around it. It is called in Hebrew ‘Bethesda.’

verses.name: John 5:3
verses.text: In these colonnades a large number of sick people were lying — blind, lame, and crippled.

verses.name: John 5:5
verses.text: One man who was there had been crippled for thirty-eight years.

verses.name: John 5:6
verses.text: Jesus saw the man lying there, and, finding that he had been in this state a long time, said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you wish to be cured?”</q>

verses.name: John 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv714"/><div sID="gen7723" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv714"/> “I have no one, Sir,” the sick man answered, “to put me into the bath when there is a troubling of the water, and, while I am getting to it, some one else steps down before me.”  <div eID="gen7723" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv715"/><div sID="gen7724" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv715"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Stand up,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“take up your mat, and walk.”</q>

verses.name: John 5:9
verses.text: The man was cured immediately, and took up his mat and began walking.

verses.name: John 5:10
verses.text: Now it was the Sabbath. So the religious authorities said to the man who had been cured: “This is the Sabbath; you must not carry your mat.”  <div eID="gen7724" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv716"/><div sID="gen7725" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv716"/> “The man who cured me,” he answered, “said to me <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Take up your mat and walk.’”</q>  <div eID="gen7725" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv717"/><div sID="gen7726" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv717"/> “Who was it,” they asked, “that said to you <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Take up your mat and walk’?”</q>

verses.name: John 5:13
verses.text: But the man who had been restored did not know who it was; for Jesus had moved away, because there was a crowd there.

verses.name: John 5:14
verses.text: Afterwards Jesus found the man in the Temple Courts, and said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You are cured now; do not sin again, or something worse may happen to you.”</q>  <div eID="gen7726" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv718"/><div sID="gen7727" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv718"/> The man went away, and told the authorities that it was Jesus who had cured him.

verses.name: John 5:16
verses.text: And that was why they began to persecute Jesus — because he did things of this kind on the Sabbath.

verses.name: John 5:17
verses.text: But Jesus replied: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“My Father works to this very hour, and I work also.”</q>

verses.name: John 5:18
verses.text: This made the authorities all the more eager to kill him, because not only was he doing away with the Sabbath, but he actually called God his own Father — putting himself on an equality with God.

verses.name: John 5:19
verses.text: So Jesus made this further reply: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself; he does only what he sees the Father doing; whatever the Father does, the Son does also.</q>

verses.name: John 5:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For the Father loves his Son, and shows him everything that he is doing; and he will show him still greater things — so that you will be filled with wonder.</q>

verses.name: John 5:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom he pleases.</q>

verses.name: John 5:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The Father himself does not judge any one, but has ‘entrusted the work of judging entirely to his Son,’</q>

verses.name: John 5:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">So that everyone may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father. The person who does not honor the Son fails to honor the Father who sent him.</q>

verses.name: John 5:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you that the person who listens to my message and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and does not come under condemnation, but has already passed out of death into life.</q>

verses.name: John 5:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you that a time is coming, indeed it is already here, when the dead will listen to the voice of the Son of God, and when those who listen will live.</q>

verses.name: John 5:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, just as the Father has inherent life within him, so also he has granted to the Son to have inherent life within him;</q>

verses.name: John 5:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and, because he is Son of Man, he has also given him authority to act as judge.</q>

verses.name: John 5:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not wonder at this; for the time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice,</q>

verses.name: John 5:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and will come out — those who have done good rising to life, and those who have lived evil lives rising for condemnation.</q>

verses.name: John 5:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I can do nothing of myself; I judge as I am taught; and the judgment that I give is just, because my aim is not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.</q>  <div eID="gen7727" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv719"/><div sID="gen7728" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv719"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">If I bear testimony to myself, my testimony is not trustworthy;</q>

verses.name: John 5:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">it is another who bears testimony to me, and I know that the testimony which he bears to me is trustworthy.</q>

verses.name: John 5:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You have yourselves sent to John, and he as testified to the truth.</q>

verses.name: John 5:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But the testimony which I receive is not from people; I am saying this for your salvation.</q>

verses.name: John 5:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He was the ‘Lamp that was burning’ and shining, and you were ready to rejoice, for a time, in his light.</q>

verses.name: John 5:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But the testimony which I have is of greater weight than John’s; for the work that the Father has given me to carry out — the work that I am doing — is in itself proof that the Father has sent me as his messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 5:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The Father who has sent me has himself borne testimony to me. You have neither listened to his voice, not seen his form;</q>

verses.name: John 5:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you have not taken his message home to your hearts, because you do not believe him whom he sent as his messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 5:39
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You search the scriptures, because you think that you find in them immortal life;</q>and, though it is those scriptures that bear testimony to me,

verses.name: John 5:40
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">you refuse to come to me to have life.</q>  <div eID="gen7728" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 5:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv720"/><div sID="gen7729" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv720"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">I do not receive honor from people,</q>

verses.name: John 5:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but I know this of you, that you have not the love of God in your hearts.</q>

verses.name: John 5:43
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not receive me; if another comes in his own name, you will receive him.</q>

verses.name: John 5:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">How can you believe in me, when you receive honor from one another and do not desire the honor which comes from the only God?</q>

verses.name: John 5:45
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father; your accuser is Moses, on whom you have been resting your hopes.</q>

verses.name: John 5:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For, had you believed Moses, you would have believed me, for it was of me that Moses wrote;</q>

verses.name: John 5:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but, if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe my teaching?”</q>  <div eID="gen7729" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.5"/> <div eID="gen7722" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv721"/><div sID="gen7730" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv721"/> After this, Jesus crossed the Sea of Galilee — otherwise called the Lake of Tiberias.

verses.name: John 6:2
verses.text: A great crowd of people, however, followed him, because they saw the signs of his mission in his work among those who were sick.

verses.name: John 6:3
verses.text: Jesus went up the hill, and sat down there with his disciples.

verses.name: John 6:4
verses.text: It was near the time of the Jewish Festival of the Passover.

verses.name: John 6:5
verses.text: Looking up, and noticing that a great crowd was coming towards him, Jesus said to Philip: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Where are we to buy bread for these people to eat?”</q>

verses.name: John 6:6
verses.text: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he meant to do.

verses.name: John 6:7
verses.text: “Even if we spent a years' wages on bread,” answered Philip, “it would not be enough for each of them to have a little.”

verses.name: John 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv722"/><div sID="gen7731" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv722"/> “There is a boy here,” said Andrew, another of his disciples, Simon Peter’s brother,

verses.name: John 6:9
verses.text: “Who has five barley loaves and two fishes; but what is that for so many?”  <div eID="gen7731" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv723"/><div sID="gen7732" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv723"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Make the people sit down,”</q>said Jesus. It was a grassy spot; so the people, who numbered about five thousand, sat down,

verses.name: John 6:11
verses.text: and then Jesus took the loaves, and, after saying the thanksgiving, distributed them to those who were sitting down; and the same with the fish, giving the people as much as they wanted.

verses.name: John 6:12
verses.text: When they were satisfied, Jesus said to his disciples: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Collect the broken pieces that are left, so that nothing may be wasted.”</q>

verses.name: John 6:13
verses.text: The disciples did so, and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves, which were left after all had eaten.  <div eID="gen7732" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv724"/><div sID="gen7733" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv724"/> When the people saw the signs which Jesus gave, they said: “This is certainly ‘the prophet who was to come’ into the world.”

verses.name: John 6:15
verses.text: But Jesus, having discovered that they were intending to come and carry him off to make him king, went again up the hill, quite alone.  <div eID="gen7733" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv725"/><div sID="gen7734" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv725"/> When evening fell, his disciples went down to the Sea,

verses.name: John 6:17
verses.text: and, getting into a boat, began to cross to Capernaum. By this time darkness had set in, and Jesus had not yet come back to them;

verses.name: John 6:18
verses.text: the Sea, too, was getting rough, for a strong wind was blowing.

verses.name: John 6:19
verses.text: When they had rowed three or four miles, they caught sight of him walking on the water and approaching the boat, and they were frightened.

verses.name: John 6:20
verses.text: But Jesus said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It is I; do not be afraid!”</q>

verses.name: John 6:21
verses.text: And after this they were glad to take him into the boat; and the boat at once arrived off the shore, for which they had been making.  <div eID="gen7734" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7730" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv726"/><div sID="gen7735" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv726"/> The people who remained on the further side of the Sea had seen that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not gone into it with his disciples, but that they had left without him.

verses.name: John 6:23
verses.text: Some boats, however, had come from Tiberias, from near the spot where they had eaten the bread after the Master had said the thanksgiving.

verses.name: John 6:24
verses.text: So, on the next day, when the people saw that Jesus was not there, or his disciples either, they themselves got into the boats, and went to Capernaum to look for him.

verses.name: John 6:25
verses.text: And, when they found him on the other side of the Sea, they said: “When did you get here, Rabbi?”

verses.name: John 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv727"/><div sID="gen7736" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv727"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“it is not because of the signs which you saw that you are looking for me, but because you had the bread to eat and were satisfied.</q>

verses.name: John 6:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Work, not for the food that perishes, but for the food that lasts for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you; for on him the Father — God himself — has set the seal of his approval.”</q>  <div eID="gen7736" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv728"/><div sID="gen7737" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv728"/> “How,” they asked, “are we to do the work that God wants us to do?”  <div eID="gen7737" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv729"/><div sID="gen7738" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv729"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“The work that God wants you to do,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“is to believe in him whom God sent as his messenger.”</q>  <div eID="gen7738" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv730"/><div sID="gen7739" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv730"/> “What sign, then,” they asked, “are you giving, which we may see, and so believe you? What is the work that you are doing?

verses.name: John 6:31
verses.text: Our ancestors had the manna to eat in the desert; as scripture says — ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”  <div eID="gen7739" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv731"/><div sID="gen7740" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv731"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but my Father does give you the true bread from heaven;</q>

verses.name: John 6:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for the bread that God gives is that which comes down from heaven, and gives life to the world.”</q>  <div eID="gen7740" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv732"/><div sID="gen7741" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv732"/> “Master,” they exclaimed, “give us that bread always!”  <div eID="gen7741" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv733"/><div sID="gen7742" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv733"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am the life-giving bread,”</q>Jesus said to them; <q marker="" who="Jesus">“whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never thirst again.</q>

verses.name: John 6:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, as I have said already, you have seen me, and yet you do not believe in me.</q>

verses.name: John 6:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">All those whom the Father gives me will come to me; and no one who comes to me will I ever turn away.</q>

verses.name: John 6:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For I have come down from heaven, to do, not my own will, but the will of him who sent me;</q>

verses.name: John 6:39
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and his will is this — that I should not lose one of all those whom he has given me, but should raise them up at the Last day.</q>

verses.name: John 6:40
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For it is the will of my Father that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have immortal life; and I myself will raise him up at the Last day.”</q>  <div eID="gen7742" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv734"/><div sID="gen7743" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv734"/> The people began murmuring against Jesus for saying — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘I am the bread which came down from heaven.’</q>

verses.name: John 6:42
verses.text: “Is not this Jesus, Joseph’s son,” they asked, “whose father and mother we know? How is it that he now says that he has come down from heaven?”  <div eID="gen7743" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv735"/><div sID="gen7744" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv735"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do not murmur among yourselves,”</q>said Jesus in reply.

verses.name: John 6:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me draws him to me; and I will raise him up at the Last day.</q>

verses.name: John 6:45
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is said in the prophets — ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who is taught by the Father and learns from him comes to me.</q>

verses.name: John 6:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Not that anyone has seen the Father, except him who is from God — he has seen the Father.</q>

verses.name: John 6:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, the person who believes in me has eternal life.</q>

verses.name: John 6:48
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the life-giving bread.</q>

verses.name: John 6:49
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Your ancestors ate the manna in the desert, and yet died.</q>

verses.name: John 6:50
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The bread that comes down from heaven is such that whoever eats of it will never die.</q>

verses.name: John 6:51
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the living bread that has come down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, they will live for ever; and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.”</q>  <div eID="gen7744" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv736"/><div sID="gen7745" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv736"/> They began disputing with one another: “How is it possible for this man to give us his flesh to eat?”  <div eID="gen7745" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv737"/><div sID="gen7746" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv737"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man, and drink his blood, you have not life within you.</q>

verses.name: John 6:54
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everyone who takes my flesh for their food, and drinks my blood, has eternal life; and I will raise them up at the Last day.</q>

verses.name: John 6:55
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For my flesh is true food, and my blood true drink.</q>

verses.name: John 6:56
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everyone who takes my flesh for their food, and drinks my blood, remains united to me, and I to them.</q>

verses.name: John 6:57
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As the living Father sent me as his messenger, and as I live because the Father lives, so the person who takes me for their food will live because I live.</q>

verses.name: John 6:58
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">That is the bread which has come down from heaven — not such as your ancestors ate, and yet died; the person who takes this bread for their food will live for ever.”</q>  <div eID="gen7746" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv738"/><div sID="gen7747" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv738"/> All this Jesus said in a synagogue, when he was teaching in Capernaum.

verses.name: John 6:60
verses.text: On hearing it, many of his disciples said: “This is harsh doctrine! Who can bear to listen to it?”

verses.name: John 6:61
verses.text: But Jesus, aware that his disciples were murmuring about it, said to them:

verses.name: John 6:62
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Is this a hindrance to you? What, then, if you should see the Son of Man ascending where he was before?</q>

verses.name: John 6:63
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is the Spirit that gives life; human strength achieves nothing. In the teaching that I have been giving you there is Spirit and there is life.</q>

verses.name: John 6:64
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet there are some of you who do not believe in me.”</q>For Jesus knew from the first who they were that did not believe in him, and who it was that would betray him;

verses.name: John 6:65
verses.text: and he added: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“This is why I told you that no one can come to me, unless enabled by the Father.”</q>

verses.name: John 6:66
verses.text: After this many of his disciples drew back, and did not go about with him any longer.

verses.name: John 6:67
verses.text: So Jesus said to the Twelve: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you also wish to leave me?”</q>

verses.name: John 6:68
verses.text: But Simon Peter answered: “Master, to whom would we go? Eternal life is in your teaching;

verses.name: John 6:69
verses.text: and we have learned to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.”  <div eID="gen7747" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 6:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv739"/><div sID="gen7748" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv739"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Did not I myself choose you to be the Twelve?”</q>replied Jesus; <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and yet, even of you, one is playing the ‘devil’s’ part.”</q>

verses.name: John 6:71
verses.text: He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who was about to betray him, though he was one of the Twelve.  <div eID="gen7748" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.6"/> <div eID="gen7735" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv740"/><div sID="gen7749" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv740"/> After this, Jesus went about in Galilee, for he would not do so in Judea, because the religious authorities (in Jerusalem) were eager to put him to death.

verses.name: John 7:2
verses.text: When the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,

verses.name: John 7:3
verses.text: his brothers said to him: “Leave this part of the country, and go into Judea, so that your disciples, as well as we, may see the work that you are doing.

verses.name: John 7:4
verses.text: For no one does a thing privately, if they are seeking to be widely known. Since you do these things, you should show yourself publicly to the world.”

verses.name: John 7:5
verses.text: For even his brothers did not believe in him.

verses.name: John 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv741"/><div sID="gen7750" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv741"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“My time,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“is not come yet, but your time is always here.</q>

verses.name: John 7:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The world cannot hate you, but it does hate me, because I testify that its ways are evil.</q>

verses.name: John 7:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Go yourselves up to the Festival; I am not going to this Festival yet, because my time has not yet come.”</q>

verses.name: John 7:9
verses.text: After telling them this, he stayed on in Galilee.  <div eID="gen7750" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv742"/><div sID="gen7751" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv742"/> But, when his brothers had gone up to the Festival, Jesus also went up — not publicly, but privately.

verses.name: John 7:11
verses.text: The authorities were looking for him at the Festival and asking ‘Where is he?’;

verses.name: John 7:12
verses.text: and there were many whispers about him among the people, some saying ‘He is a good man;’ others: ‘No! He is leading the people astray.’

verses.name: John 7:13
verses.text: No one, however, spoke freely about him, because they were afraid of the authoritites.  <div eID="gen7751" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7749" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv743"/><div sID="gen7752" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv743"/> About the middle of the Festival week, Jesus went up into the Temple Courts, and began teaching.

verses.name: John 7:15
verses.text: The authorities were astonished. “How has this man got his learning,” they asked, “when he has never studied?”

verses.name: John 7:16
verses.text: So, in reply, Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“My teaching is not my own; it is his who sent me.</q>

verses.name: John 7:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If anyone has the will to do God’s will, they will find out whether my teaching is from God, or whether I speak on my own authority.</q>

verses.name: John 7:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who speaks on their own authority seeks honor for themselves; but the person who seeks the honor of him that sent him is sincere, and there is nothing false in him.</q>

verses.name: John 7:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Was not it Moses who gave you the law? Yet not one of you obeys it! Why are you seeking to put me to death?”</q>

verses.name: John 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv744"/><div sID="gen7753" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv744"/> “You must be possessed by a demon!” the people exclaimed. “Who is seeking to put you to death?”  <div eID="gen7753" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv745"/><div sID="gen7754" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv745"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“There was one thing I did,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“at which you are all still wondering.</q>

verses.name: John 7:22
verses.text: “Is he going to kill himself,” they exclaimed, “that he says — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘You cannot go where I am going’?”</q>

verses.name: John 7:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">When a man receives circumcision on a Sabbath to prevent the law of Moses from being broken, how can you be angry with me for making a man sound and well on a Sabbath?</q>

verses.name: John 7:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not judge by appearances; judge justly.”</q>

verses.name: John 7:25
verses.text: At this some of the people of Jerusalem exclaimed: “Is not this the man who they are seeking to put to death?

verses.name: John 7:26
verses.text: Yet here he is, speaking out boldly, and they say nothing to him! Is it possible that our leading men have really discovered that he is the Christ?

verses.name: John 7:27
verses.text: Yet we know where this man is from; but, when the Christ comes, no one will be able to tell where he is from.”

verses.name: John 7:28
verses.text: Therefore, Jesus, as he was teaching in the Temple Courts, raised his voice and said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Yes; you know me and you know where I am from. Yet I have not come on my own authority, but he who sent me may be trusted; and him you do not know.</q>

verses.name: John 7:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I do know him, for it is from him that I have come, and he sent me as his messenger.”</q>

verses.name: John 7:30
verses.text: So they sought to arrest him; but no one touched him, for his time was not come yet.

verses.name: John 7:31
verses.text: Many of the people, however, believed in him. “When the Christ comes,” they said, “will he give more signs of his mission than this man has given?”

verses.name: John 7:32
verses.text: The Pharisees heard the people whispering about him in this way, and so the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him;

verses.name: John 7:33
verses.text: on which Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I will be with you but a little longer, and then I am going to him who sent me.</q>

verses.name: John 7:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You will look for me, and you will not find me; and you will not be able to come where I will be.”</q>  <div eID="gen7754" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv746"/><div sID="gen7755" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv746"/> “Where is this man going,” the people asked one another, “that we would not find him? Will he go to our countrymen abroad, and teach foreigners?

verses.name: John 7:36
verses.text: What does he mean by saying <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘You will look for me, and you will not find me; and you will not be able to come where I will be’?”</q>  <div eID="gen7755" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7752" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv747"/><div sID="gen7756" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv747"/> On the last and greatest day of the Festival, Jesus, who was standing by, exclaimed: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If anyone thirsts, let him come to me, and drink.</q>

verses.name: John 7:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I tell you what I have myself seen in the presence of my Father; and you, in the same way, do what you have learned from your father.”</q>

verses.name: John 7:39
verses.text: (By this he meant the Spirit, which those who had believed in him were to receive; for the Spirit had not yet come, because Jesus had not yet been exalted.)

verses.name: John 7:40
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, as it is, you are seeking to put me to death — a man who has told you the truth as he heard it from God. Abraham did not act in that way.</q>

verses.name: John 7:41
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You are doing what your own father does.”</q> <div sID="gen7757" type="paragraph"/> “We are not bastards,” they said, “we have one Father — God himself.”

verses.name: John 7:42
verses.text: Is not it said in scripture that it is of the race of David, and from Bethlehem, the village to which David belonged, that the Christ is to come?”

verses.name: John 7:43
verses.text: So there was a sharp division among the people because of Jesus.

verses.name: John 7:44
verses.text: Some of them wanted to arrest him, and yet no one touched him.

verses.name: John 7:45
verses.text: When the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked: “Why have you not brought him?”  <div eID="gen7757" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv748"/><div sID="gen7758" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv748"/> “No one ever spoke as he speaks!” they answered.

verses.name: John 7:47
verses.text: “What! Have you been led astray too?” the Pharisees replied.

verses.name: John 7:48
verses.text: “Have any of our leading men believed in him, or any of the Pharisees?

verses.name: John 7:49
verses.text: As for these people who do not know the Law — they are cursed!

verses.name: John 7:50
verses.text: But one of their number, Nicodemus, who before this had been to see Jesus, said to them:

verses.name: John 7:51
verses.text: “Does our law pass judgment on a person without first giving them a hearing, and finding out what they have been doing?”  <div eID="gen7758" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 7:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv749"/><div sID="gen7759" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv749"/> “Are you also from Galilee?” they retorted. “Search, and you will find that no prophet is to arise in Galilee!”  <div eID="gen7759" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7756" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 7:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv750"/><div sID="gen7760" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv750"/> And everyone went home  <chapter eID="John.7"/>

verses.name: John 8:1
verses.text: except Jesus, who went to the Mount of Olives<note>This passage is inserted in some manuscripts from an ancient source, and found either after John 7:53 or after Luke 21.38 or elsewhere.</note>.

verses.name: John 8:2
verses.text: But he went again into the Temple Courts early in the morning, and all the people came to him; and he sat down and taught them.

verses.name: John 8:3
verses.text: Presently, however, the Teachers of the Law and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery, and placed her in the middle of the Court,

verses.name: John 8:4
verses.text: and said to Jesus: <div sID="gen7761" type="paragraph"/> “Teacher, this woman was found in the act of adultery. Now Moses,in the Law, commanded us to stone such women to death; what do you say?”  <div eID="gen7761" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv751"/><div sID="gen7762" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv751"/> They said this to test him, in order to have a charge to bring against him. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.

verses.name: John 8:7
verses.text: However, as they continued asking him, he raised himself, and said: <div eID="gen7762" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7763" type="paragraph"/> “Let the person among you who has never done wrong throw the first stone at her.”

verses.name: John 8:8
verses.text: <div eID="gen7763" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7764" type="paragraph"/> And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

verses.name: John 8:9
verses.text: When they heard that, they went out one by one, beginning with the eldest; and Jesus was left alone with the woman in the middle of the Court.

verses.name: John 8:10
verses.text: Raising himself, Jesus said to her: <div eID="gen7764" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7765" type="paragraph"/> “Woman, where are they? Did no one condemn you?”

verses.name: John 8:11
verses.text: <div eID="gen7765" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7766" type="paragraph"/> “No one, Sir,” she answered. <div eID="gen7766" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7767" type="paragraph"/> “Neither do I condemn you,” said Jesus “go, and do not sin again.”  <div eID="gen7767" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7760" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv752"/><div sID="gen7768" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv752"/> Jesus again addressed the people. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am the light of the world,”</q>he said. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“The person who follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv753"/><div sID="gen7769" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv753"/> “You are bearing testimony to yourself!” exclaimed the Pharisees, “your testimony is not trustworthy.”  <div eID="gen7769" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv754"/><div sID="gen7770" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv754"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Even if I bear testimony to myself,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“my testimony is trustworthy; for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from, nor where I am going.</q>

verses.name: John 8:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You judge by appearances; I judge no one.</q>

verses.name: John 8:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet, even if I were to judge, my judgment would be trustworthy; because I am not alone, but the Father who sent me is with me.</q>

verses.name: John 8:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Why, in your own law it is said that the testimony of two persons is trustworthy.</q>

verses.name: John 8:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I, who bear testimony to myself, am one, and the Father who sent me also bears testimony to me.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Where is your father, then?”</q>they asked. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You know neither me nor my Father,”</q>replied Jesus. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If you had known me, you would have also known my Father.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:20
verses.text: These statements Jesus made in the Treasury, while teaching in the Temple Courts. Yet no one arrested him, for his time had not then come.  <div eID="gen7770" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7768" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv755"/><div sID="gen7771" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv755"/> Jesus again spoke to the people. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am going away,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and you will look for me, but you will die in your sin; you cannot come where I am going.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv756"/><div sID="gen7772" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv756"/> “Is he going to kill himself,” the people exclaimed, “that he says — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘You cannot go where I am going’?”</q>

verses.name: John 8:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You,”</q>added Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“are from below, I am from above; you are of this present world, I am not;</q>

verses.name: John 8:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and so I told you that you would die in your sins, for, unless you believe that I am what I am, you will die in your sins.”</q>  <div eID="gen7772" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv757"/><div sID="gen7773" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv757"/> “Who are you?” they asked. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Why ask exactly what I have been telling you?”</q>said Jesus.

verses.name: John 8:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have still much that concerns you to speak of and to pass judgment on; yet he who sent me may be trusted, and I speak to the world only of the things which I have heard from him.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:27
verses.text: They did not understand that he meant the Father.

verses.name: John 8:28
verses.text: So Jesus added: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will understand that I am what I am, and that I do nothing of myself, but that I say just what the Father has taught me.</q>

verses.name: John 8:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Moreover, he who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone; for I always do what pleases him.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:30
verses.text: While he was speaking in this way, many came to believe in him.

verses.name: John 8:31
verses.text: So Jesus went on to say to those who had believed him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If you remain constant to my message, you are truly my disciples;</q>

verses.name: John 8:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you find out the truth, and the truth will set you free.”</q>  <div eID="gen7773" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv758"/><div sID="gen7774" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv758"/> “We are descendants of Abraham,” was their answer, “and have never yet been in slavery to anyone. What do you mean by saying <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘you will be set free’?”</q>

verses.name: John 8:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“everyone who sins is a slave to sin.</q>

verses.name: John 8:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And a slave does not remain in the home always; but a son remains always.</q>

verses.name: John 8:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If, then, the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed!</q>

verses.name: John 8:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know that you are descendants of Abraham; yet you are seeking to put me to death, because my message finds no place in your hearts.</q>

verses.name: John 8:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I tell you what I have myself seen in the presence of my Father; and you, in the same way, do what you have learned from your father.”</q>  <div eID="gen7774" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv759"/><div sID="gen7775" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv759"/> “Our father is Abraham,” was their answer. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If you are Abraham’s children,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“do what Abraham did.</q>

verses.name: John 8:40
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, as it is, you are seeking to put me to death — a man who has told you the truth as he heard it from God. Abraham did not act in that way.</q>

verses.name: John 8:41
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You are doing what your own father does.”</q> <div eID="gen7775" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7776" type="paragraph"/> “We are not bastards,” they said, “we have one Father — God himself.”  <div eID="gen7776" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv760"/><div sID="gen7777" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv760"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If God were your Father,”</q>Jesus replied, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“you would have loved me, for I came out from God, and now am here; and I have not come of myself, but he sent me as his messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 8:43
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">How is it that you do not understand what I say? It is because you cannot bear to listen to my message.</q>

verses.name: John 8:44
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As for you, you are children of your Father the devil, and you are determined to do what your father loves to do. He was a murderer from the first, and did not stand by the truth, because there is no truth in him. Whenever he lies, he does what is natural to him; because he is a liar, and the father of lying.</q>

verses.name: John 8:45
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, as for me, it is because I speak the truth to you that you do not believe me.</q>

verses.name: John 8:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Which of you can convict me of sin? Why then do not you believe me, if I am speaking truth?</q>

verses.name: John 8:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who comes from God listens to God’s teaching; the reason why you do not listen is because you do not come from God.”</q>  <div eID="gen7777" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv761"/><div sID="gen7778" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv761"/> “Are not we right, after all,” replied the people, “in saying that you are a Samaritan, and are possessed by a demon?”  <div eID="gen7778" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv762"/><div sID="gen7779" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv762"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am not possessed by a demon,”</q>Jesus answered, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but I am honoring my Father; and yet you dishonor me.</q>

verses.name: John 8:50
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Not that I am seeking honor for myself; there is one who is seeking my honor, and he decides.</q>

verses.name: John 8:51
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, if anyone lays my message to heart, he will never really die.”</q>  <div eID="gen7779" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv763"/><div sID="gen7780" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv763"/> “Now we are sure that you are possessed by a demon,” the people replied. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets; and yet you say <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘If anyone lays my message to heart, they will never know death.’</q>

verses.name: John 8:53
verses.text: Are you greater than our ancestor Abraham, who died? And the prophets died too. Whom do you make yourself out to be?”  <div eID="gen7780" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv764"/><div sID="gen7781" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv764"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If I do honor to myself,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“such honor counts for nothing. It is my Father who does me honor — and you say that he is your God;</q>

verses.name: John 8:55
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and yet you have not learned to know him; but I know him; and, if I were to say that I do not know him, I should be a liar like you; but I do know him, and I lay his message to heart.</q>

verses.name: John 8:56
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Your ancestor Abraham rejoiced that he would see my day; and he did see it, and was glad.”</q>  <div eID="gen7781" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv765"/><div sID="gen7782" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv765"/> “You are not fifty years old yet,” the people exclaimed, “and have you seen Abraham?”  <div eID="gen7782" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 8:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv766"/><div sID="gen7783" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv766"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“before Abraham existed I was.”</q>

verses.name: John 8:59
verses.text: At this they took up stones to throw at him; but Jesus hid himself, and left the Temple Courts.  <div eID="gen7783" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.8"/> <div eID="gen7771" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv767"/><div sID="gen7784" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv767"/> As Jesus passed by, he saw a man who had been blind from his birth.

verses.name: John 9:2
verses.text: “Rabbi,” asked his disciples, “who was it that sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

verses.name: John 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv768"/><div sID="gen7785" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv768"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Neither the man nor the parents,”</q>replied Jesus; <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but he was born blind so that the work of God should be made plain in him.</q>

verses.name: John 9:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">We must do the work of him who sent me, while it is day; night is coming, when no one can work.</q>

verses.name: John 9:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”</q>

verses.name: John 9:6
verses.text: Saying this, Jesus spat on the ground, made clay with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.

verses.name: John 9:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Go,”</q>he said, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and wash your eyes in the Bath of Siloam”</q>(a word which means ‘messenger’). So the man went and washed his eyes, and returned able to see.

verses.name: John 9:8
verses.text: His neighbors, and those who had formerly known him by sight as a beggar, exclaimed: “Is not this the man who used to sit and beg?”  <div eID="gen7785" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv769"/><div sID="gen7786" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv769"/> “Yes,” some said, “it is”; while others said: “No, but he is like him.” The man himself said: “I am he.”  <div eID="gen7786" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv770"/><div sID="gen7787" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv770"/> “How did you get your sight, then?” they asked.

verses.name: John 9:11
verses.text: “The man whom they call Jesus,” he answered, “made clay, and anointed my eyes, and said to me <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Go to Siloam and wash your eyes.’</q>So I went and washed my eyes, and gained my sight.”  <div eID="gen7787" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv771"/><div sID="gen7788" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv771"/> “Where is he?” they asked. I do not know,” he answered.

verses.name: John 9:13
verses.text: They took the man, who had been blind, to the Pharisees.

verses.name: John 9:14
verses.text: Now it was a Sabbath when Jesus made the clay and gave him his sight.

verses.name: John 9:15
verses.text: So the Pharisees also questioned the man as to how he had gained his sight. “He put clay on my eyes,” he answered, “and I washed them, and I can see.”  <div eID="gen7788" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv772"/><div sID="gen7789" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv772"/> “The man cannot be from God,” said some of the Pharisees, “for he does not keep the Sabbath.” <div eID="gen7789" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7790" type="paragraph"/> “How is it possible,” retorted others, “for a bad man to give signs like this?”

verses.name: John 9:17
verses.text: So there was a difference of opinion among them, and they again questioned the man; “What do you yourself say about him, for it is to you that he has given sight?”

verses.name: John 9:18
verses.text: The religious authorities, however, refused to believe that he had been blind and had gained his sight, until they had called his parents and questioned them.

verses.name: John 9:19
verses.text: “Is this your son,” they asked, “who you say was born blind? If so, how is it that he can see now?”  <div eID="gen7790" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv773"/><div sID="gen7791" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv773"/> “We know that this is our son,” answered the parents, “and that he was born blind;

verses.name: John 9:21
verses.text: but how it is that he can see now we do not know; nor do we know who it was that gave him his sight. Ask him — he is old enough — he will tell you about himself.”

verses.name: John 9:22
verses.text: His parents spoke in this way because they were afraid of the authorities; for the authorities had already agreed that, if anyone should acknowledge Jesus as the Christ, he should be expelled from their synagogues.

verses.name: John 9:23
verses.text: This was why his parents said ‘He is old enough; ask him.’

verses.name: John 9:24
verses.text: So the authorities again called the man who had been blind, and said to him: “Give God the praise; we know that this is a bad man.”  <div eID="gen7791" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv774"/><div sID="gen7792" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv774"/> “I know nothing about his being a bad man,” he replied; “one thing I do know, that although I was blind, now I can see.”  <div eID="gen7792" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv775"/><div sID="gen7793" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv775"/> “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he give you your sight?”  <div eID="gen7793" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv776"/><div sID="gen7794" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv776"/> “I told you just now,” he answered, “and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Surely you also do not want to become his disciples?”  <div eID="gen7794" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv777"/><div sID="gen7795" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv777"/> “You are his disciple,” they retorted scornfully; “but we are disciples of Moses.

verses.name: John 9:29
verses.text: We know that God spoke to Moses; but, as for this man, we do not know where he comes from.”  <div eID="gen7795" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv778"/><div sID="gen7796" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv778"/> “Well,” the man replied, “this is very strange; you do not know where he comes from, and yet he has given me my sight!

verses.name: John 9:31
verses.text: We know that God never listens to bad people, but, when a person is god-fearing and does God’s will, God listens to them.

verses.name: John 9:32
verses.text: Since the world began, such a thing was never heard of as anyone’s giving sight to a person born blind.

verses.name: John 9:33
verses.text: If this man had not been from God, he could not have done anything at all.”  <div eID="gen7796" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv779"/><div sID="gen7797" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv779"/> “You,” they retorted, “were born totally depraved; and are you trying to teach us?” So they expelled him.

verses.name: John 9:35
verses.text: Jesus heard of their having put him out; and, when he had found the man, he asked: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you believe in the Son of Man?”</q>  <div eID="gen7797" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv780"/><div sID="gen7798" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv780"/> “Tell me who he is, Sir,” he replied, “so that I may believe in him.”  <div eID="gen7798" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:37
