verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv781"/><div sID="gen7799" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv781"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Not only have you seen him,”</q>said Jesus; <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but it is he who is now speaking to you.”</q>  <div eID="gen7799" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv782"/><div sID="gen7800" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv782"/> “Then, Sir, I do believe,” said the man, bowing to the ground before him;

verses.name: John 9:39
verses.text: and Jesus added: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It was to put people to the test that I came into this world, in order that those that cannot see should see, and that those that can see should become blind.”</q>

verses.name: John 9:40
verses.text: Hearing this, some of the Pharisees who were with him said: “Then are we blind too?”  <div eID="gen7800" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 9:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv783"/><div sID="gen7801" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv783"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If you had been blind,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“you would have had no sin to answer for; but, as it is, you say ‘We can see,’ and so your sin remains.</q>  <div eID="gen7801" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.9"/>

verses.name: John 10:1
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, whoever does not go into the sheepfold through the door, but climbs up at some other place, that person is a thief and a robber;</q>

verses.name: John 10:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but the person who goes in through the door is shepherd to the sheep.</q>

verses.name: John 10:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For him the watchman opens the door; and the sheep listen to his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.</q>

verses.name: John 10:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">When he has brought them all out, he walks in front of them, and his sheep follow him, because they know his voice.</q>

verses.name: John 10:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">They will not follow a stranger, but will run away from him; because they do not know a stranger’s voice.”</q>

verses.name: John 10:6
verses.text: This was the allegory that Jesus told them, but they did not understand of what he was speaking.

verses.name: John 10:7
verses.text: So he continued: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you, I am the door for the sheep.</q>

verses.name: John 10:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">All who came before me were thieves and robbers; but the sheep did not listen to them.</q>

verses.name: John 10:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the door; he who goes in through me will be safe, and he will go in and out and find pasture.</q>

verses.name: John 10:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The thief comes only to steal, to kill, and to destroy; I have come so that they may have life, and may have it in greater fullness.</q>

verses.name: John 10:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for his sheep.</q>

verses.name: John 10:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The hired man who is not a shepherd, and who does not own the sheep, when he sees a wolf coming, leaves them and runs away; then the wolf seizes them, and scatters the flock.</q>

verses.name: John 10:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He does this because he is only a hired man and does not care about the sheep.</q>

verses.name: John 10:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the good shepherd; and I know my sheep, and my sheep know me — </q>

verses.name: John 10:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Just as the Father knows me and I know the Father — and I lay down my life for the sheep.</q>

verses.name: John 10:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have other sheep besides, which do not belong to this fold; I must lead them also, and they will listen to my voice; and they will become one flock under ‘one shepherd.’</q>

verses.name: John 10:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">This is why the Father loves me, because I lay down my life — to receive it again.</q>

verses.name: John 10:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">No one took it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to receive it again. This is the command which I received from my Father.”</q>

verses.name: John 10:19
verses.text: In consequence of these words a difference of opinion again arose among the people.

verses.name: John 10:20
verses.text: Many of them said: “He is possessed by a demon and is mad; why do you listen to him?”

verses.name: John 10:21
verses.text: Others said: “This is not the teaching of one who is possessed by a demon. Can a demon give sight to the blind?”  <div eID="gen7784" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv784"/><div sID="gen7802" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv784"/> Soon after this the Festival of the Rededication was held at Jerusalem.

verses.name: John 10:23
verses.text: It was winter; and Jesus was walking in the Temple Courts, in the Colonnade of Solomon,

verses.name: John 10:24
verses.text: when the people gathered around him, and said: “How long are you going to keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us so frankly.”

verses.name: John 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv785"/><div sID="gen7803" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv785"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have told you so,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and you do not believe me. The work that I am doing in my Father’s name bears testimony to me.</q>

verses.name: John 10:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But you do not believe me, because you are not of my flock.</q>

verses.name: John 10:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me;</q>

verses.name: John 10:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and I give them eternal life, and they will not be lost; nor will anyone snatch them out of my hands.</q>

verses.name: John 10:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">What my Father has entrusted to me is more than all else; and no one can snatch anything out of the Father’s hands.</q>

verses.name: John 10:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The Father and I are one.”</q>  <div eID="gen7803" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv786"/><div sID="gen7804" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv786"/> Some of the people again brought stones to throw at him;

verses.name: John 10:32
verses.text: and seeing this, Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have done before your eyes many good actions, inspired by the Father; for which of them would you stone me?”</q>  <div eID="gen7804" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv787"/><div sID="gen7805" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv787"/> “It is not for any good action that we would stone you,” they answered, “but for blasphemy; and because you, who are only a man, make yourself out to be God.”  <div eID="gen7805" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv788"/><div sID="gen7806" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv788"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Are there not,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“these words in your law — ‘I said “You are gods”’?</q>

verses.name: John 10:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If those to whom God’s word were addressed were said to be ‘gods’ — and scripture cannot be set aside — </q>

verses.name: John 10:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do you say of one whom the Father has consecrated and sent as his messenger to the world ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said ‘I am God’s Son’?</q>

verses.name: John 10:37
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If I am not doing the work that my Father is doing, do not believe me;</q>

verses.name: John 10:38
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">if I am doing it, even though you do not believe me, believe what that work shows; so that you may understand, and understand more and more clearly, that the Father is in union with me, and I with the Father.”</q>

verses.name: John 10:39
verses.text: The authorities again sought to arrest him; but he escaped their hands.  <div eID="gen7806" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7802" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 10:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv789"/><div sID="gen7807" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv789"/> Then Jesus again crossed the Jordan to the place where John used to baptize at first, and stayed there some time, during which many people came to see him.

verses.name: John 10:41
verses.text: “John gave no sign of his mission,” they said; “but everything that he said about this man was true.”

verses.name: John 10:42
verses.text: And many learned to believe in Jesus there.  <chapter eID="John.10"/> <div eID="gen7807" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv790"/><div sID="gen7808" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv790"/> Now a man named Lazarus, of Bethany, was lying ill; he belonged to the same village as Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.name: John 11:2
verses.text: This Mary, whose brother Lazarus was ill, was the Mary who anointed the Master with perfume, and wiped his feet with her hair.

verses.name: John 11:3
verses.text: The sisters, therefore, sent this message to Jesus — ‘Master, your friend is ill’;

verses.name: John 11:4
verses.text: and, when Jesus heard it, he said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“This illness is not to end in death, but is to redound to the honor of God, in order that the Son of God may be honored through it.”</q>

verses.name: John 11:5
verses.text: Jesus loved Martha and her sister, and Lazarus.

verses.name: John 11:6
verses.text: Yet, when he heard of the illness of Lazarus, he still stayed two days in the place where he was.

verses.name: John 11:7
verses.text: Then, after that, he said to his disciples: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Let us go to Judea again.”</q>

verses.name: John 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv791"/><div sID="gen7809" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv791"/> “Rabbi,” they replied, “the authorities there were but just now seeking to stone you; and are you going there again?”  <div eID="gen7809" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv792"/><div sID="gen7810" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv792"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Are not there twelve hours in the day?”</q>answered Jesus. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If someone walks about in the daytime, they do not stumble, because they can see the light of the sun;</q>

verses.name: John 11:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but, if they walk about at night, they stumble, because they have not the light.”</q>

verses.name: John 11:11
verses.text: And, when he had said this, he added: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going so that I may wake him.”</q>  <div eID="gen7810" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv793"/><div sID="gen7811" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv793"/> “If he has fallen asleep, Master, he will get well,” said the disciples.

verses.name: John 11:13
verses.text: But Jesus meant that he was dead; they, however, supposed that he was speaking of natural sleep.

verses.name: John 11:14
verses.text: Then he said to them plainly: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Lazarus is dead;</q>

verses.name: John 11:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may learn to believe in me. But let us go to him.”</q>

verses.name: John 11:16
verses.text: At this, Thomas, who was called ‘The Twin,’ said to his fellow disciples: “Let us go too, so that we may die with him.”

verses.name: John 11:17
verses.text: When Jesus reached the place, he found that Lazarus had been four days in the tomb already.

verses.name: John 11:18
verses.text: Bethany being only about two miles from Jerusalem,

verses.name: John 11:19
verses.text: a number of the people had come there to comfort Martha and Mary because of brother’s death.

verses.name: John 11:20
verses.text: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him; but Mary sat quietly at home.

verses.name: John 11:21
verses.text: “Master,” Martha said to Jesus, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

verses.name: John 11:22
verses.text: Even now, I know that God will grant you whatever you ask him.”  <div eID="gen7811" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv794"/><div sID="gen7812" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv794"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Your brother will rise to life,”</q>said Jesus.

verses.name: John 11:24
verses.text: “I know that he will,” replied Martha, “in the resurrection at the Last day.”  <div eID="gen7812" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv795"/><div sID="gen7813" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv795"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am the resurrection and the life,”</q>said Jesus. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“He who believes in me will live, though he die;</q>

verses.name: John 11:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and he who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”</q>  <div eID="gen7813" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv796"/><div sID="gen7814" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv796"/> “Yes Master,” she answered; “I have learned to believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, ‘who was to come’ into the world.”

verses.name: John 11:28
verses.text: After saying this, Martha went and called her sister Mary, and whispered: “The teacher is here, and is asking for you.”

verses.name: John 11:29
verses.text: As soon as Mary heard that, she got up quickly, and went to meet him.

verses.name: John 11:30
verses.text: Jesus had not then come into the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.

verses.name: John 11:31
verses.text: So the people, who were in the house with Mary, comforting her, when they saw her get up quickly and go out, followed her, thinking that she was going to the tomb to weep there.

verses.name: John 11:32
verses.text: When Mary came where Jesus was and saw him, she threw herself at his feet. “Master,” she exclaimed, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died!”

verses.name: John 11:33
verses.text: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the people who had come with her weeping also, he groaned deeply, and was greatly distressed.

verses.name: John 11:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Where have you buried him?”</q>he asked. “Come and see, Master,” they answered.

verses.name: John 11:35
verses.text: Jesus burst into tears.

verses.name: John 11:36
verses.text: “How he must have loved him!” the people exclaimed;

verses.name: John 11:37
verses.text: but some of them said: “Could not this man, who gave sight to the blind man, have also prevented Lazarus from dying?”

verses.name: John 11:38
verses.text: Again groaning inwardly, Jesus came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone lay against the mouth of it.

verses.name: John 11:39
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Move the stone away,”</q>said Jesus. “Master,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time the smell must be offensive, for this is the fourth day since his death.”  <div eID="gen7814" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 11:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv797"/><div sID="gen7815" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv797"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Did not I tell you,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“that, if you would believe in me, you should see the glory of God?”</q>

verses.name: John 11:41
verses.text: So they moved the stone away; and Jesus, with uplifted eyes, said: <lg sID="gen7816"/> <l sID="gen7817"/><q marker="" who="Jesus">“Father, I thank you that you have heard my prayer;</q><l eID="gen7817"/> <lg eID="gen7816"/>

verses.name: John 11:42
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know that you always hear me; but I say this for the sake of the people standing near, so that they may believe that you has sent me as your messenger.”</q>

verses.name: John 11:43
verses.text: Then, after saying this, Jesus called in a loud voice: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Lazarus! Come out!”</q>

verses.name: John 11:44
verses.text: The dead man came out, wrapped hand and foot in a winding-sheet; his face, too, had been wrapped in a cloth. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Set him free,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and let him go.”</q>  <div eID="gen7815" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7808" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv798"/><div sID="gen7818" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv798"/> In consequence of this, many of the people, who had come to visit Mary and had seen what Jesus did, learned to believe in him.

verses.name: John 11:46
verses.text: Some of them, however, went to the Pharisees, and told them what he had done.

verses.name: John 11:47
verses.text: The chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the High Council, and said: “What are we to do, now that this man is giving so many signs?

verses.name: John 11:48
verses.text: If we let him alone as we are doing, everyone will believe in him; and the Romans will come and will take from us both our city and our Nationality.”

verses.name: John 11:49
verses.text: One of them, however, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them:

verses.name: John 11:50
verses.text: “You are utterly mistaken. You do not consider that it is better for you that one person should die for the people, rather than the whole nation should be destroyed.”

verses.name: John 11:51
verses.text: Now he did not say this of his own accord; but, as high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was to die for the nation —

verses.name: John 11:52
verses.text: And not for the nation only, but also that he might unite in one body the children of God now scattered far and wide.

verses.name: John 11:53
verses.text: So from that day they plotted to put Jesus to death.  <div eID="gen7818" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 11:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv799"/><div sID="gen7819" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv799"/> In consequence of this, Jesus did not go about publicly among the people any more, but left that neighborhood, and went into the country bordering on the wilderness, to a town called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

verses.name: John 11:55
verses.text: But the Jewish Festival of the Passover was near; and many people had gone up from the country to Jerusalem, for their ‘purification,’ before the Festival began.

verses.name: John 11:56
verses.text: So they looked for Jesus there, and said to one another, as they stood in the Temple Courts: “What do you think? Do you think he will come to the Festival?”

verses.name: John 11:57
verses.text: The chief priests and the Pharisees had already issued orders that, if anyone learned where Jesus was, he should give information, so that they might arrest him.  <div eID="gen7819" type="section"/> <chapter eID="John.11"/> <div eID="gen7689" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: John 12:1
verses.text: Six days before the Passover Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead, was living.

verses.name: John 12:2
verses.text: There a supper was given in honor at which Martha waited, while Lazarus was one of those present at the table.

verses.name: John 12:3
verses.text: So Mary took a pound of choice spikenard perfume of great value, and anointed the feet of Jesus with it, and then wiped them with her hair. The whole house was filled with the scent of the perfume.

verses.name: John 12:4
verses.text: One of the disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was about to betray Jesus, asked:

verses.name: John 12:5
verses.text: “Why was not this perfume sold for a year's wages, and the money given to poor people?”

verses.name: John 12:6
verses.text: He said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and, being in charge of the purse, used to take what was put in it.

verses.name: John 12:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Leave her alone,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“so that she may keep it until the day when my body is being prepared for burial.</q>

verses.name: John 12:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The poor you always have with you, but you will not always have me.”</q>

verses.name: John 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv800"/><div sID="gen7821" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv800"/> Now great numbers of people found out that Jesus was at Bethany; and they came there, not only because of him, but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.name: John 12:10
verses.text: The chief priests, however, plotted to put Lazarus, as well as Jesus, to death,

verses.name: John 12:11
verses.text: because it was owing to him that many of the people had left them, and were becoming believers in Jesus.

verses.name: John 12:12
verses.text: On the following day great numbers of people who had come to the Festival, hearing that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, took palm branches,

verses.name: John 12:13
verses.text: and went out to meet him, shouting as they went: “‘God save Him! Blessed is He who Comes in the name of the Lord’ — The king of Israel!”

verses.name: John 12:14
verses.text: Having found a young ass, Jesus seated himself on it, in accordance with the passage of scripture —

verses.name: John 12:15
verses.text: ‘Fear not, people of Zion; Your king is coming to you, Sitting on the foal of an ass.’

verses.name: John 12:16
verses.text: His disciples did not understand all this at first; but, when Jesus had been exalted, then they remembered that these things had been said of him in scripture, and that they had done these things for him.

verses.name: John 12:17
verses.text: Meanwhile the people who were with him, when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead, were telling what they had seen.

verses.name: John 12:18
verses.text: This, indeed, was why the crowd met him — because people had heard that he had given this sign of his mission.

verses.name: John 12:19
verses.text: So the Pharisees said to one another: “You see that you are gaining nothing! Why, all the world has run after him!”  <div eID="gen7821" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv801"/><div sID="gen7822" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv801"/> Among those who were going up to worship at the Festival were some Greeks,

verses.name: John 12:21
verses.text: who went to Philip of Bethsaida in Galilee, and said: “Sir, we wish to see Jesus.”

verses.name: John 12:22
verses.text: Philip went and told Andrew, and then together they went and told Jesus.

verses.name: John 12:23
verses.text: This was his reply — <q marker="" who="Jesus">“The time has come for the Son of Man to be exalted.</q>

verses.name: John 12:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains solitary; but, if it dies, it becomes fruitful.</q>

verses.name: John 12:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">A person who loves their life loses it; while someone who hates their life in the present world will preserve it for eternal life.</q>

verses.name: John 12:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If someone is ready to serve me, let them follow me; and where I am, there my servant will be also. If a person is ready to serve me, my Father will honor them.</q>

verses.name: John 12:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Now I am distressed at heart and what can I say? Father, bring me safe through this hour — yet it was for this reason that I came to this hour — </q>

verses.name: John 12:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Father, honor your own name.”</q>At this there came a voice from heaven, which said: “I have already honored it, and I will honor it again.”

verses.name: John 12:29
verses.text: The crowd of bystanders, who heard the sound, said that it was thundering. Others said: “An angel has been speaking to him.”

verses.name: John 12:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv802"/><div sID="gen7823" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv802"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It was not for my sake that the voice came,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but for yours.</q>

verses.name: John 12:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Now this world is on its trial. Now the Spirit that is ruling this world will be driven out;</q>

verses.name: John 12:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”</q>

verses.name: John 12:33
verses.text: By these words he indicated what death he was destined to die.

verses.name: John 12:34
verses.text: “We,” replied the people, “have learned from the law that the ‘Christ is to remain for ever’; how is it, then, that you say that the Son of Man must be <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘lifted up’</q>Who is this ‘Son of Man’?”  <div eID="gen7823" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 12:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv803"/><div sID="gen7824" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv803"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Only a little while longer,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“will you have the light among you. Travel on while you have the light, so that darkness may not overtake you; he who travels in the darkness does not know where he is going.</q>

verses.name: John 12:36
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">While you still have the light, believe in the light, so that you may be ‘children of light.’”</q>After he had said this, Jesus went away, and hid himself from them.

verses.name: John 12:37
verses.text: But, though Jesus had given so many signs of his mission before their eyes, they still did not believe in him,

verses.name: John 12:38
verses.text: in fulfillment of the words of the prophet Isaiah, where he says — ‘Lord, who has believed our teaching? And to whom has the might of the Lord been revealed?’

verses.name: John 12:39
verses.text: The reason why they were unable to believe is given by Isaiah elsewhere, in these words —

verses.name: John 12:40
verses.text: ‘He has blinded their eyes, and blunted their mind, so that they should not see with their eyes, and perceive with their mind, and turn — And I should heal them.’

verses.name: John 12:41
verses.text: Isaiah said this, because he saw Christ’s glory; and it was of him that he spoke.

verses.name: John 12:42
verses.text: Yet for all this, even among the leading men there were many who came to believe in Jesus; but, because of the Pharisees, they did not acknowledge it, because they were afraid that they should be expelled from their Synagogues;

verses.name: John 12:43
verses.text: for they valued honor from people more than honor from God.

verses.name: John 12:44
verses.text: But Jesus had proclaimed: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“He who believes in me believes, not in me, but in him who sent me;</q>

verses.name: John 12:45
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and he who sees me sees him who sent me.</q>

verses.name: John 12:46
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have come as a light into the world, so that no one who believes in me should remain in the darkness.</q>

verses.name: John 12:47
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">When anyone hears my teaching and pays no heed to it, I am not his judge; for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.</q>

verses.name: John 12:48
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He who rejects me, and disregards my teaching, has a judge already — the message which I have delivered will itself be his judge at the Last day.</q>

verses.name: John 12:49
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For I have not delivered it on my own authority; but the Father, who sent me, has himself given me his command as to what I should say, and what message I should deliver.</q>

verses.name: John 12:50
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And I know that eternal life lies in keeping his command. Therefore, whatever I say, I say only what the Father has taught me.”</q>  <div eID="gen7824" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.12"/> <div eID="gen7822" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv804"/><div sID="gen7825" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv804"/> Before the Passover Festival began, Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave the world and go to the Father. He had loved those who were his own in the world, and he loved them to the last.

verses.name: John 13:2
verses.text: The devil had already put the thought of betraying Jesus into the mind of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon;

verses.name: John 13:3
verses.text: and at supper, Jesus — although knowing that the Father had put everything into his hands, and that he had come from God, and was to return to God —

verses.name: John 13:4
verses.text: Rose from his place, and, taking off his upper garments, tied a towel around his waist.

verses.name: John 13:5
verses.text: He then poured some water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel which was tied around him.

verses.name: John 13:6
verses.text: When he came to Simon Peter, Peter said: “You, Master! Are you going to wash my feet?”

verses.name: John 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv805"/><div sID="gen7826" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv805"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You do not understand now what I am doing,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but you will learn by and by.”</q>  <div eID="gen7826" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv806"/><div sID="gen7827" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv806"/> “You will never wash my feet!” exclaimed Peter. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Unless I wash you,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“you have nothing in common with me.”</q>  <div eID="gen7827" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv807"/><div sID="gen7828" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv807"/> “Then, Master, not my feet only,” exclaimed Simon Peter, “but also my hands and my head.”  <div eID="gen7828" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv808"/><div sID="gen7829" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv808"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“He who has bathed,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“has no need to wash, unless it be his feet, but is altogether clean; and you,”</q>he said to the disciples, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“are clean, yet not all of you.”</q>

verses.name: John 13:11
verses.text: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘You are not all clean.’</q>

verses.name: John 13:12
verses.text: When he had washed their feet, and had put on his upper garments and taken his place, he spoke to them again. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you understand what I have been doing to you?”</q>he asked.

verses.name: John 13:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You yourselves call me ‘the teacher’ and ‘the Master’, and you are right, for I am both.</q>

verses.name: John 13:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If I, then — ‘the Master’ and ‘the teacher’ — have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet;</q>

verses.name: John 13:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for I have given you an example, so that you may do just as I have done to you.</q>

verses.name: John 13:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, a servant is not greater than their master, neither is a messenger greater than the one who sends them.</q>

verses.name: John 13:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Now that you know these things, happy are you if you do them.</q>

verses.name: John 13:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am not speaking about all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but this is in fulfillment of the words of scripture — ‘He that is eating my bread has lifted his heel against me.’</q>

verses.name: John 13:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">For the future I will tell you of things before they take place, so that, when they take place, you may believe that I am what I am.</q>

verses.name: John 13:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, the one who receives anyone that I send receives me; and the person who receives me receives him who sent me.”</q>

verses.name: John 13:21
verses.text: After saying this, Jesus was much troubled, and said solemnly: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you that it is one of you who will betray me.”</q>

verses.name: John 13:22
verses.text: The disciples looked at one another, wondering whom he meant.

verses.name: John 13:23
verses.text: Next to Jesus, in the place on his right hand, was one of his disciples, whom he loved.

verses.name: John 13:24
verses.text: So Simon Peter made signs to that disciple, and whispered: “Tell me who it is that he means.”

verses.name: John 13:25
verses.text: Being in this position, that disciple leant back on Jesus’ shoulder, and asked him: “Who is it, Master?”  <div eID="gen7829" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv809"/><div sID="gen7830" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv809"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“It is the one,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“to whom I will give a piece of bread after dipping it in the dish.”</q>And, when Jesus had dipped the bread, he took it and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot;

verses.name: John 13:27
verses.text: and it was then, after he had received it, that Satan took possession of him. So Jesus said to him: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do at once what you are going to do.”</q>

verses.name: John 13:28
verses.text: But no one at the table understood why he said this to Judas.

verses.name: John 13:29
verses.text: Some thought that, as Judas kept the purse, Jesus meant that he was to buy some things needed for the Festival, or to give something to the poor.

verses.name: John 13:30
verses.text: After taking the piece of bread, Judas went out immediately; and it was night.  <div eID="gen7830" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7825" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 13:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv810"/><div sID="gen7831" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv810"/> When Judas had gone out, Jesus said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Now the Son of Man has been exalted, and God has been exalted through him;</q>

verses.name: John 13:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and God will exalt him with himself — yes, he will exalt him forthwith.</q>

verses.name: John 13:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">My children, I am to be with you but a little while longer. You will look for me; and what I said to the people — ‘You cannot come where I am going’ — I now say to you.</q>

verses.name: John 13:34
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I give you a new commandment — love one another; love one another as I have loved you.</q>

verses.name: John 13:35
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is by this that everyone will recognize you as my disciples — by your loving one another.”</q>

verses.name: John 13:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv811"/><div sID="gen7832" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv811"/> “Where are you going, Master?” asked Peter. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am going where you cannot now follow me,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but you will follow me later.”</q>  <div eID="gen7832" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv812"/><div sID="gen7833" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv812"/> “Why cannot I follow you now, Master?” asked Peter. “I will lay down my life for you.”  <div eID="gen7833" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 13:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv813"/><div sID="gen7834" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv813"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Will you lay down your life for me?”</q>replied Jesus. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“In truth I tell you, the cock will not crow until you have disowned me three times.</q>  <div eID="gen7834" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.13"/>

verses.name: John 14:1
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not let your hearts be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in me.</q>

verses.name: John 14:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In my Father’s Home there are many dwellings. If it had not been so, I should have told you, for I am going to prepare a place for you.</q>

verses.name: John 14:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And, since I go and prepare a place for you, I will return and take you to be with me, so that you may be where I am;</q>

verses.name: John 14:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and you know the way to the place where I am going.”</q>

verses.name: John 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv814"/><div sID="gen7835" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv814"/> “We do not know where you are going, Master,” said Thomas; “so how can we know the way?”

verses.name: John 14:6
verses.text: Jesus answered: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am the way, and the truth, and the life; no one ever comes to the Father except through me.</q>

verses.name: John 14:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you had recognized me, you would have known my Father also; for the future you will recognize him, indeed you have already seen him.”</q>  <div eID="gen7835" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv815"/><div sID="gen7836" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv815"/> “Master, show us the Father,” said Philip, “and we will be satisfied.”  <div eID="gen7836" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv816"/><div sID="gen7837" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv816"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Have I been all this time among you,”</q>said Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“and yet you, Philip, have not recognized me? The person who has seen me has seen the Father, how can you say, then, ‘Show us the Father’?</q>

verses.name: John 14:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not you believe that I am in union with the Father, and the Father with me? In giving you my teaching I am not speaking on my own authority; but the Father himself, always in union with me, does his own work.</q>

verses.name: John 14:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Believe me,” he said to them all, “when I say that I am in union with the Father and the Father with me, or else believe me because of the work itself.</q>

verses.name: John 14:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you, the person who believes in me will themselves do the work that I am doing; and they will do greater work still, because I am going to the Father.</q>

verses.name: John 14:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Whatever you ask, in my name, I will do, so that the Father may be honored in the Son.</q>

verses.name: John 14:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you ask anything, in my name, I will do it.</q>

verses.name: John 14:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you love me, you will lay my commands to heart,</q>

verses.name: John 14:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and I will ask the Father, and he will give you another helper, to be with you always — the Spirit of truth.</q>

verses.name: John 14:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The world cannot receive this Spirit, because it does not see him or recognize him, but you recognize him, because he is always with you, and is within you.</q>

verses.name: John 14:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I will not leave you bereaved; I will come to you.</q>

verses.name: John 14:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In a little while the world will see me no more, but you will still see me; because I am living, you will be living also.</q>

verses.name: John 14:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">At that time you will recognize that I am in union with the Father, and you with me, and I with you.</q>

verses.name: John 14:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is they who have my commands and lays them to heart that loves me; and the person who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love them, and will reveal myself to them.”</q>  <div eID="gen7837" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv817"/><div sID="gen7838" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv817"/> “What has happened, Master,” said Judas (not Judas Iscariot), “that you are going to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”  <div eID="gen7838" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv818"/><div sID="gen7839" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv818"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Whoever loves me,”</q>Jesus answered,<q marker="" who="Jesus">“will lay my message to heart; and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.</q>

verses.name: John 14:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who does not love me will not lay my message to heart; and the message to which you are listening is not my own, but comes from the Father who sent me.</q>

verses.name: John 14:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have told you all this while still with you,</q>

verses.name: John 14:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but the helper — the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in my name — will teach you all things, and will recall to your minds all that I have said to you.</q>

verses.name: John 14:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Peace be with you! My own peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled, or dismayed.</q>

verses.name: John 14:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You heard me say that I was going away and would return to you. Had you loved me, you would have been glad that I was going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.</q>

verses.name: John 14:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And this I have told you now before it happens, so that, when it does happen, you may still believe in me.</q>

verses.name: John 14:30
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I will not talk with you much more, for the Spirit that is ruling the world is coming. He has nothing in common with me;</q>

verses.name: John 14:31
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">but he is coming so that the world may see that I love the Father, and that I do as the Father commanded me. Come, let us be going.</q>  <div eID="gen7839" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.14"/> <div eID="gen7831" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv819"/><div sID="gen7840" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv819"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the True Vine, and my Father is the Vine-grower.</q>

verses.name: John 15:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Any unfruitful branch in me he takes away, and he cleanses every fruitful branch, so that it may bear more fruit.</q>

verses.name: John 15:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You are already clean because of the message that I have given you.</q>

verses.name: John 15:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Remain united to me, and I will remain united to you. As a branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it remains united to the vine; no more can you, unless you remain united to me.</q>

verses.name: John 15:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the Vine, you are the branches. If you remains united to me, while I remain united to you — you bear fruit plentifully; for you can do nothing apart from me.</q>

verses.name: John 15:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If anyone does not remain united to me, they are thrown away, as a branch would be, and withers up. Such branches are collected and thrown into the fire, and are burnt.</q>

verses.name: John 15:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you remain united to me, and my teaching remains in your hearts, ask whatever you wish, and it will be yours.</q>

verses.name: John 15:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It is by your bearing fruit plentifully, and so showing yourselves my disciples, that my Father is honored.</q>

verses.name: John 15:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you; remain in my love.</q>

verses.name: John 15:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you lay my commands to heart, you will remain in my love; just as I have laid the Father’s commands to heart and remain in his love.</q>

verses.name: John 15:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have told you all this so that my own joy may be yours, and that your joy may be complete.</q>

verses.name: John 15:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">This is my command — love one another, as I have loved you.</q>

verses.name: John 15:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">No one can give greater proof of love than by laying down their life for their friends.</q>

verses.name: John 15:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And you are my friends, if you do what I command you.</q>

verses.name: John 15:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I no longer call you ‘servants,’ because a servant does not know what their master is doing; but I have given you the name of ‘friends,’ because I made known to you everything that I learned from my Father.</q>

verses.name: John 15:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">It was not you who chose me, but I who chose you, and I appointed you to go and bear fruit — fruit that should remain, so that the Father might grant you whatever you ask in my name.</q>

verses.name: John 15:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am giving you these commands that you may love one another.</q>

verses.name: John 15:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If the world hates you, you know that it has first hated me.</q>

verses.name: John 15:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If you belonged to the world, the world would love its own. Because you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world — that is why the world hates you.</q>

verses.name: John 15:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Remember what I said to you — ‘A servant is not greater than their master.’ If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have laid my message to heart, they will lay yours to heart also.</q>

verses.name: John 15:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But they will do all this to you, because you believe in my name, for they do not know him who sent me.</q>

verses.name: John 15:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have had no sin to answer for; but as it is, they have no excuse for their sin.</q>

verses.name: John 15:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">The person who hates me hates my Father also.</q>

verses.name: John 15:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">If I had not done among them such work as no one else ever did, they would have had no sin to answer for; but, as it is, they have both seen and hated both me and my Father.</q>

verses.name: John 15:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And so is fulfilled what is said in their law — ‘They hated me without cause.’</q>

verses.name: John 15:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But, when the helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father — the Spirit of truth, who comes from the Father — will bear testimony to me;</q>

verses.name: John 15:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">yes, and you also are to bear testimony, because you have been with me from the first.</q>  <chapter eID="John.15"/>

verses.name: John 16:1
verses.text: I have spoken to you in this way so that you may not falter.

verses.name: John 16:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">They will expel you from their Synagogues; indeed the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think that they are making an offering to God.</q>

verses.name: John 16:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">They will do this, because they have not learned to know the Father, or even me.</q>

verses.name: John 16:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I have spoken to you of these things so that, when the time for them comes, you may remember that I told you about them myself.</q>

verses.name: John 16:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I did not tell you all this at first, because I was with you. But now I am to return to him who sent me; and yet not one of you asks me — ‘Where are you going?’</q>

verses.name: John 16:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Although your hearts are full of sorrow at all that I have been saying to you.</q>

verses.name: John 16:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet I am only telling you the truth; it is for your good that I should go away. For otherwise the helper will never come to you, but, if I leave you, I will send him to you.</q>

verses.name: John 16:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And he, when he comes, will bring conviction to the world as to sin, and as to righteousness, and as to judgment;</q>

verses.name: John 16:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">as to sin, for people do not believe in me;</q>

verses.name: John 16:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">as to righteousness, for I am going to the Father, and you will see me no longer;</q>

verses.name: John 16:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">as to judgment, for the Spirit that is ruling this world has been condemned.</q>

verses.name: John 16:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have still much to say to you, but you cannot bear it now.</q>

verses.name: John 16:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet when he — The Spirit of truth — comes, he will guide you into all truth; for he will not speak on his own authority, but he will speak of all that he hears; and he will tell you of the things that are to come.</q>

verses.name: John 16:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">He will honor me; because he will take of what is mine, and will tell it to you.</q>

verses.name: John 16:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Everything that the Father has is mine; that is why I said that he takes of what is mine, and will tell it to you.</q>

verses.name: John 16:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In a little while you will no longer see me; and then in a little while you will see me indeed.”</q>

verses.name: John 16:17
verses.text: At this some of his disciples said to one another: “What does he mean by saying to us <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘In a little while you will not see me, and then in a little while you will see me indeed’;</q>and by saying <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Because I am going to the Father’?</q>

verses.name: John 16:18
verses.text: What does he mean by <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘In a little while’?”</q>they said; “we do not know what he is speaking about.”

verses.name: John 16:19
verses.text: Jesus saw that they were wanting to ask him a question, and said: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Are you trying to find out from one another what I meant by saying ‘In a little while you will not see me; and then in a little while you will see me indeed’?</q>

verses.name: John 16:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">In truth I tell you that you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice; you will suffer pain, but your pain will turn to joy.</q>

verses.name: John 16:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">A woman in labor is in pain because her time has come; but no sooner is the child born, than she forgets her trouble in her joy that a child has been born into the world.</q>

verses.name: John 16:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You, in the same way, are sorry now; but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will rob you of your joy.</q>

verses.name: John 16:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And at that time you will not ask me anything; in truth I tell you, if you ask the Father for anything, he will grant it to you in my name.</q>

verses.name: John 16:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">So far you have not asked for anything, in my name; ask, and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.</q>

verses.name: John 16:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have spoken to you of all this in figures; a time is coming, however, when I will not speak any longer to you in figures, but will tell you about the Father plainly.</q>

verses.name: John 16:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You will ask, at that time, in my name; and I do not say that I will intercede with the Father for you;</q>

verses.name: John 16:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from the Father.</q>

verses.name: John 16:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I came out from the Father, and have come into the world; and now I am to leave the world, and go to the Father.”</q>

verses.name: John 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv820"/><div sID="gen7841" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv820"/> “At last,” exclaimed the disciples, “you are using plain words and not speaking in figures at all.

verses.name: John 16:30
verses.text: Now we are sure that you know everything, and need not wait for anyone to question you. This makes us believe that you did come from God.”  <div eID="gen7841" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv821"/><div sID="gen7842" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv821"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you believe that already?”</q>Jesus answered.

verses.name: John 16:32
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Listen! A time is coming — indeed it has already come — when you are to be scattered, each going his own way, and to leave me alone; and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.</q>

verses.name: John 16:33
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have spoken to you in this way, so that in me you may find peace. In the world you will find trouble; yet, take courage! I have conquered the world.”</q>  <div eID="gen7842" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.16"/> <div eID="gen7840" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv822"/><div sID="gen7843" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv822"/> After saying this, Jesus raised his eyes heaven-wards, and said: <lg sID="gen7844"/> <l sID="gen7845"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Father, the hour has come; honor your Son, so that your Son may honor you;</q><l eID="gen7845"/> <lg eID="gen7844"/>

verses.name: John 17:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">even as you gave him power over all humanity, so that he should give eternal life to all those whom you has given him.</q>

verses.name: John 17:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And the eternal life is this — to know you the one true God, and Jesus Christ whom you has sent as your messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 17:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have honored you on earth by completing the work which you has given me to do;</q>

verses.name: John 17:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and now do you honor me, Father, at your own side, with the honor which I had at your side before the world began.</q>

verses.name: John 17:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have revealed you to those whom you gave me from the world; they were your own, and you gave them to me; and they have laid your message to heart.</q>

verses.name: John 17:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">They recognize now that everything that you gave me was from you;</q>

verses.name: John 17:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">for I have given them the teaching which you gave me, and they received it, and clearly understood that I came from you, and they believed that you has sent me as your messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 17:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I intercede for them; I am not interceding for the world, but for those whom you has given me, for they are your own — </q>

verses.name: John 17:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">All that is mine is yours, and all that is yours is mine — and I am honored in them.</q>

verses.name: John 17:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Now I am to be in this world no longer, but they are still to be in the world, and I am to come to you. Holy Father, keep them by that revelation of your name which you has given me, so that they may be one, as we are.</q>

verses.name: John 17:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Whilst I was with them, I kept them by that revelation, and I have guarded them; and not one of them has been lost, except that lost soul — in fulfillment of scripture.</q>

verses.name: John 17:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But now I am to come to you; and I am speaking like this, while still in the world, so that they may have my own joy, in all its fullness, in their hearts.</q>

verses.name: John 17:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have given them your message; and the world hated them, because they do not belong to the world, even as I do not belong to the world.</q>

verses.name: John 17:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I do not ask you to take them out of the world, but to keep them from evil.</q>

verses.name: John 17:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">They do not belong to the world, even as I do not belong to the world.</q>

verses.name: John 17:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Consecrate them by the truth; your message is truth.</q>

verses.name: John 17:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Just as you has sent me as your messenger to the world, so I send them as my messengers to the world.</q>

verses.name: John 17:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">And it is for their sakes that I am consecrating myself, so that they also may be truly consecrated.</q>

verses.name: John 17:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But it is not only for them that I am interceding, but also for those who believe in me through their message,</q>

verses.name: John 17:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">that they all may be one — that as you, Father, are in union with us — and so the world may believe that you have sent me as your messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 17:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have given them the honor which you has given me, so that they may be one as we are one — </q>

verses.name: John 17:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I in union with them and you with me — that so they may be perfected in their union, and so that the world may know that you have sent me as your messenger, and that you have loved them as you have loved me.</q>

verses.name: John 17:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Father, my desire for all those whom you have given me is that they may be with me where I am, so that they may see the honor which you have given me; for thou did love me before the beginning of the world.</q>

verses.name: John 17:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Righteous Father, though the world did not know you, I knew you; and these people knew that you have sent me as your messenger.</q>

verses.name: John 17:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I have made you known to them, and will do so still; that the love that you have had for me may be in their hearts, and that I may be in them also.”</q>  <chapter eID="John.17"/> <div eID="gen7843" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv823"/><div sID="gen7846" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv823"/> When Jesus had said this, he went out with his disciples and crossed the brook Kedron to a place where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples went.

verses.name: John 18:2
verses.text: The place was well known to Judas, the betrayer, for Jesus and his disciples had often met there.

verses.name: John 18:3
verses.text: So Judas, who had obtained the soldiers of the Roman garrison, and some police officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

verses.name: John 18:4
verses.text: Jesus, aware of all that was coming upon him, went to meet them, and said to them: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“For whom are you looking?”</q>

verses.name: John 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv824"/><div sID="gen7847" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv824"/> “Jesus of Nazareth,” was their answer. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am he,”</q>said Jesus. (Judas, the betrayer, was also standing with them.)

verses.name: John 18:6
verses.text: When Jesus said <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘I am he,’</q>they drew back and fell to the ground.

verses.name: John 18:7
verses.text: So he again asked for whom they were looking, and they answered: “Jesus of Nazareth.”  <div eID="gen7847" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv825"/><div sID="gen7848" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv825"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have already told you that I am he,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“so, if it is for me that you are looking, let these people go.”</q>

verses.name: John 18:9
verses.text: This was in fulfillment of his words — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Of those whom you have given me I have not lost one.’</q>

verses.name: John 18:10
verses.text: At this, Simon Peter, who had a sword with him, drew it, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

verses.name: John 18:11
verses.text: But Jesus said to Peter: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Sheathe your sword. Should I not drink the cup which the Father has given me?”</q>  <div eID="gen7848" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7846" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv826"/><div sID="gen7849" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv826"/> So the soldiers of the garrison, with their commanding officer and the Jewish police, arrested Jesus and bound him,

verses.name: John 18:13
verses.text: and took him first of all to Annas. Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

verses.name: John 18:14
verses.text: It was Caiaphas who had counseled the religious authorities, that it was best that one person should die for the people.

verses.name: John 18:15
verses.text: Meanwhile Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. That disciple, being well-known to the high priest, went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard,

verses.name: John 18:16
verses.text: while Peter stood outside by the door. Presently the other disciple — the one well-known to the high priest — went out and spoke to the portress, and brought Peter in.

verses.name: John 18:17
verses.text: So the maidservant said to Peter: “Are not you also one of this man’s disciples?” <div sID="gen7850" type="paragraph"/> “No, I am not,” he said.

verses.name: John 18:18
verses.text: The servants and police officers were standing around a charcoal fire (which they had made because it was cold), and were warming themselves. Peter, too, was with them, standing and warming himself.

verses.name: John 18:19
verses.text: The high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

verses.name: John 18:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“For my part,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I have spoken to all the world openly. I always taught in some synagogue, or in the Temple Courts, places where everyone assembles, and I never spoke of anything in secret.</q>

verses.name: John 18:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Why question me? Question those who have listened to me as to what I have spoken about to them. They must know what I said.”</q>

verses.name: John 18:22
verses.text: When Jesus said this, one of the police officers, who was standing near, gave him a blow with his hand. “Do you answer the high priest like that?” he exclaimed.

verses.name: John 18:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“If I said anything wrong, give evidence about it,”</q>replied Jesus; <q marker="" who="Jesus">“but if not, why do you strike me?”</q>

verses.name: John 18:24
verses.text: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.name: John 18:25
verses.text: Meanwhile Simon Peter was standing there, warming himself; so they said to him: “Are not you also one of his disciples?” Peter denied it. “No, I am not,” he said.

verses.name: John 18:26
verses.text: One of the high priest’s servants, a relation of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, exclaimed: “Did not I myself see you with him in the garden?”

verses.name: John 18:27
verses.text: Peter again denied it; and at that moment a cock crowed.  <div eID="gen7850" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7849" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv827"/><div sID="gen7851" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv827"/> From Caiaphas they took Jesus to the Government house. It was early in the morning. But they did not enter the Government house themselves, otherwise they might become ‘defiled,’ and so be unable to eat the Passover.

verses.name: John 18:29
verses.text: Therefore Pilate came outside to speak to them. “What charge do you bring against this man?” he asked.

verses.name: John 18:30
verses.text: “If he had not been a criminal, we should not have given him up to you,” they answered.

verses.name: John 18:31
verses.text: “Take him yourselves,” said Pilate, “and try him by your own law.” <div sID="gen7852" type="paragraph"/> “We have no power to put anyone to death,” the authorities replied —

verses.name: John 18:32
verses.text: In fulfillment of what Jesus had said when indicating the death that he was destined to die.

verses.name: John 18:33
verses.text: After that, Pilate went into the Government house again, and calling Jesus up, asked him: “Are you the king of the Jews?”  <div eID="gen7852" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv828"/><div sID="gen7853" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv828"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Do you ask me that yourself?”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“or did others say it to you about me?”</q>  <div eID="gen7853" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv829"/><div sID="gen7854" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv829"/> “Do you take me for a Jew?” was Pilate’s answer. “It is your own nation and the chief priests who have given you up to me. What have you done?”  <div eID="gen7854" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv830"/><div sID="gen7855" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv830"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“My kingly power,”</q>replied Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“is not due to this world. If it had been so, my servants would be doing their utmost to prevent my being given up to the authorities; but my kingly power is not from the world.”</q>  <div eID="gen7855" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv831"/><div sID="gen7856" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv831"/> “So you are a king after all!” exclaimed Pilate. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“Yes, it is true I am a king,”</q>answered Jesus. <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I was born for this, I have come into the world for this — to bear testimony to the truth. Everyone who is on the side of truth listens to my voice.”</q>  <div eID="gen7856" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv832"/><div sID="gen7857" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv832"/> “What is truth?” exclaimed Pilate. After saying this, he went out to the crowd again, and said: “For my part, I find nothing with which he can be charged.

verses.name: John 18:39
verses.text: It is, however, the custom for me to grant you the release of one man at the Passover Festival. Do you wish for the release of the king of the Jews?”  <div eID="gen7857" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 18:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv833"/><div sID="gen7858" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv833"/> “No, not this man,” they shouted again, “but Barabbas!” This Barabbas was a robber.  <div eID="gen7858" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="John.18"/> <div eID="gen7851" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv834"/><div sID="gen7859" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv834"/> After that, Pilate had Jesus scourged.

verses.name: John 19:2
verses.text: The soldiers made a crown with some thorns and put it on his head and threw a purple robe around him.

verses.name: John 19:3
verses.text: They kept coming up to him and saying: “Long live the king of the Jews!” and they gave him blow after blow with their hands.

verses.name: John 19:4
verses.text: Pilate again came outside, and said to the people: “Look! I am bringing him out to you, so that you may know that I find nothing with which he can be charged.”

verses.name: John 19:5
verses.text: Then Jesus came outside, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe; and Pilate said to them: “Here is the man!”

verses.name: John 19:6
verses.text: When the chief priests and the police officers saw him, they shouted: “Crucify him! Crucify him!” <div sID="gen7860" type="paragraph"/> “Take him yourselves and crucify him,” said Pilate. “For my part, I find nothing with which he can be charged.”  <div eID="gen7860" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv835"/><div sID="gen7861" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv835"/> “But we,” replied the crowd, “have a law, under which he deserves death for making himself out to be the Son of God.”

verses.name: John 19:8
verses.text: When Pilate heard what they said, he became still more alarmed;

verses.name: John 19:9
verses.text: and, going into the Government house again, he said to Jesus: “Where do you come from?”

verses.name: John 19:10
verses.text: But Jesus made no reply. So Pilate said to him: “Do you refuse to speak to me? Do not you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?”  <div eID="gen7861" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: John 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv836"/><div sID="gen7862" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv836"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">“You would have no power over me at all,”</q>answered Jesus, <q marker="" who="Jesus">“if it had not been given you from above; and, therefore, the man who betrayed me to you is guilty of the greater sin.”</q>

verses.name: John 19:12
verses.text: This made Pilate anxious to release him; but the crowd shouted: “If you release that man, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who makes himself out to be a king is setting himself against the Emperor!”

verses.name: John 19:13
verses.text: On hearing what they said, Pilate brought Jesus out, and took his seat on the Bench at a place called ‘The Stone Pavement’ — in Hebrew ‘Gabbatha.’

verses.name: John 19:14
verses.text: It was the Passover Preparation day, and about noon. Then he said to the crowd: “Here is your king!”

verses.name: John 19:15
verses.text: At that the people shouted: “Kill him! Kill him! Crucify him!” <div eID="gen7862" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen7863" type="paragraph"/> “What! Should I crucify your king?” exclaimed Pilate. “We have no king but the Emperor,” replied the chief priests;

verses.name: John 19:16
verses.text: so Pilate gave Jesus up to them to be crucified.  <div eID="gen7863" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen7859" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv837"/><div sID="gen7864" type="section"/> <title>So they took Jesus;</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv837"/> and he went out, carrying his cross himself, to the place which is named from a scull, or, in Hebrew, Golgotha.

verses.name: John 19:18
verses.text: There they crucified him, and two others with him — one on each side, and Jesus between them.

verses.name: John 19:19
verses.text: Pilate also had these words written and put up over the cross — ‘JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.’

verses.name: John 19:20
verses.text: These words were read by many people, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and they were written in Hebrew, Latin and Greek.

verses.name: John 19:21
verses.text: The chief priests said to Pilate: “Do not write ‘The king of the Jews’, but write what the man said — ‘I am the king of the Jews.’”

verses.name: John 19:22
verses.text: But Pilate answered: “What I have written, I have written.”  <div eID="gen7864" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv838"/><div sID="gen7865" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv838"/> When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his clothes and divided them into four shares — a share for each soldier — and they took the coat also. The coat had no seam, being woven in one piece from top to bottom.

verses.name: John 19:24
verses.text: So they said to one another: “Do not let us tear it, but let us cast lots for it, to see who will have it.” This was in fulfillment of the words of scripture — <lg sID="gen7866"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7867"/>‘They shared my clothes among them,<l eID="gen7867" level="1"/> <l level="2" sID="gen7868"/>And over my clothing they cast lots.’<l eID="gen7868" level="2"/> <lg eID="gen7866"/> That was what the soldiers did.

verses.name: John 19:25
verses.text: Meanwhile near the cross of Jesus were standing his mother and his mother’s sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary of Magdala.

verses.name: John 19:26
verses.text: When Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved, standing near, he said to his mother: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“There is your son.”</q>

verses.name: John 19:27
verses.text: Then he said to that disciple: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“There is your mother.”</q>And from that very hour the disciple took her to live in his house.  <div eID="gen7865" type="section"/>

verses.name: John 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv839"/><div sID="gen7869" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv839"/> Afterwards, knowing that everything was now finished, Jesus said, in fulfillment of the words of scripture: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I am thirsty.”</q>

verses.name: John 19:29
verses.text: There was a bowl standing there full of common wine; so they put a sponge soaked in the wine on the end of a hyssop-stalk, and held it up to his mouth.

verses.name: John 19:30
verses.text: When Jesus had received the wine, he exclaimed: <q marker="" who="Jesus">“All is finished!”</q>Then, bowing his head, he resigned his spirit to God.

verses.name: John 19:31
verses.text: It was the Preparation day, and so, to prevent the bodies from remaining on the crosses during the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a great day), the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.

verses.name: John 19:32
verses.text: Accordingly the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man, and then those of the other who had been crucified with Jesus;

verses.name: John 19:33
verses.text: but, on coming to him, when they saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

verses.name: John 19:34
verses.text: One of the soldiers, however, pierced his side with a spear, and blood and water immediately flowed from it.

verses.name: John 19:35
verses.text: This is the statement of one who actually saw it — and his statement may be relied on, and he knows that he is speaking the truth — and it is given in order that you also may be convinced.

verses.name: John 19:36
verses.text: For all this happened in fulfillment of the words of scripture — ‘Not one of its bones will be broken.’

verses.name: John 19:37
