verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1338"/><div sID="gen8906" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1338"/> I wrote a few lines to the church; but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, declines to recognize us.

verses.name: III John 1:10
verses.text: Therefore, when I come, I will not forget his conduct in ridiculing us with his wicked tongue. Not content with that, he not only declines to recognize our friends who are followers himself, but actually prevents those who would, and expels them from the church.  <div eID="gen8906" type="section"/>

verses.name: III John 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1339"/><div sID="gen8907" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1339"/> Dear friend, take what is good for your example, not what is bad. The person who does what is good is from God; the person who does what is bad has never seen God.

verses.name: III John 1:12
verses.text: Everyone has always had a good word for Demetrius, and the truth itself speaks for him. Yes, and we also add our good word, and you know that what we say about him is true.  <div eID="gen8907" type="section"/>

verses.name: III John 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1340"/><div sID="gen8908" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1340"/> I have a great deal to say to you, but I do not care to trust it to pen and ink in a letter.

verses.name: III John 1:14
verses.text: I hope, however, it will not be long before I see you, and then we will speak face to face. Peace be with you. Our friends here send you their greetings. Greet each one of our friends.  <div eID="gen8908" type="section"/> <chapter eID="3John.1"/> <div eID="gen8902" osisID="3John" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:1
verses.text: To those who, having received the call, have been loved by God the Father and protected by Jesus Christ, From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and the brother of James.

verses.name: Jude 1:2
verses.text: May mercy, peace, and love be yours in ever increasing measure.  <div eID="gen8910" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1341"/><div sID="gen8911" type="majorSection"/> <title>Warnings against moral corruption</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1341"/> Dear friends, while I was making every effort to write to you about our common salvation, I felt that I must write to you at once to encourage you to fight in defense of the faith that has once for all been entrusted to the keeping of Christ’s people.

verses.name: Jude 1:4
verses.text: For there have crept in among you certain godless people, whose sentence has long since been pronounced, and who make the mercy of God an excuse for profligacy, and disown our only lord and master, Jesus Christ.

verses.name: Jude 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1342"/><div sID="gen8912" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1342"/> Now I want to remind you — but you already know it all — that, though the Lord delivered the people from Egypt, yet he afterwards destroyed those who refused to believe in him;

verses.name: Jude 1:6
verses.text: and that even those angels, who did not keep to their appointed spheres, but left their proper homes, have been kept by him for the judgment of the great day in everlasting chains and black darkness.

verses.name: Jude 1:7
verses.text: Like Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns near them, which gave themselves up to fornication, and fell into unnatural vice, these angels now stand out as a warning, undergoing, as they are, punishment in eternal fire.  <div eID="gen8912" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1343"/><div sID="gen8913" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1343"/> Yet in the same way these people, too, cherishing vain dreams, pollute our human nature, reject control, and malign the celestial beings.

verses.name: Jude 1:9
verses.text: Yet even Michael, the archangel, when, in his dispute with the devil, he was arguing about the body of Moses, did not venture to charge him with maligning, but said merely ‘The Lord rebuke you!’

verses.name: Jude 1:10
verses.text: But these people malign whatever they do not understand; while they use such things as they know by instinct (like the animals that have no reason) for their own corruption.

verses.name: Jude 1:11
verses.text: Alas for them! They walk in the steps of Cain; led astray by Balaam’s love of gain, they plunge into sin, and meet their ruin through rebellion like Korah.

verses.name: Jude 1:12
verses.text: These are the people who are blots on your ‘love-feasts,’ when they feast together and provide without scruple for themselves alone. They are clouds without rain, driven before the winds; they are leafless trees without a vestige of fruit, dead through and through, torn up by the roots;

verses.name: Jude 1:13
verses.text: they are wild sea waves, foaming with their own shame; they are ‘wandering stars,’ for which the blackest darkness has been reserved for ever.  <div eID="gen8913" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1344"/><div sID="gen8914" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1344"/> To these people, as to others, Enoch, the seventh in descent from Adam, declared — ‘See! The Lord has come with his hosts of holy ones around him,

verses.name: Jude 1:15
verses.text: to execute judgment on all people, and to convict all godless people of all their godless acts, which in their ungodliness they have committed, and of all the harsh words which they have spoken against him, godless sinners that they are!’  <div eID="gen8914" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1345"/><div sID="gen8915" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1345"/> These people are always murmuring, and complaining of their lot; they follow where their passions lead them; they have arrogant words on their lips; and they flatter others for the sake of what they can get from them.  <div eID="gen8915" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1346"/><div sID="gen8916" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1346"/> But you should, dear friends, recall what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.name: Jude 1:18
verses.text: how they used to say to you — ‘As time draws to an end, there will be scoffers, who will be led by their godless passions.’

verses.name: Jude 1:19
verses.text: These are the people — animal and unspiritual — who cause divisions.

verses.name: Jude 1:20
verses.text: But you must, dear friends, build up your characters on the foundation of your most holy faith, pray under the guidance of the Holy Spirit,

verses.name: Jude 1:21
verses.text: and keep within the love of God, while waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, to bring you to eternal life.

verses.name: Jude 1:22
verses.text: To some show pity, because they are in doubt. ‘Drag them out of the fire,’ and save them.

verses.name: Jude 1:23
verses.text: To others show pity, but with caution, hating the clothing polluted by their touch.  <div eID="gen8916" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8911" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Jude 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1347"/><div sID="gen8917" type="majorSection"/> <title>Ascription</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1347"/> To him who is able to guard you from falling, and to bring you into his glorious presence, blameless and rejoicing —

verses.name: Jude 1:25
verses.text: to the one God, our Savior, be ascribed, through Jesus Christ, our Lord, glory, majesty, power, and dominion, as it was before time began, is now, and will be for all time to come. Amen.  <div eID="gen8917" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Jude.1"/> <div eID="gen8909" osisID="Jude" type="book"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:1
verses.text: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him to make known to his servants, concerning what must shortly take place, and which he sent and revealed by his angel to his servant John,<l eID="gen8920"/> <lg eID="gen8919"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:2
verses.text: who testified to the message of God and to the testimony to Jesus Christ, omitting nothing of what he had seen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:3
verses.text: Blessed is the one who reads, and blessed are they who listen to, the words of this prophecy, and lay to heart what is here written; for the time is near.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1348"/><div sID="gen8921" type="majorSection"/> <title>Messages to the Seven Churches</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1348"/> From John, to the seven churches which are in Roman Asia. Blessing and peace be yours from him who is, and who was, and who will be, and from the seven spirits that are before his throne,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:5
verses.text: and from Jesus Christ, ‘the faithful witness, the first-born from the dead, and the Ruler of all the kings of the earth.’ To him who loves us and freed us from our sins by his own blood —

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:6
verses.text: and he made us ‘a kingdom of priests in the service of God,’ his Father! — to Him be ascribed glory and dominion for ever. Amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:7
verses.text: ‘He is coming among the clouds!’ Every eye will see him, even those who pierced him; ‘and all the nations of the earth will mourn over him.’ So will it be. Amen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1349"/><div sID="gen8922" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1349"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘I am the Alpha and the Omega,’</q>says the Lord, <q marker="" who="Jesus">the God who is, and who was, and who will be, the Almighty.</q>  <div eID="gen8922" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1350"/><div sID="gen8923" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1350"/> I, John, who am your brother, and who share with you in the suffering and kingship and endurance of Jesus, found myself on the island called Patmos, for the sake of the message of God and the testimony to Jesus.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:10
verses.text: I fell into a trance on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like the blast of a trumpet.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:11
verses.text: It said — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches, to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamus, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicaea.’</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:12
verses.text: I turned to see what voice it was that spoke to me; and when I turned, I saw seven golden lamps,

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:13
verses.text: and in the midst of the lamps one ‘like a man, in a robe reaching to his feet,’ and with a golden girdle across his breast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:14
verses.text: ‘The hair of his head was as white as wool, as white as snow; his eyes were like flaming fire;

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:15
verses.text: and his feet were like brass’ as when molten in a furnace; ‘his voice was like the sound of many streams,’

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:16
verses.text: in his right hand he held seven stars, from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like ‘the sun in the fulness of its power.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:17
verses.text: And, when I saw him, I fell at his feet like one dead. He laid his hand on me and said — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">the Everliving. I died, and I am alive for ever and ever. And I hold the keys of the Grave and of the place of the dead.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore write of what you have seen and of what is happening now and of what is about to take place — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 1:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">the mystic meaning of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamps. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lamps are the seven churches.</q>  <chapter eID="Rev.1"/> <div eID="gen8923" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1351"/><div sID="gen8924" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1351"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: — <lb/> “These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand, and walks among the seven golden lamps: — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know your life, your toil and endurance, and I know that you cannot tolerate evil-doers. I know, too, how you tested those who declare that they are apostles, though they are not, and how you proved them false.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You possess endurance, and have borne much for my name, and have never grown weary.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But this I have against you — You have abandoned your first love.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore remember from what you have fallen, and repent, and live the life that you lived before; or else, I will come and remove your Lamp from its place, unless you repent.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But this is in your favor — You hate the life lived by the Nikolaitans, and I also hate it.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:7
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let him who has ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches. To him who conquers — to him I will give the right ‘to eat the fruit of the Tree of life, which stands in the Paradise of God.’ “</q>  <div eID="gen8924" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1352"/><div sID="gen8925" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1352"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: — <lb/> “These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died, but is restored to life: — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know your persecution and your poverty — yet you are rich! I know, too, the slander that comes from those who declare that they are God's people<note>God’s people: Literally ‘Jews.’ These people claimed to be God’s people because they were Jews.</note>, though they are not, but are a Congregation of Satan.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil is about to throw some of you into prison so that you may be tempted, and may undergo persecution for ten days. Be faithful even to death, and I will give you the Crown of life.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let those who have ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches. Those who conquer will suffer no hurt from the Second Death.”</q>  <div eID="gen8925" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1353"/><div sID="gen8926" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1353"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Pergamus write: — <lb/> “These are the words of him who holds the sharp two-edged sword: — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know where you live, where the throne of Satan stands. And yet you hold to my name, and you did not disown my faith even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death among you where Satan dwells.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:14
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet I have a few things against you — You have among you those who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put temptations in the way of the Israelites, so that they should eat idol-offerings and commit licentious acts.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Again you have among you those who hold in the same way to the teaching of the Nikolaitans.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore repent, or else, I will come quickly and contend with such people with words that will cut like a sword.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let those who have ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches. To those who conquer — to them I will give a share of the mystic manna, and I will give them a white stone; and on the stone will be inscribed a new name, which no one knows except the person who receives it.”</q>  <div eID="gen8926" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1354"/><div sID="gen8927" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1354"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: — <lb/> “These are the words of the Son of God, ‘whose eyes are like flaming fire, and whose feet are like brass’: — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know your life, your love, faith, service, and endurance; and I know that your life of late has been better than it was at first.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet I have this against you — You tolerate the woman Jezebel, who declares that she is a Prophetess, and misleads my servants by her teaching, until they commit licentious acts and eat idol-offerings.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I gave her time to repent, but she is determined not to turn from her licentiousness.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore I am laying her on a bed of sickness, and bringing great suffering on those who are unfaithful with her, unless they repent and turn from a life like hers.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:23
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I will also put her children to death; and all the churches will learn that I am he who ‘looks into people's hearts and souls’; and I will give to each one of you what their life deserves.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:24
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But I say to the rest of you at Thyatira — all who do not accept such teaching, whose who did not learn ‘the secrets of Satan,’ as people call them — I am not laying on you any further burden;</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:25
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">only hold fast to what you have received, until I come.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:26
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">To those who conquer and are careful to live my life to the end — to them I will give authority over the nations,</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:27
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and ‘they will rule them with an iron rod, as when earthen vessels are broken in pieces’ (as I myself have received from my Father)</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:28
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">and I will give them the morning star.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 2:29
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let those who have ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches.”</q>  <chapter eID="Rev.2"/> <div eID="gen8927" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1355"/><div sID="gen8928" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1355"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Sardis write: — <lb/> “These are the words of him who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars; — I know your life, and that people say of you that you are living, though you are dead.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:2
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Be on the watch, and strengthen what still survives, though once it was all but dead; for I have not found your life perfect in the eyes of my God.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:3
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore remember what you have received and heard, and lay it to heart and repent. Unless you are on the watch, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I am coming to you.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:4
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Yet there are some few among you at Sardis who did not soil their robes; they will walk with me, robed in white, for they are worthy.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:5
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Those who conquer will be clothed in these white robes, and I will not ‘strike their name out of the book of life’; but I will own them before my Father, and before his angels.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:6
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let those who have ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches.”</q>  <div eID="gen8928" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1356"/><div sID="gen8929" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1356"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: — <lb/> “These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds ‘the Key of David, who opens and no one will shut, and shuts and no one opens’: — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:8
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know your life (see, I have set a door open before you which no one is able to shut), I know that, though you have but little strength, you kept my teaching in mind, and did not disown my name.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:9
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Listen, I give some of the Congregation of Satan, the people who declare that they are God's people<note>God’s people: Literally ‘Jews.’ These people claimed to be God’s people because they were Jews.</note>, though they are not, but are lying — I will make them ‘come and bow down at your feet,’ and they will learn that I loved you.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:10
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Because you kept in mind the story of my endurance, I will keep you in the hour of trial that is about to come on the whole world, the hour that will test all who are living on earth.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:11
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I will come quickly. Hold to what you have received so that no one may take your crown.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Those who conquer — I will make them a pillar in the Temple of my God; and never more will they leave it; and I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the New Jerusalem, which is coming down out of heaven from my God, and I will write on them my new name.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let those who have ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches.”</q>  <div eID="gen8929" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1357"/><div sID="gen8930" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1357"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">To the angel of the church in Laodicaea write: — <lb/> “These are the words of the Unchanging One, ‘the witness faithful and true, the beginning of the Creation of God’: — </q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I know your life; I know that you are neither cold nor hot. If only you were either cold or hot!</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:16
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">But now, because you are lukewarm, neither hot not cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:17
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">You say ‘I am rich and have grown rich, and I want for nothing,’ and you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, naked!</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:18
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Therefore I counsel you to buy from me gold which has been refined by fire so that you may grow rich; and white robes, so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness be hidden; and ointment to anoint your eyes, so that you may see.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:19
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘All whom I love I rebuke and discipline.’ Therefore be in earnest and repent.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:20
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am standing at the door and knocking! If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will go in, and will feast with them, and they will feast with me.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:21
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">To those who conquer — to them I will give the right to sit beside me on my throne, as I, when I conquered, took my seat beside my Father on his throne.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 3:22
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">Let those who have ears hear what the Spirit is saying to the churches.”</q>  <div eID="gen8930" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Rev.3"/> <div eID="gen8921" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:1
verses.text: After this, in my vision, I saw an open door in the heavens, and the first voice that I heard was like the blast of a trumpet speaking to me. It said — ‘Come up here and I will show you what must take place.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:2
verses.text: Immediately after this I fell into a trance. There stood a throne in heaven, and on the throne was One seated.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:3
verses.text: He who was seated on it was in appearance like a jasper and a sardius; and ‘around the throne there was a rainbow’ of the color of an emerald.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:4
verses.text: And around the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these I saw twenty-four councillors sitting clothed in white robes; and on their heads they had crowns of gold.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:5
verses.text: Out from the throne ‘come flashes of lightning, cries, and peals of thunder’! There are seven torches burning in front of the throne, which are the seven spirits of God;

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:6
verses.text: and in front of the throne is what seemed to be a sea of glass, ‘resembling crystal, while within the space before the throne and around the throne are four Creatures full of eyes’ in front and behind.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:7
verses.text: The first Creature is like a lion, the second Creature like a calf, the third Creature has a face like a man’s, and the fourth Creature is like an eagle on the wing.

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:8
verses.text: These four Creatures have each of them six wings, and all around, and within, they are full of eyes; and day and night they never cease to say — <lg sID="gen8932"/> <l sID="gen8933"/>‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, our God, the Almighty, who was, and who is, and who will be.’<l eID="gen8933"/> <lg eID="gen8932"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:9
verses.text: And, whenever these Creatures give praise and honor and thanks to him who is ‘seated on the throne, to him who lives for ever and ever,’

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:10
verses.text: the twenty-four councillors prostrate themselves before him who is seated on the throne, and worship him who lives for ever and ever, and throw down their crowns before the throne, saying — <lg sID="gen8934"/> <l sID="gen8935"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 4:11
verses.text: ‘Worthy are you, our Lord and God, to receive all praise, and honor, and power, for you did create all things, and at your bidding they came into being and were created.’<l eID="gen8935"/> <lg eID="gen8934"/>  <chapter eID="Rev.4"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:1
verses.text: Then I saw at the right hand of him who was ‘seated on the throne a book, with writing inside and out, and sealed’ with seven seals;

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:2
verses.text: and I saw a mighty angel who was proclaiming in a loud voice — ‘Who is worthy to open the book and break its seals?’

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:3
verses.text: But no one either in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the book or look within it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:4
verses.text: At this I wept long, because no one could be found who was worthy to open the book or look within it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:5
verses.text: But one of the councillors said to me — ‘Do not weep. The Lion conquered — the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Scion of David — and can therefore open the book with its seven seals.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1358"/><div sID="gen8936" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1358"/> Then, within the space between the throne and the four Creatures, and in the midst of the councillors, I saw, standing, a Lamb, which seemed to have been sacrificed. It had seven horns and seven eyes. (These eyes are the seven spirits of God, and they are sent into all the world.)

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:7
verses.text: The Lamb came forward; and he has taken the book from the right hand of him who was seated on the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:8
verses.text: And, when he had taken the book, the four Creatures and the twenty-four councillors prostrated themselves before the Lamb, each of them holding a harp and golden bowls full of incense. (These are the prayers of Christ’s people.)

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:9
verses.text: And they are singing a new song — <lg sID="gen8937"/> <l sID="gen8938"/>‘You are worthy to take the book and break its seals, for you were sacrificed, and with your blood you did buy for God people of every tribe, and language, and people, and nation,<l eID="gen8938"/> <lg eID="gen8937"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:10
verses.text: and did make them a kingdom of priests in the service of our God, and they are reigning on the earth.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:11
verses.text: Then, in my vision, I heard the voices of many angels around the throne, and of the Creatures, and of the councillors. In number they were ‘ten thousand times ten thousand and thousands of thousands,’

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:12
verses.text: and they cried in a loud voice — <lg sID="gen8939"/> <l sID="gen8940"/>‘Worthy is the Lamb that was sacrificed to receive all power, and wealth, and wisdom, and might, and honor, and praise, and blessing.’<l eID="gen8940"/> <lg eID="gen8939"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:13
verses.text: And I heard every created thing in the air, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all that is in them crying — <lg sID="gen8941"/> <l sID="gen8942"/>‘To him who is seated on the throne and to the Lamb be ascribed all blessing, and honor, and praise, and dominion for ever and ever.’<l eID="gen8942"/> <lg eID="gen8941"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 5:14
verses.text: And the four Creatures said ‘Amen,’ and the councillors prostrated themselves and worshiped.  <div eID="gen8936" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.5"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1359"/><div sID="gen8943" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1359"/> Then I saw the Lamb break one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four Creatures crying with a voice like thunder — ‘Come.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:2
verses.text: And in my vision I saw ‘a white horse.’ Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he went out conquering and to conquer.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1360"/><div sID="gen8944" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1360"/> When the Lamb broke the second seal, I heard the second Creature crying — ‘Come.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:4
verses.text: Then there went out another horse, ‘a red horse,’ and to its rider was given the power to deprive the earth of peace, so that people should kill one another; and he was given a great sword.  <div eID="gen8944" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1361"/><div sID="gen8945" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1361"/> When the Lamb broke the third seal, I heard the third Creature crying — ‘Come.’ And in my vision I saw ‘a black horse.’ Its rider held scales in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:6
verses.text: And I heard what seemed to be a voice, coming from among the four Creatures, crying — ‘A quart of wheat for a silver coin, and three quarts of barley for a silver coin! But do not harm the oil and the wine.’  <div eID="gen8945" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1362"/><div sID="gen8946" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1362"/> When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth Creature crying — ‘Come.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:8
verses.text: And in my vision I saw a grey horse. His rider’s name was Death, and the Lord of the place of Death rode behind him; and power was given them over the fourth part of the earth, so that they might ‘destroy with sword and famine and death, and by means of the wild beasts of the earth.’  <div eID="gen8946" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1363"/><div sID="gen8947" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1363"/> When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the sake of God’s message and for the testimony which they had borne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:10
verses.text: They cried in a loud voice — ‘How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, before you will give judgment and avenge our blood on all who are living on the earth?’

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:11
verses.text: Then to each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to rest yet a little longer, until the number of their fellow servants and of their friends in Christ's service who were about to be put to death, as they had been, should be complete.  <div eID="gen8947" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1364"/><div sID="gen8948" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1364"/> And I saw the Lamb break the sixth seal, and then there was a great earthquake. The sun became black, like sackcloth, and the moon, which was at its full, like blood.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:13
verses.text: ‘The stars of the heavens fell’ to the earth, as when a fig-tree, shaken by a strong wind, drops its unripe fruit.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:14
verses.text: The heavens disappeared like a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:15
verses.text: Then all the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the generals, and the rich, and the powerful, and every slave and free person, ‘hid themselves in the caves and under the rocks’ of the mountains;

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:16
verses.text: and they are crying to the mountains and the rocks — ‘Fall on us, and hide us from the eyes of him who is seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

verses.name: Revelation of John 6:17
verses.text: for the great day of their wrath is come, and who can stand to meet it?’  <div eID="gen8948" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1365"/><div sID="gen8949" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8949" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.6"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:1
verses.text: After this, I saw four angels standing ‘on the four corners of the earth,’ restraining the four winds of the earth, so that no wind should blow over the earth, or over the sea, or against any tree.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:2
verses.text: And, in the east, I saw another angel, ascending, holding the seal of the living God; and he cried in a loud voice to the four angels, to whom there had been given power to harm the earth and the sea —

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:3
verses.text: ‘Do not harm the earth, or the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:4
verses.text: I heard, too, the number of those who had been sealed. It was one hundred and forty-four thousand; and they were from every tribe of the Israelites. <lg sID="gen8950"/> <l sID="gen8951"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:5
verses.text: From the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed,<l eID="gen8951"/> <l sID="gen8952"/>from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8952"/> <l sID="gen8953"/>from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8953"/> <l sID="gen8954"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:6
verses.text: from the tribe of Asher twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8954"/> <l sID="gen8955"/>from the tribe of Napthali twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8955"/> <l sID="gen8956"/>from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8956"/> <l sID="gen8957"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:7
verses.text: from the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8957"/> <l sID="gen8958"/>from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8958"/> <l sID="gen8959"/>from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8959"/> <l sID="gen8960"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:8
verses.text: from the tribe of Zebulon twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8960"/> <l sID="gen8961"/>from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand,<l eID="gen8961"/> <l sID="gen8962"/>from the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.<l eID="gen8962"/> <lg eID="gen8950"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:9
verses.text: After this, in my vision, I saw a vast throng which no one could number, of people from every nation and of all tribes, and peoples, and languages. They stood in front of the throne and in front of the Lamb, robed in white, holding palm branches in their hands.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:10
verses.text: And they are crying in a loud voice — <lg sID="gen8963"/> <l sID="gen8964"/>‘salvation be ascribed to our God who is seated on his throne and to the Lamb.’<l eID="gen8964"/> <lg eID="gen8963"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:11
verses.text: And all the angels were standing around the throne and the councillors and the four Creatures, and they prostrated themselves on their faces in front of the throne and worshiped God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:12
verses.text: saying — <lg sID="gen8965"/> <l sID="gen8966"/>‘Amen. Blessing and praise, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might be ascribed to our God for ever and ever. Amen.’<l eID="gen8966"/> <lg eID="gen8965"/>  <div eID="gen8943" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1365"/><div sID="gen8967" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1365"/> Then one of the councillors turned to me and said ‘Who are these who are robed in white? And where did they come from?’

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1366"/><div sID="gen8968" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1366"/> ‘My Lord,’ I answered, ‘it is you who know.’ <div eID="gen8968" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8969" type="paragraph"/> ‘These,’ he said, ‘are they who come through the Great Persecution; they washed their robes white in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:15
verses.text: And therefore it is that they are before the throne of God, and are serving him day and night in his Temple; and he who is seated on the throne will shelter them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:16
verses.text: Never again will they be hungry, never again will they be thirsty, nor will the sun smite them, nor any scorching heat;

verses.name: Revelation of John 7:17
verses.text: for the Lamb that stands in the space before the throne will be their shepherd, and will lead them to life-giving springs of water; and God will wipe away all tears from their eyes.’  <div eID="gen8969" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1367"/><div sID="gen8970" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8970" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.7"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:1
verses.text: As soon as the Lamb had broken the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for, it might be, half an hour.  <div eID="gen8967" type="section"/> <div eID="gen8931" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1367"/><div sID="gen8971" type="majorSection"/> <title>Vision of Seven Trumpet-Blasts</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1367"/> Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1368"/><div sID="gen8972" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1368"/> Next, another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer in his hand; and a great quantity of incense was given to him, to mingle with the prayers of all Christ’s people on the golden altar before the throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:4
verses.text: The smoke of the incense ascended, with the prayers of Christ’s people, from the hand of the angel before God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:5
verses.text: Then the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it down on the earth; and there followed ‘peals of thunder, cries, flashes of lightning,’ and an earthquake.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:6
verses.text: Then the seven angels holding the seven trumpets prepared to blow their blasts.  <div eID="gen8972" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1369"/><div sID="gen8973" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1369"/> The first blew; and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it fell on the earth. A third part of the earth was burnt up, and a third of the trees, and every blade of grass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1370"/><div sID="gen8974" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1370"/> Then the second angel blew; and what appeared to be a great mountain, burning, was hurled into the sea. A third of the sea became blood,

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:9
verses.text: and a third part of all created things that are in the sea — that is, of all living things — died, and a third of the ships was destroyed.  <div eID="gen8974" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1371"/><div sID="gen8975" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1371"/> Then the third angel blew; and there fell from the heavens a great star, burning like a torch. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs.

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:11
verses.text: (The star is called ‘Wormwood.’) A third of the water became bitter as wormwood, and so bitter was the water that many died from drinking it.  <div eID="gen8975" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1372"/><div sID="gen8976" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1372"/> Then the fourth angel blew; and a third of the sun and a third of the moon and a third of the stars were blasted, so that a third of them was eclipsed, and for a third part of the day there was no light, and at night it was the same.  <div eID="gen8976" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1373"/><div sID="gen8977" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1373"/> And, in my vision, I heard an eagle flying in mid-heaven and crying in a loud voice — ‘Woe, woe, woe for all who live on the earth, at the other trumpet-blasts of the three angels who have yet to blow.’  <div eID="gen8977" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1374"/><div sID="gen8978" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8978" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.8"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:1
verses.text: Then the fifth angel blew; and I saw a star that had fallen on the earth from the heavens, and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:2
verses.text: He opened the bottomless pit, and from the pit rose a smoke like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air grew dark because of the smoke from the pit.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:3
verses.text: Out of the smoke locusts descended on the earth, and they received the same power as that possessed by scorpions.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:4
verses.text: They were told not to harm the grass, or any plant, or any tree, but only those who have not ‘the seal of God on their foreheads.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:5
verses.text: Yet they were not allowed to kill them, but it was ordered that those men should be tortured for five months. Their torture was like the torture caused by a scorpion when it stings a person.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:6
verses.text: In those days people ‘will seek Death and will not find it’; They will long to die, but Death flees from them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:7
verses.text: In appearance the locusts were like horses equipped for battle. On their heads there were what appeared to be crowns that shone like gold, their faces resembled human faces,

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:8
verses.text: and they had hair like the hair of a woman, their teeth were like lions’ teeth,

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:9
verses.text: and they had what seemed to be iron breastplates, while the noise of their wings was like the noise of chariots drawn by many horses, galloping into battle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:10
verses.text: They have tails like scorpions, and stings, and in their tails lies their power to harm people for five months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:11
verses.text: They have as their king the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name, in Hebrew, is ‘Abaddon,’ while, in Greek, his name is ‘Apollyon’ (the Destroyer).

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1374"/><div sID="gen8979" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1374"/> The first Woe has passed; and still there are two Woes to follow!  <div eID="gen8979" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8973" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1375"/><div sID="gen8980" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1375"/> Then the sixth angel blew; and I heard a voice proceeding from the corners of the golden altar that stood before God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:14
verses.text: It spoke to the sixth angel — the angel with the trumpet — and said ‘Let loose the four angels that are in chains at the great river Euphrates.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:15
verses.text: Then the four angels, that were held in readiness for that hour and day and month and year, were let loose, to destroy a third of mankind.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:16
verses.text: The number of the hosts of cavalry was ten thousand times ten thousand, twice told; I heard their number.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:17
verses.text: And this is what the horses and their riders appeared to be like in my vision: — They had breastplates of fire, blood-red and sulphurous, and the heads of the horses were like lions’ heads, while out of their mouths issue fire, and smoke, and sulphur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:18
verses.text: Through these three curses a third of humanity perished — because of the fire, and the smoke, and the sulphur that issued from their mouths;

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:19
verses.text: for the power of the horses lies in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like snakes, with heads, and it is with them that they do harm.

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:20
verses.text: But those who were left of humanity, who had not perished through these curses, did not repent and turn away from what their own hands had made; they would not abandon the worship of ‘demons, and of idols made of gold or silver or brass or stone or wood, which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk’;

verses.name: Revelation of John 9:21
verses.text: and they did not repent of their murders, or their sorceries, or their licentiousness, or their thefts.  <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1376"/><div sID="gen8981" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8981" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.9"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:1
verses.text: Then I saw another mighty angel, descending from heaven. His robe was a cloud; over his head was the rainbow; his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:2
verses.text: in his hand he held a little book open. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land;

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:3
verses.text: and he cried in a loud voice like the roaring of a lion. At his cry the seven peals of thunder spoke, each with its own voice.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:4
verses.text: And, when they spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say — ‘Keep secret what the seven peals of thunder said, and do not write it down.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:5
verses.text: Then the angel, whom I had seen standing on the sea and on the land, ‘raised his right hand to the heavens,

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:6
verses.text: and swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, and the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it,’ that time should cease to be.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:7
verses.text: Moreover at the time when the seventh angel will speak, when he is ready to blow his blast, then the hidden purposes of God, of which he told the good news to his servants, the prophets, are at once fulfilled.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:8
verses.text: Then came the voice which I had heard from heaven. It spoke to me again, and said — ‘Go and take the book that is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:9
verses.text: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little book. And he said ‘Take it, and eat it. It will be bitter to your stomach, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:10
verses.text: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand ‘and ate it, and, while in my mouth, it was like the sweetest honey’; but, when I had eaten it, it was bitter to my stomach.

verses.name: Revelation of John 10:11
verses.text: And I was told — ‘You must prophesy again about men of many peoples, and nations, and languages, and about many kings.’  <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1376"/><div sID="gen8982" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8982" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.10"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:1
verses.text: Then I was given a measure like a rod, and a voice said to me — ‘Go and measure the Temple of God and the altar, and count the worshiper there.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:2
verses.text: But omit the court outside the Temple, and do not measure that, for it has been given up to the nations; and the holy City will be under their heel for forty-two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:3
verses.text: Then I will give permission to my Two Witnesses, and for those twelve hundred and sixty days they will continue teaching, clothed in sackcloth.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:4
verses.text: These men are represented by ‘the two olive trees and the two lamps that stand before the Lord of the earth.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:5
verses.text: When anyone wishes to harm them, ‘fire comes from their mouths and consumes their enemies’; and whoever wishes to harm them will, in this way, inevitably perish.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:6
verses.text: These men have the power to close the heavens, so that ‘no rain may fall’ during the time that they are teaching; and they have power ‘to turn the streams into blood, and to smite the land with any curse,’ whenever they will.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:7
verses.text: As soon as they have completed their testimony, ‘the wild Beast that ascends from the bottomless pit will make war on them and conquer’ and kill them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:8
verses.text: Their dead bodies will lie in the streets of the great city, which is mystically spoken of as ‘Sodom’ and ‘Egypt,’ where their Master was crucified.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:9
verses.text: People of all nations, and tribes, and languages, and races look at their dead bodies for three days and a half, and do not allow them to be laid in a grave.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:10
verses.text: Those who live on the earth rejoice over them and are merry, and they will send presents to one another, because these two prophets brought torments on those who live on the earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:11
verses.text: After three days and a half ‘the life-giving breath of God entered these men, and they stood up on their feet,’ and a great terror took possession of those who were watching them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:12
verses.text: The two men heard a loud voice from heaven which said to them — ‘Come up here,’ and they went up to heaven in the cloud, while their enemies watched them.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:13
verses.text: At that very time a great earthquake occurred. A tenth part of the city fell, and seven thousand people perished in the earthquake. Those who escaped were much terrified, and praised the God of heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1376"/><div sID="gen8983" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1376"/> The second Woe has passed; and there is a third Woe soon to follow!  <div eID="gen8983" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8980" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1377"/><div sID="gen8984" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1377"/> Then the seventh angel blew; and loud voices were heard in heaven saying — <lg sID="gen8985"/> <l sID="gen8986"/>‘The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign for ever and ever.’<l eID="gen8986"/> <lg eID="gen8985"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:16
verses.text: At this the twenty-four councillors, who were seated on their thrones before God, prostrated themselves on their faces and worshiped Him,

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:17
verses.text: saying — <lg sID="gen8987"/> <l sID="gen8988"/>‘We thank you, Lord, our God, the Almighty, who is and who was, that you have assumed your great power and reigned.<l eID="gen8988"/> <lg eID="gen8987"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:18
verses.text: The nations were enraged, and your wrath fell on them; the time came for the dead to be judged, and for you to give the reward to your servants the prophets, and to the people of Christ, and to those who honor your name — the high and the low alike — and to destroy those who are destroying the earth.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 11:19
verses.text: Then the Temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark containing his covenant was seen in his Temple; and there followed ‘flashes of lightning, cries, peals of thunder,’ an earthquake, and ‘a great storm of hail.’  <div eID="gen8984" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Rev.11"/> <div eID="gen8971" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:1
verses.text: Then a great portent was seen in the heavens — a woman whose robe was the sun, and who had the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:2
verses.text: She was pregnant; and ‘she is crying out in the pain and agony of childbirth.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:3
verses.text: Another portent also was seen in the heavens There was a great red Dragon, with seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads were seven diadems.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:4
verses.text: His tail draws after it a third of the stars in the heavens, and it hurled them down on the earth. The Dragon is standing in front of the woman who is about to give birth to the child, so that he may devour it as soon as it is born.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:5
verses.text: The woman gave birth to a son, a male child, who is destined to rule all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was at once caught up to God on his throne.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:6
verses.text: But the woman fled into the wilderness, where there is a place prepared for her by God, to be tended there for twelve hundred and sixty days.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1378"/><div sID="gen8990" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1378"/> Then a battle took place in the heavens. Michael and his angels fought with the Dragon. But though the Dragon, with his angels, fought,

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:8
verses.text: he did not prevail; and there was no place left for them any longer in the heavens.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:9
verses.text: Then the great Dragon, the primeval snake, known as the ‘devil’ and ‘Satan,’ who deceives all the world, was hurled down to the earth, and his angels were hurled down with him.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:10
verses.text: And I heard a loud voice in heaven which said — <lg sID="gen8991"/> <l sID="gen8992"/>‘Now has begun the day of the salvation, and Power, and Dominion of our God, and the Rule of his Christ; for the Accuser of our people has been hurled down, he who has been accusing them before our God day and night.<l eID="gen8992"/> <lg eID="gen8991"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:11
verses.text: Their victory was due to the blood of the Lamb, and to the message to which they bore their testimony. In their love of life they shrank not from death.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:12
verses.text: Therefore, be glad, heaven, and all who live in heaven! Alas for the earth and for the sea, for the devil has gone down to you in great fury, knowing that he has but little time.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:13
verses.text: when the Dragon saw that he was hurled down to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:14
verses.text: But to the woman were given the two wings of the great eagle, so that she might fly to her place in the wilderness, where she is being tended for ‘one year, and for two years, and for half a year’ in safety from the snake.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:15
verses.text: Then the snake poured water from its mouth after the woman, like a river, so that it might sweep her away.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:16
verses.text: But Earth came to her help, and opened her mouth and drank up the river which the Dragon had poured out of its mouth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 12:17
verses.text: The Dragon was enraged at the woman, and went to fight with the rest of her offspring — those who lay to heart the commands of God and bear their testimony to Jesus; and he took his stand on the sea-shore.  <div eID="gen8990" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1379"/><div sID="gen8993" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8993" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.12"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:1
verses.text: Then I saw, ‘rising out of the sea, a wild Beast with ten horns’ and seven heads. On its horns were ten diadems, and on its heads were blasphemous names.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:2
verses.text: The Beast that I saw was like a leopard; but its feet were like a bear’s, and its mouth like the mouth of a lion. The Dragon gave it his power and his throne, and wide dominion.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:3
verses.text: One of its heads seemed to me to have been mortally wounded, but its deadly wound had been healed. The whole earth followed the Beast, wondering;

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:4
verses.text: and men worshiped the Dragon, because he had given his dominion to the Beast; while, as they worshiped the Beast, they said — ‘Who can compare with the Beast? And who can fight with it?’

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:5
verses.text: The Beast was given ‘a mouth that spoke proudly’ and blasphemously, and it was empowered to work its will for forty-two months.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:6
verses.text: It opened its mouth only to blaspheme God, to blaspheme his name and his tent — those who live in his tent in heaven.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:7
verses.text: It had been permitted to fight with Christ’s people and to conquer them, and it had received power over men of every tribe, and people, and language, and nation.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:8
verses.text: All who are living on earth will worship it — all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb that has been sacrificed from the foundation of the world.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:9
verses.text: Let those who have ears hear.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:10
verses.text: ‘Whoever is destined for captivity goes into captivity.’ Whoever will kill with the sword must inevitably be killed with the sword. (Here there is need for endurance and faith on the part of Christ’s people.)

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1379"/><div sID="gen8994" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1379"/> Then I saw, rising out of the earth, another wild Beast. It had two horns like those of a lamb, and its voice was like a dragon’s.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:12
verses.text: It exercises all the authority of the first Beast under its eyes; and it makes the earth and all who are living on it worship that first Beast, whose mortal wound was healed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:13
verses.text: It performs great marvels, even causing fire to fall from the heavens to the earth, before people’s eyes;

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:14
verses.text: and in consequence of the marvels which it was allowed to perform under the eyes of the Beast, it is able to deceive all who are living on the earth. It tells those who live on the earth to make a statue in honor of the Beast, who, despite the wound from the sword, yet lived.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:15
verses.text: It was permitted to breathe life into the image of the Beast, so that the image of the Beast might speak; and it was also permitted to cause all who refused to worship the image of the Beast to be put to death.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:16
verses.text: High and low, rich and poor, free and enslaved — it causes a brand to be put on the right hand or on the forehead of every one of them,

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:17
verses.text: so that no one is able to buy or sell, except those that bear this brand — either the name of the Beast or the number indicated by the letters of his name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 13:18
verses.text: (Here there is need for discernment.) Let him who has the ability compute the number of the Beast; for the number indicates a person’s name. Its number is six hundred and sixty-six.  <div eID="gen8994" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.13"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1380"/><div sID="gen8995" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1380"/> Then, in my vision, I saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion. With him were a hundred and forty-four thousand, with his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:2
verses.text: And I heard a sound from heaven, ‘like the sound of many waters,’ and like the sound of a loud peal of thunder; the sound that I heard was like the music of harpers playing on their harps.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:3
verses.text: They are singing what seems to be a new song, before the throne, and before the four Creatures and the councillors; and no one was able to learn that song except the hundred and forty-four thousand who had been redeemed from earth.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:4
verses.text: These are the men who never defiled themselves in their intercourse with women; they are as pure as virgins. These are the men who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were redeemed as the first-fruits of mankind for God and for the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:5
verses.text: ‘No lie was ever heard on their lips.’ They are beyond reach of blame.  <div eID="gen8995" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1381"/><div sID="gen8996" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1381"/> Then I saw another angel, flying in mid-heaven. He had the good news, decreed from eternity, to announce to those who live on the earth — to men of every nation, and tribe, and language, and people;

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:7
verses.text: and he cried in a loud voice — ‘Reverence God, and give him praise (for the hour of his judgment has come) and worship him who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all springs of water.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1382"/><div sID="gen8997" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1382"/> Then a second angel followed, crying — ‘She has fallen! She has fallen — Babylon the Great, who has made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her licentiousness!’  <div eID="gen8997" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1383"/><div sID="gen8998" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1383"/> Then a third angel followed them, crying in a loud voice — ‘Whoever worships the Beast and its image, and receives its brand on his forehead or on his hand,

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:10
verses.text: that person will drink the maddening wine of God that has been poured unmixed into the cup of his wrath, and they will be tortured with fire and sulphur before the eyes of the holy angels and before the eyes of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:11
verses.text: The smoke from their torture rises for ever and ever, and they have no rest day nor night — those who worship the Beast and its image, and all who are branded with its name.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:12
verses.text: (Here there is need for endurance on the part of Christ’s people — those who lay to heart the commands of God and the faith of Jesus.)

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:13
verses.text: Then I heard a voice from heaven saying ‘Write — “Blessed are the dead who from this hour die in union with the Lord.” <div eID="gen8998" type="paragraph"/> <div sID="gen8999" type="paragraph"/> “Yes,” answers the Spirit, “that they may rest from their toil. Their good deeds go with them.”’  <div eID="gen8999" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen8996" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1384"/><div sID="gen9000" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1384"/> Then, in my vision, I saw a white cloud, and on the cloud there was sitting one ‘like a man.’ On his head he had a crown of gold, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1385"/><div sID="gen9001" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1385"/> Then another angel came out from the Temple, crying in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud — ‘Take your sickle and reap, for the time to reap has come; the Harvest of Earth is ready.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:16
verses.text: He who was sitting on the cloud brought his sickle down on the earth, and the Harvest of Earth was reaped.  <div eID="gen9001" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1386"/><div sID="gen9002" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1386"/> Then another angel came out of the Temple in heaven; he, also, had a sharp sickle.  <div eID="gen9002" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1387"/><div sID="gen9003" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1387"/> Then another angel came out of the altar; he had power over fire, and he called in a loud voice to the angel that had the sharp sickle — ‘Take your sharp sickle, and gather the bunches from the Vine of Earth, for its grapes are ripe.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:19
verses.text: The angel brought his sickle down on the earth and gathered the fruit of the Vine of Earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 14:20
verses.text: The ‘grapes were trodden in the press’ outside the city; and blood came out of the press, rising as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of two hundred miles.  <div eID="gen9003" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen9000" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Rev.14"/> <div eID="gen8989" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:1
verses.text: Then I saw another portent in the heavens — a great and marvelous portent — seven angels with the seven last curses; because with them the wrath of God is ended.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1388"/><div sID="gen9005" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1388"/> Then I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire; and, standing by this sea of glass, holding the harps of God, I saw those who had come victorious out of the conflict with the Beast and its image and the number that formed its name.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:3
verses.text: They are singing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb — <lg sID="gen9006"/> <l sID="gen9007"/>‘Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord, our God, the Almighty. Righteous and true are your ways, eternal King.<l eID="gen9007"/> <lg eID="gen9006"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:4
verses.text: Who will not honor and praise your name, Lord? You alone are holy! All nations will come and worship before you, for your judgments have become manifest.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:5
verses.text: After this I saw that the inmost shrine of the tent of testimony in heaven was opened,

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:6
verses.text: and out of it came the seven angels with the seven curses. They were adorned with precious stones, pure and bright, and had golden girdles around their breasts.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:7
verses.text: One of the four Creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls, filled with the wrath of God who lives for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 15:8
verses.text: ‘The Temple was filled with smoke from the glory’ and Majesty of God; and no one could enter the Temple, until the seven curses inflicted by the seven angels were at an end.  <div eID="gen9005" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.15"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:1
verses.text: Then I heard a loud voice, which came from the Temple, saying to the seven angels — ‘Go and empty the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1389"/><div sID="gen9008" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1389"/> The first angel went and emptied his bowl on the earth; and it turned to loathsome and painful sores on all who bore the brand of the Beast and who worshiped its image.  <div eID="gen9008" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1390"/><div sID="gen9009" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1390"/> Then the second angel emptied his bowl on the sea; and it turned to blood like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing died — everything in the sea.  <div eID="gen9009" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1391"/><div sID="gen9010" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1391"/> Then the third angel emptied his bowl on the rivers and springs of water; and it turned to blood.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:5
verses.text: And I heard the angel of the Waters saying — ‘Righteous are you, you who is and who is, the Holy One, in inflicting this judgment;

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:6
verses.text: for men shed the blood of Christ’s people and of the prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:7
verses.text: And I heard the response from the altar — ‘Yes, Lord, our God, the Almighty, true and righteous are they judgments.’  <div eID="gen9010" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1392"/><div sID="gen9011" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1392"/> Then the fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun; and he was permitted to scorch men with fire;

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:9
verses.text: and men were scorched by the intense heat. They blasphemed the name of God who controlled these curses, yet they did not repent and give him praise.  <div eID="gen9011" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1393"/><div sID="gen9012" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1393"/> Then the fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the Beast; and darkness fell on its kingdom. Men gnawed their tongues for pain,

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:11
verses.text: and blasphemed the God of heaven, because of their pains and because of their sores; yet they did not repent of what they had done.  <div eID="gen9012" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1394"/><div sID="gen9013" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1394"/> Then the sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great river Euphrates; and the water in the river was dried up, so that the road for the kings of the East might be made ready.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:13
verses.text: And I saw three foul spirits, like frogs, come from the mouth of the Dragon and from the mouth of the Beast and from the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:14
verses.text: They are the spirits of demons, and perform marvels; they go to kings all over the world, to collect them for the battle on the great day of Almighty God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:15
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">(‘I am coming like a thief! Happy will he be who is on the watch, and keeps his clothing at hand, so that he will not have to walk about unclothed and let men see his nakedness.’)</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:16
verses.text: And the spirits collected the kings at the place called in Hebrew ‘Har-Magedon.’  <div eID="gen9013" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1395"/><div sID="gen9014" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1395"/> Then the seventh angel emptied his bowl on the air. (A loud voice came from the throne in the Temple; it said ‘All is over.’)

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:18
verses.text: There followed ‘flashes of lightning, cries, and peals of thunder’; and there was a great earthquake, such as had not occurred since man began to be on the earth — none so great;

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:19
verses.text: and the great city was torn in three, and the cities of the nation fell, and God remembered Babylon the Great, and gave her the maddening wine-cup of his wrath;

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:20
verses.text: and every island vanished, and the mountains disappeared.

verses.name: Revelation of John 16:21
verses.text: Great hailstones, a pound in weight, are falling on men from the heavens. And men blasphemed God because of the curse of the hail, for it was a very terrible curse.  <div eID="gen9014" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.16"/> <div eID="gen9004" type="majorSection"/>
