verses.name: Revelation of John 17:1
verses.text: Then one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls came and spoke to me. ‘Come here,’ he said, ‘and I will show you the sentence passed on that Great Harlot who is seated at the meeting of many waters,

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:2
verses.text: and with whom all the kings of the earth have had licentious intercourse; while all who live on the earth have been make drunk by the wine of her licentiousness.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:3
verses.text: And he bore me away in a trance to a lonely place, and I saw a woman seated on a scarlet Beast, which was covered with blasphemous names; it had seven heads and ten horns.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:4
verses.text: The woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and glittering with gold ornaments, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup, full of idolatrous abominations, and the unclean fruits of her licentiousness;

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:5
verses.text: while on her forehead there was written this mystic name — ‘BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND OF ALL IDOLATROUS ABOMINATIONS on EARTH.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:6
verses.text: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of Christ’s people and with the blood of the martyrs for Jesus. When I saw her, I was amazed beyond measure;

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:7
verses.text: but the angel said to me — ‘Why were you amazed? I will tell you the mystic meaning of the vision of this woman, and of the Beast, with the seven heads and ten horns, that carries her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:8
verses.text: The Beast that you saw was, but is not, and is about to rise out of the bottomless pit, and is on its way to destruction. Those who are living on earth will be amazed — those whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world — when they see that the Beast was, but is not, and yet will come.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:9
verses.text: (Here there is need for the discerning mind.) The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman is seated.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:10
verses.text: They are also seven kings; of whom five have fallen and one remains, while one is not yet come. When he comes, he must stay for a little while.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:11
verses.text: So must the Beast that was, but is not. He counts as an eighth king , although he is one of the seven, and is on his way to destruction.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:12
verses.text: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received their kingdoms, but for an hour they receive the authority of kings, together with the Beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:13
verses.text: These kings are of one mind in surrendering their power and authority to the Beast.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:14
verses.text: They will fight with the Lamb, but the Lamb will conquer them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; so, too, will those with him who have received the call and are chosen and faithful.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:15
verses.text: And the angel said to me — ‘The waters that you saw, where the Harlot is seated, are throngs of people and men of all nations and languages.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:16
verses.text: The ten horns that you saw, and the Beast — they will hate the Harlot, and cause her to become deserted and strip her bare; they will eat her flesh and utterly consume her with fire.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:17
verses.text: For God has put it into their minds to carry out his purpose, in carrying out their common purpose and surrendering their kingdoms to the Beast, until God’s decrees will be executed.

verses.name: Revelation of John 17:18
verses.text: As for the woman whom you saw, she is the great city that holds sway over all the kings of the earth.’  <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1396"/><div sID="gen9016" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen9016" type="paragraph"/> <chapter eID="Rev.17"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:1
verses.text: After this I saw another angel, descending from heaven, invested with great authority; and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:2
verses.text: With a mighty voice he cried — ‘She has fallen! She has fallen — Babylon the Great! She has become an abode of demons, a stronghold of every wicked spirit, a stronghold of every foul and hateful bird.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:3
verses.text: For, after drinking the maddening wine of her licentiousness, all the nations have fallen; while all the kings of the earth have had licentious intercourse with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich through the excess of her luxury.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:4
verses.text: Then I heard another voice from heaven saying — ‘Come out of her, my people, so that you may not participate in her sins, and that you may not suffer from the curses inflicted on her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:5
verses.text: For her sins are heaped up to the heavens, and God has not forgotten her misdeeds.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:6
verses.text: Pay her back the treatment with which she has treated you; yes, repay twice over what her actions deserve; in the cup which she mixed for you, mix for her as much again;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:7
verses.text: for her self-glorification and her luxury, give her now an equal measure of torture and misery. In her heart she says ‘I sit here a queen; no widow am I; I will never know misery.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:8
verses.text: Therefore in one day will these curses strike her — death, misery, and famine, and she will be utterly consumed by fire; for mighty is the Lord God who condemned her.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:9
verses.text: All the kings of the earth who had licentious intercourse with her and shared her luxury will weep and lament over her, when they see the smoke from the burning city,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:10
verses.text: while they stand at a distance, horrified at her torture, and cry — ‘Alas! Alas! Great city! Mighty city of Babylon! In a single hour your judgment fell.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:11
verses.text: And the merchants of the earth weep and wail over her, because no longer does anyone buy their cargoes —

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:12
verses.text: their cargoes of gold, or silver, or precious stones, or pearls, or fine linen, or purple robes, or silk, or scarlet cloth; nor their many scented woods; nor their many articles of ivory; nor their many articles of choicest wood, or brass, or iron, or marble;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:13
verses.text: nor their cinnamon, or spice, or incense, or perfumes, or frankincense, or wine, or oil, or fine flour, or wheat, or cattle, or sheep; nor their horses, or chariots, or slaves; nor the bodies and souls of people.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:14
verses.text: The fruit that your soul craved is no longer within your reach, and all dainties and luxuries are lost to you, never to be found again.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:15
verses.text: The merchants who sold these things, and grew rich by her, will stand at a distance weeping and wailing, horrified at her torture, and crying —

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:16
verses.text: ‘Alas! Alas! Great city! City clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet cloth! City adorned with gold ornaments, and precious stones, and pearls!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:17
verses.text: In a single hour your vast wealth vanished.’ Every ship’s captain and all who sail to any port, and sailors, and all who get their living from the sea, stood at a distance,

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:18
verses.text: and seeing the smoke from the burning city, cried — ‘What city can compare with the Great city?’

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:19
verses.text: They threw dust on their heads, and, as they wept and wailed, they cried — ‘Alas! Alas! Great city! All who have ships on the sea grew rich through her magnificence. In a single hour it has vanished.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:20
verses.text: Rejoice over her, heaven, and people of Christ, and apostles, and prophets, for God has avenged you on her!

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:21
verses.text: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and threw it into the sea, crying — ‘So will Babylon, the great city, be violently overthrown, never more to be seen.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:22
verses.text: No more will the music of harpers, or minstrels, or flute players, or trumpeters be heard in you, no more will any worker, skilled in any art, be found in you; no more will the sound of a mill be heard in you;

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:23
verses.text: no more will the light of a lamp shine in you; no more will the voices of groom and bride be heard in you. Your merchants were the great men of the earth, for all the nations were deceived by your magical charms.

verses.name: Revelation of John 18:24
verses.text: Yes, and in her was to be found the blood of the prophets and of Christ’s people, and of all who have been put to death on the earth.’  <chapter eID="Rev.18"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1396"/><div sID="gen9017" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1396"/> After this, I heard what seemed to be a great shout from a vast throng in heaven, crying — <lg sID="gen9018"/> <l sID="gen9019"/>‘Hallelujah! To our God belong salvation, and glory, and Power,<l eID="gen9019"/> <lg eID="gen9018"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:2
verses.text: for true and righteous are his judgments. For he has passed judgment on the Great Harlot who was corrupting the earth by her licentiousness, and he has taken vengeance on her for the blood of his servants.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:3
verses.text: Again they cried — ‘Hallelujah!’ And the smoke from her ruins rises for ever and ever.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:4
verses.text: Then the twenty-four councillors and the Four Creatures prostrated themselves and worshiped God who was seated on the throne, crying — ‘Amen, Hallelujah!’;

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:5
verses.text: and from the throne there came a voice which said — <lg sID="gen9020"/> <l sID="gen9021"/>‘Praise our God all you who serve him, You who worship him, both high and low.’<l eID="gen9021"/> <lg eID="gen9020"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:6
verses.text: Then I heard ‘what seemed to be the shout of a vast throng, like the sound of many waters,’ and like the sound of loud peals of thunder, crying — <lg sID="gen9022"/> <l sID="gen9023"/>‘Hallelujah! For the Lord is king, our God, the Almighty.<l eID="gen9023"/> <lg eID="gen9022"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:7
verses.text: Let us rejoice and exalt; and we will pay him honor, for the hour for the Marriage of the Lamb has come, and his Bride has made herself ready.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:8
verses.text: And to her it has been granted to robe herself in fine linen, white and pure, for that linen is the good deeds of the people of Christ.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:9
verses.text: Then a voice said to me ‘Write — “Blessed are those who have been summoned to the marriage feast of the Lamb.”’ And the voice said — ‘These words of God are true.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:10
verses.text: I prostrated myself at the feet of him who spoke to worship him, but he said to me — ‘Forbear; I am your fellow servant, and the fellow servant of your brothers and sisters who bear their testimony to Jesus. Worship God. For to bear testimony to Jesus needs the inspiration of the prophets.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:11
verses.text: Then I saw that heaven lay open. There appears a white horse; its rider is called ‘Faithful’ and ‘True’; righteously does he judge and make war.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:12
verses.text: His eyes are flaming fires; on his head there are many diadems, and he bears a name, written, which no one knows but himself;

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:13
verses.text: he has been clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood; and the name by which he is called is ‘The Word of God.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:14
verses.text: The armies of heaven followed him, mounted on white horses and clothed in fine linen, white and pure.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:15
verses.text: From his mouth comes a sharp sword, with which ‘to smite the nations; and he will rule them with an iron rod.’ He ‘treads the grapes in the press’ of the maddening wine of the wrath of Almighty God;

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:16
verses.text: and on his robe and on his thigh he has this name written — ‘KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.’  <div eID="gen9017" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1397"/><div sID="gen9024" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1397"/> Then I saw an angel standing on the sun. He cried in a loud voice to all the birds that fly in mid-heaven — ‘Gather and come to the great feast of God,

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:18
verses.text: to eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of commanders, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all free and enslaved, and of high and low.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:19
verses.text: Then I saw the Beast and the kings of the earth and their armies, gathered together to fight with him who sat on the horse and with his army.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:20
verses.text: The Beast was captured, and with him was taken the false prophet, who performed the marvels before the eyes of the Beast, with which he deceived those who had received the brand of the Beast and those who worshiped his image. Alive, they were thrown, both of them, into the lake of fire - of burning sulphur.

verses.name: Revelation of John 19:21
verses.text: The rest were killed by the sword which came out of the mouth of him who rode on the horse; and all the birds fed on their flesh.  <chapter eID="Rev.19"/> <div eID="gen9024" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1398"/><div sID="gen9025" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1398"/> Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, with the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:2
verses.text: He seized the Dragon, the primeval snake (who is the ‘devil’ or ‘Satan’), and bound him in chains for a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:3
verses.text: He flung him into the bottomless pit and locked it, and set his seal on it; that he should not deceive the nations any more, until the thousand years were ended. After that he must be let loose for a while.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1399"/><div sID="gen9026" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1399"/> Then I saw thrones, and to those who took their seats on them authority was given to act as judges. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony to Jesus and because of the message of God, for they had refused to worship the Beast or its image, and had not received the brand on their foreheads and on their hands. They were restored to life, and they reigned with the Christ for a thousand years.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:5
verses.text: (The rest of the dead were not restored to life until the thousand years were ended.) This is the first resurrection.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:6
verses.text: Blessed and holy will he be who shares in that first resurrection. The second Death has no power over them; but they will be priests of God, and the Christ, and they will reign with him for the thousand years.  <div eID="gen9026" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1400"/><div sID="gen9027" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1400"/> When the thousand years are ended, Satan will be let loose from his prison,

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:8
verses.text: and he will come out to deceive the nations that live in ‘the four corners of the earth — Gog and Magog.’ He will come to gather them together for battle; and their number will be as great as the sand on the sea-shore.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:9
verses.text: They went up over the breadth of the whole earth, and surrounded the camp of Christ’s people and the city that he loves. Then fire fell from the heavens and consumed them;

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:10
verses.text: and the devil, their deceiver, was hurled into the lake of fire and sulphur, where the Beast and the false prophet already were, and they will be tortured day and night for ever and ever.  <div eID="gen9027" type="paragraph"/> <div eID="gen9025" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1401"/><div sID="gen9028" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1401"/> Then I saw a great white throne, and him who was seated on it. ‘The earth and the heavens fled from his presence; no place was left for them.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:12
verses.text: And I saw the dead, high and low, standing before the throne; and books were opened. Then another book was opened, the book of life; and the dead were judged, according to their actions, by what was written in the books.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:13
verses.text: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and the Lord of the place of Death gave up their dead; and they were judged, one by one, each according to his actions.

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:14
verses.text: Then Death and the Lord of the place of Death were hurled into the lake of fire. This is the Second Death — the lake of fire;

verses.name: Revelation of John 20:15
verses.text: and all whose names ‘were not found written in the book of life’ were hurled into the lake of fire.  <div eID="gen9028" type="section"/> <chapter eID="Rev.20"/> <div eID="gen9015" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:1
verses.text: Then I saw new heavens and a new earth. The former heavens and the former earth had passed away; and the sea has ceased to be.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:2
verses.text: And I saw the Holy City, Jerusalem, descending new out of heaven from God, like a bride adorned in readiness for her husband.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:3
verses.text: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, which said — ‘See! The tent of God is set up among people. God will live among them, and they will be his Peoples, and God himself will be among them,

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:4
verses.text: and he will wipe away all tears from their eyes. There will be no more death, nor will there be any more grief or crying or pain. The old order has passed away.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:5
verses.text: And he who was seated on the throne said — ‘See, I make all things new!’ And he said — ‘Write this, for these words may be trusted and are true.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:6
verses.text: And he said to me — ‘They are fulfilled. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the End. To those who thirst I will give of the spring of the water of life, freely.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:7
verses.text: Those who conquer will enter into possession of these things, and I will be their God, and they will be my children.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:8
verses.text: But as for cowards, unbelievers, the degraded, murderers, the impure, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars — their place will be in the burning lake of fire and sulphur. That is the Second Death.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1402"/><div sID="gen9030" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1402"/> Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, and were laden with the seven last curses, came and spoke to me. ‘Come here,’ he said, ‘and I will show you the Bride, the Wife of the Lamb.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:10
verses.text: He carried me away in a trance to a great high mountain, and showed me Jerusalem, the Holy City, descending out of heaven from God, filled with the glory of God.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:11
verses.text: Its brilliance was like a precious stone, like a jasper, transparent as crystal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:12
verses.text: It had a great high wall, in which were twelve gates; and at these gates there were twelve angels, and there were names inscribed on the gates, the names of the twelve tribes of the Israelites.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:13
verses.text: ‘There were three gates on the east, three gates on the north, three gates on the south, and three gates on the west.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:14
verses.text: The wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, on which were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:15
verses.text: And the angel who was speaking to me had as a measure a gold rod, with which to measure the city and its gates and its wall.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:16
verses.text: The city is square; the length and the breadth are the same. The angel measured with his rod; it was twelve hundred miles; its length, and breadth, and height are equal.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:17
verses.text: Then he measured the wall; it was two hundred and eighty-eight feet, as people measure, that is as the angel measured.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:18
verses.text: The material of the wall of the city was jasper, and the city was built of pure gold, which shone like clear glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:19
verses.text: The foundations of the wall of the city were ornamented with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation stone was a jasper; the second a sapphire; the third a chalcedony; the fourth an emerald;

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:20
verses.text: the fifth a sardonyx; the sixth a carnelian; the seventh a chrysolite; the eighth a beryl; the ninth a topaz; the tenth a chrysoprase; the eleventh a hyacinth; and the twelfth an amethyst.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:21
verses.text: The twelve gates were made of twelve pearls, each gate of one pearl. The street of the city was of pure gold, transparent as glass.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:22
verses.text: And I saw no Temple there, for the Lord, our God, the Almighty, and the Lamb are its Temple.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:23
verses.text: The city has no need of ‘the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God illuminated it,’ and its Lamp was the Lamb.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:24
verses.text: ‘The nations walk by the light of it; and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:25
verses.text: Its gates will never be shut by day,’ and there will be no night there.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:26
verses.text: And people will bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

verses.name: Revelation of John 21:27
verses.text: ‘Never will any unhallowed thing enter it,’ nor they whose life is shameful and false, but only ‘those whose names have been written in the Lamb’s book of life.’  <chapter eID="Rev.21"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:1
verses.text: And the angel showed me ‘a river of the water of life,’ as clear as crystal, issuing from the throne of God and of the Lamb,

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:2
verses.text: in the middle of the street of the city. On each side of the river was a Tree of life which bore twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit each month; and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:3
verses.text: ‘Every thing that is accursed will cease to be.’ The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within it, and his servants will worship him;

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:4
verses.text: they will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:5
verses.text: Night will cease to be. They have no need of the light of a lamp, nor have they the light of the sun; for the ‘Lord God will be their light, and they will reign for ever and ever.’  <div eID="gen9030" type="section"/> <div eID="gen9029" type="majorSection"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1403"/><div sID="gen9031" type="majorSection"/> <title>Conclusion</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1403"/> Then the angel said to me — ‘These words may be trusted and are true. The Lord, the God that inspires the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants what must quickly take place;

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:7
verses.text: and they said <q marker="" who="Jesus">“I will come quickly.”</q>Blessed will he be who lays to heart the words of the prophecy contained in this book.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1404"/><div sID="gen9032" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1404"/> It was I, John, who heard and saw these things; and, when I heard and saw them, I prostrated myself in worship at the feet of the angel that showed them to me.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:9
verses.text: But he said to me — ‘Forbear; I am your fellow servant, and the fellow servant of your fellow prophets, and of all who lay to heart the words in this book. Worship God.’  <div eID="gen9032" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1405"/><div sID="gen9033" type="paragraph"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1405"/> Then the angel said to me — ‘Do not keep secret the words of the prophecy contained in this book; for the time is near.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:11
verses.text: Let the wrong-doer continue to do wrong; the filthy-minded continue to be filthy; the righteous continue to act righteously; and the holy-minded continue to be holy.’

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:12
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">(‘I will come quickly. I bring my rewards with me, to give to each what their actions deserve.</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:13
verses.text: <q marker="" who="Jesus">I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the beginning and the End.’)</q>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:14
verses.text: Blessed will they be who wash their robes, that they may have the right to approach the Tree of life, and may enter the city by the gates.

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:15
verses.text: Outside will be the filthy, the sorcerers, the impure, the murderers, the idolaters, and all who love the false and live it.’  <div eID="gen9033" type="paragraph"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1406"/><div sID="gen9034" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1406"/> <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘I, Jesus, sent my angel to bear testimony to you about these things before the churches. I am the Scion and the Offspring of David, the bright star of the Morning.’</q>  <div eID="gen9034" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1407"/><div sID="gen9035" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1407"/> ‘Come,’ say the Spirit and the Bride; and let him who hears say ‘Come.’ Let him who thirsts come; let him who will take the water of life freely.  <div eID="gen9035" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1408"/><div sID="gen9036" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1408"/> I declare to all who hear the words of the prophecy contained in this book — ‘If anyone adds to it, God will add to his troubles the curses described in this book;

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:19
verses.text: and if anyone takes away any of the words in the book containing this prophecy, God will take away his share in the Tree of life, and in the Holy City — as described in this book.’  <div eID="gen9036" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1409"/><div sID="gen9037" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1409"/> He whose testimony this is says — <q marker="" who="Jesus">‘Assuredly I will come quickly.’</q>‘Amen, come, Lord Jesus.’  <div eID="gen9037" type="section"/>

verses.name: Revelation of John 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1410"/><div sID="gen9038" type="section"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1410"/> May the blessing of the Lord Jesus Christ, be with his people.  <div eID="gen9038" type="section"/> <div eID="gen9031" type="majorSection"/> <chapter eID="Rev.22"/> <div eID="gen8918" osisID="Rev" type="book"/>
